description: Pac and Bomber: Maze Blast combines strategic bomb laying with frantic maze navigation. Dodge enemies, set traps, and blast your way through intricate levels. Can you master the maze?

title: Shiling
description: The protagonist "Luo Ling" travels following vague memories in her mind, during which she discovers a child "Wuyi," who claims to be pursued by monsters and seeks help. They agree to stick together and find home.

title: The Last Match Girl
description: Finding the Place to Return, A survival horror of ashes and light. In a city where the dawn never comes, Scavenging for food, scavenging for life, And yet you are still alive. ………"Welcome home."

title: Intonight
description: In "Intonight" dive into an emotional journey under dazzling neon lights, where love collides with betrayal. Witnessing your girlfriend's infidelity at a nightclub shatters your world, pushing you to seek a fresh start amidst nightlife's temptations and challenges.

title: Gallery X
description: "Will you be the next one to get out of here alive?" GalleryX, a horror game that focuses on observation and memory.In the dim environment, there are more than 60 anomalies, 2 endings, different experiences,waiting for you to explore.Please watch out for enemies.

title: Arisen Force: HeroTest
description: Experience stylish-action battles and beautiful pixel art, summon heroes across time and space, and challenge the magic tower to save the heroic spirits and goddesses!

title: Bella Wants Blood
description: Entertain the god-like Bella’s thirst for blood in this absurd bite-sized roguelike terror defense game.

title: The 9th Station of M.t...
description: While being careful of any abnormalities, continue down the mountain path that continues like a cycle and try to escape safely.

title: Haunted Paws
description: Haunted Paws is a Cozy Coop Horror game where you will play as two Puppies trying to rescue their human friend in a haunted mansion. Create your puppy, explore spooky environments and defeat evil creatures in an action packed adventure!

title: The Tome of All Tales
description: The Tome of All Tales is a minimalist old-school shooter that offers a new story every day.

title: RewindGirl
description: Running, jumping, rewinding— A time-leap action puzzle where you cooperate with your past self!

title: S4U: Citypunk 2011 and Love Punch
description: This is a modern adventure of young adults seeking love and meaning. Return to 2011's Castor Yard, tap on your keyboard, and make those letters dance: Use your online persona to make meaningful decisions for your clients and yourself.

title: Ace Attorney: Turnabout Of A Legend
description: Apollo returns from his trials abroad to attend Chief Prosecutor Edgeworth's 5 Year anniversary project. Only to find his mentor, and dear friend Phoenix Wright murdered. With an old co-worker and friend accused, it is up to Apollo to prove her innocence, and find Phoenix's true killer! Investigate the crime, while uncovering more of the corruption ring at the Prosecutor's Office.

title: Piggy One Super Spark
description: PIGGY ONE SUPER SPARK is a single-player action game starring Xiamy, Yuez, and a lost newborn baby they happen to find. Follow the trio in their chaotic but heart-warming adventure!

title: Nightmare Operator
description: NIGHTMARE OPERATOR is an action horror shooter about hunting Youkai in the haunted ruins of Tokyo. Combat fuses the tense, shooting gameplay of classic survival horror, with the skill-based mechanics and execution of fighting games and spectacle fighters.

title: Gold of Skulls
description: "GOLD OF SKULLS" is a new Free-to-play, client-based collectible card game with NFT integration. It blends heroic turn-based auto-battler mechanics with rich RPG elements and deep tactical gameplay. Players will lead teams of fantastical heroes through intricate PvP and PvE battles in a world where the lines between life and death are deeply entwined.

title: Mia Fey: Ace Spirit Attorney
description: Follow Mia Fey, the original Turnabout Lawyer, as she uncovers the secrets of DL-6. Murder after murder, incident after incident, Mia Fey is one step closer to the the truth about DL-6. But at the same time, she's also getting herself into a cutthroat world of law, where all is not what it seems. In fact, the law system is broken. Prosecutors getting replaced every week, the prosecution department short on prosecutors... Utter chaos in the law. The ultimate question: will Mia Fey survive the world of law, and will she uncover the truth about DL-6? Or will she die trying?

title: Roku and Rei
description: Dive into the world of Roku and Rei, a puzzle game where the protagonists move in reverse directions! Use their ability to interact with color-coded objects and tackle mind-bending challenges.

title: Destiny of Heroes
description: Destiny of Heroes is a twin-stick, squad-based shooter set in occupied Indonesia at the end of World War II. Fighting Dutch and Japanese colonizers, you will lead the struggle for independence, in a heroic struggle against foreign tyrants. Liberty or death!

title: Stories of the Dreaming World
description:
Stories of the Dreaming World is a collection of short stories put together in RPG Maker VX Ace. Though some of them may seem unrelated, they are small pieces of a bigger puzzle.

The stories follow the perspectives of different characters involved with a certain world. An immortal alchemist. The fledgling god of a newborn world. A homunculus and the weight of knowing.

And perhaps more?

title: Strange Antiquities
description: Become the custodian of a store dealing in occult antiquities. Explore the quaint and gloomy town of Undermere, where strange goings-on and dark mysteries abound. Find and identify arcane artefacts, use your collection to aid the townsfolk with their unusual problems — and remember to pet your cat!

title: The Terraces
description: A classic Doom 2 city-style map originally made for the cancelled community project "Plain Ol' Doom 2". Originally designed as a Map 20 replacement. Level layout is a based on "Central Yharnam" level from From Software's Bloodborne, and the visual theme is a homage to Viggles' Brigandine.

title: The Civvie 11 Massacre
description: 20 new maps created by Civvie's discord in a contest with a hub map.

title: Mouldy Old Void
description: Mouldy Old Void is a single-level PK3 for Doom II using the GZDoom source port. It was designed by zrrion the insect and uses the music track. In 2015 it won the Doomjà-Vu contest.

title: Kenny vs. Spenny: Versusville
description:
Based on the TV series Kenny vs Spenny (starring Kenny Hotz and Spencer Rice), Versusville is free to play and features 4 different games that can be played in real time in either single or multiplayer online modes.

The four games are Residence Evil, Wasteball, Kart Dart & Grave Rave. High scores were featured on the website for the game when it was active.

title: The Dragon's Turnabout
description: This trial follows the first bad ending of Dual Destinies

title: Anothereal
description: Accompany Astra as she discovers the world outside her solitude and uncovers the mysteries of the Real. Engage in shmup-style combat encounters to leave an impact and fight back against the ones who would challenge her EXISTENCE.

title: 2Ship2Harkinian
description:
2Ship2Harkinian is a mod of the famous Nintendo 64 game,
This mod adds quality of life improvements to the game, like Widescreen resolution, HD textures and compatibility with modern controllers, while making it playable on Windows.

title: A House for Alesa 2
description: One year after the events of A House for Alesa (note: canon ending is ending F having kept your tongue intact), Alesa receives a call from a detective who confirms her worst fear: Mr. Bob and his family are back and they are coming for her. Will Alesa survive the night? How many more horrors must she endure? Is there another house of horrors waiting for her?

title: Rolling Lee
description: A game where you control a rolling ball named Lee!

title: My Time at Sandrock: Monster Whisperer
description: Embark on an exciting adventure in Sandrock! Utilize professional tools to discover and capture a diverse array of adorable monsters, forming special bonds with each one. Your pet adventure begins now!

title: Robert on Earth
description: Running a special underground farm in the distant and desolate future, exploring various crop abilities. Mining, fishing, meeting new robot friends, discovering new unknown areas, and exploring the truth that belongs to you

title: Co|incidence
description: "co|incidence" is a FVN produced for Renpy.

title: Water: Transformer
description: This is a platform jumping game, you can obtain different abilities by transforming between solid, liquid, and steam three forms, thus crossing obstacles and solving puzzles. The workshop allows you design and share their own created maps with the players all around the world.

title: Fire Showdown
description: "Fire Showdown" is a classic ARPG game with a retro style. The game can bring players exquisite graphics experience, hearty combat experience and rich and spectacular game experience.

title: Fishing Fishing
description: Fishing Fishing is a first person fishing simulation role-playing game where you will travel to multiple provinces in China, experience different scenery and cuisine, and use a variety of fishing gear to fight against big fish.

title: Echoes of The Backrooms
description: "Echoes of The Backrooms" is an indie horror game that masterfully captures the unsettling atmosphere of the Backrooms and the uncanny eeriness of liminal spaces. This game excels in creating an immersive experience with its cinema-quality visuals and meticulously crafted environments.

title: Earthborne
description: Explore, fight, craft and develop an automated technological civilization complete with airships and robotic drones!

title: Hamstörm
description: Hamstörm is a turn-based puzzle game where you play as a dwarf hamster who must go warn his people of the imminent invasion by the Chedd'Ore clan. Help Hamstörm make his way through the various mines, now infested with terrible rats!

title: Avaricity: New Shadows
description: A twist on the classic turn-based RPG style with the full intent on you growing with the environment!

title: University Days: Season 1
description: Step into the shoes of a Student at an all-but-ordinary University, where there seems to never be a dull day with hot women around every corner. Just so happens that you could just be the most wanted guy at this University... Who will you fall for?.. And who will fall for you?

title: Reflection Link
description: Locked inside a facility that erases memory, seven people must recover what they've forgotten to earn their freedom. Explore escape-room puzzles, piece together broken relationships, and uncover the truth behind the sins none of them remember committing in this branching path visual novel.

title: Micron Defense Force
description: A Roguelike Tower Defense in space with missions to conquer. Can you hold against the spreading alien bosses? Build and upgrade towers against the corruption. Choose your technologies and warpspeed your way to victory.

title: Undead Kingdom Survivors
description: Prepare to face the relentless onslaught of the undead! Clear the undead realm either solo or with up to 2 friends in online multiplayer. Choose powerful abilities to vanquish hordes of undead. Upgrade stats and unlock new heroes as you strive for survival in this intense roguelite bullet hell.

title: Show Me How To Live
description: "Show Me How to Live" is a minimalist aesthetic shoot 'em up game, in which we control a ship that must navigate and understand the perspective of a person capable of seeing the senselessness of life but unable to do anything about it.

title: Cappadocia Puzzle
description: Cappadocia Puzzle is a classic puzzle that offers you to put the picture together from a huge number of details! You will find as many as 15 puzzle levels with juicy graphics and an History-style plot that you will need to add up.

title: BomberHit
description: BomberHit is an action-packed multiplayer game where you defeat your opponents by detonating bombs. Think strategically, develop tactics, and conquer your adversaries in labyrinthine battles! Engage in combat with friends or online players and fight to become the ultimate bomber!

title: Fork Road
description: Fork Road is a first-person immersive atmospheric game with new gameplay , Be prepared to face fears you've never faced before

title: Mysterious Voyage: Set sail
description: Here, you can freely sail your ship, explore the endless ocean, and find hidden islands and treasures!

title: Vertig8
description: In Vertig8, explore a vertical world unlike any other. Ascend through a skyscraper, engaging in strategic gameplay and exhilarating action. Join internet celebrities in this unique multiplayer experience. Experience Vertigo and redefine your gaming adventure.

title: Fear Calibration
description: Who are you? What time is it? How long have you been in this place? In this horror-puzzle escape room, uncover the dark secrets hidden within the shadows as you solve your way through the empty classrooms of your school–or what seems to be of it. Do you really think you can escape this madness?

title: Unsought
description: Unsought is a 360° subjective exploration, panoramic horror adventure game. It takes place in a provincial town in 1990s Japan. You are an elementary school student lost in an empty town, but will you be able to return home?

title: Towerheart
description: Towerheart is a simple sokoban-style puzzle game where you can swap with objects.

title: Chained Runes
description: Plan your chain of runes as well as possible, analyze your opponents, and build up an optimized deck to reach King Gormnoq.

title: Smile Simulation
description: Psychological-surreal-analog-survival horror game. Find the smiles and get out.

title: Tyga
description: Welcome to Tyga! It's your job to help us deliver lifesaving medicine to those who can afford it. With enough hard work, someday that could be you! See you on the road Tygan!

title: Lunar Lander Redux
description: Explore a rough space landscape in a fragile capsule. Good for an hour of fun or frustration depending on skill. Physics mostly accurate.

title: Sea of Brave: Beast Island
description: Explore a unique island, find allies, and defeat the fearsome minions of Captain Kingg, in this new Sea of Brave adventure, a turn-based, single-player, deck-building, strategy roguelike. Don't let them capture you!

title: Everlasting: Tomorrow
description: Embark on a harrowing journey with Alice, a college student, and her classmate Adrian, as they venture to a desolate town in search of a special cave. Uncover the chilling mystery surrounding Alice's strange nightmares and their connection to the town. The horror awaits.

title: Don't Kill Them All
description: Don't Kill Them All is a turn-based strategy game with base-building, where you play the Orcs, the most feared creatures of the land. In the midst of an economic crisis, your Warlord is prepared to do whatever it takes to bring glory to the clan. Something has to change, and fast!

title: Croquettes Gang
description: Keep an eye on your master, steal his kibble and achieve your dream!

title: Dangerous Land
description: Dangerous Land is a first-person strategic game enriched with elements of exploration and action. Assume the role of the ruler of your settlement, manage and develop it in real-time, recruit and upgrade units, take care of resources, and participate in epic battles.

title: BackRooms's 1995: The Lost Footage - Chapter1
description: My name is Jacob, and I'm 25 years old. I've heard a lot of rumors about an abandoned house where people claim to see strange things. But I'm not here for that. I'm here to find my brother. He disappeared in January of 1970, I'll do whatever it takes to locate him, no matter what.

title: Musgro Farm
description: Plant crops, combine them intro recipes, and distribute them for sale in this incremental factory game. Optimize your layouts and reinvest in your infrastructure to maximize your output. Gain experience to unlock new technologies and expand your ever-growing farm.

title: Little Duck Adventure
description: Together with your friend, help two cute ducks through many trials. Work as a team to get the big picture. And remember, communication is the key to success.

title: My Girlfriend is... Centaur
description: Step into an extraordinary romance despite physiological disparities. Can you navigate a relationship with a centaur girl and overcome the challenges together?

title: Mr. Pompy's Extravagant Quiz
description: Think you're smart? Prove it by stepping into Mr. Pompy's Extravagant Quiz—an educational experience for clever kids and curious minds! Just don't disappoint Mr. Pompy.

title: Booster Racers
description: Are you ready to show your competitiveness? Here is Booster Racers, a chaotic racing game that you can play together with a friend in local multiplayer, or you can play alone too if you have no friends.

title: Benny's Backrooms
description: A co-op horror where you and your friends (if applicable) explore a seemingly infinite expanse of eerie creature-infested liminal spaces, armed only with a glorified vacuum and specialized equipment to help you locate and extract a rare substance in the name of science.

title: Speedy 500
description: Speedy 500 isn’t just a race; it’s a quest for immortality. Strap in, rev those engines, and chase the chequered flag. The countdown begins—500 miles await!

title: Digital Exorcist: CF1_Defrag
description: After the mysterious death of a Superstar Idol, disgraced DATA Agent Sawyer must face his ultimate challenge yet, being an undercover high school teacher while also keeping the Mississipi Inaka safe from Daemonic influence.

title: Find Kittens: The Last of Cats - Extra Level
description: New challenge for your observation in this cozy and addictive object search game.

title: Trash Can Tactics
description: Ever since the Nature's Legacy Institute has opened their doors to all, there have been an odd string of thefts - not of rare artifacts, but rather of the food from the cafeteria. Play as either a museum staff member, or an intelligent raccoon, in this asymmetrical PvP heist game.

title: 666: El día del portal
description: Action-platformer game with dual scrolling and multidirectional shooting.

title: Abandoned Hut
description: Explore scary places in this first-person horror game. Interact with characters, solve puzzles and discover that bad intentions can lead to catastrophic consequences.

title: Aeronesia
description: Aeronesia is a non-linear platform RPG with emphasis on exploration, combat, dialogue and quest-based progression. After an accident transports you and hundreds of other people into an alien world, it's up to you to find a way to survive and discover some means of getting back home.

title: A Great Hunger
description: A short Visual Novel where a demon offers a woman a terrifying proposal: to kill the man she once loved.

title: Age of Privateer
description: Age of Privateer is a real-time card battle-based roguelike deck-building game. Combine various cards to create a powerful deck and explore the vast seas. Can you uncover the secrets hidden in the ocean and find the ancient treasure?

title: You Are A Chat AI
description: "You are a chat AI" is a simulation game. No real AI is used, and the player pretends to be a chat AI and converses with NPCs. This game consists of two parts: "conversation" and "learning". The appeal of the game is that players who normally use AI can experience being used on the other hand.

title: AI Solitaire
description: AI Solitaire features Klondike Solitaire and Pyramid Solitaire, 18 different deck styles, and has password protected parental controls. The base game is offered for free and can be played as is without any cost forever.

title: AI Solitaire: Anime Cuties
description: AI Solitaire - Anime Cuties provides 12 new decks to use with AI Solitaire! This DLC is themed around beautiful girls in an anime style.

title: All the Darkest Places
description: Step into Alex, an upcoming college freshman battling depression. Living with his widowed father, Alex prepares to move in with Laura, a friend of his late mother. Guide Alex through university life, navigating personal struggles, forming connections, friendship and support.

title: Alpha Nomos
description: It’s time to wield the beat! Play as Cello and slice through an army of rogue puppets in a vibrant, melody-twisted world. Combat pulses to the soundtrack - time your moves to the beat to unleash show-stopping combos and perfectly choreographed chaos!

title: Almost Dungeon
description: Almost Dungeon reverses the roles by making you play a Dragon protecting his Dungeon. Arrange the corridors into a labyrinth of your liking and fool the adventurer who dared to enter your lair. Place traps in his way as fast as possible to get rid of him before he finds and slays you !

title: Alice's World
description: Alice's World is a story-driven 2D adventure puzzle game. Amidst desolate ruins and deserted cities in a world filled with death, the young girl Alice hears "your" voice from in front of the screen. You must guide her forward, solve the mysteries, and reach the top of the tower.

title: A Letter From Mom
description: On the morning of your 14th birthday, you receive a party invitation from your missing mom. The address leads you to a cult village. In this point-and-click puzzle adventure, you play as Nero, a black cat, as you unravel the mysteries behind your mom's disappearance.

title: Alchemic Beasts

description: 1: A 3-d character game. 2: Experience the passionate fun of killing monsters. 3: Getting a large number of crystals can improve your ability. 4: Role level up obtainning the corresponding skills.

title: Cryptic Route
description: "Cryptic Route" begins with the protagonist driving through a rainy night forest. Relying on navigation, each choice influences the outcome of the journey. The multiple ending system offers various results, immersing players into a tale of mystery and horror.

title: Crystal's Castle
description: 2-D Pixel art retro platformer

title: Cursed Sword Edo
description: "HD-2D JRPG" Adam is a soldier who works for Edoward Kingdom. With his best friend Prince Edo, they travel the world to save their King.

title: Cursed Places: Hotel Floor 13
description: Cursed Places: Hotel Floor 13 is an observation game where you are trapped on the Cursed Floor 13. Reach the first floor to escape from this cursed endless loop

title: Daily Bread
description: It's a board game with sword fighting elements that you play with yourself and three other CPUs in a dark atmosphere.

title: Dark Destruction
description: This is an open world role-playing game with a medieval magical background, requiring players to explore. You can defeat invading enemies or lead followers to defeat evil leaders. Monster camps, wilderness bosses, dungeon dungeons are full of adventure and passion.

title: Dark Daemon
description: In the dark world where demons rule, a group of warriors who fight against the dark forces stand up, bring a ray of justice to mankind, and start an unprecedented adventure.

title: Dangerous Connections
description: As a crisis brews in the Soviet Union, all of your skills as special agent Dan Morris are in demand. Explore the dark machinations of your opponents in a gripping story with exciting and unforgettable characters and use weapons and vehicles typical of the time, as well as a series of spy gadgets.

title: Cyclopean: The Great Abyss
description: Cyclopean: The Great Abyss is a small scale, mechanics driven CRPG/Roguelike in a retro, monochromatic style, that takes place in the underworld of H.P. Lovecraft's Dreamlands.

title: Darknesssssssssssssssss
description: This game is a medieval survival game. Defeat the enemies hiding in the castle. Actively use your shield and roll to avoid the enemy's attacks and exploit the opponent's loopholes to defeat the enemy.

title: Darkly Darkness
description: Darkly Darkness is a simple 2D action platformer where you jump and shoot, destroying carefully crafted enemies along the way using pistols, shotguns, and more. It is about a boy trying to discover what has happened to our planet recently. Is it aliens? Something else? He needs to find out.

title: Death Protocol
description: The voices in your head keep repeating numbers. You know only one way to make them stop...

title: Death Finder
description: horror experience, with puzzles to be solved and collecting files to win avoiding monsters and big giant spiders. Walk slow, pay attention to details and read all papers when see. Stay away from monsters and Spiders or risk becoming another victim of the abandon hospital

title: Deals With Witch
description: A crisis has descended upon the village where you live. Following an ancient legend, you embarked on the journey to find the witch. In order to save the village, you had to strike deals with the witch repeatedly. A huge conspiracy buried in history was also uncovered.

title: Deliver Us Home
description: Deliver Us Home is a solitary sci-fi experience where one astronaut works to secure a new home and future for humanity.

title: Delivery Express
description: "Delivery Simulator": Drive and upgrade your delivery vehicle to handle more packages and improve energy efficiency. Tackle increasing daily challenges to become the ultimate delivery master.

title: Demon Crush
description: Demon Crush is a fast-paced 2D side-scrolling combat-platformer that blends expressive, combo-based fighting mechanics with the charming visuals and intuitive controls of a bygone era. Play as multiple characters, master different weapons and combat styles, and plunge into adrenaline-soaked action in a fantasy Japanese setting. Wall jumps, air combos, grappling hook traversal, super moves, chaotic battles, death-defying leaps, and razor-sharp duels to the death against inhuman, villainous bosses all await you!

title: Demon Kingdom
description: Demon Kingdom is a strategy card game with elements of a interactive novel. Rule the kingdom, solve mysteries, build relationships, and defeat your enemies.

title: Desk Deck Heroes
description: Dip your pen in the company ink with this roguelite card-based adventure game! Find heroes, assemble a powerful party, and get ready to fill your weekdays with battles and quests!

title: Desert Kingdoms 2
description: Desert Kingdoms 2 is a minimal real-time strategy game. Manage resources, develop villages, protect your king and conquer the desert!

title: Descent the Abyss
description: Descent the Abyss - you take on the role of an experienced detective who goes in search of a lost traveler lost in a dangerous underground labyrinth. You must explore dark and twisted corridors, solve puzzles, fight monsters, and overcome traps to navigate through danger and find the missing person.

title: Derf Party
description: Players compete in a shooter, party game where the rules and goals of the game change for every minigame.

title: Dino Precision Platformer
description: Dino Precision Platformer is an intuitive platformer game in which you play as a cute little dinosaur. The main feature of the game is that the platforms on which the dinosaur must jump appear and disappear at certain points in time.

title: DinD
description: Will the Earth be better off when it loses humans？ 'DinD' is a 3rd person action-adventure,Walking in a world where mankind has disappeared, but not in peace。 Explore worlds that are no longer familiar, slay all sorts of monstrous creatures, and find out the answers to the world。

title: Shaolin Bao
description: Beat and batter your friends in this chaotic party arena game. Sauce up your attacks with spicy power ups as you team up or dish it out solo in fast-paced rounds across interactive Chinese-inspired arenas.

title: DJ Simulator
description: DJ SIMULATOR takes you from "Bedroom DJ" beginnings to festival headlining superstardom! Master REAL DJing techniques, upgrade and buy more gear, learn to read crowds and climb the ranks to fame and success!

title: Dj 8 Beats: Infinite
description: ... One Dj ... ... eight Levels ... ... some beats ...

title: Dirty Love
description: Dirty Love - is an erotic game in the genre of "Arkanoid", in which you will have to break the cubes and gradually discover really beautiful and hot images.

title: Domino Fit
description: Can you Domino Fit? The best parts of sudoku, mixed with those little tiling puzzles you'd play at the dentist, Domino Fit is a rewarding logic puzzle about getting all the dominos to fit! Supports 6x6, 7x7, and 8x8 boards.

title: Don't Drop Luggage!
description: Don't drop your cargo! Your job is a simple task to load the falling cargo well so that it does not fall off the back of the truck. Some of the packages may be a little unusual, such as bear figurines or lampposts, but don't worry about the details.

title: Do You Remember?
description: A realistic psychological experience where you undergo psychic tests while living a repetitive routine in a kind of psychiatric clinic.

title: Downpour Dash!
description: Downpour Dash is a fast-paced 3D platformer where you take on challenging curated levels and user-generated levels. Are you up to challenge?

title: Doom Roller
description: Doom Roller is a fast paced physics arcade game. Guide the ball through the level avoiding obstacles and the dreaded Orbs of Doom! Collect all the gems within time to proceed to the next level. There's an evil twist though... every time you collect a gem your time decreases by five seconds!

title: Doodle Harmony Idle Merge
description: Doodle Harmony Idle Merge is a cozy and relaxing idle game. Generate doodles or purchase them in the store. Customize your experience with a dark mode and a music selector. As you progress, you unlock new doodles, merge them to complete the doodle collection.

title: Don't Find Me!!
description: Dive into horror with Don't Find Me!!, where your mission is to survive by collecting 6 books while avoiding the lurking monsters. Keep your cool and your flashlight on to hope for escape. Are you ready to face your fears in this terrifying nightmare?

title: Nibeos
description:
Have you ever entered the L o s t t i m e beyond midnight? Have you ever felt the wind on an empty dark street? Have you ever climbed dark branches between the buildings of humankind? If you have perhaps you already know Nibeos, now hear the story of that place.

Experience a visual novel created entirely in paint and shadow, touch the horror of the depths of the sable time, drink in the dark jazz of the empty streets, soak in the atmosphere of the city, in summer, at night.

title: DrainSim
description: Dive into DrainSim and take control of the floods! Clean up the flooded streets of the city using a wide range of tools - from rakes to submersible pumps. Enjoy the satisfying feeling of restoring the water flow. Become the hero of the city, one drain at a time.

title: Dream Addict
description: Dream Addict is an action RPG set in a dream world. Battle animals and monsters with swords and skills to earn "Battle Memories." Use these at your base to unlock new abilities. Strengthen yourself as you explore the dreams. What lies at the end of your dream addiction?

title: Dream Hotel Master
description: Manage and operate your dream hotels, expand your business, enhance hotel services, and attract more guests to create a unique five-star hotel!

title: Dummy Guyz
description: Dummy Guyz is a multiplayer physics sandbox with no predefined rules. Get creative by building or breaking things your way. Warning: the game is bare-bones with no theme and minimal graphics, focusing solely on physics interactions.

title: DummyDoodle
description: Developed, drawed and song created by one. Try to eliminate Final Bosses and complete levels.

title: Dull Acres
description: You strayed from the path. Now you are doomed to wander the woods.

title: Duelite
description: The Wild West dueling card roguelite. Duelite is an attractive card game where you must survive countless duels against all types of rivals in the Wild West. Will you be able to build a deck on par with the most wanted? Find out yourself!

title: Dunderbeck
description: Grind magical creatures into sausages in the mystical world of Cincinnati, Ohio!

title: Dunes of Valor
description: You will fight in an open field in the desert, switching to AI control depending on the situation.

title: Echo: Defy Death
description: A Roguelite RPG about betrayal, revenge, and how much you’re willing to pay to get it. Use echolocation to fight your enemies, make pacts with demons to grow stronger, gather weapons, find the one who stole your eyes and make them pay!

title: EatFish
description: Eat small fish to accumulate points and continue to grow, pay attention to avoid red things!

title: Eden Warrior
description: Embark on a journey to claim back what was yours. Battle legendary warriors of the past in simple but challenging setup. Free them from the entity that has corrupted them. Find out who you are!

title: E-Commerce Simulator
description: Build your own e-commerce empire! Start in your room with a 3D printer, fulfill and ship orders, and expand into a full workshop. Manage stock, set prices, and scale your business. Play solo or co-op with friends to turn a small shop into a global giant.

title: Echo of Mobius
description: Echo of Mobius is an innovative AI-driven role-playing game that incorporates CRPG-style adventures, simulation, and character-training gameplay. Players can create unique characters and their growth paths, or write and share adventure stories.

title: Echo in Capistrano
description: Echo in Capistrano is an atmospheric horror game with a simple goal - rescue the survivors, escape, and most importantly survive. Use your unique echo ability to find a path through the dizzying cave system of Capistrano, but be careful, there are things that lie in wait and they are hungry...

title: Echoes Afterfall
description: Team up in a chilling co-op experience, delving into mysterious realms to unearth relics amidst lurking horrors. Survive together or succumb to the abyss.

title: EOEOnline
description: EOEOnline is a fantasy MMORPG in a vast world with quirky and humorous characters and a depth of unique lore and world building. The game takes place in a dynamic world we're in game events become canon and build onto the game's lore and world.

title: Emitime
description: A Grid-based deck builder RPG where music and beat are your strategies. Expand your deck as you capture the enemies you encounter along the way, and solve puzzles by switching between the two protagonists from the past and future as you explore the world.

title: EOL: End Of Line
description: A sci-fi turn-based strategy game, no gimmicky mechanics just pure 4x glory.

title: Equire
description: Dive into this immersive equestrian simulation and experience realistic horseback riding. Build your dream ranch and establish deep bonds with your horses. You are the boss! Manage staff and guests, or focus on challenging competitions. Breed, trade and raise foals as you choose your own destiny.

title: Escape Peng
description: Can you reach the top of the crevasse?

title: Escape from Ever After: Onboarding
description: A genre-bending RPG inspired by the classic Paper Mario games! Embark on a quest to battle Ever After Inc, a greedy megacorp from the real world, as they seize control of fairytales for their cheap labor! Escape from Ever After: Onboarding is a prologue ver. of the game Escape from Ever After.

title: Escape And Build
description: Escape from the enemies and build a fortress to face them, you can play alone or in online games of up to 4 players.

title: Fighting Frontier
description: The three-day doujin convention has opened, but many troublemakers have shown up. Fighting Frontier is a small comedy 3D third-person action game with 3 levels. Knock those troublemakers down before they break the roadblocks or get into the hall.

title: Find the Orange Narwhal
description: Overcome your crippling hangover and work out how to get the Narwhal back! Point-and-click your way around town, run errands, and uncover the mystery. But choose who you help carefully - your decisions may come back to bite you! Think outside the box and brace yourself for a fever-dream adventure!

title: Chess Club Valley
description: Chess Club Valley is a 2D Open-World Chess RPG. Experience this epic chess adventure for the first time across a world filled with unique character’s, monsters, secrets and super bosses, while playing chess to level up your XP. A total of 20+ hours of gameplay!

title: Modern Modern Chef
description:
One of the five titles in Game & Watch Gallery 2 was Chef, a game about a chef flipping food in the air with their frying pan to keep them from touching the ground. Alongside a remake of that handheld was also Modern Chef, a mini-game featuring Peach doing the same: keeping food in the air by flipping it in her frying pan. Though added challenges included aspects of cooking the food, feeding Yoshi, keeping food from burning, etc!

Modern Modern Chef is a remake of that remake! Faithfully recreated with completely hand-drawn artwork, playable with both the original gameplay style and a challenging new reaction-based game mode! Also included are several control and accessibility options plus secrets and unlockable extras!

title: Beyond The Clouds
description: Embark on an exhilarating journey in 'Beyond The Clouds,' where parkour skills are key to conquering towering heights. Master fluid movement to overcome obstacles and puzzles, pushing your limits physically and mentally. Will you rise to claim your place beyond the clouds?

title: Beyond The Walls
description: Immerse yourself in a 3D tower defense game set in a medieval realm. Build towers with unique effects and strategically manage your town to amass resources. Master the elements and devise cunning strategies to triumph in this captivating fusion of defense and city management.

title: I Am Part-time Worker!!
description: This is an action-comedy game where you work part-time at a convenience store register while taking down troublesome "nuisance customers."

title: Hypogea
description: Escape from a mysterious underground megastructure in this short atmospheric 3d-platformer.

title: HyperFatal
description: AIR STRAFE, ROCKET JUMP, and SURF your way through dimensions in this HYPER-intensive skill-based movement shooter of old. The onslaught of foes in your way are invading worlds, and the only way to stop them is to show you will be FATAL.

title: Hyper Drive Runner
description: You are a Hyper Drive Runner. You will guide your ship as far as you can while avoiding the many obstacles in the cosmos. The further you go, the higher the score you will achieve and the higher on the leader board you will place.

title: Hush Hush High
description: SHHH! Hold onto those secrets! Step into the mind of a gossip monger as she navigates through the corridors of her high school and help her resist the urge to share every tantalizing piece of gossip with quick time events.

title: Hyperslice
description: Fast paced action arena roguelike where you defeat waves of enemies using your dash. Slice through enemies or push them to survive. Upgrade and buy abilities throughout your run to turn your ship into a killing machine.

title: Hybrid Miniature Golf Beta
description: Experience the ultimate fusion of classic miniature golf and adrenaline-pumping action in Hybrid Mini Golf! Master parkour challenges, race against time, and craft custom courses with the intuitive map maker. Get ready to swing into a world of competitive fun!

title: Hup Hup The Cupcake
description: High jump, long jump, and wall jump your way through an endless array of procedurally generated levels set above the clouds! Customize the length and difficulty of your journey to your liking in Hup Hup The Cupcake, the relaxing 3D precision platformer!

title: Hunt the Pale Gods
description: A cosmic horror grid based roguelike deck builder. Fight nightmarish creatures, add cards to your deck, discover powerful curios and combine all their unique effects in game breaking synergies. Awaken and Hunt the Pale Gods.

title: Humans vs. Monsters
description: The objective of the game is to destroy the opposing team by capture.

title: Humanolve: A Human Evolution Card Saga
description: Embark on a primal card-based survival odyssey in Humanolve. Lead your tribe through perilous hunts, weather the wrath of nature, and forge tools of triumph. Combine cards to craft tools and weapons, explore the wilderness, and conquer your nemesis. Your choices will shape human evolution itself.

title: Hunter's Requiem
description: Hunter’s Requiem is a rogue-lite horror game. Coming from a long lineage of monster hunters, you must protect your town from the creatures surrounding it. Through crafting and exploration, you will discover the town's history and find a way to solve its monster problem once and for all.

title: Honcho
description: Take on the Keiretsu and reclaim your grandfather's rightful spot amongst Japan's financial elite. Use your bespoke kei truck to deliver packages, purchase real estate and expand your company to show them you're more than just another Sukeban.

title: Honor Battle
description: **Honor Battle**: Dive into the heart of conflict in this thrilling action game, where you stand as the last line of defense against a brutal terrorist insurgency.

title: Horatio: Connector 13
description: Akio's accidental encounter with "Horatio’s Life" leads to a mysterious journey intertwining his past with a parallel world. Unravel secrets, confront otherworldly threats, and uncover the truth in this atmospheric adventure.

title: Horatio: Connector 13 (Chapters 1-12)
description: Akio's accidental encounter with "Horatio's Life" leads to a mysterious journey intertwining his past with a parallel world. Unravel secrets, confront otherworldly threats, and uncover the truth in this atmospheric adventure.

title: Hot & Lewd: Miami
description: Get ready for an exciting world of vibrant colors, high speeds in Hot & Lewd: Miami. In this dynamic visual novel, you will meet the main character, a young guy who just graduated from the police academy but chose a life of wild parties and extreme street races over serving as an officer.

title: Horse Runner DX
description: Lead your herd. Survive the chaos. Grow and guide your ever-expanding horse herd in this fast-paced arcade roguelite runner. Stack unique power-ups, master the trail, and push your limits in addictive high-score runs to climb the global leaderboard.

title: Horror In Hongdae
description: Solve the mystery of the disappearance of a real estate tycoon. This adventure/visual novel game will unveil the secrets hidden behind the facades of a neighborhood in Seoul, with some being frightening and others holding pleasant surprises.

title: Hornet the Vanguard
description: "Reveal all, deceive all." Hornet the Vanguard, a mystery-solving adventure game. Solve mysteries and gather information in the exploration part, and uncover the truth in the deduction part! …The key to the case is always with buddy.

title: House of Golf 2
description: House of Golf 2 delivers an engaging multiplayer golf experience with over 100 unique holes to conquer. Gather up to 4 players for lively couch play sessions, showcasing your skills with jaw-dropping shots. Compete in live tournaments for exciting rewards and leave your mark on the world of golf!

title: HSHS
description: HSHS! Turn me on is a virtual interactive romance game designed for women. You will take on the role of Pricilla Tang, a new entrant live streaming operations assistant, you will encounter him amidst the hustle and bustle of daily life, leading to a destiny that is uniquely yours!

title: Impawlse
description: Take care of your kittens, decorate their space, play with them.... It's all about kittens! The ultimate cat experience awaits you!

title: Impostor Online
description: Impostor Online is a 4–16 player social deduction game of murder, lies, and paranoia. Every match you're dealt a secret role: investigate, heal, deceive—or kill. Someone at the table wants you dead. Find them first, or make sure they never find you.

title: Industring
description: A minimalistic urban planning puzzle. Manage resources and building locations. Accumulate knowledge points and discover the secrets of the destroyed planet

title: Infantry Attack: Drone Squad
description: Equip yourself with new drones and show your opponents who's the real boss!

title: Infantry Attack: Strike from Above
description: Equip yourself with a new secondary weapon and show your opponents who's the real boss!

title: Infinite Coaster
description: What speed would make the roller coaster go off the track? Experience a realistic yet crazy riding of Roller Coaster now! Can you reach the end safely in limited time? Accelerate the roller coaster boldly but cautiously, feeling your heartbeat and excitement now! Try now!

title: Infinite Survivor
description: Fight your way to survival with tons of abilities and Survivors to choose from. Create the ultimate combination of Survivor and Abilities in this rogue lite, bullet hell action adventure. Unlock new Survivors and use unique abilities to achieve the ultimate goal of survival.

title: Inkression
description: Enter the world of Milly Sommerville, a troubled tattoo artist tasked with capturing the remnants of her nearly-demolished neighborhood through her art. Walk the streets of her dark world, reconcile with her own past, and redefine the meanings of impressions in this first person narrative game.

title: In Search of Heroes!
description: Calling all Heroes! The age of knights is in its twilight, but the people still require your aid! Venture through various randomly-generated locales, complete quests and take down fearsome bosses. Return to your home estate to construct new buildings, equip powerful weapons, and rally new heroes!

title: Insectum: Epic Battles of Bugs
description: Immerse yourself in the epic battles of "Insectum" and unleash the power of your monstrous insects. Face off against your rivals on the battlefield by strategically using cards.

title: In Memoriam
description: In Memoriam brings you back to one of the darkest times of Argentinian history.

title: Instant Armory
description: Instant Armory is an application that allows you to design arms, armor, and equipment for fantasy tabletop roleplaying games.

title: In The Disorderly Courtyard
description: This is a platform puzzle game, The game mainly tells the story of playing the female lead and repairing the virtual world. The game takes 2-3 hours and features unique cartoon rendering technology, global dynamic lighting, and a blend of sunrise and sunset colors and light sources.

title: Java Journey
description: Embark on a caffeine-fueled escapade! Play as a brave coffee cup reclaiming stolen treasures from tea slimes. Navigate charming landscapes, overcome obstacles, and solve puzzles. Join the whimsical adventure and taste victory!

title: Jesus Christ Simulator
description: 'Jesus Christ Simulator' is a new take on the 'Superhero Simulator' game genre. You are tasked by God your Father with fixing the broken system that humans now live in. Armed with Unlimited Miracles, Flight & Superpowers, you will change the world and help its people. You are THE Ultimate Superhero!

title: Jianghu Chronicles
description: Jianghu Chronicles is a Wuxia-themed clan simulator, which focuses on simulating Jianghu clans and experiencing realistic battle. Set up a clan of your own, recruit disciples, complete missions... And eventually make your clan second to none by improving its power and reputation.

title: Jin Ping Mei
description: This game is adapted from the classic novel Jin Ping Mei. The protagonist was born in a merchant family. His parents died young and left him a pharmacy. On his 25th birthday, he made a vow: I will spend the rest of my life with wives and concubines, rich as hell...

title: Jordi & Oslo: The Lost Tail
description: Cute 2D Point-n-Click of the adorable comic book characters Jordi and Oslo the dragon.

title: Pixel Puzzles Ultimate Jigsaw: Mini Beasts
description: Pixel Puzzles, The Number #1 place for Jigsaws!

title: John Fox
description: John Fox is an elite warrior and super soldier who saved the leaders of various States. He was a professional mercenary who retired with honor. But now his beloved pet, Milo, has been killed. You have to avenge him!

title: Josh Powlison's Button: Mildly Remastered Edition
description: Press a button. Increment a number. Change reality. The instant classic returns for a mildly remastered electric boogaloo on modern computer systems. Once again experience the euphoria of button pressing with Josh Powlison's striking developer commentary to guide you.

title: JosPlays' Escape: GameJam April 2024
description: ESCAPE! Collect the 5 tools and escape from this creepy attic. Keep the score high by avoiding ghosts and collecting the ghost diamonds, but keep in mind with every diamond you collect, more ghosts will appear and they will become harder to avoid.

title: Journey of Reincarnation
description: 【Reincarnation Roguelike Retro RPG】Battle is fully automatic with no commands! Support the characters who think for themselves and do their best by collecting “Jewel”. Repeatedly reincarnate and aim to conquer dungeons that change their appearance each time you enter them!

title: Journey of Harvest
description: Welcome to Hope Town! You will be given an abandoned land where you can collect resources, assemble production lines, upgrade equipment, start adventures, harvest rewards, etc. I believe that in the near future, you will be able to unlock the secrets of the mine and enjoy this harvest journey.

title: Kado Hunter
description: As you are stranded in Vanada, you're meeting the sisters Aya and Chiyo. After you get to know what is happening, you decide to help them. In your journey as KADO HUNTER you will collect KADOS, fight against monsters, solve quests and get ready to explore Vanada.

title: Kadin the Soul Eater
description: A Story driven game, where choices can branch. Pretend to be a mortal with so called friends.

title: Just You
description: "Only One Must Remain Alive" thrusts you into a relentless battleground where survival hinges solely on your individual prowess.

title: Just Walk
description: One Character, One way and One Button you must never let go of.Just Walk.

title: Karting with Animals
description: "Karting with Animals: The Wild Race" flips the script on traditional racing games, infusing the thrill of speed with the unpredictability of the animal kingdom.

title: Karm: Early Access Archives
description: KARM brings back '90s FPS look and feel in a lovecraftian world.

title: Karjala
description: VHS bodycam horror in the atmosphere of Soviet Backrooms. Karelia is a country of rivers, forests and lakes, where the modern world comes in contact with superstitions and ancient rituals. Soldier Solnyshkov agrees to take part in a strange experiment of his command.

title: Kana
description: Start your Japanese learning journey by learning the fundamentals! In Kana, you get to practice Hiragana and Katakana, which are two of the writing systems in Japanese.

title: Kalasta
description: Kalasta is a roguelite deckbuilder fish game with real time strategy mechanics. Play cards to spawn fish, feed them and defend your fish from waves of monsters!

title: K-Bot
description: K-Bot is an innovative puzzle casual game that cleverly combines classic block stacking and path planning game elements. Players need to strategically move within a dynamically changing play area to achieve the goal of clearing lines.

title: Keaton's Adventure
description: Traverse the newly formed Milkdromeda Galaxy to restore balance and stomp out the Ultralite invasion!

title: Kittentegy
description: Are you ready to accept the challenge and stand up for the delicious cheese? In the Kittentegy game, you have to stop the mice from stealing the cheese from the houses. Your strategic skills and decisive actions will be the key to victory!

title: Kitty Collapse
description: Kitty Collapse offers an explosive first-person experience. Armed with diverse weapons, players demolish towering structures filled with mischievous cats. Each level brings unique challenges, with maps ranging from bustling cityscapes to tranquil countryside settings

title: Koitsugi: Legend of the Water Guardian
description: Play as Kaida, a koi who is reluctantly thrown in to save, not just her pond, but the entire river from a poison that turns the habitants into raged filled monsters. In this story driven action-adventure you will slug it out with some of these river dwellers, friend and foe, to save your home!

title: Korean Rail Driving Tour: LRT Busan-Gimhae
description: This game is a railroad simulation game that allows you to experience actual railroad operation based on 1080p, 60 frame video footage of the driving direction of an actual train. Get feeling of being a train driver just by operating the accelerator and brakes. Enjoy S.Korea’s beautiful scenery!

title: Kunkun League
description: Damn! Kunkun, unable to bear the humiliation from Xiao Hei, turned to Lao Da to learn basketball skills. Lao Da's challenge is to find exploding basketballs.

title: Kun’tewiktuk: A Mi’kmaw Adventure
description: Kun’tewiktuk: A Mi’kmaw Adventure is a fantasy adventure game inspired by Mi’kmaw legend and folklore. It chronicles the adventures of siblings Wasuek ("Flower") and her brother U'n ("Fog"). They get separated one summer morning and they go on an adventure through the spirit world to reunite.

title: Lade's Sandbox
description: A voxel-based sandbox game

title: LaughterLost
description: LaughterLost takes you through a surreal journey of work and family life. Face psychological twists, narrative choices, puzzles, and unexpected unique confrontations! Will you break this dystopian cycle of everyday life?

title: Leap 'n Bump!
description: A sexy platformer, now with an extra game expansion. Solve the underground tunnels mystery and help the Endless Forest in the extra content!

title: Le Dernier Don
description: Following a tragic event in an orphanage caused by horrific human experiments, an orphan tries to find other survivors while danger still lurks.

title: Legend of the Master Baiter
description: A fun and unique fishing RPG anybody can enjoy! Beings known as fishgirls show themselves before only a select few worthy fishermen. Fish inhabiting lakes, rivers, and the sea take on bold new forms! Try to collect them all!

title: Leo: The Square
description: Leo: The Square is a minimalist 2D platformer where players guide Leo, a square character, through various levels filled with puzzles and challenges. Explore unique environments, solve puzzles, and uncover the secrets of Leo's journey in this atmospheric adventure.

title: Let's Learn Xaad Kil
description: Let's Learn X̱aad Kíl (Alaskan dialect) is an interactive self-study program designed to help those curious about Haida and to help them be as familiarized as possible. It includes games, activities, and a picture glossary.

title: Life of Kanji Island
description: Life of Kanji Island is a game that helps you understand the ‘meaning’ of Japanese Kanji characters. Survive the island where all elements are composed of Kanji and master the Kanji!

title: Light Bearers 2
description: Light Bearers 2 is a fast paced hide and seek, asymmetrical multiplayer horror game. A Shadow is trying to corrupt all Light Bears. The Light Bears must use their movement and cunning. To keep each other from becoming corrupted by darkness.

title: Light Unseen
description: An underground adventure with magic and fantasy-like monsters with a story where actions affect the outcome

Unfortunately, his eagerness comes back to haunt him as he's thrown into a series of events that turn his world inside-out. The remake features entirely rebuilt visuals in Unreal Engine 5, over-the-shoulder gameplay, reworked combat, and new voice acting.

description: A 3D RPGMaker Horror game about exploring a weird bunker. The bunker will have different horrors waiting in it depending on how you broke into it! 7 different routes to 9 unique endings! An ending collecting game!

title: Beer Simulator
description: You are single? You have a very hard work and small salary? Then this game is just for you. In this game you can earn beer just by clicking on beer. Upgrade your beer, sell your beer, earn gold, purchase more beer without becoming an actual alcoholic.

title: Basket Brawl DX
description: Embark on a quest with Himari and her friends! Traverse 40+ rooms, unlock characters, and groove to chiptune tunes in this speedy platformer.

title: The Dungeons Of Algoduul
description: Delay your death for as long as possible after finding yourself trapped in a neatly kept Dungeon full of skeletons without legs! Use your Fireballs, Powers, Physics and even use your enemies against each other as you stumble through your very own well lit purgatory!

title: Beneath the Cardboard: Be Happy
description: You will have to survive the cold New Year's Eve, look for food in the trash in the world where no one cares about you. This is an adventure where you have to survive Christmas, a holiday that has never been so cold before...

title: Bot Loop
description: Embark on a roguelike turn-based adventure where simulations become your battleground. Possess a powerful robot, face the Glitch and navigate an ever-evolving loop of challenges.

title: Starduster
description: STARDUSTER is a musical and arcade game wrapped in an abstract aesthetic with neon lights designed for players who enjoy difficult challenges and seek to push their own limits.

title: Crisis in the Kremlin: The Cold War
description: PERESTROIKA - CONTINUATION OF OCTOBER Crisis... Crisis has caught up with the Motherland of the Revolution and lurks in its very heart - the Kremlin. Lead the country through the most difficult times. "Crisis in the Kremlin" opens up huge prospects for you.

title: CaveVox
description: CaveVox — the ONLY first-person voxel roguelike with permadeath. Live as your character: descend into a deadly dungeon, fight monsters, gain loot, and return to the surface for your next descent. Each expedition is unique — solo or with a party of adventurers, your choices shape your journey.

title: Scunner's Run
description: A fast, twin-stick shooter micro-roguelike with bullet hell elements, chunky weapons and satisfying destruction. Your AI friend AL-4N will help you along the way with new weapons, upgrades and vague moral support, as you attempt to beat the Scunner's Run.

title: Necromancer for a Week
description: Reanimate monsters, choose their ideal moveset and form the perfect 3-monster-team to dominate the competition in this turn-based strategy roguelike. Use action points each turn on brutal combos and strategic positioning to be crowned champion of the annual Necromancer Tournament!

title: First Law
description: Escape the ice caves of Europa and return home in this retro inspired 2D sci-fi platformer. Journey through ice caves using Newtonian physics.

title: RnGesus Slayer
description: RnGesus Slayer is an exhilarating roguelike deckbuilder where your cards come from a slot-machine! Customize your slot-decks, twist fate to your advantage, and together with your wife, challenge RnGesus in your epic quest to become the ultimate Demon King.

title: Reclaim Earth
description: Reclaim Earth is a base-building, colony management, survival game where you play as a semi benevolent robot crash-landed on a post apocalyptic Earth. You must build your base, enlist the help of humans, and defend against hordes of mutated bugs.

title: Supernatural
description: Detective Wyatt confronts a chilling mystery as he investigates a housemaid's disappearance. Unearth sinister secrets as you navigate through a haunted house, where every shadow hides a lurking terror.

title: I Hate My Waifu Streamer
description: Draw the attention of the streamer at any cost, before someone else does it. Write comments, chat, make donations to your waifu, but do not dare to hate her!

title: Survive In Ankara
description: Welcome to Survive in Ankara! Are you ready to defeat the creatures that attack you, either with your friends or alone? I'm sure you can overcome these creatures with 5 customized characters. Join this adventure and destroy all creatures on 5 different maps

title: I Commissioned Some Butterflies 3
description: I paid artists to hide butterflies and flowers in 15 artworks. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: The Bell of Time
description: The Bell of Time is an adventure, puzzle and combat game where you'll play a teenager brought to a mysterious mansion. Explore this mansion with its horror-like visual and audio ambience, fight against the supernatural and solve puzzles using never-before-seen mechanics!

title: Honeydew
description: Discover your destiny in Honeydew, an enchanting adult visual novel of self-discovery and romance, unraveling the secrets of a diverse and captivating world. With lush art, branching narrative, full narration, and a player-driven story, embark on an adventure where every choice defines your path.

title: The Crusade Is Nigh
description: The Crusade is Nigh Or TCIN is a game consisting of rpg, rts, and tower defense elements where you fight to control up to 5 lanes while trying to keep your base alive from enemy attacks using strategy & skill

title: Jumpers' Mountain
description: Join our little friends on this adventure, jumping between platforms to uncover the paths of 'Jumper's Mountain'. However, beware, as there are many secrets to reach the top, and a miscalculated jump can be quite costly.

title: Beer Runner
description: Run through wild and crazy pubs, jump across insane platforms, and drink so much beer as you can! The bartender refused to give you free beer.. time to teach him a lesson and become the one and only Beer Runner!

title: Funky Rock Hoppers
description: Jump, dodge and flap yourself out of danger as a funky rockhopper. See what distance your penguin can reach while dodging various objects as well as sharks, birds and UFOs!

title: The End of You
description: The End of You is a short, emotional narrative game about love lost, the ghosts of the past, and the painful crawl towards closure.

title: Click On Lanterns Together
description: Can you and your friends find all 100+ lanterns in this panoramic level? Difficulty: Easy

title: Reflect
description: This is a simple and complex puzzle game about light. You need to use Optical components to direct lights and lit up the rings.

title: Sensei! I Like You So Much!
description: Sensei! I Like You So Much! is a fangirl simulator. Step into the shoes of a passionate fan girl and embark on a journey through the vibrant world of fan culture in this immersive simulation management game.

title: Click On Candy Together
description: Can you and your friends find all 100+ candies in this panoramic level?

title: Click On Red Pandas Together
description: Can you and your friends find all 100+ red pandas in this panoramic level?

title: Sentry System
description: Sentry System is a tower defense roguelike where you collect, modify and upgrade your sentries while progressing through a network of challenging encounters.

title: Roll 'n' Watch
description: Roll 'n' Watch is a simulated marble racing game where we bring the marble customization, beautiful tracks, customization, and the randomness of the beloved trending races you watch below those videos on social media.

title: Grasp of Dread
description: Grasp Of Dread is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game where one player takes on the role of a monster from another world and tries to escape, while the other four players are monster hunters who seek to deal with the undead as soon as possible.

title: Quest of Peril
description: Dive into the dark world of a Dying Earth, in this Idle exploration rougelike with turn based combat

title: Literally Every FNF Mod Ever
description:
Uh Oh, the man Bob is angry and you made them angry and they are so angry man, what did you do to make them angry? Honestly don’t know I’m just a game description.
Some parts of the Bob mod close the game unexpectedly and trigger a link to open that might trigger any anti-virus software to detect it as malware, please be aware that this is a fnf mod and not a trojan virus. If Bob asks for your personal information, please give it to them as it might be important.

for legal reasons this is a joke

title: Whimsical Wizardry
description:
Whimsical Wizardry is multiplayer party game about casting spells at your friends. Turn eight maps and four game modes into a chaotic battlefield as you scramble for victory! Who will be the best worst wizard of them all?

Cast 20 unique spells at your friends and enemies, each with their own wacky effects! Customize your wizard before heading into battle.

Whimsical Wizardry is developed by Silver Standard Studios, an independent game studio based out of Ottawa, Ontario.

title: Horror Family: Flight
description: Horror Family - Flight is a time-loop horror game set on an airplane.

title: Night Project
description: Night Project is the first game to introduce you to the history of corporate Degrees Intertainment. As you progress through the game, you will be able to find notes that will fully describe to you the entire deep history of the largest corporation in this game universe. The main antagonist is not a successful experiment of the Degrees Laboratories companies, called the "Kili project". Your task is not only to search for keys and notes, but also to simultaneously deceive the AI, whose task is to scare you as much as possible.

title: Lake Minnewaska
description: Lake Minnewaska is a narrative driven first person fishing game. Fish, explore, and uncover the secrets of Lake Minnewaska as you guide Sosa's journey in becoming a better father.

title: Tower Defense: Last Castle
description: In the depths of an ancient forest, your castle the last human stronghold stands as the final bastion against a monstrous horde. Strategize your defense by employing soldiers, traps, towers, and even the monsters themselves.

title: Pixelitos: Spritle Royale
description: A creature-collecting teambuilding autobattler with over 130 unique elemental creatures to collect and battle with! Assemble a team of Pixelitos to face opponents in 6v6 auto battles. Face off in online asynchronous multiplayer, online versus with friends, or in the single-player campaign.

title: Vribyss Refuge The Escape
description: While fleeing from the Kexxrans, Isla falls deep into a cave. As she searches for a way out, she encounters mysterious beings trapped there that may be able to help her get out. Discover the mysteries of Vribyss in this short-action role-playing story-driven game!

title: Starstream
description: Starstream is a 3D action-adventure shooter. In it, the brave Arlen must reclaim Castle Starstream, seized by the corrupt Lord Nova. Arlen battles through the Keep, Great Halls, and Startower to confront Lord Nova and free the Castle.

title: Pelago
description: Pelago is a creature-catching adventure game! Explore the islands of Pelago and befriend the creatures that live there. Build your perfect team to overcome any challenge and unravel the mysteries of the islands.

title: Permanence Break
description: A sci-fi first-person puzzle game based around object permanence. Move and look around rooms in order to pick which objects you see and which you don't.

title: Grave Realms
description: Grave Realms is a fast and fun, arcade style twin-stick shooter with RPG elements. Powerups and elemental projectile attacks help carve your way through waves of unique enemies. Using the powerful Purge system, you decide your gameplay style! Can you survive the Grave Realms?

title: Malware
description: In order to induce users to install malware, unscrupulous software vendors try their best to hide malicious installation options in the installation programs of normal software. Can you avoid the numerous inducements set by software vendors and install pure software on your computer?

title: War of The Titans
description: Your people have been driven from their homeland by war. The elders speak of an ancient land where gods and men lived as one. After months at sea you land on a mysterious island that the elders believe is your ancient homeland. Rebuild your civilization, and uncover the secrets of your ancestors.

title: Ground to Dust
description: Navigate your way through a hostile underground facility in this two-dimensional side-scroller inspired by games like Hollow Knight and Metroid. Fight everything from a cleaning robot to a businessman trying to sell you goods while actively killing you. There are over 20 levels to explore in this non-linear platformer.

title: Poolrooms
description: Welcome to Level 37, commonly known as the Poolrooms, a psychological horror experience that immerses players in an eerie, otherworldly environment.

title: Runeflame
description: Runeflame is a point-and-click fantasy adventure with an open world and an emphasis on puzzle-solving. Guide your custom character through the immersive world of Runeflame, where secrets and magic have minds of their own.

title: Fluff's Adventure: A Tale of Fur and Steel
description: Fluff's Adventure: A Tale of Fur and Steel is a 3D third-person puzzle game with platforming elements. The game is focusing on non-textual storytelling, exploration and puzzles centered around fluffy furballs called "Fluffs". It creates a wholesome atmosphere in a stylized and colorful environment.

title: Sparky: Hills of Death
description: Hito Corporation immerses players in a dark universe where the monster, Sparky, comes to life in a sinister way, blurring the boundaries between reality and game. While cyber security expert Zac and his girlfriend Marina face strange events both in the game and in real life.

title: Gasping.2
description: GASPING.2 is a single player survival game, a dangerous and abandoned game world where only you and your companions exist. If you can tolerate loneliness, then explore it, which requires patience.

title: Elf Defense
description: Players can place characters, sell characters, set up automatic skill release, skill synthesis and more by clicking the mouse. The game provides an intuitive and easy to understand interface and operations, so that players can easily play the game.

title: Purge Party
description: See what's coming ahead and select your targets with the FEARBOARD battle system, a fresh take on turn-based combat. Explore a nightmarish world full of secrets, and make unlikely friends and enemies along the way.

title: Cyber Assasin
description: Cyber Assassin is a fast-paced arena shooter where you control a robot annihilating waves of enemies. Survive, upgrade your character after each wave, and become more powerful to dominate the arena!

title: Rap Pop Jump Core
description: Rap Pop Jump Core is a hardcore action platformer demanding constant movement, quick decisions, and combat. Navigate a vibrant city by leaping between platforms. One mistake, and you fall to your fate. Escape swiftly!

title: Dungeon Digger
description: Dungeon Digger is a roguelike game about a brave dwarf seeking legendary treasures. Descend deep underground, mine valuable minerals, craft upgraded gear, and battle spiders, golems, worms, and ghosts to become a cave hero!

title: Titleless Tale
description: An auto-battle RPG. Gather randomly generated rare equipment and companions to train your party and take on formidable foes.

title: Station Zeta
description: Run, jump, shoot, and think your way to safety in this retro-inspired 2D puzzle-platformer. Station Zeta is out of control, and you'll have to deal with crazed robots, terribly designed station machinery, and blatant safety hazards as you try to make your escape across 35 levels.

title: 5 Minute Raid
description: A boss raid where the boss is also a player!A team of 3 guardians. 6 classes 12 perksAn abomination from the 3rd dimension, ready to singlehandedly destroy the worldOnly 5 minutes until the destruction of the 2nd dimension!A casual quirky 1 vs 3 asymmetrical PvP experience: 5 Minute Raid!

title: AI Solitaire: Handsome Heroes
description: AI Solitaire - Handsome Heroes provides 12 new decks to use with AI Solitaire! This DLC is themed around handsome men in a variety of artistic styles ranging from phtorealistic to comic book styles.

title: AI Solitaire: Lovely Ladies
description: AI Solitaire - Lovely Ladies provides 12 new decks to use with AI Solitaire! This DLC is themed around beautiful girls in a photorealistic style.

title: Northern Song Dynasty
description: A real-time strategy game based on the history of the Northern Song Dynasty. The player can experience the fun of conquering cities, directing the country, and ultimately uniting the world through their own efforts in the simulated historical background of the game!

title: Zlin City: Arch Moderna
description: Build charming miniature diorama cities and train routes in a magical world inspired by the 1930s–40s. Create cozy towns, craft detailed rail networks, and relax to an original soundtrack. Inspired by real historical events and the architecture of Zlin.

title: Z-Ape: Tower Defense
description: Z-Ape is a unique tower defense and first person shooter mash up game. Hordes of enemies attacking your base, it's up to you to stop them by placing towers or fighting them on FPS mode with guns, or both!

title: Within: Hannah's Journey
description: In this turn-based JRPG, discover Hannah's strange journey into the confines of her nightmares and memories. Taking part in a mysterious place where all her regrets, mourning and mistakes reside.

title: Wizlite: Everybody loved RPGs
description: “Wizlite” is an RPG that merges the old-school command battle system with the popular roguelite genre. It offers gripping moments during battles and while unlocking treasure chests, as well as strategic decisions about whether to advance or rest based on remaining health and spell count.

title: Wizwag
description: Explore a charming, mysterious world in a classic, top-down action adventure! Investigate monster-infested dungeons, collect items to unlock new moves, and solve puzzles to uncover the truth, with help from some unusual friends.

title: Phoots and the Pineapple Throne
description: Take action as a demon from another world takes over your home island. Play as Ridge, a Phoot who lost his memories and must save the island from being destroyed. Travel across hand drawn environments, unlock weapons and spells, and defeat challenging bosses.

title: Wonder Wand
description: Embark on a spellbinding adventure in a strange land that’s brimming with puzzling dungeons, bouncing slimes & zany encounters in WONDER WAND, a 2D puzzle game about a confused fox with a magical wand.

title: Woohoo!
description: Woohoo! is a compilation of casual puzzle and arcade games.

title: Woohoo!: Game - Pool Frenzy
description: Pool Frenzy is a game where you shoot the white ball to hit the other balls into the pockets in the lowest amount of time. You also must not let the white ball fall into a pocket. There's 3 pool tables, 3 ball orientations and 2 ball group counts to choose from.

title: Woohoo!: Game - Skee Madness
description: Skee Madness is a game where you roll the ball with force down a table and then the ball flies through the air towards a group of holes. You earn points depending on which hole the ball goes through. There are 3 game modes.

title: Woohoo!: Game - Triangles
description: Triangles is a game where you lay triangular shaped tiles next to each other on a grid. The numbers in the three corners of a tile must match the numbers of the touching tiles in that affiliated corner.

title: Woohoo!: Game - WordSearch
description: WordSearch is the classic game of finding words in a grid of characters. Every level is random. Every level uses a random subject and picks random words for that subject. The placement of the words are random too. You won't play the same level twice. Use your mouse to select the words in the grid.

title: Word On The Hook
description: An exciting intellectual fishing game, where as a “fish” you need to catch words and earn coins!

title: World Heritage VR: Swedish Farmhouse
description: Virtual World Heritage: Fågelsjö is a VR rendition of the Fågelsjö farmsteads from the 1700s, located in the Hälsningland area of Sweden.

title: Narcis Crosswords
description: Narcis Crosswords is a crossword game that is bundled in with the Persian software Narcis Dictionary. The game is made to help English learners understand the language better using crossword puzzles.

title: Heaven Over It
description: The theme is to go up, and your mission is to get to heaven. It's a vertical scroll platformer, indie and single player action game. It is controlled using only the mouse and can be completed in a few minutes.

title: Ace Attorney: Ultimate Justice
description: Ultimate Justice is a fan-made crossover between the murder mysteries franchise of Ace Attorney and Danganronpa. It will follow the lawyers of the Wright Anything Agency as they defend students of Hope’s Peak in various murder cases.

title: Terezi Pyrope: Ace Attorney
description: Tavros is accused of Murder by an old FLARPing buddy in a Court-Only Tutorial case.

title: Odens öga
description:
Odens Öga is a third-person action game with twelve levels. Players must find and collect keys to unlock gates to the next level. The worlds are populated with monsters, including aggressive wolves and rabbits. Players use ranged missile attacks and limited flight abilities to combat these creatures.

There are seven characters to choose from, differing only in appearance. Points are earned by defeating enemies and collecting amulets. Other collectibles, like stones and chests, boost health or reduce monster damage. Stepping on anthills affects player abilities, either positively or negatively. Players have three lives per level and must restart the level if all lives are lost.

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Crusade of Chasing Shadows
description:
Version 7.5 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes:
• New Part 2 Story Chapter 3: A Crime Foretold
• New S Rank Valkyrie: Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser (Lantern)
• New Featured Event: Lantern Against Shadows
• New Event: Non-Stop Stage Clears Carnival
• ...and more!

title: Swingmania
description: Swingmania is a Virtual Reality rhythm game where you slice the notes!

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III - Season 4
description:
A disturbing discovery can change everything. A mysterious DNA bomb has been found at Popov Power in Urzikstan, and it’s up to you and your squadmates to unlock the mystery behind this potentially devastating weapon and prevent catastrophe.
