While you obtain various DNA samples during the ominous Critical Countdown Event, you can also further explore the multitude of bunkers across Urzikstan, potentially unearthing new ways to exit.

The potential outbreak seeps into Multiplayer, with a worldwide assortment of core 6v6 maps, plenty of exhilarating modes, revered weapons, new perks, destructive killstreaks, and battle-ready recon and hazmat inspired gear throughout the Battle Pass, so you can stay protected while remaining deadly calm and effective. One slip-up could alter everything, so suit up, drop in, uncover the truth, and stop the threat!

title: The Bathhouse Restored Edition
description: The Bathhouse | 地獄銭湯 Remake is a Japanese horror game that revolves around working at a bathhouse. A complete revamp of the original bathhouse.

title: Touhou Danmaku Maze
description: Developed by Ice Fall Creative, Touhou meets Maze Play in this Hand-Drawn Comedy Arcade game featuring the strongest fairy in Gensoukyou!

title: Le Sceptre d'Anubis
description: Le Sceptre d'Anubis is a French text-based adventure game with graphics set in the Pyramid of Djoser. The player takes a role of an experienced archeologist on vacation in Egypt, who occasionally discovered an ancient papyrus in one of the souks or Cairo. Deciphering its hardly readable hieroglyphs, he realized that the secret entrance within this pyramid leads to the tomb of Amenhotep II, holding the gift of the gods: The Scepter of Anubis. Trying to find it, the archeologist was going on an expedition equipped with a high-tech hieroglyph decryptor, a flashlight, and a gun, but forgetting to take a water. So, typing in the commands in form of "verb + noun", the player should help the archeologist to find the Scepter of Anubis avoiding the numerous traps and hostile pyramid's inhabitants.

title: Turnabout Train Or Shine
description: The familiar case is presented in a new, more rational and grounded, but also more wholesome and satisfying way. Using the simplistic but enjoyable Ace Attorney mechanics, approaching the same case from different angles, this will be an enjoyable experience for those that know the case very well and cannot get over it.

title: Le Pacte
description: e Pacte is an horror style adventure game published by the French Company Loriciels in 1986. The story revolves around the player being part of a team sent to investigate the house of Amityville, with two other parapsychologists called Evrett Wilson and Laura Relfod (plus their dog, Black). The game does not use a textual interface, like most of the adventure games of its time; instead the player has to associate two words within a very long list.

title: New Hope
description:
New Hope is an LGBTQI+ inclusive story starring Justin, an 18-year-old high school senior with two very big secrets. He's gay and trying to hold onto his secrets until finally finishing senior year and moving off to college. But when he loses his songbook, things take an unexpected turn as Justin begins to message a mystery guy who shares the same secret.

Being gay isn't the only thing Justin's trying to hide, however.

title: Wingless Fairies
description:
Wingless Fairies is a first-person stage play about becoming someone new again.

YOU ARE: Fawn-Mar Evangeline, a Great Fairy in training. It's your first day shadowing at your friend Velvet's gay bar / dressing room hybrid. Your role is simple on paper, but being a mentor to all who walk through the door will take more vulnerability than you know. Enter Rain.

title: Star Defender 4
description: Star Defender 4 is a simulation-arcade game developed by VADZIM KAMKOU and Awem Studio. It was originally released in 2008. It was published by Awem Studio.

title: Look_in_Dark
description: This game was created within the Touhou Game Jam held on Touhou Station in August 2021 and is a derivative work of Touhou Project.

title: Flip-Flip
description:
Flip-Flip was created at Touhou Game Jam.
This game is a Touhou Project fan game.

title: Flip-Flip plus
description:
Flip-Flip plus was created at Touhou Game Jam.
This game is a Touhou Project fangame.

If Flip-Flip was not enough for you or you have the skill, give it a try!

title: Day of the Hamster
description:
Day of the Hamster is a point & click graphic adventure game in the style of Day of the Tentacle. It's a short and sweet experience about escaping from a locked vault.
It's a sidequel to Day of the Sandwich.

title: Otaku Simulator
description:
Otaku Simulator is a simulation game who the goal is to protect player's reputation
You can kill all of yours enemies who want to destroy your reputation.

title: Shoka
description: The most grueling and unfair Isekai turn based RPG made with a budget of literally $0 (got RPG Maker VXA from a steam key giveaway), most will fail over and over and over until they eventually gives up and quit. Will you accept the challenge or chicken out? The choice is yours to be made. I pride myself on my ability to create a game with consistent power scaling and no plot holes.

title: Cosmo Mambo No. 5
description: Space Mambo Shooter.

title: Metal Dragon
description: METAL DRAGON is a 5 map episode for doom2.wad using primarily metallic and industrial textures sourced from otex with some relatively difficult, but not extremely intense gameplay.

title: Puzzles and Pieces
description: Puzzles and Pieces is very small set of monsterless vanilla puzzle maps made by Christophine Place, and makes use of Patchtex (by Gothic) and plenty of mapping tricks and exploits. Each map is set in a small comfy environment to walk around and solve little brain teasers in.

title: Spectrum Descent
description: Spectrum Descent is an MBF21-compatible project with a colorful, gothic aesthetic by The Afternoon Crew, led by Ludi.The wad features a fully bespoke soundtrack, lots of custom textures, and a wide variety of gameplay styles.

title: Eureka fountains
description:
A map made by RataUnderground to test the Eureka editor.
Lost in another place, in another time... The fountains of Eureka were a citadel that could only be accessed through portals.

title: Sonic Robo Blast 2: The Chaotix
description:
The Chaotix Are Here!

Six unique characters, six unique playstyles! Play as Espio, Mighty, Charmy, Vector, Heavy, and Bomb in SRB2!

title: The Front Yard
description:
"Meat embraces you whole."

Chicago, 1883.

At the epicenter of bloody beef and pig innards live Fergal Byrne and Eoin Kairys, two New Yorkers who've moved to The Yards for work. Their days are drawn out, miserable, and smelly as they survive work just to sleep another night.

The Front Yard is a short, visual-novel-style RPG Maker game following the monotonous and mundane lives of two best friends who've been consumed by the guilt of living and meat they work with.

title: Perfect Love
description: A horror-romance visual novel where you shape Milo Change, a student in one of the classes that you attend, into your desired, Perfect Love.

title: Yass or Pass
description: "You're a totally voluntary and in no way kidnapped contestant on the hottest speed dating game show in this reality!"

title: One-sided Loneliness
description: 'One-sided loneliness' is a short clicker game, where you take care of a cute alien goat boy. Made for Summer Slow Jams 2023: Idle, using creative theme 'Mutation'.

title: Late Night Hunger
description: Enter a quiet town where Alex, a 9-year-old boy, lives a normal life. But when the clock strikes midnight, his house turns into a place of mystery and fear. Dark hallways, hidden rooms, and strange shadows transform his familiar home into a creepy adventure.

title: Mobile Quest GB
description:
In an alternate universe where the Mobile Adapter GB made it outside japan, one company released a "massively multiplayer" online game that could be played without raking up phone bills, allowing it to garnering a strong player base...

Until today when it was announced the servers would be going down. Out of the blue you get an email from a friend you partied with numerous times before, telling you to log in today for one final quest before the game dies.

title: Maskerade: The Deadpan Cry
description: Maskerade is a first person narrative oriented Survival Horror game, where you incarnate a young girl who has been kidnapped and forced to work as a ballerina in a terrific and mysterious cabaret, from which she must find a way to escape from the clutches of the Madame who runs it.

title: Backrooms: Between Lost Dimension
description: Backrooms: Between Lost Dimensions is a horror game that immerses you in the surreal world of the Backrooms. Trapped in an endless maze of monotonous rooms, you must solve disturbing puzzles and face sinister creatures to find an escape. Is your escape just an illusion?

title: It's Our Revolution
description:
It's Our Revolution! is a freeware "puzzle RPG" by Wood Penguin made in RPG Maker VX Ace.

The goal of the game is for the unheard youth to gather a following to sway the king. Unfortunately, as your ensemble grows, you'll find it becomes a little difficult to get around...

title: Edward's Sewer Adventure
description:
"I'm going to tell you the story, the story of how I got lost in the sewers..."

In Edward's Sewer Adventure

You explore the depths of the sewers found on Pine Island. Located beneath the city, hidden from plain sight, many things can take place in the dark. Strange noises have been recorded. Are you brave enough to venture into the dark and damp smelly sewers? Or are you chicken...
You will meet friends unlooked for and evil forces on your journey.
You will experience revolutionary 3D-Graphics. A true stable of cutting edge PSX technology.

title: Touhou: Wandering Souls
description: Wandering Souls is a 2013 action role playing game developed by Estheone using RPG Maker VX. The player takes the role of three characters; Reimu, Marisa and Sakuya as they try to collect all wandering souls and travel to Edge of Heaven to find out who is responsible for the incident of Kekkai (barriers). The player starts with Reimu while Marisa and Sakuya will join later. Only one can fight while others act as supporting characters. Each character has a different special move, weapon and accessories; but have the same basic moves such as double jump, air dash and hyper mode. There are four barriers and each require different conditions to be unlocked. Sometimes enemies drop money and the player can use it to purchase items, weapons or accessories at Rinnosuke's shop. Wandering Souls also features hidden paths, an extra final boss and new game modes with higher difficulties which can be unlocked upon game completion.

title: Low Frequency
description:
After a catastrophe you are left adrift on your old ship hoping to find life.

Although not human...

title: Road To Siren Hills: Dark Journey
description:
Your car has died in the middle of nowhere.
The only thing you see is darkness and a flashlight lying on the grass.
Your only option is to go on foot, but where will the journey lead you to?

title: Altcode
description: Hordes of robotic ships from another world threaten the earth. As the newly self-aware hive mind of every CRT monitor display humans threw away to replace with fancy flat screen plasma tvs, you have to prove your worth and defend those who originally created you. Maybe they will want you back?!!

title: Legacy of Kalevala
description: Legacy of Kalevala is a re-engineered, re-envisioned and re-maked version of the original Legend of Kalevala flash game!

title: Purrfect Apawcalypse: Infamous Furiend?!
description: This is the PA series third Fan-game!

title: Purrfect Apawcalypse: Ideal Finale!!!
description: This is the PA series fourth Fan-game!

title: Tiny Hawk: Pico Sk8r
description: An isometric bird-based demake of the Tony Hawk's Pro Skater series.

title: Danger Street
description:
Danger Street is an arcade game set in New York 2017, a superb city filled with most infamous criminals in the entire galaxy. The highest council of New York has decided to finish it once and for all and massively eliminate these scums. The player is the vigilante of the future, who must rid the city of all these decadent beings. New York is counting on you!

So, the player should shoot the enemies appearing on the screen and shooting at you with an aiming crosshair while scrolling the street from left to right. Once all the enemies are eliminated on the level, the player is transferred to the next level gaining the scores and the bonus. There is no health bar, and it is only one life for the player.

title: Profanation
description: Profanation is an action game, where the player controls a fearless adventurer on his way to the mystical doors leading to hell. Entering a devilish castle with his only friend, a superb rifle, the adventurer should find a door on the level, collecting the treasures and eliminating their guardians such as bats, blobs of slime, zombies, insects and giant flies. The found door transfers the adventurer to the next level. When the adventurer is collided with an enemy, he is transferred to the most recent stored position on the level without one of his lives. Losing all the lives leads to the end of the game.

title: Grit & Valor: 1949
description: Command an elite squad of Mechs in this alternate World War 2 dieselpunk real-time tactics roguelite. Think fast, battle the Evil Axis forces, and neutralise their HQ. Upgrade your Mechs and Pilots, and develop new strategies to defeat the enemy!

title: Erina to Kima no Miyako
description: Erina, an engineer and a self-proclaimed adventurer, finds herself in Era Sheila after wandering from place to place fulfilling requests in pursuance of the romantic adventuring dream. The city is named after a famous adventurer, who happens to be one of Erina's aspirations as an adventurer herself. Little did she know, the city had another moniker, widely known as the City of Machines. Just what does this city, one full of sex-starved men, have in store for Erina?

title: Sly Cooper and the Thievius Raccoonus
description: A port of Sly Cooper and the Thievius Raccoonus, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save and custom video filters.

title: Below, Rusted Gods
description: You are the lifeline supporting an expedition into the unknown. Keep both yourself and your squad alive by interpreting instrument readings, explore the facilities, and uncover something ancient and eager to be born.

title: Catastrophe Crow
description: Catastrophe Crow is a game that emulates Nintendo 64 graphics and gameplay. The game started off as an ARG, and has now become a full length game.

title: Super Crate Box Together
description: A Super Crate Box mod that introduces local and online multiplayer modes with support for up to 4 players.

title: Phantom of the Twilight
description: Enjoy a sweet romance with vampires in this otome novel adventure.

title: Honko's World
description: Honko is lost in the forest of some mysterious alien world. Help Honko find his home planet.

title: Fohh
description: Explore a mysterious world with a mysterious magical companion!

title: The Crawler
description: In the middle of a forest, a group of kids stop by a supermarket to grab some snacks. As they wander through the aisles, strange things start to happen. They soon realize they are not alone. The main character must uncover the secrets of the supermarket and find a way out before it’s too late.

title: The Cornfield Road
description: This is a short horror experience where you find yourself stuck in a mysterious road, tring to get back home. But are you really safe walking all by yourself?

title: Tiny Adventure
description:
Welcome to Tiny Adventure!
A tiny tiny adventure in a big, big world.

title: Laundry Night
description: You take a late night trip to the laundromat to do your laundry. It's incredibly peaceful when no one else is around, and you don't have to wait for a washer to be available. But, out of nowhere, spooky things start to happen. Will you survive the night?

title: Tap It Away
description: Tap the blocks to make them fly away and clear the screen. The blocks will only fly in one direction. As player progress, the blocks form bigger and bigger shapes, and the blocks themselves change form. There are more than 600 tapping levels with a variety of game mechanics.

title: Babies vs. Monsters
description: Babies Vs Monsters is a bullet hell rogue-like game with RPG elements. Designed with cartoonish animations, this game offers various characters, level designs, and challenging boss battles that are both fun and difficult!

title: Rags to Liches
description: A small, third-person, action, tower defense game where you play as a peasant who gets tired of adventurers breaking into his house. Place down towers and fight off waves and waves of "enemies." Progress through the story and see just how far one man will go to protect his beloved llama.

title: Hive and Seek
description: Hive and Seek is a side-scrolling strategy base-building game where you clear randomly generated Roguelike stations infested with monsters. By rallying robots and clearing rooms, you will be able to destroy hives and recapture the station piece by piece.

title: Two Days to the Race
description: Two Days to the Race is a text adventure game that you can play on your vintage computers. A text adventure is a game where all the interaction takes places with textand you instruct your alter ego by typing command at a prompt. The rest is done by your fantasy!

title: The Queen's Footsteps
description:
Today is August 27th, 1904. Nine months ago, you, Emilia Vittorini, joined the Italian Archeological Expedition in Egypt led by Ernesto Schiaparelli, the director of the Egyptian Museum of Turin. You are now back in Genoa, Italy: your steam ferry arrived three days ago with 25 wooden boxes containing Queen Nefertari Meritmut's grave goods, a real treasure! They left Genoa by train, heading towards Turin, yesterday evening. While they were in transit, you were invited to a sumptuous reception organised by a wealthy art lover, Eugenio Collovati, count of Raligotto, but it would be hard to say that you appreciated the evening.

But the reception was yesterday: now, you must catch the train to Turin and check that the treasure arrived safely. I will be your eyes and ears. Good luck.

title: Sonic Robo Blast 2: Heroes
description:
A Sonic Heroes inspired level pack for Sonic Robo Blast 2 by STHE1230.

Team mechanics implemented like in the real Heroes game. There is a total of 34 emblems to find. Each level is a combination of act 1 and 2 from the original game. The Chaos Emeralds are hidden in the levels, think you can find them all?

title: SUGOI
description: SUGOI (Shut Up and Get On It) is a collaborative level pack created as a community project led by TehRealSalt. It was inspired by DUMP, a similar project from the ZDoom community. The premise of SUGOI was to encourage community members to make a level in a limited timeframe, similar to the Official Level Design Contest but without the competitive aspects. Any community member could contribute, regardless of their mapping experience, and all submissions made in good faith were accepted, regardless of their quality. The mapping phase lasted from July 9th until August 9th, 2016. Afterwards, TehRealSalt compiled the results into a level pack, which was released on September 6th, 2016. The project was much more successful than originally anticipated, receiving 30 maps from 25 different contributors. Its success inspired two sequels, SUBARASHII and KIMOKAWAIII.

title: Kimokawaiii
description: KIMOKAWAIII (also known as SUGOI 3, full title: KIMOKAWAIII Is My Origin, KIMOKAWAIII Always Waits And Is Intensely Interested) is the third and last entry in the SUGOI series, a series of collaborative level packs created by community members under the supervision of TehRealSalt. It contains 56 levels and features work by more than 60 different contributors, created over the months of April and May 2018 in two phases, with the first consisting of collaborative work on levels like the previous iterations (labeled KAWAIII) and a latter phase focused on the creation of custom boss fights (labeled KIMOIII), which later were merged into a single project. The level pack was initially released on August 17th, 2019, and is specially notable for bringing about the last patch of its current version of SRB2, v2.1.25, that catered to PolyObject bugs and a further expansion in the number of freeslots.

title: ​Outer Wilds: A Thrilling Graphical Text Adventure
description: The original text adventure prototype for Outer Wilds, released to the public in celebration of the original game's fifth anniversary.

title: Bloodrun
description: Completely redesigned Quake III Arena, it is already having 6 champions, following the same principle as in Quake Champions, it is planned to add more champions and add way more other champions. All mechanics and engine is Quake III Arena based, but the rest (maps, damage, weapons, champions) will be different.

title: Ad Nauseam
description:
Ad Nauseam is an intricate choice-heavy psychological thriller about an amnesiac facing both real and mental horrors within a world akin to an endless, liminal hospital. The game itself is what I like to call an RCN (Roleplay & Click Novel) - a fusion genre of Visual Novel, RPG, and Point-&-Click games that centers around distressing content and how people choose to cope with trauma. Uncover the secrets of this strange world, and the ones lying within your own forgotten memories. Will you accept your limitations, or will you dive deep into delusion for a chance at hope?

Can you face the world? Can you face yourself?

Are you sure?

title: Letter Bunny
description: Take on a cozy adventure as Anne, a small and determined bunny with a heart of gold. Explore the peaceful island, deliver many packages and discover that behind every letter is a unique story! Make new friends, help people out and most importantly, have fun!

title: Grapefruit
description: Grapefruit is a research-creation project exploring the concept of videogames rules by Salen and Zimmerman through the work of Yoko Ono, specifically the event scores or performative instructions published in Grapefruit.

title: Dah-Varsity
description:
In this game, you’ll explore different STEAM topics like cars, math, music, books, space, and creating things. It’s a chance for you to learn while playing! When you play Dah-Varsity, you’ll learn about different jobs that match your interests in STEAM!

The game aims to help young adults develop a basic understanding of STEAM and entrepreneurship topics and foster the foundation for advanced STEAM learning and professional careers in the future.

Join the Dah-Varsity community and get ready for an awesome adventure filled with STEAM! Learn, have fun, and show the world what you can do.

title: A Second Mario Bros. X Thing: Analog Funk
description: A Second Mario Bros. X Thing: Analog Funk is the sequel to A Super Mario Bros. X Thing: Prelude to the Stupid. Also developed by Talkhaus through the Super Mario Bros. X engine. Much like the first game, players can pick between 5 playable characters: Demo, Iris, Kood, Sheath and Raocow himself.

title: Make a Good Level Contest X3: The Movie - The Contest: The Game
description: A collaborative level design contest by the SMBX/SMBX2 community, released in 2021, and having taken over a third of SMBX's life cycle to be completed.

title: 2K1X Subzero Heroes
description: The final episode in SMBX's 2k1x series.

title: Make A Fun Awesome Boss 3: Friendship Always Best
description: A collaborative boss design contest held by Talkhaus in the Super Mario Bros. X 2 engine and released in 2023.

title: Doki: Chapter 0
description: A Super Mario Bros. X2 episode by Doki containing a original cast of characters.

title: Salomónico
description:
An interactive experiment inspired by the story of King Solomon.

This is a personal and clumsy relationship about imparting your judgment in crazy situations with sword blows.

You could say that it is in bad taste in many moments, it even gives you the option of cutting a baby in half.

title: A Day for Soft Food
description:
In A Day for Soft Food the player controls the hungry cat of a household. Its master (called "the Provider" in the game) is sound asleep in his bed, ill from some unknown sickness. His state of misery has left his faithful pet with barely anything to eat, and even the slightest mewl seems to annoy him. Can food be found without waking him up?

As with most modern interactive fiction, the player types in full sentences describing their intended actions (LOOK AT THE PROVIDER, MEW, and so on). The game requires a Z-interpreter to run.

title: Innocence: A Seduce Me Story
description:
Before the demon war, there was a brilliant kingdom.
Within its walls lived a beautiful succubus princess.
She was a beacon of hope and peace to her people.
With such a heavy crown to bear, the princess found solace and affection in her childhood friend.
Does he truly love her in return?
--This is a prequel to the 2015 visual novel "Seduce Me the Otome"--

title: Pizz'Amore
description: You play as either Mario or Maria, the owner and lone chef of the famous New York Pizzeria “Pizz’Amore” who is suddenly and cruelly dumped! Unable to cope with the heartbreak, you decide that you will make the perfect pizza to heal your wounded heart!

title: The Bragger's Club
description: You don’t know how you got there. You don’t know why you were invited. However, you’re trapped in a room with only a speaker and mic to communicate with 4 other victims. What could possibly happen?

title: Maid With Perfection
description:
It's your lucky day! You won a special lottery! In the mail, you get the deed to a large estate in a place you've never heard of. You find yourself being driven there in a luxury car, feeling like a billion dollars.

As you arrive, you meet your maid, whom you get to name. She apparently the best Maid in the area and the fact that she chose you to be her master/mistress should honor you. The first day goes almost like a dream: your maid prepares amazing food, cleans the house, preps your bath, and even flirts with you a bit! Lucky you!

title: 2K Invaders
description:
Resist the waves of aliens. Protect from their lasers behind your bunkers which are gradually crumbling...

Created for the 2001 mini game competition by Richard Wilson.

title: Advanced Fantasian: Quest for Lost Sanctuary
description: Long ago, humans and other creatures lived peacefully in a magical paradise. However, one day a new star appeared nearby. A meteorite fell onto the Earth, turning it into a realm of perpetual darkness and misery. Humans managed to restore the land to its original state. But orcs, trolls, and other hostile races refused to give up their territory. Thus, the second age of peace quickly turned into an age of a new battle...

title: Arabian Kid
description: Arabian Kid is a Japanese Action-puzzle platformer game, developed by Yellow Horn Co and published by ASCII Entertainment, which was released in Japan in 1996.

title: Vibrant Frame
description: An otome novel adventure that captures a slice of life and sweet romance of youths striving for their dreams without despairing over reality.

title: Cruelty
description: "CRUELTY" is a Japanese-made splatter horror. You were in an accident and lost consciousness. The moment you wake up, you find yourself in a nightmare world, one that is not of this Earth. In an abattoir ruled by madness, horrific scenes unfold, and inescapable terror awaits you.

title: The Fall: Mutant City
description: Caught in post-apocalyptic desert and ravaged by a treacherous disease, nameless outcast has reached a biosphere, a huge dome that covers the city and protects it from the desert. This city is now controlled by mutant clan, which worships to the prophet. Several survivors exist in their hideouts, and one of them, Henry Leicester, saves the outcast once he enters the city. His motives are simple; the outcast should help him with certain tasks and he helps the outcast with medicine to cure the disease. During the game, player will meet more survivors, understand who is who, and try to survive.

title: Persist Online
description: Persist Online is an MMORPG with zombies, so you better get yourself a gun. Survive in an unforgiving open world, where every building is accessible. Forge a deadly team with friends and claim what's not yours. Take your loot to your safe bunker to craft better gear. Some survive. The best persist!

title: The Witches' Whisk
description:
Manage a magical bakery with your witches' whisk — which doubles as a wand!

Bake pastries, cakes, cookies, and more by casting spells and enchantments to complete orders for your hungry customers. In the Witches' Whisk, you'll play as a witch who owns a bakery. You'll be tasked with bakery management, challenging spell casting, recipe unlocking, decorating desserts and more.

In addition, you will be able to build and upgrade your bakery, including decorating the layout and earning new spells along the way to help you take your recipes even further! You'll be able to decorate your baked goods in fun ways that are unique to your style that you can re-use later. Speaking of style... you will be able to create and customize your own character in this magical journey.

title: Miss Chocolate Eater
description: A very short visual novel about a lonely, bitter woman running a dusty shop meeting the most beautiful women she's ever met, who are also taking her beloved chocolates.

title: Fridge Escape
description: Don't let anyone eat you. Run to save your life!

title: Mega Man: Square Root of Negative One
description: Mega Man Square Root of Negative One is a fan game created by Theimaginarymegaman (also known as snow runt pyro.)

title: Ring Man in the Castle
description:
"Play as Ring Man and venture through an old Wily castle at Dr Cossack's request.

Complete four levels and battle 5 bosses in this short fangame.

Made with Megamix Engine."

title: Tackle Fire With Gun: The Game
description:
"There is no plot. Just kill!
Dash and shoot as Tackle Fire through 7 action packed levels.
Amass various weapons and get power-ups through a card combo system.

Features: powerful bosses, a gun, invinsible dashing , flame gun,
over 9 card combos, big gun, awesome mid-air flip animation, laser gun,
a truck."

title: Father's Day Journey
description: Father's Day Journey is a delightful puzzle game designed to celebrate the enchanting atmosphere of Father's Day. Flip Father's Day themed cards to uncover matching pairs.

title: Warfront Tactics: Battlefield Chronicles Battle Simulator
description: Unleash the commander within in Warfront Tactics - Battlefield Chronicles Battle Simulator, a captivating physics-based strategy game that thrusts you into the heart of epic warfare. Strategically allocate your resources, craft a formidable army, and outmaneuver your opponents in intense battles governed by realistic physics. Witness the chaos and spectacle of combat as your meticulously planned strategies unfold on the battlefield. Every decision carries weight, every encounter presents a challenge, and every victory is hard-won.

title: Samurai Katana Rampage: Stickman Saga
description: Unleash Your Inner Samurai: Seek Justice with the Power of the Katana!

title: Critical Strike Shooter: SWAT Rescue Missions
description: Become an elite operative, rescue hostages, win glory. Intense rescue missions await!

title: Yaoling: Mythical Journey
description: Yaoling: Mythical Journey is a creature collecting Eastern fantasy RPG featuring an world filled with rich stories and unique Yaolings. Tasked to uncover a mysterious evil, you embark on a journey with your Yaolings, forming new friendships, engage in intense battles, and face countless challenges!

title: Arcade Archives: Fighter & Attacker
description:
"F/A" is a shooting game released by Namco (now Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1992.
Choose one of 16 mechs and conquer eight stages.
Each mech's attacks are broadly divided into six types, so choose the one that best suits your taste.

title: Namco Super Heroes
description: Namco Super Heroes is a fan-made fighting game for Windows developed by hiro, released in 2007, with the latest version in 2016. Five classic Namco characters are playable; Bravoman (written as "Berabow Man"), Wonder Momo, Gil from The Tower of Druaga, Rick from Splatterhouse, and Valkyrie from Valkyrie no Bouken.

title: Dokyusei: Bangin' Summer - Home Edition
description: It’s the ’90s. Summer’s back! Dōkyūsei: Bangin’ Summer brings the heat—a Japanese adventure classic, all decked out in HD graphics.

title: Diabotical Rogue
description: Diabotical Rogue is an online, PvP, first-person shooter with roguelike systems. Made for FPS enthusiasts, players can experience fast-paced gameplay in buttery smooth movement, combined with the power of roguelike upgrade choices.

title: Super Cursor
description: Start your journey in Cursor Ville, where you'll be tested in your precision, agility, patience, and determination! Will you be able make your ways through the treacherous world and save your beloved princess? Aim, dodge, move, and most importantly, never give up!

title: Vay
description: The 16-bit cult classic RPG from 1994 returns with tons of improvements! When your peaceful kingdom is attacked on your wedding day and your wife-to-be is kidnapped, it falls to you to journey across the world and stop the terrible machines of war that threaten to lay waste to it.

title: The Backstreets
description: The Backstreets is a doom-like FPS made by GRG Productions. You play as Kain Rodriguez, who must fight The Moths to stop them from cloning people. However, you might be a clone yourself. The Moths are a vicious terrorist organization who have taken over many towns and cities, but there are rumors that something much more is going on behind the scenes. Find out what they are doing by playing The Backstreets.

title: Maximum Apocalypse: The Video Game
description: Scavenge, battle, survive! Choose your survivor and face diverse apocalyptic scenarios in this cooperative digital adaptation of the hit board game Maximum Apocalypse. Grab your friends or make new ones with 1-6 player apocalyptic roguelike gameplay.

title: Living in a Brothel
description: Live the experience of being a Brothel Manager and train the girls to "serve" the customers in the best way possible.

title: Pulzar
description: Evade solar storms to escape galactic police.

title: Pokémon Donjon Mystère Online
description:
PDMO is a French free 2D MMORPG based on the Pokemon Mystery Dungeon series. Embark on a unique adventure as one of 20 different pokemon starters! Missions, harvesting, crafting, tumultuous dungeons, events, pokemons and, above all, fun!

Start your adventure now!

title: Pipsqueak!
description:
Explore a strange and hostile world in this search-action platformer starring a tiny mouse named Tofu.

Pipsqueak! is a search-action platformer starring Tofu, a small mouse exploring a strange and hostile world. Uncover the truth of this expansive world and your place within it through exploration, discovery, combat, and platforming challenges. Bring hope to this dying world and its tiny inhabitants in this grand adventure of mouse-sized proportions!

title: Cozy Dungeons
description: Explore deadly dungeons, clear them out of enemies and renovate them in Cozy Dungeons, a one-of-a-kind adventure/interior design game!

title: BrokenLore: Low
description: Low, a first-person Horror Game, immerses players in the dark prelude of BrokenLore's story. Set in a mist-shrouded Japanese village, players uncover deep-seated hatred and ancient secrets. Navigate a hyperrealistic, claustrophobic environment where supernatural forces and tragic cycles abound.

title: Deckfort Alchemist
description: Strategic roguelike tower defense game where you fortify your defense line by stacking cards in deckforts, play various cards on enemies and deployable grids, and receive general contributions to your defense from altar structures.

title: Cluster
description:
Cluster is a metaverse platform that lets you play, from anywhere, from many devices. Phones, PC, VR are supported and expanding.

Events like concert and meetups, and many worlds await you. You can game, or chill out with friends, ... possibilities are endless.

title: QBeez 2
description: The adorable stars of one of the most addictive puzzle games around are back! And this time, they've brought a few friends! Join the colorful QBeez on Q's Quest where you'll be introduced to twelve all-new puzzle elements, including explosive bombs, buzzing bees, chomping sharks and more. Challenge your matching skills in Classic Mode or bend your brain in Puzzle mode. Even create your own QBeez puzzles in the easy-to-use Puzzle Maker. QBeez together - again!

title: Seascape Paradiso
description:
Underwater photographer Jay has always had a passion for the ocean. She'd never tell you that she thinks she's seen it all...but she'd have to admit that she never thought she'd meet a real-life mermaid on a dive!

But bubbly and mysterious Echo disappears nearly as soon as Jay meets her. Can the two of them reunite, or will it be a one-time encounter?

title: City Bus Simulator 2024
description: Embark on the ultimate urban adventure in City Bus Simulator 2024, where the bustling streets are your playground and the city's pulse beats through every road. Get ready to take the wheel of detailed buses, transporting passengers through a dynamic metropolis teeming with endless possibilities!

title: Late Night Shift
description: Late Night Shift is a first-person horror game where you step into the shoes of a gas station employee working an overnight shift deep in the woods. What starts as another dull night quickly turns into something far more sinister.

title: Say a Prayer
description: Enter a radiant sanctuary, where the glow of God Rays illuminates gentle Shih Tzu, Peaches, and her daughter Pudding. Each prayer they send up brings you closer to the illustrious 9999 milestone. At biblically significant point totals, reveal Digital Scripture Cards, earn celestial trophies, enjoy captivating sounds, and spectacular visual effects powered by Unreal Engine. Lead Pudding and Peaches on the path to ultimate glory!

title: Tiny Little Farm
description:
Take care of your own plantation with different types of crops.

“Amazing, the best!“

title: Frame Breaker
description: Frame Breaker is a top-down roguelite precision platformer.

title: Danganronpa Mauve
description: A Korean Danganronpa Fangame, 15 students are trapped in Hope's Peak Academy, with a new cast introduced for this story.

title: Circling
description:
Poem adapted from "The sun changed colors" by Margorie Agosín.

Created for bitsy jam #81 - tomatoes.

title: Danganronpa Croxx: The Beginning of the Despair Plan
description: Danganronpa Croxx is a Korean fan game based on the Danganronpa Series.

title: Danganronpa Hope Recreation
description: Embark on a thrilling journey filled with deception, despair, and unexpected twists, all in a parallel universe with no connection to the original creators of danganronpa.

title: Hyper Danganronpa Melancholy
description:
16 Students Trapped in a Killing Game?
But a story of dual academies, forming into one.
A story filled with students from dual academies being faced up into the same brim of ....Melancholy. Each student not only has a unique talent.. but a unique special secret each of them have...

title: Danganronpa Blowback: The Stage of Repeated Despair and Hope
description: A cancelled Korean fan game created by a group of Korean Danganronpa fans called Team MonoLab. The game had a prologue and two fully released chapters prior to its cancellation.

title: Danganronpa Weeping Rebellion
description: A french fangame based on the Danganronpa series, playing with a new cast of characters as Herschel Klosmo, the Ultimate Police Officer, forced into a brand new killing game.

title: Eldegarde
description: Eldegarde is a mini-MMO Action RPG with PvE, PvPvE and Arena modes. Explore vast outdoor zones, craft powerful gear, and fight to survive in a living fantasy world.

title: Danganronpa: Eternal Endings
description: After each dying in horrific accidents, 17 people from all across the world and time find themselves trapped in a strange purgatory like realm with only one way to free their trapped souls: spiritual murder.

title: Danganronpa: Abandoned Lights
description:
14 former students get called back to their school that they used to go.

But as they go there, things escalate pretty quickly.

title: Re: Danganronpa Refresh Retreat
description: After a rather odd kidnapping, 16 people wake up in a mansion, all the doors are locked and it seems like there is no way out. Follow Amy Miller and the fifteen other inhabitants of the refresh retreat as they uncover the mystery surrounding the killing game and who exactly is keeping them imprisoned.

title: Danganronpa Absolute Vindication
description: Mearu, The Ultimate Journalist who goes by a pseudonym, suddenly awakes in an empty classroom amongst 14 other Ultimate Students, unsure how she got there. After some investigation, they're all met with an android known as Monorakun, who explains to them that they'll live in that school until the rest of their lives, unless they choose to murder a fellow classmate and get away with it.

title: Danganronpa Dreamland: Hymn of the Sea and Whales
description: The premise is as usual 15 students trapped in a school, Hope Peak Academy....or is it?

title: Danganronpa Daydream
description: A fan game of the Danganronpa series made in Korea.

title: One Room: Prisoner's Dilemma
description: 6 People - 1 Room - 1 way to escape. Welcome to One Room - Prisoner's Dilemma.

title: Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds
description: Explore new lands, wield a spear in combat, and test yourself in challenging encounters in Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds. The newest adventure in the world of Tyria will play out over the course of four quarterly releases: a year of content, feature updates, and more.

title: Run & Jump Guy
description: Leap into "Run & Jump Guy," a pixel-packed platformer spanning three thrilling worlds: Island, Snowy Forest, and Castle. Overcome enemies and obstacles to conquer the ultimate boss!

title: Mortal Kombat X: Blue Steel Sub-Zero
description: Play as Blue Steel Sub-Zero.

title: Outbreak: Blood & Teeth Collection
description: Classic survival horror burns strong in three unique adventures as dinosaurs and zombies tear a sleepy midwestern town apart.

title: The Battle of Aurinoxia
description: A retro space shoot 'em up with pixel art graphics, unique enemies, tough angry bosses, and a killer soundtrack. You are among the first pilots to arrive in the system to mount the counteroffensive against the aggressors. Get out there and show these aliens the price for messing with The Alliance!

title: Intergalacto-1
description: Intergalacto-1 features intense multiplayer battles in Warzone mode and thrilling survival experiences in mystical horror mode, filled with magical elements and numerous exciting modes. Conquer the galaxy's hidden worlds and face the formidable boss, INM.

title: Just Keep Digging
description: Welcome to Bodie, a company mining town. Meet rising weekly profit quotas by digging deeper for rare ores and gems. Encounter ruined structures, ancient fossils, and dangerous cave dwellers. Sell your findings for company coins to upgrade your gear and keep digging!

title: Tomb Stalkers
description: An Arcade Action Puzzle game like few with fast paced mechanics. Walk around the tombs to open them and reveal their content, you require to get a key and a relic to be able to unlock the exit to the next level. But beware, the sorceress minions are upon you with their unique abilities.

title: DCS World: OH-58D Kiowa Warrior
description: Experience the ultimate in rotary-wing aviation with the OH-58D Kiowa Warrior in DCS World. This meticulously crafted simulation brings the legendary reconnaissance and light attack helicopter to life with unparalleled accuracy and detail.

title: Memo Blox
description: Memo Blox is a casual game that challenges your attention and memory. The game features a good minimalistic style and great music. Can you become a Master of Memo Blox?

title: Broken Shell
description: Broken Shell is a cute and cozy adventure game filled with love and courage. Join Mr. and Mrs. Hermit, an adorable couple, as they navigate through a charming world filled with puzzles, challenges, and heartwarming moments on their heartfelt journey to a better life.

title: Flag Clicker
description: Flag is a clicker Game, in which you click a Flag!

title: Ark: Fantastic Tames - Pyromane
description: Introducing the first of a new series of Fantastic Tames for ARK: Survival Ascended: the Pyromane! Owners of one of this new class of creatures gain access to a wondrous array of useful abilities!

title: Ark: The Center Ascended
description: The Center is a free add-on for ARK: Survival Ascended that includes a massive new map for survivors to explore. The Center is nearly double the size of The Island, making it about 70 sq. kilometers and featuring a rich, hand-drawn Tolkien-esque aesthetic.

title: Kitesurf Runner
description: Become a kitesurfing hero in this 2D X-treme sports runner game.

title: Goo Go
description: Test your skills, patience, and nerves in a game where one mistake will send you back to the beginning. Oh, and welcome to "Goo Go"!

title: The South Island
description: Welcome to The South Island! Step into the shoes of a young adventurer, explore the rich fauna and flora while collecting essential resources, learn about the indigenous culture, and face unique enemies and bosses of the region to rescue your family in this old-school RPG!

title: Oracle of Meles
description: An ancient prophecy, a chosen one? Hack and slash your way through an evil castle, collect powerful artifacts, and uncover its dark secrets. Explore this 2D hand-drawn world full of magic and monsters where nothing is as it seems.

title: Alex the Ball
description: Alex has turned into a ball after an experiment went wrong. As he navigates Nova Station, things become even more complicated when he finds himself in a parallel universe. A physics-based 3D platformer that can be completed in one go, if you don't fall, die, or quit.

title: Twinworld Survivor
description: Twinworld Survivor is a survival roguelite where you play a girl just become an investigator and entered the twinworld by accident. Choose from a variety of traits and items to create unique builds, and defeat waves of monsters to survive, and uncover the secrets of the twinworld.

title: Below Level
description: Navigate through an underground parking lot in search of four important cars. Armed with only a phone, evade the abnormals that are sent to intercept you and make it out alive.

title: Boxmania
description: Boxmania is a 2D puzzle game designed to be challenging, fun, and to make the player think on every level. Each of the 50 levels is created to show unique aspects of the simple concept of moving boxes, all while being possible. After completion, enjoy the other equally fun game modes.

title: Ultimate General: American Revolution - Premium Edition
description: The Premium Edition is a tribute to our most dedicated fans and supporters. By purchasing the Premium Edition, you are not only getting access to all the exclusive content of the Premium Edition but also showing your support for the continued development and expansion of the Ultimate General series.

title: Construction Simulator: Stadium Expansion
description: Ready, set, goal? Wait a second! For thrilling soccer matches you'll need an equally impressive venue - and the Stadium Expansion for Construction Simulator is your chance to build a stadium including related facilities.

title: Pinball M: Texas Chainsaw Massacre Pinball
description: Put on the mask and rev the chainsaw - Leatherface returns to slaughter in pinball form! Aim your shots and use all your skills to take out your victims in one of the most brutal pinball tables ever created.

title: Bankshot Launchers
description: Create havoc in this ricocheting arena shooter where precise trick-shots are king. Master a variety of unique weapons and work with your team in challenging levels to achieve victory over your opponents.

title: STEM Defense
description: Battle microscopic threats in 'STEM Defense', a hex-grid tower defense adventure using the power of the Immune System. Face waves of pathogens, unlock powerful Cells and Upgrades, Evolve your defenses and prepare for a microscopic battle of survival!

title: Blocky Ascent
description: A high-stakes first-person parkour platformer. Overcome dynamic obstacles like moving platforms and anti-gravity fields. Discover shortcuts to reach the summit faster, but beware, the climb demands mastery.

title: Golf Bash: Online
description: Golf Bash: Online is the ultimate golf showdown where friendship takes a swing! In this silly party game, grab your clubs and prepare to battle it out throughout a round of golf.

title: Silent Mourning
description: Your sister has been missing for a few days. You head out to the cabin she was staying at, but it seems you're not the only one there

title: The Playful Worm
description: Embark on a Challenging Journey to Freedom!

title: Pirate's Money
description: Welcome to Pirate's Money, the ultimate adventure on the seven seas, where strategy, courage and cunning determine who will reign over the treacherous waters of Pirate's Island! Your legend begins now. Raise the sails, load the cannons and win BIG in Pirate's Money.

title: Samurai of the Samurais
description: Begin your fight for honor and freedom now!

title: The Falling Car
description: Are you tired of mundane car drifting games?

title: The Crystal of the Cave
description: Embark on an Epic Quest in The Crystal of the Cave!

title: Crackin' Smackin: Customization Set - Sandman
description: Send your adversaries to the land of dreams with the Sandman-Set! Lovingly put everyone to sleep with a Pillow whilst looking adorable in your Pajamas. - Customization DLC

title: Crackin' Smackin: Customization Set - Pumpkinhead
description: Show your spooky side and send your opponents for a run! - Customization DLC

title: Crackin' Smackin: Customization Set - Warrior
description: Leather, spikes and horns what else could a real warrior need? Show your martial prowess with style! - Customization DLC

title: Crackin' Smackin: Customization Set - Skully
description: Trophies are not only collected to be hung on a wall! Show them what you got! - Customization DLC

title: Crackin' Smackin: Customization Set - Woodpecker
description: A feathery appearance for your Caveman! Knock your opponent out with precise smacks! - Customization DLC

title: I Commissioned Some Bunnies 8
description: I paid artists to hide bunnies and carrots in 15 artworks. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: Final Spin
description: A 2-4 player online party game about risking your life for the thrill of high-stakes gambling. Use your items wisely to gain an edge over chance and play until you are the last person standing.

title: Random Hero Defense
description: Block enemies with randomly generated heroes Survive until the last round and clear the game. Defeat enemies and use the gold you earn to produce more heroes and become stronger.

title: Red Rampant
description: Red Rampant is a narrative-driven action-adventure game set in Medieval Scotland. With the ability to travel back in time through their memories of previous gameplay and begin again, players use knowledge gained from past mistakes and hindsight of future events to change the course of history.

title: Total Conflict: Resistance - Eastern Airborne Forces
description: Additional research branch "Eastern Airborne Forces".

title: The Unseen Fears: Fortune's Consequence - Collector's Edition
description: Can you escape an ancient ice spirit before it's too late?

title: Ranger Force
description: Ranger Force is an atmospheric third person, action, adventure, shooter, and fighting game that can be experienced alone, or with a partner in multiplayer split-screen mode.

title: Void Mother: Survivor
description: Conquer Void Mothers horde of fever dream creatures in this action packed horde shooter. Theorycraft with player passives and navigate a fast paced world with randomly generated items whilst battling your way to become an unstoppable force.

title: Breadborn
description: Breadborn is a crazy action game where you command an army of crumb minions that came from very own body. Branches, axes, or a killer mini-gun? It's up to you to decide how to equip your army in order to sow chaos among the peasants and get to the PRINCE himself!

title: Neon Puzzle Ball
description: Neon Puzzle Ball is a fun and challenging 2D action puzzle platformer. Navigate each level unlocking doors and mastering new modifiers and hazards, while striving for quicker completion times.

title: Brainwave Trials
description: Brainwave Trials presents itself as a first-person puzzle-platformer experience where the player takes the role of a volunteer within the Garnet Research And Development Sector. By utilizing parkour mechanics and dimensional manipulation, the player will be able to overcome the trials of science.

title: The Mythical City 3
description: Two sides, two crystals

title: Brok the InvestiGator + The Brawl Bar
description: Investigate by day, brawl by night!

title: Le Mans Ultimate: BMW M Hybrid V8
description: The first in a new wave of Hypercars - BMW M Hybrid V8 available as FREE DLC! Download the BMW M Hybrid V8 and take to the track!

title: Money Simulator
description: Become a mogul in this thrilling simulation game! Buy, sell, and customize cars, trade in cryptocurrencies, and expand your empire with your very own shop. Take risks, make deals, and watch your business flourish in this dynamic world.

title: The Mythical City 2
description: Protect your city from evil!

title: Konon: Zew Choroszczy
description: A game about Konon, his arch-enemies, his missing friend, parcels with God's surprises and out-of-date ones (with peasant or children's inserts). Go in search of your nitro friend, fight your opponents, collect collectibles and unleash a mighty bang!

title: Shrineflow
description: Shrineflow is a multiplayer (1 vs 1) hide-and-seek game between a Kitsune and a Ninja. The Kitsune uses her magical abilities to track down her opponent. The Ninja uses his stealth skills to stay undetected while he collects enough to coins to break into the treasure trove.

title: The Ultimate Math Teaching Game
description: A Math game combined with a futuristic 3D gaming experience that will teach you Algebra, Geometry, and Trigonometry. You will properly understand these concepts and solidify them by solving practical problems. Start your science and engineering career with this game!

title: Steve's Warehouse: Physics. Roguelike. Chaos.
description: Steve's Warehouse is a melting pot of Suika game, rogue-like and deckbuiling. Purchase objects, combine them, but don't make any falls!

title: Pixel Playground
description: A little box of pixels I made specially for you :)

title: Bug Alliance
description: Bug Alliance is a pixel style top-down action RPG, where you play as bug warriors, each with unique abilities and weapons. Choose your Bug, select a game mode and dive into battles against worm tyranny. Fight, upgrade, farm resources, evolve and become a legend. Alliance is calling you!

title: Miner Tower Defense
description: This is a game that combines mining and tower defense elements. Players need to build defense towers by digging and gathering minerals underground to resist a constant stream of monsters!

title: Once in Hell
description: Once in Hell: I tried to create a game where i union History,Horror,Riddle and Parkour. In game u can use: Inventory,torch,flashlight and everything that can help you to survive. I am sure that, time you'll spend on a game will be enjoyable.

title: Fandom
description: "Fandom" is a psychological horror game played through a girl obsessed with celebrities. It explores the dark side of stalking and shows that obsession goes with terrible consequences.

title: 2D Top Racing
description: Get ready for heart-pounding action in 2D Top Racing! Choose from 12 unique cars, tackle 20 challenging tracks, and customize your ride for maximum performance. Compete against challenging AI in this adrenaline-fueled top-down racing game. Are you ready to claim victory?

title: King of Stocks
description: Welcome to King of Stocks! This is an engaging simulated stock trading game that allows you to experience the excitement and challenges of stock market investment. You can utilize your intelligence and insight to succeed in the market.

title: Only Way is Down
description: Embark on a purr-fectly perilous adventure as this lil kitty cat took an unfortunate cat-nap and ended up stranded sky high! With no way but down, unleash your feline agility and platforming prowess to navigate your descent through the urban jungle in this whimsical and gravity-defying escapade!

title: Dead Island 2: Expansion Pass
description: Dive back into the epic horror pulp adventure of Dead Island 2 with our Expansion Pass. Brace yourself for mayhem as you uncover more of Hell-A, with brand-new missions, caches of lethal weapons, skill cards to master, fresh fits, and all the zombies you can slay.

title: Graviteam Tactics: The Far Escape
description: Soviet troops of the SWF were encircled near Kiev. CMG Belov received the order of advance to the Romny to provide support to the encircled troops. In order to prevent a breakthrough of the encirclement ring, the German HQ strengthened the outer perimeter with elements of 10MID and MID SS "Reich".

title: Dead Island 2: Red’s Demise Katana
description: Slice through the zombie horde with the Red's Demise Katana, which earns you a temporary damage boost with every slay.

title: Sumerians: Assyrian Statues
description: Assyrian statues to decorate your cities.

title: Lust Potions
description: Now that Lil' Dude has turned 30, he's decided to become a wizard and summon a succubus to take his virginity! Use alchemy to brew the potions and ingredients needed to summon and seduce each succubus. Can you help Lil' Dude get laid?

title: Stunts above Clouds 3
description: Welcome to Stunts Above Clouds 3, the thrilling conclusion to the epic series.

title: Red Ruins
description: Red Ruins is an asymmetric VR game created by students, where one player becomes a Demon Lord in VR, facing off against Heroes on PC. With powerful weapons and strategic gameplay, players must either vanquish their foes or join forces to conquer the Red Ruins together.

title: TranceWave Neo
description: tranceWave NEO is a classic arcade twin-stick shmup, inspired by others in the "trance shooter" genre. Move, shoot, survive, and aim for a high score!

title: Rose and Cross
description: Our main character, absorbed in the study of sects and the occult, made a big mistake by going to an abandoned farm.

title: Astro Looter
description: Astro Looter combines survival and tower defense gameplay. Play as heroes like Storm Striker across planets to seize minerals, using weapons and defenses to fight alien bugs. Upgrade gear with minerals and explore diverse planets. Notably challenging, few pass the first level.

title: Killer Klowns From Outer Space: Infernal Ranger - Fluxo
description: From the far reaches of space come the incredible Fluxo! Many humans will flee from this magician of death, only to find he always has tricks up his sleeve. Fluxo is a special character skin for the Ranger Klown Type and is only cosmetic.

title: Swapmeat
description: Frenetic roguelite meat 'em up action! Rip through alien worlds solo or co-op, harvest mutant body parts to wield their powers, and fulfill your delicious destiny.

title: Goldorak
description:
The Alcorak was destroyed by Vega's forces.
Grendizer's mission is to travel to the four corners of the planet to find each piece of debris from the device in order to be able to reconstruct it.

During his journey, Goldorak will have to face many enemies.
At the end of each level, a part of the Alcorak will be won.
When all the parts of the Alcorak have been assembled, it will then be possible to start the game again on board.

title: Kira Kano
description: Kira Kano is an upcoming visual novel developed by AZARASHI SOFTWARE in collaboration with Lump of Sugar to commemorate the latter's 10th anniversary that tells the story of Yuzuru, an ordinary student at first glance but he's actually famous on the Internet. His secret identity leaks to a classmate and she... asks to make her his apprentice.

title: The Breakup Arena
description: A Beat 'Em Up game where you confront your ex-lovers, blending intense action with deep emotional storytelling. Explore the complexities of relationships and discover inner peace through unique gameplay.

title: Darkwatch
description: Created by a 4 man team this short FPS puts you in the shoes of a Darkwatch agent fighting against mysterious creatures. With your loyal canine by your side, upgrade weapons, buy perks and fight the forces of darkness!

title: How We Die
description: Pack your bag with good tools, modify your character's dice, and reach the end of the story.

title: Zapnator
description: Dodge and destroy enemies and asteroids to get food and grow bigger! Be careful though, the game only gets harder over time. Deal with incoming bosses and find yourself your own unique strategy with the attribute system! Change up the gameplay with different stages and characters to choose from!

title: Tragala
description: Tragala is a graphic adventure game in which you will play Kurt, a restless young man who tries to escape from the system house ruled by the junjuma, a control and blame machine that is part of a systematic and terrible monster known as Tragala.

title: Cracker
description: Cracker is a fast-paced arcade game where you have to destroy as many blocks as possible before you run out of lives.

title: Trailblazers: Into the March
description: Embark on a thrilling adventure in this roguelite colony-sim strategy game. Command your Landship in tactical battles, care for a crew composed of all sorts of characters, shape your home, manage resources, and lead expeditions into the March. Discover what lies at its heart... and in yours.

title: Devils Run
description: An indie platformer and race to escape an imploding planet! Time your moves carefully..

title: Dimension Pirates
description: Here is the ultimate, third-person bullet hell game. Help save the universe and humanity by blasting away a wide array of villains that are trying to take over multiple dimensions.

title: Soviet Anomaly 7
description: You are trapped in an endless soviet-era building.Observe your surroundings carefully to reach escape.Don't overlook any anomalies.If you find anomalies, turn back to downstairs.If you don't find anomalies, come to upstairs.

title: Rollz
description: ◆In a 3D fantastic distant universe and a mysterious atmosphere◆ An action game where you roll a ball through a beautiful 3D space and aim for the goal. Clear each stage while navigating through various obstacles.

title: Lamplight
description: Lamplight is a 3D mind-bending puzzle platformer where you defy gravity and warp your perception. Navigate a labyrinth of rooms where walls become floors, ceilings become pathways, and time bends unexpectedly. Unravel the secrets hidden within this distorted world - are you ready to be challenged?

title: Stop The F
description:
Stop The F is a first-person puzzle. Use a camera capable of capturing objects from reality into subspace and bringing them back.
Use various filters that enhance the camera's performance.

The project aims to recreate and reimagine F-stop, a canceled prequel to Valve’s Portal. While Stop The F draws direct inspiration from it, it is ultimately an original creation by an indie team, crafted with its own vision and identity.

title: Get Up In The Night
description: "Get Up In The Night" tells a sci-fi story set in the future, filled with dark humor. An old man wakes up in a completely unfamiliar place... His bladder can no longer hold, and he must rush to the bathroom! But what exactly is going on? What secrets are hidden within all this?

title: Lunia Record
description: Originally an ordinary adventure life, after meeting a problem person, the brother and sister stepped into a magnificent and extraordinary world.

title: System Malfunction
description: "System Malfunction" is a first-person horror game set in a mysterious building. The player takes on the role of a security guard who witnesses strange occurrences during the night shift. In a fear-inducing environment, the player explores the building to uncover hidden truths.

title: Legend Square
description: Rubik's Cube + Chess + Roguelike = ?Playing chess on a Rubik's Cube? And I brought a shotgun?--They say I'm not fit for this prison--A prison for the guilty--I agree--But they only got it half right--I can twist this space with ease--Leaving here is a piece of cake for me!

title: Yvy
description: YVY is a fast-paced rogue-lite dice battler set in a world inspired by 16th-century Brazil. Channel the power of ancient divinities, craft your perfect dice by strategically choosing each face, and defend your homeland against the threat of colonial invasion. Roll for resistance!

title: Alpha and Iota
description: Alpha and Iota is a puzzle platformer about repairing a computer system inhabited by sentient agents. You operate a repair core, which can navigate the system by ejecting between a variety of different host types. Some hosts are fixed in place, while others jump, slide, climb walls, or follow rails.

title: Snatch & Swallow
description: This is an action rougelike game Players need to strategically select possession objects while also selecting various beneficial gain attributes that benefit them.

title: Within the Vault
description: Within The Vault is an action packed isometric roguelite with a heavy influence from classic film noire. Featuring dynamic dialogue, energetic big band inspired tracks, a variety of ranged and melee weapons to choose from, and unlockable permanent upgrades for endless fun.

title: Cook For Love
description: Win the hearts of Parisians with your cooking, discover delicious recipes, and become a chef worthy of working onboard the Orient Express.

title: RPM: Road Punk Mayhem
description: Hit the road for explosive bullet hell action through a post-apocalyptic wasteland!

title: Goblin Auto Club Manager
description: Imagine building fantastic cars out of scrap metal and letting idiots drive them. Goblin Auto Club Manager is a wacky racing management simulation. Buy parts from the junkyard, build cars with them and choose your racing strategy. Your crazy goblins do the driving. Keep fingers crossed...

title: HackHub: Ultimate Hacker Simulator
description: Unravel cyber secrets and foil mass surveillance as a skilled hacker in Hackhub. Challenge authority, rewrite the rules, and emerge as the ultimate digital rebel.

title: The Tortoise and the Hare
description: Explore a retelling of the classic Aesop Fairy Tale. A songbird, named Simon, narrates the tale, bringing the story alive one word at a time. The experience is fully animated and voiced with an easy to digest story mode and lots of bonuses and secrets to discover!

title: Proto Garden
description: From a single beehive, pollinate your way to planetary regeneration. Grow flowers, automate honey production, and research new plants to assist the bees. Optimize your garden, paint new terrain, and watch the land come to life!

title: Sequence
description: Sequence is a dice-based poker game, multiplayer & competitive, inspired by the classics Generala/Yahtzee/Yacht/Yatzy (every area of the world has a name for the game!). Now, players from all over the world can compete to climb the ranks - will you become a Senior Master?

title: Power Grid
description: Dive into the world of the energy industry with the Power Grid app, designed by award-winning author Friedemann Friese.

title: Matreshka
description: Matreshka is a first-person psychological horror experience, you must navigate a maze of old soviet building by elevator. Searching for a way to escape.

title: Lost Lullabies: The Orphanage Chronicles
description: "Lost Lullabies - The Orphanage Chronicles" is a Co-Op horror game set in 1980, inspired by the real stories of an orphanage ruined by a fire in 1960 Lowell. Playable with 1-4 players, the goal is to identify and expel malevolent spirits alone or with your team.

title: Too Late Forest
description: "Too Late Forest" is a belt-scrolling adventure game in which a boy navigates his way through a mysterious forest. The deeper the boy goes into the forest, the more his body gradually transforms into a beast, and by turning back at any time, the ending will branch out.Can you lead him to happiness?

title: Carbon
description: Carbon is Action RPG set in cyberpunk/biopunk world. Create your path to power through 18 uniquely themed specializations in the passive skill tree. Carbon is developed by a team of industry veterans and ARPG enthusiasts who have long felt that the sci-fi theme was underrepresented in this genre.
Embark on a journey of Zen riddles in a Buddhist mandala space. Reach Nirvana with a 1 in 8192 chance in a mystical world adorned with tombstones and Buddha statues.

title: Spiritmorph
description: A Monster collecting simulator game! Buy, Play, Pet, and Feed up to 12 monsters known as Spiritmorph!

title: Reverb
description: Reverb is a multiplayer PVPVE extraction stealth shooter with a first-person perspective, set in a fictional Biopunk universe where there is a constant struggle for evolution.

title: Port of Jumanah
description: From a humble port, you set out to clean the ocean of troublemakers. Hack and harpoon through absurd foes, shady allies, and your own bad calls. The world wants a hero… your friends want you to punch an orca. Both valid. Choose wisely—or don’t. The sea remembers everything.

title: Potion Punch Rivals
description: Potion Punch Rivals puts your shopkeeping, potion punching skills to the test. Race against your rival to see who can take orders first, prep fastest, and serve best.

title: Crimson Temple
description: It is a vanilla DOOM 2 styled map with a bit of atmosphere, some custom atmospheric BGM and a lot of secrets, including a hidden exit - though that exit doesn't lead anywhere special for now, this is just a single map. Id say its between Doom 2 and Plutonia in general difficulty, and takes between 30 minutes and 1 hour to complete.

title: The Nine Tailed Celestial Fox
description: It's a sandbox cultivation game where players recruit and train talents, build their own homesteads, practice alchemy and crafting, battle monsters, and collect materials. The combat mode features automatic side-scrolling battles with companions, meanwhile player can click cards to execute attacks.

title: Sweet Forest
description: Sweet Forest - is a simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game with relaxing music accompaniment. After completing the level, you can enjoy the girl's photo in the gallery.

title: AnimalLaboratory
description: Far out in outer space, there is an experimental base where aliens use a catalyst to transform humans into animals to satisfy their needs. Here, you are a human who has escaped from a laboratory and explores the game levels while avoiding enemies.

title: Coin Eruption
description: Experience the thrill of a mountain-top coin pusher game in Coin Eruption! Drop coins, collect special upgrades, unlock rewards, and trigger epic volcano eruptions. Customize your game with avatars and backgrounds while leveling up through dynamic and exciting gameplay.

title: Pacification Light
description: Pacification Light is an exciting 2D platformer that takes us back to a time when spirits and ghosts inhabited our world. During this period, there lived a brave hero who decided to confront the darkness and cleanse the earth of sinister supernatural entities.

title: SkyNuggets
description: Click to fly and avoid Obstacles, increasing your score.

title: Heaven Seeker: The Savior of This Cruel World
description: "Heaven Seeker: The Savior of This Cruel World" is a twin-stick rogue-lite shooter where you take your own shot at the castle in the sky! A dungeon with a different structure each time you enter, a variety of magic bullets - and a formidable barrage of bullets - await you.

title: Dark the Dead
description: Dark the Dead is an exciting game where you take on the role of a hidden wanderer who goes to meet an elder to receive a new task. The elder's magic coins were stolen, and your main goal is to return them.

title: Demon Slayer
description: Demon Slayer - Set in the year 2075, when dark demons have invaded the world and threaten all of humanity. You will play the role of the leader of a group of killers, whose goal is to destroy demons and collect their analyzes to ensure the survival of humanity.

title: Kokoronull
description: "Kokoronull" is a hardcore action game that adds the element of "slipperiness" to the usual platform action gameplay. Conquering all 25 stages is an impressive achievement.

title: Ninja 1987
description: Ninja 1987 is a dive back into the past with the most authentic 8-bit side-scrolling action-platformer. Use shinobi skills to thwart a nefarious threat and rediscover all the adrenaline of timeless classics!

title: Shenaniganza
description: Outsmart friends in goofy hide-and-seek with crazy power-ups, vibrant cartoon aesthetics, and endless laughter. Form alliances, betray buddies, and experience multiplayer mayhem in this unpredictable, entertaining game. Get ready for a bonanza of fun – where laughs never stop!

title: Hentai Puzzle: Girls
description: Hentai Puzzle: Girls is a fun puzzle game that tests your intelligence and attention! Create wonderful images by correctly combining jigsaw puzzles in this game featuring colorful and attractive anime girls.

title: Kuiper Belt Survivor
description: Kuiper belt survivor is an arcade style bullet heaven, where every run is endless. It brings a unique spin to the bullet heaven genre by making every part of the players weapon arsenal customizable with well over 10,000 unique weapons to build, and unique stats for every enemy.

title: Kappa's Asylum
description: Kappa's Asylum is a survival horror game in which you control a youtuber in an abandoned asylum to record a video.

title: Hunter Legends
description: RPG game and Open World,in this game ,you kill monsters and beast of prey，and some small games can play.

title: Romanizer
description: Immerse yourself in Roman history with this management game! Gain acceptance of the goddess Cybele into the pantheon of Roman gods, influence public opinion, and go through many historical events. Will you be able to get Cybele adopted by the Romans?

title: Mafia Simulator
description: Rise as a crime lord in "Mafia Simulator" : A simulation game blending action, strategy, and an open world. Conquer the city by managing illicit businesses like weed farms, weapons manufacturing and cocaine trading, and make decisions that could mean life or death.

title: Volcanewt
description: Volcanewt is an action city destruction game where the goal is annihilation. Destroy the city, defeat the WWDF and their creations, and save? the Hawiwi Archipelago.

title: Wizard Pulse
description: Wizard Pulse is a casual shooter game about wizards. Shoot through hordes of enemies and unlock new abilities.

title: Bleakwood
description: Bleakwood desecrates the foundation of chess in this roguelike deckbuilder. Enter a sinister fantasy world where corruption is key to success. Grow stronger with each run by unlocking cards, improving units, and making sacrifices, ultimately conquering your enemies. But remember, absolute power corrupts absolutely. Will you defile your morals to reclaim what is yours?

title: Spec
description: A series of classic arcade style game modes that will test your skill, puzzle-solving, and reaction. There are 66 levels to conquer across 11 different game modes, secrets to discover along the way, bonus modes to unlock... you'll be surprised how much can be packed into one little spec.

title: Apocalypse Delivery Service
description: Apocalypse Delivery Service is an exciting survival and adventure game. You will enter a post-apocalyptic world where you play as a courier delivering packages. But don't think it will be easy! Your task is to find necessary items, survive, and most importantly, escape from the city.

title: Insert Item Apocalypse
description: Insert Item Apocalypse - interactive 3D puzzle in genre "find and click". Explore a world full of many details, conveying the spirit of the aftermath of a major man-made disaster.

title: Medival Hustle
description: Madival Hustle is a captivating 3D medival-quest game, where you will immerse yourself in a world of fantasy landscapes, where every hill and castle hides its own secrets and adventures. Follow the storyline completing the quests and find out what awaits you in the finale.

title: Z Rush
description: Z Rush is an exciting strategic 3D game where your task is to place zombies in such a way that they can destroy all the turrets on the level.

title: Meadow Assault
description: Embark on an epic journey of survival and adventure alone or with up to 4 players online. Cultivate crops, trade for upgrades, and battle your way through the dense forest to uncover the mysterious maze and its secrets. But be vigilant, for danger lurks where least expected.

title: My Bath Tub Companion

This includes: the Onyx Hippogriff Mount.

Hogwarts Legacy is an open-world action RPG set in the world first introduced in the Harry Potter books. Embark on a journey through familiar and new locations as you explore and discover magical beasts, customize your character and craft potions, master spell casting, upgrade talents and become the wizard you want to be.

Experience Hogwarts in the 1800s. Your character is a student who holds the key to an ancient secret that threatens to tear the wizarding world apart. Make allies, battle Dark wizards, and ultimately decide the fate of the wizarding world. Your legacy is what you make of it. Live the Unwritten.

title: Neon Doctrine's Greatest Hits Vol. 1
description: Lost Castle, The Legend of Tianding, and Yuppie Psycho. Three different games with almost nothing in common. Nothing that is, except they all captured your hearts.

title: The Ghost X: Sniper Simulator - Arsenal Expansion
Ancient Demon Shadow
description: Set in a vibrant and diverse otherworld, players will navigate through intricate puzzles, collect experience points, and train themselves to become stronger. Utilizing a variety of weapons and magic, they must eliminate massive creatures and monsters.

title: Omusubi
description: One day, Hinako, a high school student, finds her path to school transformed into the Sanzu River, where she meets a strange-looking man named Issa. Will she be able to get through the mysterious devices of the mysterious mansion and return safely to her family?
