The minotaur is a creature that stands at the boundary between human and animal. To be in-between boxes is to be a monster, something to be ostracized. So, really, you ought to choose if you want to be a man or a woman already. Don't you know the consequences if you don't?

A short, surreal kinetic novel about gender.

title: Make a Good Mega Man Level Contest 3
description:
Make a Good Mega Man Level Contest 3 is a Classic Mega Man Level Design Contest turned into a fully-fledged fangame, and the largest one yet!
Clear the contest entries, explore the hub worlds and witness the overarching plot unravel as you soak in the game's myriad of content!

title: Once Upon a Galaxy
description:
Once Upon a Galaxy is a mobile based card battler brought to you by Million Dreams.

Recruit a rag-tag squad of fairy book characters, heroes from legend, scheming villains and treasure hoarding dragons as they do battle across the galaxy where last one standing wins.

title: Facing Demons: Chara Battle
description: You finally reached the Final Coridor completing another Genocide route. You once again faced your nemesis - Chara Dreemurr, but this time something seems off. Ready your chainsaw, darling! The last actor is on the scene!

title: BugBurgh
description:
Care for a little village of cute lil bugs!
Explore the forest, forage for food, gather resources, construct little houses and buildings, watch the little village grow and try to keep everyone happy!
How many bugs can you care for? How many bugs is too many bugs?

title: 3 Kings
description:
In this pocket roguelike strategy game, you have to build a kingdom powerful enough to withstand the other king's invasions and be crowned the king of kings.

3 Kings is a 2024 Promotional demo of 9 kings before its official release in 2025.

title: Armor Battle
description: A simulator of the handheld game Armor Battle.

title: Destiny Star Girlfriend 3
description: In the final(?) route of this award-winning VN series, Seiji survives an attempt on his life by Kanoko, aka secret magical girl no. 3. The leads all point to a childhood tragedy and a certain deep-space Majin, so why him? And will Kanoko leave the dark side to save Seiji—and mankind—from herself?

title: Astérix: Hunt for the Boars
description: A digital simulator of the LCD handheld game of the same name.

title: Baseball
description: Step up to the plate in Baseball, a simple yet thrilling game where you control all the action on the field. Choose between easy, medium, or hard difficulty to match your skill level and start swinging!

title: Caccia al Ladro/Heathcliff
description: A digital simulator of the handheld game Caccia al Ladro/Heathcliff.

title: Sonic Frenzy Adventure
description: Sonic Frenzy Adventure is a retro-style fangame developed since 2004, featuring 11 zones and 5 playable characters, including two original ones. The game introduces unique mechanics such as a revised ring system with four levels, various shields with passive effects, and special powers exclusive to Sonic. Players explore each zone, ending in a boss fight, with a storyline focused on defeating EggRobo's mechanical empire. Achievements track high scores and hidden collectibles, and the game offers character-specific routes and challenges.

title: Abaddon
description: Abaddon is a first-person psychological horror game steeped in Lovecraftian elements. Descend into a haunting story as you take on the role of Jimmy, searching for his missing brother Georgie while confronting his past in a nightmarish world.

title: Ronin's Requiem
description: In Ronin's Requiem you play as a ninja who has fallen from grace and now, to regain his honor, he has to eliminate an army of demons in a foreign land. Ronin's Requiem is a fast-paced platformer with solid gameplay and fast-paced combat.

title: Dawn of Defiance
description: You are the Defier, subjected to a mythic plot across ruined isles. In this Greek myth-inspired survival craft, ascend from weak soldier to god-like anti-hero. Build impressive Greek structures, craft and upgrade your gear, and face down the trials of Gods with up to 3 friends.

title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Reckoning of New York
description: Vampire: The Masquerade - Reckoning of New York is a narrative game set in the World of Darkness Universe. Play as one of the members of the Vampire Clans in a shifting political landscape between the Camarilla and the Anarchs while trying your best to survive.

title: Prezzemolo in un Viaggio da Sogno
description: "Prezzemolo in un Viaggio da Sogno" is the second PC video game based on the mascot of Gardaland , the dragon Parsley . It is the sequel to "Prezzemolo in una giornata da incubo" and, like its predecessor, in addition to being a point and click adventure , it has some voice actors from the animated series also inspired by Parsley.

title: Keychain
description: Keychain is a short game made by Ivan Zanotti & fran43 for GMTK Game Jam 2019. In Keychain your survival depends on how you use the keys you find.

title: Pokemon Garbage Gold
description: To begin, Garbage Gold is a trashmon hack, meaning the player will only be able to obtain and use weak Pokemon. In most cases, these Pokemon will be less than 425 BST (combined base stat total). There are some exceptions, but this is the general rule. A wide variety of encounters are available, and are significantly different from vanilla Heart Gold. Evolution levels are changed, and some Pokemon wont evolve at all if the evolutions are too good.

title: Hunter Moonstrike
description: Hunter Moonstrike is the first survival game integrated with artificial intelligence. In this game, all npc have their own unique story and you can see the story of the game from their point of view. Talk to any person, ask any question you like, they will answer and think they are alive

title: Cessate il Fuoco/Heathcliff
description: A digital simulator of the handheld of the same name.

title: Donkey Kong "Special Edition"
description: A second simulator by the same creator for the Game & Watch Multi Screen port of Donkey Kong. This version has additional features.

title: Donkey Kong II
description: A digital simulator based on the Game & Watch Multi Screen handheld under the same name.

title: Tear Ripple
description:
Please see what i can't see. say the word that i can't say
A letter from me to you

title: The Raphael Parable
description:
The Raphael Parable is a community-made modification for The Stanley Parable, being the most popular mod created for the game along with Experiment 427 and the Escape Pod Ending Overwrite Mod.

The Raphael Parable expands the Office to contain several new areas, new visual assets such as furniture, and new Narrator dialogue. Unlike the main game, The Raphael Parable only contains two endings.

title: Matchbox's Pizza Adventure
description: A Short Pixel-Art Platformer Game!

title: Experiment 427
description:
Experiment 427 is a free modification for The Stanley Parable. During development, the modification got abandoned and never got finished. There is a beta version, however.
The mod begins when a player activates the Confusion Ending and clicks on the Confusion Schedule. The player is then teleported out of the map on the opposite side of the Confusion Schedule and begins a new adventure. The mod was also going to customize the game's textures, add new objects, change the main plot, and add new rooms.

title: Raining City: Millions Recollections
description: One night, Luxuan woke up soaked in blood, a mysterious black hole in the palm of her hand – and millions pouring out of that hole, like an unstoppable fountain of wealth. Still in shock, Luxuan has to evade the monsters that rushed to her and her new riches. A strange story begins in a gloomy city…

title: Restore
description: In this RPG, take on the role of Shouichi, who is summoned to another world alongside Azuha and Emily. With your abilities sealed, you'll need to rely on your wits and teamwork to survive. Will you be able to protect your friends and get them back home safely?

title: Currents
description:
Currents is a puzzle game about guiding ships on the open ocean.
Dodge rocks, swing on whirlpools, and outrun pirates, using only ocean currents!
And for added challenge, try to complete each level under par!

title: The Destiny Star of Girlfriend: Episode of Fujiko
description: A mini-episode of Destiny Star Girlfriend for the sub-heroine Yonamine Fujiko.

title: Five Nights with Mac Tonight 2
description:
Ever since the Mac Tonight commercials came in, McDonald's has been swarming with Customers for their new night hourly openings. One McDonald's made so much profit, they decided to step up their advertising and order a set of new animatronics to entertain the customers while they eat! That's where you come in.
The animatronics were recently shipped to a Storage Facility that McDonald's owns that keeps old belongings in there from the past moments. The animatronics are as of now being stored in there until the Staff at the McDonald's get the place set up properly before the Animatronics arrivals.
You're were hired to work in their Warehouse due to word that people have been breaking into the Warehouse, and stealing or even vandalising the property.
These animatronics were spent a fortune on, and McDonald's cannot afford having parts of them stolen or even destroyed. Don't let anyone get in.

title: Destiny 2: Echoes
description: An aurora spreads across the stars, and from within its shimmering confines, a mysterious object materializes and falls to the surface of Nessus. Travel to the planet and begin your search for this object, known only as an Echo.

title: StarCraft: Evolution Complete
description: StarCraft: Evolution Complete is a full remake of StarCraft: Brood War, including the campaigns and all 3 races with all of their units, buildings, abilities, researches, upgrades and art.

title: Ribbit Rampage
description: An arcade-style top-down shooter where your only weapon is your froggy tongue. Eat hoardes of enemy insects in frantic, high-precision fights that demand clever decision-making. Don't get surrounded - it's one hit and you're croaked.

title: Flintlock: The Siege of Dawn - Deluxe Edition
description: The Flintlock: The Siege of Dawn – Deluxe Edition includes the base game and three customization packs for Nor.

title: Lexibble
description: The first release from Finger Games Studio. It's a word game with roguelike mechanics that allow you to improve your letters to score the maximum points.

title: Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite & Beyond
description: A mod conversion of MVC:I that overhauls the functionality, art, and playstyle of general characters in the game, including the addition of a new 4-player, 2v2 mode where all 4 characters actively fight on-screen at the same time.

title: Sword and Plow
description:
An RPG mixed with a gardening game!

Can a farmer slay an evil dragon?
Grow and eat your food to gain strength
Drag items with the left mouse button.
Use and equip items in your inventory with a right click. Drag seeds onto the farm plot squares to either side of your inventory to grow crops.

title: Trabi Racer
description: On streets in Poland and all of Europe we can still see these cars. With Trabi Racer you can expierience racing with this cultic machine. Characteristic sound of engine, box-shaped view, 5 car versions and tuned supermachines from the beggining of 1980!.

title: Funny Racer
description: Funny Racer is a 3D kart racing game for young audiences. Funny Racer requires time, skills and great agillity, because opponents are really crazy!

title: Love Eternal
description: Wander a castle built of bitter memories in Love Eternal, a psychological horror platformer with devious trials and an unsettling, experimental narrative. Find a way out - or live in Shelter forevermore.

title: Auld Lang Syne: Cat and Mouse
description:
Auld Lang Syne: Cat and Mouse is a visual novel made in RPG Maker VX Ace.

It's a Granblue Fantasy fangame about two Zodiacs of many years in the past.

You don't need to know much about Granblue Fantasy, only that its setting is a world of floating islands with its own fantasy races, and that there's a group of characters inspired on the Chinese Zodiac/the Twelve Divine Generals.

With the exception of the minor NPCs and Dormouse, it's all original characters and story.

title: Kayak VR: Mirage - Soča Valley
description: Explore the beautiful Soča Valley in Slovenia, known for its iconic green water, mountain vistas and lush nature. Take on a new thrilling challenge by paddling down whitewater rapids or explore the nature of this serene valley at your own pace.

title: Pizza Delivery: A Short Thriller
description: A horror/thriller about what may happen when delivering a pizza late at night.

title: Elegy of Fate
description: Embark on a unique RPG journey as a resurrected hero. Obtain the sealed power of a malevolent deity in a ring, evading the pursuit of a goddess. Explore the world, awaken legendary heroes, and shape your destiny with a formidable order of knights. Uncover the long-buried tales of this continent.

title: Multiversus: Season 1 - Puns & Villainy
description: The relaunch of Multiversus comes with a new season. Included are new cometics, maps, and characters such as The Joker, Jason Voorhees, and Banana Guard.

title: Air Garden
description: A tiny cozy idle incremental game where you grow plants and pop bubbles to clean the air.

title: How Would You Survive?
description:
How Would You Survive? is an education program based on the book series of the same name. It covers Egyptians, Aztecs and Vikings. The premise is that it shows children the ropes of the people's lives in those time periods in case the player should become one of them. The program mostly consists of interconnected, narrated slides which contain explanations about the subject in question.

It also contains a quiz. Here the player chooses a difficulty level (which only changes the number of wrong guesses before the game is over) and is presented with 10 multiple-choice questions. The goal is to answer all questions before all wrong guesses are spent. When a wrong answer was chosen, the game creates a link to the appropriate slide. After reading it, the player can switch to the quiz and try again. Normally the quiz covers only one time period except for the masterquiz option which is about all three periods.

title: Street Cleaner 3
description: In this 8 bit retro action platformer sequel, you play as the eponymous Street Cleaner taking back the streets of San Diego from punks, ninjas, and now some weird spooky creatures! You're not alone, though. You can switch at will between the Street Cleaner, whip wielding rival turned ally Cogex, and high-school girl brawler Honoko who each bring their own attacks and abilities.

title: Misericorde Volume Two: White Wool and Snow
description:
Sister Hedwig is having a bad time.

It wasn't long ago that the Mother Superior dragged her out of her cell, forcing Hedwig to break her oath to God as an Anchoress and face the outside world. Acting as a spy for the leader of Linbarrow Abbey, Hedwig was given one seemingly simple task: Discover who really murdered Sister Catherine.

Hedwig has tried her best, but she is no closer to solving the mystery. Things just keep getting more and more complicated: Why can't any of the Sisters give her a straight answer about what happened the night of the murder? Who--or what--is the mysterious figure that haunts the abbey? And just who was Sister Catherine?

In White Wool & Snow, Sister Hedwig must steel herself. Time is running out, and so is sympathy for her situation. It's understandable that being thrust into the waking world after a life of quiet reflection as an anchoress would require some adjustment, but if Hedwig wants to save an innocent man she will have to get serious fast. Can she navigate increasingly difficult social situations, maintain her cover, and make the progress the Superior demands?

title: Fun Fruit Merge
description:
A different take on the highly popular watermelon merging game.

A casual game where the goal is to merge different fruits to get the watermelon, it takes inspiration from the merge 3 puzzle game format and adds it's own twist.

title: Re;Lord 3: The Demon Lord of Groessen and The Final Witch
description:
This is the third and final episode in Escu:de’s Re;Lord series. Following the liberation of Herford and Cologne, Iris was captured by Adler’s Jäger unit. Since she possessed too much sensitive information to fall into enemy hands, including the concealment of his own magic and plans for a rebellion, Wilfried pursued them into Greiz instead of going after the third witch.

Greiz is a middle-sized city in the center of Groesen, and it is home to the capitol. However, there were no trains entering the castle town, and the hustle and bustle of the past was eerily missing. Surprisingly, it was also under the territory of the third witch. He was forced to fight on two fronts, as fate also seemed to conspire against him. Wilfried’s final battle has begun.

title: Hastafa Invaders
description: Hastafa Invaders combines intense arcade shooter action with a rich storyline and dynamic characters. Players are immersed in the conflict between the Azure Dominion and the Crimson Legion, experiencing the thrill of aerial combat while unraveling the fate of the enigmatic planet Hastafa.

title: Squaretrail: Lines of The Frame
description: Squaretrail: Lines of The Frame is a puzzle and adventure game where you progress by rotating square-shaped worlds. Your main character is a cube and you have to overcome different challenges in each level.

title: Overwatch 2: Season 11 - Super Mega Ultrawatch
description: Gear up for an epic showdown as Ultrawatch faces mythic Calamity Empress Ashe, celebrate 100 million heroes with the return of Pink Mercy discover ancient mystique and modern technology in the new Runasapi map, and more!

title: Silly.tiff
description: The official sequel to Sunky.MPEG!

title: Color Snake
description: A mix of Snakes and Colours for an exciting gameplay experience!

title: Shopping Clutter: Winter Break
description: All kinds of holidays are coming up… from winter festivities to celebrations of love! Can you ensure everything goes off without a hitch?

title: Shopping Clutter: Spring Blossom
description: Whether you’re helping Auntie Sheep decorate her flower shop, or serving delicious coffee in the mornings… Animalville needs you!

title: Shopping Clutter: Halloween Mystery
description: An antique store transformed into Dracula’s lair… a thief in the town of Animalville… what’s next?!

title: Frog Jumper
description: Jump into our latest game and guide a lively frog across a pond. Test your timing and skill as you hop from lily pad to lily pad. Play now and discover how high you can soar!

title: Poopy Time
description: Don't get caught by the guards, you little vandal!

title: Football 2024 Journey
description: Tile matching game

title: Dead Station 2
description:
Humanity has colonized the Moon and Mars. The search for extraterrestrial civilizations is among the main ideas of man. For the purpose of a more detailed study of space, as well as the search for other civilizations, research bases are being created. One such base, "TAU-9", was set up on Titan, Saturn's moon.

But one day, "TAU-9" stopped communicating. For this reason, a rescue shuttle was sent to Titan. But approaching the Titan, for some reason, the shuttle loses control...

title: Cowboy Duel: Red Wild West Massacre
description: Enter the lawless world!

title: Nora: The Wannabe Alchemist + Mosaic Chronicles Deluxe
description: Enter worlds full of magic and enchantment with Nora: The Wannabe Alchemist and Mosaic Chronicles Deluxe.

Explore vibrant yet desolate environments teeming with secrets and hidden areas waiting to be discovered. The game rewards curiosity and exploration, offering extra challenge and replayability for those who seek it.

Dive into turn-based combat that allows you to strategize your moves and abilities. Action commands during battles add an interactive element, increasing engagement and rewarding skillful timing. Unique partners with diverse abilities join you on your journey, offering strategic options in both combat and exploration.

A richly crafted narrative unfolds as you explore the world, uncovering its mysteries and meeting unforgettable characters. The game’s lighthearted atmosphere and humorous tone create a fun and memorable experience.

Intuitive controls and easy-to-understand mechanics make the game welcoming to players of all skill levels. Playful and whimsical art style with a focus on creating a cheerful and inviting atmosphere.

title: Exit16: Byilhan Hotel
description:
"Exit16: Byilhan Hotel" is a "walking simulator" & "Spot the Difference" game. The game challenges players to unravel hidden anomalies strewn across the enigmatic corridor of the Byilhan Hotel.

Each floor of the hotel presents a unique canvas, with some adorned by the peculiarities of anomalies while others maintain an eerie semblance of normalcy. Your task is to discern the subtle nuances that distinguish the ordinary from the extraordinary, as every object, every angle, and every shadow holds a potential clue.
Traverse the hallways with caution, for not all anomalies reveal themselves readily.

If you suspect there is an anomaly, turn back. If you believe everything is normal, that there are no anomalies, do not turn back and continue down the corridor. If you make a mistake, you will know by looking at the level number. If the number has increased, you have made the correct choice. If you return to level 1, you have made a mistake and will need to start over (the anomalies will be different). The goal is to reach the final level.

Navigate the twists and turns of the Byilhan Hotel, unraveling its mysteries one anomaly at a time.

description: "Hetu" is an ink painting-style CCG themed around cultivation. In the game, players build decks based on the unique characteristics of heroes from three races: Humans, Monsters, and Gods, to compete in battles.

title: Mystopia
description: Mystopia is a relaxing sandbox game about building your own worlds and crafting magical potions. Discover blocks inspired by witchcraft, use potions for mystifying effects and build your dream worlds! The only limit is your imagination!

title: Undo The Jam Damage
description: Bruce's love for PB&J sandwiches has entangled him in a spellbinding predicament. Venture into the enchanted forest to help Bruce lift the witch’s curse. Tread carefully, though—the woods are fraught with dangers for the unprepared.

title: Transit Loop
description: Escape from an Anomalous Looping Subway through the Appropriate Exit.

title: Versus Purgatory
description: Versus Purgatory is a micro-roguelike shoot-em-up with mind-bending gameplay inwhich you delve into a dungeon, controlling two characters at the same time.

title: Artificial Gravity Cat
description: 2D physics platformer! Control a cat in space and gravity itself!

title: Fantasy Shootoff
description: Fantasy Shootoff is a free PvPvE fantasy game where you fight against enemy npcs or have a duel with your friends on one big map filled with crazy weapons, story and much more. Play Single player and level up your character or jump into Multiplayer and kill enemies or just hang out with others

title: Lunar Eclipse
description: Ealish, the sole survivor, hides in the shadows, seeking shelter from the merciless creatures that now dominate this devastated world. Immerse in the grim atmosphere of what’s happening. Fight for life, create anew, explore the unknown, become a hunter in a world where everyone has become prey!

title: Garden of Táozi
description: In this stylized, 3D sliding block puzzle adventure, play as a cute version of Sun Wukong as he goes on a quest to collect the legendary Golden Peach of Healing! Push blocks and collect peaches to progress forward!

title: The Lost Compressor
description: A violence-free top-down puzzle adventure for everyone interested in engineering.

title: Path for the Seeker
description: Path For The Seeker is a detective adventure in which a young nun investigates the disappearance of a famous inventor in a city on the border of two worlds.

title: 7th Floor
description: Find your missing daughter in the Hospital of Madness. Collect items, fight enemies, and do whatever it takes to reach her!

title: Welcome Back, Commander
description: Commander, your strike team is to dive deep into the contaminated city of Sun Stone and get some answers before the mysterious deadly plague spreads beyond the city limits. Good luck Commander!

title: Alerta Roja
description: Space-themed action and skill game.

title: Dimensional Phobos Threat
description: Dimensional Phobos Threat You are trapped in a cursed place in this horror investigation game for 1 to 4 players that you can play with your friends. The only way to lift the curse is to search the place and find and destroy the cursed items according to the clues

title: Tamer: King of Dinosaurs
description:
Tamer: King of Dinosaurs - an action/adventure game for people of culture who love dinosaurs, adventure, and harem dating sims featuring beautiful alien women. Complete quests, gather resources, and bond with your lovers while keeping your tribe safe on a deadly primitive world.

Play as Victor Shelby, a Los Angeles animal control officer abducted by aliens and stranded on a deadly dinosaur planet where he must help a group of beautiful alien women survive.

Craft and upgrade weapons like spears, clubs and axes to engage dinosaurs in brutal melee combat with your hunting partner, Sheela. Utilize the adrenaline system to unleash special attacks and even special over-the-top, gore-filled executions.

Tamer: King of Dinosaurs offers a gripping story filled with adventure, an engaging story, and romance.

title: S-Project 66
description: Survive this nightmare by hiding in your surroundings. Be discreet, because death will be final.

title: The Day Of Survival
description: The Day Of Survival Immerse yourself in a post-apocalyptic world where every decision is crucial. "The Day Of Survival" is a thrilling survival game that challenges players to explore a harsh, unforgiving landscape filled with zombies and enemy soldiers.

title: Slimecore
description: SLiMECORE is a squad-based hero shooter featuring a dynamic roguelite augment system. In this ever-shifting battleground, you'll find countless ways to customize and evolve your team's playstyle.

title: Necromage
description: Be a necromancer who can learn to summon any creature from the world. Level up and equip your minions by crafting enchanted spells to use on them. All this takes place in an isometric action-RPG with intense combat and powerful bosses that will require your army of minions to defeat.

title: Rogue Rollout
description: Rogue Rollout is a roguelike deckbuilder where you score points in a Yahtzee-style dice game, choose powerful artifacts, and face challenging impairments as you push through endless levels.

title: Dash n Cry
description: DASH n CRY is a fast-paced, challenging 2D Precision Platformer game for those who want to put their skills to their limits. Jump and dash your way through a young astronaut's training routine inside his spaceship.

title: Qazaq: Son of the Sun
description: Qazaq: Son of the Sun - a single-player first-person open-world game with puzzles set in Kazakhstan, where you are the last surviving Qazaq saved by the Sun God.

title: Jigs4w3D: Puzzle Challenge
description: Jigs4w3D Puzzle Challenge is a casual single-player experience. Chill, enjoy the immersive 3D environments and complete a fine selection of your favourite puzzles. Choose from different categories and solve all 20 puzzles on 5 difficulty settings for completely free or grab your favourite DLC.

title: Jigs4w3D: Loft Office Environment DLC
description: Jigs4w3D Puzzle Challenge is a casual single-player experience. Chill, enjoy this immersive 3D environment and complete a fine selection of your favourite puzzles. How would that feel solving puzzles at work after all your colleagues went home? Try it now in the Loft Office Environment DLC.

title: Jigs4w3D: Futuristic Apartment Environment DLC
description: Jigs4w3D Puzzle Challenge is a casual single-player experience. Chill, enjoy this immersive 3D environment and complete a fine selection of your favourite puzzles. How would that feel solving puzzles far from the noise of a bustling city? Try it now in the Futuristic Apartment Environment DLC.

title: Jigs4w3D: My Photos DLC
description: Jigs4w3D Puzzle Challenge is a casual single-player experience. Chill, enjoy the immersive 3D environments and complete a fine selection of your favourite puzzles. How would that feel solving puzzles generated by your own photos? Search no further and try it now in the My Photos DLC.

title: Olympics Go! Paris 2024
description:
Participate in 12 games and build a city around Olympic venues.

Featuring archery, artistic gymnastics, athletics - 100m, basketball, breaking, cycling track, fencing, golf, rowing, shooting - skeet, skateboard - park, and swimming - 100m freestyle.

title: Neon World Maker
description: Neon World Maker is a platformer and game creation system. Players can design their own levels and maps using the editor and share with friends.

title: Och Noe: Thegame
description: OCH NOE -thegame- is a zombie survival shooter type game, but is also meant to be kinda funny. As the player you must try to stay alive for 15 minutes.

title: Wakey Wakey
description: Wakey Wakey is a Puzzle Platformer with a unique world-bending twist. Navigate your everchanging bedroom, take control of new household objects, and overcome surprising obstacles to help this sleepy guy get a good night's rest.

title: Harry Potter: Skurge Challenge
description: Skurge Challenge was a small 2D mini-game that was coming with promotional CDs Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets video game. That CD was also including screensavers, wallpapers and demo versions of first two Harry Potter games. After completing Skurge Challenge the players could get access to a secret level within Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets video game. The secret level can be also be accessed by using the debug mode

title: Gummy Nightmares
description: Step into the enigmatic world of Gummy Nightmares as a little boy who wakes up in a mysterious amusement park with no memory. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover lost memories while evading sinister plushie robots. Use weapons, set traps, and find hideouts to survive and reveal the truth

title: Joyville 2
description: Joyville 2 is a first-person horror-puzzle adventure game set in an abandoned children's camp. You will explore the camp and encounter its magical inhabitants. By solving puzzles and overcoming challenges, you will travel between two parallel worlds, uncovering the secrets of this enigmatic...

title: Swampify
description: A top-down puzzle game where you place hexagon tiles to build a river and restore a swamp ecosystem

title: Shovel Knight: Dig - Fate and Fortune
description: The Fate and Fortune update is packed with even more adventure, including a brand new challenging quest called Knightmare Mode, sweet mementos to unlock and show off in the HUB, and tons of quality of life improvements to make your journey even smoother. We can't wait for you to dive back into Shovel Knight's epic journey and experience this expansive and FREE addition to the game.

title: Shovel Knight: Dig - Wicked Wishes
description: Be careful what you wish for as you climb the ranks at Hoofman's Adventurer's Guild, where a plethora of quests and mysteries await! Discover new Relics, mini-games, Accessories, secrets, and crucial gameplay enhancements, too! We can't wait for you to dive back into Shovel Knight's epic journey and experience this expansive and FREE addition to the game.

title: Shovel Knight: Shovel of Hope DX
description: Shovel Knight: Shovel of Hope DX is an enhanced edition of the pixel-perfect adventure. Jump, battle foes, and dig up treasure as you quest to defeat the Order of No Quarter and The Enchantress. DX adds 20 playable characters, online multiplayer, and new features like rewind and save states.

title: Lust for Lucre
description: Lust For Lucre is a fantasy-themed match-3 dating sim combining strip monster battles and dungeon exploration. Romance 14 unique damsels and explore perilous dungeons. Use your lust and lucre to upgrade stats and acquire powerful items in this adult adventure.

title: Sword Phantom
description: A high speed stylish Action Game about 2 girls in the future world! Use your gun, sword, and fist to finish the enemy and save the world! The game also contains many equips and underwears to dress up your character.

title: Home: Mother
description: The "HOME" series is a miniature word game based on different native family backgrounds. Explore each room, collect information clues through solving puzzles and finding objects, and infer and restore the protagonist's secrets and life story.

title: Cybercum 2069
description: CYBERCUM 2069 - is an erotic game in the genre of "Arkanoid", in which you will have to break the cubes and gradually discover really beautiful and hot images.

title: Super Sized Rescue Squad
description: Super sized Rescue Squad is a high energy 2D Platformer where you run, jump, and try to rescue as many little civilians as possible. All while fighting an evil cult hell bent on world domination.

title: DragonMirrored with Hyoga & Magma
description: The two dragons, the main characters, move symmetrically during the puzzle as if they are mirror images of each other. Over 300 puzzles appear in the game. As the game progresses, various gimmicks appear one after another.

title: Girls of The Tower: Journey To Chaos
description: In "Girls of The Tower: Journey To Chaos" ,players can choose a character to embark on the adventure of chaos. In battles, players can use original monsters as minions to fight, and equipped items will gain more powerful abilities through enchantment.

title: SOVL: Ratkin Clans
description: This is a Faction Pack for SOVL - Fantasy Warfare. It adds the Ratkin Clans faction to the game.

title: Not an Aim Trainer
description: A young girl escapes into new realities through video games and her art, adventuring through different aim training scenarios; she aims to be the best.

title: Holy Grain
description: Holy Grain is an absurd and hilarious roguelike, packed with tons of events, crazy battles, and one simple goal: blindly follow the counselor's orders. Your army's gonna have your back as you smash through those objectives, and the entity will always be there to protect you.

title: Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Emote Expansion Set: I Work Out
description: This pack includes new emotes for characters to use. • Push-ups • Sit-ups • Squats

title: Dungeon Full Dive: True Supporter Dice
description: This special pack features uniquely designed digital dice, crafted exclusively for our most dedicated supporters. Ideal for collectors and enthusiasts looking to add a touch of exclusivity to their gameplay.

title: Cazzarion: Portal Pilot
description: Fly through Portals in a city but don't collide with any obstacle!

title: A House 4 Alesa
description:
Rpg Maker horror about a social worker trapped in a house of horrors.
4th game in the series (excluding the remake) and direct sequel to A House for Alesa 3

title: Learn to Play Vol. 3: Mice Love Cheese
description:
We all know that mice really love cheese.

Guide the little mouse through 30 short levels and help her collect all the cheese pieces on the way. Watch out for tiny holes in the floor. If your mouse falls inside, you have to start the level from the beginning.

Complete all 30 levels for victory. A short and fun experience that can be enjoyed by players of all ages.

title: Rocket League: Season 15
description:
Rocket League gets a punk rock makeover for the “SoCal” Season 15! Swerve into Salty Fest and start breaking conventions.

Put your hands, horns, and cars in the air and make some noise for the launch of Rocket League Season 15! This Season sounds off on June 5.
⁠
⁠In Season 15, hit the ground spinning on a grassier new variant of Salty Shores. Just take it easy on the donuts as you tear up the field with Rocket League’s newest sports cars!

title: Space Planet Invader: Cosmic Power
description: Defend, Build, Conquer Unleash Your Cosmic Power

title: BeatRider
description: Mioi and the others, as apprentice Tuners, embarked on a six-month investigation in Baixiang City. As their mission progressed, the city's normalcy began to unravel, with dissonance and disturbances growing increasingly frequent and severe.

title: Monsterburg
description: What's better than a quintuple bloody burger, or nuggets and fries fried in human fat? You wanna taste? You bet. Just don't forget to wear diapers. If you can eat everything on our menu and make it to the toilet, our monsters are sure to scare the hell out of you !

title: Acrylic Nails!
description:
Step into the world of beautification as you explore the magic of nail art! Choose the length of the client's nail, shape it using a file and then go wild with your choice of nail polishes, patterns and accessories!

You have plenty of possibilities to create stunning acrylic designs thanks to a large range of products. In your beauty salon you will find nail polishes with glitter, fashionable stencils to make gorgeous patterns as well as decorations in many shapes, made of different materials.

Many female clients want to use your amazing services. If they have any requests about the appearance of their nails, fulfill them and you will get the maximum rating of 3 stars!

title: Devil Cult Party
description:
Bring about the doom of mankind, and watch out for competitors!

Human sacrifices, studying the occult, selling merch, bringing back the dead and transforming cultists into demonic abominations is all part of the business. Get to work, the world won't end itself!

title: Wyrm Climb
description: a silly foddian where you control 2 ends of the same wyrm

title: 2Xtreme
description: Experience 2Xtreme originally released on the PlayStation console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Ore no Shikabane wo Koete Yuke
description:
Experience Oreshika originally released on the PSP (PlayStationPortable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Live, die and repeat, in this legendary generation-spanning RPG.

Oreshika is an RPG where you take control of a clan twice-cursed by demon leader Shuten Doji, whose hordes are hell-bent on attacking humans and destroying Kyoto. Join them on their quest to slay Shuten Doji, lift the two curses and bring peace and prosperity to the capital once more.

title: Dontrel Dolphin
description: May Dolphin is in trouble, and Dontrel must save her. Travel across treacherous landscapes as you fight and dodge your way to victory. Use Cannon Caliber, the magical sword, to aid Dontrel during his quest.

title: Blocked-Out!
description: Conceptualized during the development of Hamtex, this is a community project focused on Block-Outs for Classic Doom.

title: Doomium II
description: A sequel to DOOMIUM I, this is a megawad worth of maps that are Short, Straight Forward, and with Frantic Action, from industrial compounds, concrete cities, mountain ranges, fragments of realities, and many more! The megawad contain 6 episodes of 5 maps each with the addition of a secret for each episode, each episode have it's unique theme, including industry, brutalism, and natures, and the classic void levels for the finale episode.

title: Jiffy Bag
description: Jiffy Bag is a collection of 32 random maps made by Jimmy over the last 5 years or so. The maps all vary quite dramatically in theme, and are similar only in terms of size and design - given the short time Jimmy had to make these in, his general approach to mapping is pretty obvious in how each map plays and is structured, but this should hopefully contribute to a well-rounded, consistent end product.

title: Morituri Te Salutant
description: It's time to test your mettle in a Grecco-Roman-ish single adventure map, Morituri Te Salutant! Doomguy has found himself summoned to an ancient, crumbling villa - the court of the Red Emperor. The Emperor is conspicuously absent, but he and his cronies watch with great interest from afar as you rip and tear your way through his tests. Will you make it through the trials, or will you be split from nose to navel? Play and find out.

title: Otherworldly Ossuary
description:
Don't give up skeleton! Fight your way out of space purgatory.
You are already dead, but everything here wants you 7 feet under.

Otherworldly Ossuary﻿ is a small MBF21 single map with cramped puzzle-like combat.

title: Revenge of the Speeddemons!
description: REVENGE of the Speeddemons is the eighteenth Pineapple Under the Sea Speedmapping series event. Featuring 7 maps, each from a unique author, ROTS promises to throw the player headfirst into an action movie of their own starring. Fit snugly into the lead role as you blast your way through hundreds of demons mercenaries across an occupied Earth. The Rowdy Rudy resource pack replaces nearly all of the monster bestiary as well as the majority of the weapons.

title: Crystal Cliffs
description: This is a medium to hard difficulty single map mixing up puzzles and small scale slaughter

title: We Live Inside A Dream
description:
We are like the dreamer who dreams, and then lives inside the dream...but who is the dreamer?

We Live Inside a Dream is a first person interactive experience combining elements of the FPS, horror, puzzle, driving and stealth genres. Experience the uncanny town of Snoqualmie: The Hotel, Double R Diner, The Sheriffs Department, The Convenience Store, The Red Room and much more.

Uncover the mystery of the missing Deputy and answer the question of...who is the dreamer?...but be cautious as the road may not even lead you there...

title: Plants vs. Zombies: Garden Warfare - Zomboss Down
description: Zomboss Down features a brand new Gardens & Graveyards map "Cactus Canyon," where Zombies have crash landed in the desert and need to fight their way to a local golf course and destroy a secret Plant facility located under the 18th hole. 8 new characters have also been added as well as hundreds of new CRAAAZY customization items to collect! In addition, this pack also contains hundreds of tuning/balance changes, and bug fixes.

title: Lost Chakras
description: A physics-based puzzle game made for all ages.

title: Project Walker
description: Attempt to escape the maze while being hunted by the Walkers.

title: Reverse Snake Extreme
description: Classic game of snake but with a twist. Control the food and try not to get eaten or touch the lava. Survive for four minutes and win or die trying.

title: Wild Eclipse
description: Help Pieto traverse dangerous terrain and avoid the natural disasters thrown at him.

title: Bunker Game
description: A short, post-apocalypse, story-driven point-and-click game about companionship and legacy.

title: Oyasumii
description: Relive the nostalgia with Oyasumii, a horror and exploration game inspired by PSX and N64 classics. Enter liminal spaces and face surreal terrors in an adventure that challenges your skills and sanity. Are you ready to relive the golden age of video games with Oyasumii?

title: Sonic Nexus
description: Sonic Nexus was a game created by Nexus Team, headed by Slingerland. The game used the Retro Sonic engine by The Taxman who joined the project in 2008. The game began development in the summer of 2006 and had three demo releases, two at the Sonic Amateur Games Expo and one during the summer of 2008. It is a critically acclaimed fangame, garnering comments such as, "absolute perfection of the classic Sonic style" from SAGE visitors and various blogs. The character lineup consisted of Sonic, Tails, and Knuckles.

title: Murderlings
description: Control a murder of crows and hunt prey before you starve to death. A finished version of its game jam prototype for IndieCade's Community Jam 2015. The theme was cooperation.

title: Loser Simulator
description: The game "Loser Simulator" invites players to plunge into the life of an ordinary person named Bari, for whom everything goes awry. We have to help him overcome a series of failures and ridiculous situations in one day.

title: Otome Sekai no Arukikata
description: Set in a near-future Japan after its society became completely dominated by women due to the rampancy of radical feminists and the country introducing the "Gender Segregation Act" decades ago, you are Katagiri Yui, originally a child soldier in the defense forces who eventually got to hid in a remote village under a fake identity, who is ordered by Mother, an social management AI, to attend the training school of the Security Force, a women's armed forces with your adoptive sister.

title: Dontrel Dolphin 2
description: Mr. Grim has stolen 60 power gems from the palace, and he also captured a lovely dolphin by the name of May. Dontrel arrives at the palace to recover the gems throughout the realm in an epic quest to save his girlfriend. Here is where the action starts.

title: Rectangulong
description: A silly game about hitting a ball back and forth. Play against a friend or a computer in 12 levels awesome style.

title: Britney Spears' Theme Park
description: A fan game for the pop icon of the century

title: ZDog Hotel Hero Z
description: ZDog Hotel Hero Z is a game where a dog must fight in a hotel to collect as many bones as possible within a minute

title: Subject:Love
description:
Love. A feeling coveted by writers and detested by those who live by logic.

A natural sensation that arises at the most unexpected moment to bring out the best in you.

But what happens when someone who has never felt it before tries to understand it? How far can this person go?

A heartless witch and six confused boys join this journey for an answer.

Now. Will they find love, or will another feel awake inside them?

title: Wonder Ball
description: An action 3D platformer with fast-paced gameplay and low-poly style graphics, inspired by the greatest classics of the genre. Full of platforming levels, combat arenas, many collectibles and secrets. Explore five worlds of Cyberland and save them from the malicious Virus and its army of bots!

title: TomHanksFrThMmrs
description: A Point-and-Click starring Tom Hanks. Made for Hanks Jam.

title: 12 Vengeful Ghosts
description:
12 Vengeful Ghosts is Touhou Project meets 12 Angry Men.

This game is a narrative bullet hell very loosely inspired by the aforementioned film. You play as one of twelve ghosts responsible for deciding the fate of a mortal, but those other ghosts aren't nearly as forgiving as you.

title: Aoki Shinjuku
description:
Shinjuku, 2017. Sharp rise in temperature resulted in flood of huge territories.
Deck runs an "information store" and gets a request to investigate a "NOKIA" program. At the same time a big package is delivered that turns out to be a girl who awakens from Cold Sleep and remembers only Shinjuku of 20th century prior to the huge flood...

title: Myror i Brallan
description: Myror i Brallan [Ants in the Pants] is a Swedish children's game based on the children's TV programme of the same name. The game was published in 2001 by Young Genious.

title: Naisu Gaisu Survivors
description:
Try out this small and charming take on the survivors genre

Fight hordes of enemies and level up to try to beat the final boss.

Every level up you have the choice between:

Getting stronger and choosing from a variety of different power-ups
Adding to your fina lscore multiplier

Balance your strength with your score multiplier to try to gain the highest score possible.

Choose between 5 different starting characters characters and 3 levels.
More characters are there to be unlocked!

title: The Caldecott Caper
description: The lowest form of life in the Sixth World is that of the corporate rent-a-cop. You are paid a paltry wage for the privilege of defending the megacorps' ostentatious wealth from the desperate gangers of the Orkland Sprawl. Enter a world of turmoil, greed, and violence, as you struggle for survival with the help of a few hand-picked allies.

title: LXD: Red Honey
description: A strange machine appeared in the sky, breaking down much of the plant life across the region into their core elements, including your humble garden. Collect and harness the power of these fragments in order to rebuild your world piece by piece. Explore 6 unique areas in order to find and defeat the evil that sought your world's destruction.

title: Dolls' Domain
description: You find yourself in a dollhouse - can you escape, or will you meet your fate? Navigate through the escape room-style puzzles, and avoid being caught by the creatures who exist in this place, and gain your freedom from the dollhouse!

title: 2048 Boys
description: Get your players on the field! Build the strongest team possible!

title: Guess the Flag!
description:
Embark on a global journey with the game “Guess the Flag!”

Test your knowledge of 255 countries, islands and international organizations in 6 addictive modes. Test your memory by matching the flag to the name of a country or play the reverse mode. If you are already an expert in flag knowledge, you can try the mode in which you have to write the name of the country yourself. Feel the thrill of matching locations to a country and, for a change, immerse yourself in the unpredictable random mode that combines all the challenges.

title: Hentai Games Collection
description: Meet fantastic girls in the biggest bundle of the hentai games along with all DLCs.

title: Itazura Madness
description: Itazura Madness is an first-person cartoony roguelike with 4 playable characters, 7 bosses, 100+ items and 60+ weapons

title: Basic Platformer
description: A platformer with puzzle elements made for the Vircon32 virtual console.

title: BFDI: Branches
description: BFDI: Branches is an all-new platformer game with Firey, Leafy, Coiny, and Pin! Featuring multiple characters with varied gameplay, a story mode with branching paths, a complete level editor, and an online level browser!

title: Run Forrest Run
description: A side-scrolling Puzzle 'n' Run made for the Hanks Jam

title: Nonogram Animals
description: Use your logic to paint beautiful images in this relaxing puzzle. The gorgeous visuals and relaxing soundtrack will help you forget all your problems and have a great time!

title: Drifto: Infinite Touge
description: No campaign, no cutscenes, just beautifully simple scenery and a whole lot of tyre smoke. How far can you get?

title: Died
description: Survive amidst colleagues turned into monsters due to a virus leak in this horror game. Explore the 10-floor underground lab to uncover the secrets.

title: Dice Player One: Trailer
description: "Dice Player One" is a roguelike strategy game where dice reign supreme! Roll your dice, seize pivotal moments, and transform limited chances into boundless opportunities. Conquer challenges, unearth hidden secrets, and master the art of dice manipulation!

title: GameLib
description: GameLib is an application that brings together several 3D multiplayer mini-games, such as Werewolves Online, Ludo, Connect 4 (4 in a row). GameLib features an in-app voice chat function, so you can communicate with other players during the game.

title: For Whom the Stars Shine
description: "Some stories are best told to none," she whispered. Long ago, the stars disappeared. Then, a man returned them. Few would believe such a thing; fewer still can recall how he bent heaven's ear. However, you won't find the tale in books or archives—only in the hearts of those who were there.

title: Pennon and Battle
description: "Pennon and Battle" is a turn-based strategy war game. As a lord, you will play a crucial role in the revival of the kingdom! Lead heroes and armies to expand territory in Ruachland, utilize tactics and magic to eliminate enemy forces, and create your own legend!

title: Project: Cube
description: Project: Cube is an asymmetrical 1vAll action party game set in a simulation world. If you are the Survivor, your goal is to survive the time. If you are a killer, your goal is to kill everyone within the time.

title: Flying Tobacco Eggs
description: Welcome to the exciting world of Flying Tobacco Eggs, an exciting arcade game with pixel graphics and addictive gameplay!

title: MoonMan Adventures
description: Lunar was on a routine mission when something went wrong. He crashed on a hostile planet and must now find a way home.

title: Call Me Hero
description: Players will transform into the male protagonist Lin Feng, meet three beautiful women with vastly different appearances and personalities, and embark on an exciting love journey with them, becoming their heroes in the process.

title: Getting There
description: Getting There is a narrative adventure game telling the story of the world after what is only known as The Collision. After the death of her lover Kirsten, Lauren gets in her van and journeys across the strange and quiet world in search of civilisation.

title: Jaro Adventures
description: Jaro adventures is a 2d action/adventure platformer. You play as a character Jaro and through levels try to defeat enemies that get in your way. Try to collect as many coins as those will buy you character upgrades.

title: Two Doors
description: Immerse yourself in a gripping horror game where you repeatedly enter the same room. Spot subtle changes and choose the correct door to advance. With 3 difficulty levels, this game offers a thrilling challenge for every player. Will you survive the nightmare?

title: Nowhere Near
description: Do you believe in ghosts? As a skeptical video blogger, you will travel to France to one of the most cursed places - the abandoned Lagarde psychiatric hospital. Will you be able to capture something. or someone.

title: Resonating Worlds
description: Resonating Worlds is a Turn-based strategy game, with a lot of Character customization and progression. Mysterious towers have appeared in the world of Atuhm. These towers are a connection between worlds. But the towers bear a dark secret, that waits to be uncovered...

title: Tour de Drone
description: Tour de Drone - Race Your drone around A.I. enhanced 3D photorealistic holographic paintings of locations from around the world.

title: Brick Breaker Infinity
description: Break bricks, collect power-ups, endless levels for high scores. Test your skills, adaptability, and strategy. Addictive and fun! Let's play!

title: Z-Factor
description: Story-driven RPG with survival elements. Open seamless world, first person view. Adventures on an island where intelligent life has been destroyed by a zombie virus.

title: Rogue Defense
description: The first of its kind, a Tower Defense Roguelike. Unlock, build, upgrade, expand, and defend with a continuously expanding path from multiple directions which you can influence.

title: Cute Dogs Slide
description: Cute Dogs Slide is a fun game where you rearrange tiles to complete adorable dog pictures. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts, it challenges your skills and offers a delightful experience with each cute dog image you solve. Ideal for all ages!

title: Garden Paradise
description: "Garden Paradise" is a casual and relaxing game that you can freely design your ideal garden by dragging and placing various units. The game offers a wide variety of unit types and you combine these elements to create unique garden layouts.

title: Solridge
description: Solridge is an educational video game aligned with third-grade Common Core competencies. As the player, you will obtain gold by helping the townsfolk with their problems. If you want to save the village from disaster, you must continue gathering gold and growing stronger!

title: Parse-O-Rhythm
description: Parse-O-Rhythm is a rhythm game about slashing errors in files to fix them. Slice and dice your way through files with nothing but the mouse and two buttons!

title: Rust Rivalry
description: A futuristic sci-fi first person shooter where combatants fight for the fate of their home.

title: Persnippety
description: Never lose a clipboard snippet again. Easily copy, paste, and sync text and images from your clipboard.

title: Abrakajumpa
description: Jump your way to the top!

title: Future Swashbuckler
description: This is a swordplay game in which you fight well for five days to get a good evaluation from your employer. You fight by switching between controlling two characters.

title: Nakamers: La Huida
description: Escapa del colapso de una civilización que está a punto de extinguirse. Acompaña a Xioon en busca de su familia perdida mientras intentas ponerte a salvo de los desprendimientos y sorteando los ríos de lava. Sumérgete en una historia épica llena de emociones.

title: Codename: God
description: Randall is your typical nerdy kid living a normal, unexciting life in the 80s. Secretly in love with the most popular girl in school and bullied by the soccer team gang, one day he meets you, a divine entity who can change everything!

title: Ima Survivor
description: IMA SURVIVOR - Shipwrecked on a remote island, You have to try to survive on Your own.

title: Shadow of Pharos
description: Shadow of Pharos is a short first-person horror game.

title: Troma Presents Poultrygeist
description: Crack the case of a chicken massacre and prevent a town of lawn mower lovers and suburban chicken farmers from destroying each other while managing a looming magical threat.

title: Confidential Mission
description: Join the fight and make your mark in the battle for global peace in Confidential Mission.

title: SOF: Enemy from the future
description: Lead the SOF squad and defend the world against alien invasion! Engage in thrilling turn-based battles and uncover the mysteries of enigmatic extraterrestrials. Your time has come – join the fight and safeguard our future!

title: Starlines
description: Explore the galaxy along with a beautiful girl and imbibed incredible feeling from the exciting brain of your gameplay.

title: Dead for Dread
description: Dead for Dread is an exciting game in which you take on the role of a brave hero who goes into the dark labyrinths to retrieve a stolen artifact. Embark on a dangerous journey through mysterious dungeons full of mysteries and sinister creatures.

title: Mechieval
description: The twilight of the plague-ravaged Middle Ages. Pilot a five-story-high mech, unleashing torrents of ammunition, dancing with magic, and hunting the demons spreading pestilence in this frenzied top-down shooter.

title: Figure Adventure
description: "Figure Adventure" is a trendy game with the theme of hand-made figures, which integrates card cultivation and placement and hang-up gameplay!

title: Meow Path
description: A puzzle game in which you have to figure out how to draw a path across the entire board. To lead the cat to its favorite toy

title: Little Herbal Baker
description: Little Herbal Baker is a cozy and laid-back game where you play as Lilia, a novice baker who has freshly arrived in a town called ‘MILKYWOOD’ in the fantastical world. Taking over a bakery formerly managed by a master baker, you are now embarking on your journey to become a master baker.

title: Widen
description:
WIDEN is a psychological horror experience focused on atmosphere, exploration, and story-driven puzzles.
Navigate the city's empty streets, live through past distorted memories, and survive against creatures that feed on fear.

title: Holy Light
description: It is a popular elimination game with its dazzling color matching and extremely smooth visual expression.

title: Project Juggler
description: FPS/Task Management Action Game

title: Tehnodrom
description: "Tehnodrom" offers exciting gameplay, a variety of enemies and weapons, and the ability to make strategic decisions that affect the course of the game. The game is intended for fans of casual games in the 2D platform style who love challenges and want to test themselves as a brave tehnodrom pilot.

title: Crimson Capes
description: Crimson Capes is a soulslike Action-RPG taking place in a Sword & Sorcery setting. Engage in fluid 2D pixel art swordplay, hunt witches, track monsters and experience the age of high adventure.

title: Roll Five
description: Roll Five is the dice game roguelike. Play this exciting deckbuilder where you compose creative dice figures, discover your favorite prisms, all in a pixel art medieval fantasy ambiance.

title: Where wh..?
description: "Where wh..?" ("何处") is a point and click puzzle game based on Lowpoly art style, you need to find the different and hidden resources in the screen, travel through nine worlds, explore the unknown areas, various gameplay, melodious music, suitable for all people to get started easily.

title: Hunt Me
description: HUNT ME is a co-op horror survival game for 1-4 players. Gather the ingredients for the ritual, weaken the threat and banish it. Be careful, you're also the prey!

title: Cat Memories - Find the Hidden Stories
description: Explore a surreal handcrafted world in Hidden Kitties Memories. Find lost souls of kitties and help them remember their favorite moments with their humans. Each discovery transforms the kitty and reveals its touching memory. Immerse yourself in this unique hidden object adventure.

title: Alien Strike: Blasting the Intruders
description: The earth has been invaded by aliens, and even though they are still in training, a group of soldiers are trying to save their city while trying to understand why it happened so quickly.

title: ZombCube
description: ZombCube is a first-person, cross-platform, zombie survival, wave based game. Play solo or with friends all over the world destroying the evil ZombCube's. Use teamwork, leadership, and skills to be the best and rank on the leaderboards.

title: Times Tables Games
description: Get ready to multiply the fun with Times Tables Games!

title: Rolldown
description: Race against your friends in this fast paced and exciting game. The goal is simple: be the first ball to roll down to the bottom of the hill.

title: Rubber Sharks
description: Plunge into the tranquil existence of the sweet poolside life with the amazing company of peaceful Rubber Sharks. This adventure invites you to revel in the bliss of your cherished poolside sanctuary. But could there be a mystery hidden in this peaceful scene, or even more?

title: Escape From Castle Frankenstein
description: Escape from Castle Frankenstein is a thrilling platformer game where you play as Frankenstein's monster, a creation desperate to flee the dark halls of Dr. Frankenstein's ominous castle. Will you outsmart Dr. Frankenstein and gain your freedom, or will you be trapped within these walls forever?

title: The Great Adventures of Nedmapagmahal
description: Action rage game that will test your limits

title: Air Sea Modern Conflict
description: Dive into the heart-pounding action of "Air Sea Modern Conflict," an exhilarating game where you take direct control of powerful ships and aircraft to annihilate waves of relentless enemies. As a skilled commander, you'll pilot various naval vessels, from agile destroyers and stealthy submarines to massive aircraft carriers, each armed with an array of devastating weapons. Take to the skies with an impressive selection of aircraft, including nimble fighters, heavy bombers, drones and versatile helicopters, to dominate both land and sea.

title: Agnostiko Origins
description:
Welcome to 1890's steampunk Philippines.
where there are mysterious monsters roaming around manila
What you will encounter here is based on Philippine Mythology
You will play the role of the "man in the red scarf"
explore the mysterious mansion and discover the truth behind this nightmare
Inspired by 90s 16bit art style
from the characters to the background everything is created
in style using pixel art like the 4th generation consoles.
A Filipino Metroidvania game that features Filipino Folklore like Aswang, Kapre, Tikbalang, Manananggal, duwende, whitelady and more.

title: AneeMate
description:
AneeMate is a PvPvE creature extraction shooter where survival means more than just staying alive—you must rescue, evolve, and fight for the future of the AneeMates. Built in Unreal Engine 5, this high-intensity adventure blends exploration, combat, and AI-driven strategy, creating a dynamic and unpredictable battleground.

Explore, Catch, Level Up—Decide the Fate of AneeMates

title: Gunnel Vision
description:
Gunnel Vision was made in 3 days for the Blockjam on Humble Bundle and was developed by Ludosity. It is now available for free on itch.io and is featured in Scrap Pack 4 on Daniel Remar's website.

Gunnel Vision is all about guns. The more guns the better.
Pick up a gun - shoot a gun. Pick up two guns, shot with two guns. Pick up 100 guns - MAYHEM! In Gunnel Vision you don't need an inventory - use your entire arsenal at once until your vision is blocked by it - with nothing left to see but the enemy dead center.

title: Once a Porn a Time: Porn and Cards
description: Porn and Cards is an adult visual novel/turn-based card game with stunning 2D visuals and a fun, immersive narration in the Galactic Wild West

title: The Isles of the Seven Moons
description: The Isles of the Seven Moons is a First-Person Ritual Sacrifice Adventure where you explore a surreal and relaxing environment while completing an ancient ritual in order to meet the Moon-Sage.

title: Fanastasis
description: A spirit attempts to find its memories.

title: Argus
description: Medieval fantasy game about religion and philosophy, featuring yuri and ossan bromance.

title: Vitris
description: A tetris-clone style puzzle game for the Vircon32.

title: Fierce Soldier
description: A side-scrolling shooter for the Vircon32.

title: 100 Waiting Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in the funny waiting situations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artworks of While Waiting themed locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️ Can you find them all? ️

title: Simple Tennis
description: A Pong clone for Vircon32.

title: 100 Aztec Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in the Azcte-themed with Cats in Ancient World! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of Ancient themed locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.

title: Stray Cats in Cozy Town
description: Welcome to Cozy Town, where every day is International Cat Day! Be a part of a village community where every stray is respected, loved and fed. Explore the charming streets and alleys to discover all the stray cats in this hidden-object game.

title: Click on piña coladas together
description: Can you and your friends find all 100+ piña coladas in this panoramic level?

title: Click On Staplers Together
description:
Can you and your friends find all 100+ staplers in this panoramic level?

Search an incredibly detailed hand-drawn environment for staplers. When you find one, click it to mark it as yours. The game is won once everything has been found, and a scoreboard will be displayed showing who found what. No time limit, just you and your friends. Singleplayer is available too!

title: Search All: Veggies
description: This is a game in the "search for objects" genre in which you need to find all the vegetables in a large location. Vegetables will be located in a variety of places, from the most visible to barely noticeable places

title: Jet Set Radio: MiniMix
description: A year in the making, it's finally here. Jet Set Radio MiniMix v1.0

title: Department of Collections
description: A tasked based fully procedural online co-op sci-fi horror game that can be played both casually or more hardcore. Descend further into the facility using the elevator to discover truths about the facility while avoiding hazards and threats and completing tasks for the Department.

title: Habbo Hotel: Origins
description: Habbo Hotel: Origins is a restored version of the 2005 version of Habbo Hotel with a fresh, community-led approach.

title: Super Smash Bros Ultimate: Judd Hat
Ball Dodge
description:
You are a ball, you must dodge things. It is as easy as that!

Simple one button controls yet still challenging.

title: Cyber Citizen Shockman Zero
description: Experience the revival of a retro but timeless co-op action classic

title: Octopo
description: Octopo exploring the sandy shores. Collect shells scattered across the beach to earn points. Along the way, they'll encounter special items that grant temporary boosts like speed, double coins, or invincibility. But watch out! The beach isn't just a serene playground; it's also home to pesky enemies like snails with shells (slugs) and the occasional bomb dropping from above, ready to explode. With each shell collected and enemy evaded, players strive to achieve the highest score possible, making "Octopo" a thrilling adventure of skill and strategy.

title: I Love Finding Cats & Pups - Collector's Edition
description: Have a pawsome adventure finding cats and pups!

title: So Much Stuff 3: Odds & Ends - Collector's Edition
description: Discover So Much Stuff!

title: Rise & Fall: Online Digital Edition
description: Risse & Fall is a game involving strategic units positioning, territory control and opportunity seizing designed by Christophe Boelinger (Dungeon Twister, Earth Reborn, Archipelago, Living Planet...). Each player leads a nation trying to expand and progress in a fantasy world.

title: The Croaker: The Ice
description: An Ice-Themed Expansion Pack with tons of new levels!

title: Star: M
description: Diverse worlds, diverse battlefields, diverse gameplay, diverse appreciation, and diverse fun!

title: Queen of The Hill
description: You are a Queen Ant who has taken her colony's survival into her own hands. Fight off hoards of enemies while also being a good mother Hatch swarms of (questionably intelligent) children to gather food for the nest Aid your swarm as it grows up big and strong

title: Cyberpunk Inquisitor
description: The world's first rogue-lite point-and-click adventure! As an Inquisitor in a dystopian cyberpunk world, enter a Megabuilding and solve the immersive, procedurally-generated murders within. Talk to witnesses, collect evidence, identify the culprit and unmask the truth!

title: Skylark 64
description: A 64-bit 3D Collect-a-thon Platformer where you play as A flying squirrel who can glide, run, jump and roll in open non-linear levels collecting Acorns, Soul Leaves and 7 pieces of armor with unique power-ups! You can even play with a friend in Split-Screen Co-op!

title: Project Evolve
description: Take control of Azula in this action-packed beat-em-up adventure game, where you will recover your abilities as you progress through the simulation. Use close combat attacks and powerful electrical strikes to defeat your enemies and reach the end!

title: The Hardest Game in the Universe: DLC 3
description: The DLC 3 for "The Hardest Game in the Universe" has arrived, bringing an extra dose of difficulty and challenging new enemies. Get ready to tackle complex environments, new traps, and a variety of cunning adversaries.

title: OMSI 2: Add-on Zürich Tram Linie 11
description: Having a tram as a vehicle in OMSI 2, now you have the opportunity to drive through the mere center of Zurich and enjoy the classical, intact and divine architecture of this unique worldwide famous city.

title: Train Simulator: EA-692
description: A Romanian rail icon arrives from developer Train Motion.

title: Train Simulator: Payerbach - Wien Hbf Route Add-On
description: Explore the east side of Austria from Wien (Vienna) to Payerbach with this Train Simulator route from RSSLO.

title: Train Simulator: ÖBB 4748
description: Take control of this modern electric multiple unit from RSSLO, as you drive across the Austrian / Italian border.

title: Hamlet in a Pond
description: Hamlet in a Pond is a unique looking relaxed city builder. Live out your creativity and build your own little slice of paradise in a tiny pond - with no pressure like goals to reach and no stress from juggling resources.

title: Duck Creator 2
description: Duck Creator 2, Create your own Duck but better version!

title: Genso Manège
description: Follow Emma as she fights to reawaken her magical powers in order to aid a unique cast of characters, all of whom are trapped inside a travelling amusement park. Having lost memories from youth, Emma must rediscover her past through love and friendship in this stunning dream-like fantasy otome.

title: Free Stars: Children of Infinity
description: Experience a stellar space adventure and the sequel to The Ur-Quan Masters. Travel through hyperspace, engage in fast-paced combat, discover weird worlds, and meet a unique cast of truly alien aliens as you uncover a mystery that threatens the galaxy.

title: _Turing
description: "_turing" is a new sci-fi adventure game that allows the player to chat with the heroine during the story and teach her feelings to the AI heroine, thereby changing her personality and the outcome of the story. What will happen to you and Iris after you learn about her feelings?

title: One of Them
description: One of Them is a Social Deduction sci-fi horror game. Up to 12 players are playing either as a Human Astronaut trying to escape, or as a disguised Alien Beast out to kill everyone.

title: Sinderfury
description: From a team of two developers, an INDIE co-op action RPG for 1 - 4 players. Warning: This ARPG has very little hand holding, and is designed for more hardcore players looking for a challenge. The systems are in depth, the bosses are brutal, and the demons are unrelenting.

title: Uphill
description: A precision platformer that allows you to alter the environment.

title: Ragdoll Mayhem Maker
description: I love ragdolls and I love physics, so I thought I would mush the two together with a level editor and make a cool sandbox game for people to play around in. Currently, there is a very basic JSON-based level editor and 20 pre-built levels.

title: Whiskers Wonderland
description: Whiskers Wonderland: a game where your pops sent you to find something that was lost in a restaurant, but be warned, Mr Whiskers doesn't like trespassers and you unfortunately are one, so he's after you... You do remember another robot named Dr Mouser. Ready to find what happend to him?

title: Finch & Archie
description: An episodic co-op murder mystery in which you play as one half of a crime-fighting duo: Jack Finch the detective or Archie the police dog! Use your skills to find evidence, interrogate suspects, and catch the culprit in a gritty 1930s setting.

title: Peter's Journey
description: Embark on a journey of this text anime quest with RPG elements! Walk through beautiful locations, overcome challenges and make Peter’s dreams come true. Every step you take matters. And don’t forget to take the diary - you’ll need it!

title: Project Werewolf
description: Enter a world full of mystical dangers in the merciless northern Sweden. Uncover the dark secrets of the werewolves as you fight for survival in a relentless open world. Will you solve the puzzle of the beasts and conquer them?

title: Trainz Plus: BR Diesel Brake Tenders
description: This pack contains 3 types of British Railways (BR) brake tenders, 2 prototypes and 1 main production variant, which includes 3 different types of bogies, with 3 different period liveries in clean and weathered versions.

title: Trainz Plus: Model Trainz - Freemont Mills
description: Model Trainz: Freemont Mills is inspired from the Jan. 2024 issue of Model Railroader by Steven Otte. While small, there are plenty of operations that can be performed which can turn into a challenge.

title: Trainz Plus: Pro Train - Sequoia Valley
description: Climbing through the steep Sequoia Valley, this route set in the Badgers Pass county connects Fox City and Elk River to Wilmington and finally Sequoia Falls. This route includes 4 new sessions, and CP AC4400CW and SD40-2 locomotives, and UP SD40-2 locomotives.

title: Trainz Plus: Milton Valley Railroad
description: The Milton Valley Railroad (MVR) is a fictional railroad based in North Carolina, its reach extending at the height of its power all the way north to Canada and south to Georgia. The MVR as represented in this route is currently in the 1960s transitional era, featuring both diesel and steam locos.

title: Trainz 2019: Pro Train - Sequoia Valley
description: Climbing through the steep Sequoia Valley, this route set in the Badgers Pass county connects Fox City and Elk River to Wilmington and finally Sequoia Falls. This route includes 4 new sessions, and CP AC4400CW and SD40-2 locomotives, and UP SD40-2 locomotives.

title: Trainz 2019: Model Trainz - Freemont Mills
description: Model Trainz: Freemont Mills is inspired from the Jan. 2024 issue of Model Railroader by Steven Otte. While small, there are plenty of operations that can be performed which can turn into a challenge.

title: Trainz 2019: BR Diesel Brake Tenders
description: This pack contains 3 types of British Railways (BR) brake tenders, 2 prototypes and 1 main production variant, which includes 3 different types of bogies, with 3 different period liveries in clean and weathered versions.

title: Trainz 2022: Model Trainz - Freemont Mills
description: Model Trainz: Freemont Mills is inspired from the Jan. 2024 issue of Model Railroader by Steven Otte. While small, there are plenty of operations that can be performed which can turn into a challenge.

title: Trainz 2022: Pro Train - Sequoia Valley
description: Climbing through the steep Sequoia Valley, this route set in the Badgers Pass county connects Fox City and Elk River to Wilmington and finally Sequoia Falls. This route includes 4 new sessions, and CP AC4400CW and SD40-2 locomotives, and UP SD40-2 locomotives.

title: Trainz 2022: Milton Valley Railroad
description: The Milton Valley Railroad (MVR) is a fictional railroad based in North Carolina, its reach extending at the height of its power all the way north to Canada and south to Georgia. The MVR as represented in this route is currently in the 1960s transitional era, featuring both diesel and steam locos.

title: A Tale of a Legacy
description:
Dery Marlon, a young vagabond who has just settled in a camp on the outskirts of the city of Zippar, receives a misterious letter in which an unknown man gives him a considerable part of his inheritance.

In order to collect the inheritance, he will have to travel far and wide across the Kingdom of Arval, traversing many villages and regions of the kingdom. This adventure will lead him to discover who the mysterious Feyer Golesh is and the motives behind leaving him the riches.

Love, betrayal, mystery, tension and entertainment blend together in this adventure that will delight the fans of classic graphic adventures.

title: Kart Heros Ultra
description: A micro Racing game, spanning accross multiple levels. Players can race AI with multiplayer and local support coming soon.

title: Fiesta Animal
