description: Fiesta Animal is a party multiplayer game 5v5 online. Play with friends and your family! cooperation and friendship are your best tools to victory. Run, jump, swimming and laugh as much as you want!

title: The White Canvas
description: The White Canvas is the story of Nico Sales, a very ironic painter without inspiration and with a lot of personal problems. Midas, the most important patron in the world has arrived at his city. Nico needs to find him and convince him to take care of his artistic career. This won't be very easy for Nico because feels depressed and anxious due to his lack of inspiration. Moreover, Midas it's very evasive and discret. Will Nico be able to find Midas and convince him? Try to help him and you will find out a lot of interesting things about the charismatic painter Nico Sales. -- Thanks to David Silva for his help.

title: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous - A Dance of Masks
description: A Dance of Masks is the sixth and final premium DLC for Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous in Season Pass 2, one last love letter to the Knight Commander and their loyal companions

title: Mario & Luigi: Brothership
description:
The brothers return for a brand new adventure on the high seas! Set sail with Mario and Luigi on Shipshape Island (part ship, part island) and journey through the vast world of Concordia. Launch out of Shipshape’s cannon to visit, explore, and quest your way through islands that range from tropical rainforests to bustling cities.

Meet new friends along the way, like Connie and Snoutlet (who's definitely not a pig), and encounter familiar faces from the Mushroom Kingdom like Peach and Bowser, who may help you on your journey!

You’ll have to rely on Mario and Luigi’s brotherly bond to succeed. Use Bros. Moves to get past obstacles while you explore, and powerful Bros. Attacks in a dynamic twist on turn-based combat. You’ll need every edge this 'brothership' will give you to save the day!

title: Fairy Tail 2
description: The sequel to the 2020 "FAIRY TAIL" console game has finally arrived! Play as Fairy Tail guild members such as protagonists Natsu or Lucy, and experience first-hand how the dramatic events unfold in the series' climactic Alvarez Empire Arc. Enjoy epic battles against Zeref, the Emperor of the Alvarez Empire, his team of elites, the Spriggan 12, and the Black Dragon Acnologia.

title: Fantasian Neo Dimension
description:
The father of Final Fantasy, Hironobu Sakaguchi, and renowned composer Nobuo Uematsu return to deliver an original RPG story. Experience an enhanced version of FANTASIAN, initially released for Apple Arcade in 2021, with brand-new features, including English and Japanese voiceovers and an additional difficulty option.

In FANTASIAN Neo Dimension, assume the role of Leo as he journeys to recover his memories and solve the mystery of a strange mechanical infection destroying his world.

Experience an original and modern take on the beloved turn-based battle system, with a wealth of unique mechanics and strategic combat that shake up the classic RPG formula, and explore a multi-dimensional universe come to life, set against the backdrop of over 150 charming hand-crafted dioramas.

title: Nintendo Switch Sports: Basketball
description: Use motion controls to sink as many baskets as you can within the time limit in the solo Three-Point Challenge. If you’re looking for friendly competition, then up to four players can compete in Five-Streak Battle or Three-Point Contest, and you can dribble, pass and score in two-on-two matches.

title: Mio: Memories in Orbit
description: MIO: Memories in Orbit is a 2.5D side-scrolling metroidvania platformer. Players control a robot named Mio who explores a vast spaceship called the Vessel, gaining new abilities such as wall climbing, dodging, grappling, and gliding while fighting machines that have gone rogue. Combat emphasizes aerial fighting, and players can equip modifiers that adjust their abilities at the cost of modifier slots. Currency called Nacre is used to purchase upgrades and is lost on death, and fast-travel devices serve as save points across the ship.

title: Looney Tunes: Wacky World of Sports
description:
Compete against friends and family with the Looney Tunes squad in basketball, soccer, golf and tennis.

Play your way solo or in four-player local co-op and choose the characters that best suit your play style.

Avoid wacky obstacles and gain power-ups to incite chaos as you control your favorite Looney Tunes all-stars!

title: Donkey Kong Country Returns HD
description:
Donkey Kong and Diddy Kong are back for some ground-pounding action in this HD version of Donkey Kong Country Returns, originally released on the Wii system.

Play solo, or with a buddy in local two-player co-op, in an adventure brimming with hijinks where you can stomp obstacles, send mine carts careening, fly high on rocket barrels and even hitch a ride on Rambi the Rhino.

Experience 80 a-peel-ing levels, including the additional ones from the Nintendo 3DS version.

title: Metal Slug: Attack - Reloaded
description: Metal Slug Attack Reloaded is a remaster of the original Metal Slug Attack. Build the strongest team you can and crush enemy bases with a variety of strategies and hundreds of characters.

title: Phantom Brave: The Lost Hero
description: Join Marona and her Phantom friends on a mission to defeat the sinister Shipwreck Fleet! Recruit Phantoms, bind them to objects, combine them with Gadgets, and even merge them with Marona herself in this Play-It-Your-Way RPG.

title: Marvel vs. Capcom Fighting Collection: Arcade Classics
description:
Marvel vs. Capcom Fighting Collection: Arcade Classics is a 2024 fighting game compilation developed and published by Capcom.

It includes Marvel Super Heroes (1995), Marvel vs. Capcom: Clash of Super Heroes (1998), and Marvel vs. Capcom 2: New Age of Heroes (2000), marking the first time these titles became available on new platforms since the seventh generation of video game consoles, as well as the first faithful console port of the beat 'em up title The Punisher (1993) and the first new console versions for X-Men: Children of the Atom (1994), X-Men vs. Street Fighter (1996), and Marvel Super Heroes vs. Street Fighter (1997) since their initial console releases.

title: Super Mario Party Jamboree
description:
Get ready for the biggest party yet in Super Mario Party Jamboree for Nintendo Switch. From running through merry-go-rounds to motion-control minigolf, this jamboree is jam-packed with over 110 minigames – the most of any Mario Party game to date!

With seven boards in all, you can go with the flow in Goomba Lagoon, search for stars in Rainbow Galleria, revisit the classics of Western Land and Mario’s Rainbow Castle from past titles and more.

Race across the party board in Koopathlon, a series-first 20-player online competition to see who can rack up the highest scores in minigames like the fast-paced Lane Change. The higher your score in each round, the faster you’ll get to the goal. Koopathlon is just one of a slew of additional modes – there’s something for every kind of Mario Party player to enjoy!

title: The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom
description:
The people of Hyrule are being stolen away by strange rifts that have appeared, and with a certain swordsman among those missing, it’s up to Princess Zelda to save her kingdom.

Team up with the mysterious fairy, Tri, and use the power of the Tri Rod to learn how to create echoes, imitations of things found in the environment. You can then recreate those echoes whenever you like to solve puzzles and defeat enemies.

Create echoes like water blocks to reach new heights, make bridges out of old beds, throw rocks at foes, or find your own creative combination of echoes to do things your way. You can even create echoes of monsters to fight at your side in combat!

title: Just Dance 2025 Edition
description:
Get your friends and family together to let loose on Just Dance! To party, exercise, or create special family moments, Just Dance 2025 Edition has something for everyone, with 40 hot new songs.

Need a fun way to exercise? Start your own routine with the Workout Mode and keep yourself motivated by tracking the calories burnt and the time spent dancing. Use Workout Mode to enjoy a dance workout in solo or with your family and friends!

title: Ace Attorney Investigations Collection
description: EUREKA! Miles Edgeworth moves beyond the courtroom and straight to the crime scene in Ace Attorney Investigations Collection with revamped graphics, new language options, bonus features, and more! Featuring two remastered titles - Ace Attorney Investigations: Miles Edgeworth and the Western debut of Ace Attorney Investigations 2: Prosecutor's Gambit - it's a perfect package.

title: The Hundred Line: Last Defense Academy
description: A new adventure from the creators of the Danganronpa and Zero Escape series! 15 students are tasked with defending a school from grotesque monsters for 100 days. Can they make it to the end? And will they survive long enough to uncover the truth?

title: Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven
description:
Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven is a full remake of the groundbreaking non-linear RPG Romancing SaGa 2, which originally launched in Japan in 1993.

Embark on an adventure featuring both new and classic SaGa franchise features, complete with Japanese and English voiceovers, original and rearranged compositions, and much more! This is an ideal entry point for new players and provides an amped-up experience for longtime fans.

title: Disney Illusion Island: Mystery in Monoth
description: Curious clues are popping up across Monoth, and Dash Dolphin needs your help to find them. Locate clues, close cases, and solve this brand-new detective mystery.

title: La Salamanca
description: "La Salamanca" is an inmersive first-person psychological horror experience, a story-driven game where you traverse different sections, solve puzzles, and survive the horrors lurking in the shadows of a twisted apartment complex. Inspired by an Argentine local urban legend.

title: Q2Jump
description: Jump is a mod for Quake II where instead of plain deathmatch and killing, the idea is to jump around various jump maps in the fastest possible time. There are all sorts of different jumps you need to pull off, from double and triple jumps to circle and ladder jumps. Quake II's equivalent of DeFRaG.

title: Dad
description: "DAD" is a horror game with a bizarre style and story. Inspired by horror and suspense films from the 80s and 90s. With PS1 style graphics.

title: Pillow Fight
description: A short, free deckbuilding game where you count sheep in order to defeat different "enemies" of sleep and learn some real sleep tips along the way!

title: Mourning Tide
description: Mourning Tide is a first-person fishing horror game. A guilt-ridden fisherman ventures into unknown waters. Each catch reveals haunting reminders of his past sins. Unravel the mystery and seek redemption, or be consumed by the mourning tide...

title: Threewave Capture
description: Threewave Capture is a modification for Quake made by Dave 'Zoid' Kirsch. CTF introduced a couple of things in addition to goal orientated teamplay: runes and a grapple hook. A version of it is included in Quake Remastered.

title: Solar Dominion
description: Its Sentries versus Serpents in this multiplayer shooting adventure. Team up or compete against one another to earn rewards.

title: Threewave
description: Threewave is a remake of the namesake mod for Quake III Arena, featuring other gamemodes like Rune Free-for-All and Capture-Strike. Much of its content was later added to Quake Live.

title: Helbreath Argentina
description:
Helbreath is a dark medieval MMORPG featuring intense PvP, strategic alliances, and a trade-centric economy. Choose between two warring factions and immerse yourself in epic battles and quests in a vast fantasy world.

Helbreath es un MMORPG medieval oscuro que presenta un intenso PvP, alianzas estratégicas y una economía centrada en el comercio. Elige entre dos facciones en guerra y sumérgete en batallas y misiones épicas en un vasto mundo de fantasía.

title: Project Astrid
description: Shroud announces Project Astrid: The new Open-World Survival Shooter game he’s been working on alongside Sacriel and Splash Damage to bring forth a new era of gaming. Splash Damage has over 20 years’ experience working on some of the biggest IPs in the world; Halo, Gears of War, Doom & more. Combined with my expertise in the FPS Industry - I believe we will create something truly special.

title: Dontrel Dolphin 3
description: The evil wizard Bretinado has captured the Trellings of Trelland. He also wants the mysterious gems of virtue to give him enough power to destroy the realm. Only Dontrel Dolphin has the ability to stop the villain. Help the dolphin knight in his next exciting adventure!

title: Loki's Minions Capture the Flag
description: LMCTF was released a day after the Quake II SDK was released and soon became very popular. Its defining feature, compared to the later official remake of Threewave, was the use of an off-hand grappling hook, which allowed the player to fly through the air while still being able to fire their weapon.

title: Tupi: The Legend of Arariboia
description: Tupi: The Legend of Arariboia is a turn-based roguelite role-playing game based on the story of the Indigenous hero Araribóia and the set of myths that make up South American native mythology as a whole.

title: Butto Bird
description:
Aerial battle action game that allows up to four players to enjoy the exhilarating experience of flying freely through the sky with a charming and lovable “bird” equipped with a powerful “jetpack.”

The game’s unique combination of cute and hardcore elements creates a thrilling and entertaining gameplay experience.

With simple controls, both beginners and advanced players can enjoy intense aerial battles together.

title: Kamaitachi no Yoru x3
description: ​Kamaitachi no Yoru x3 is a collection commemorating the 30th anniversary of the renowned sound novel series "Kamaitachi no Yoru." This compilation includes the main stories of "Kamaitachi no Yoru," "Kamaitachi no Yoru 2," and the series' third and final installment, "Kamaitachi no Yoru x3." Even newcomers can fully enjoy the series, as the relationships between characters and past incidents are thoroughly explored. ​

title: Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken: Tempest Stories
Natsu-Mon: 20th Century Summer Kid: Broadcast Over Sunset
description: This is paid downloadable content for Natsu-Mon: 20th Century Summer Kid, featuring a brand new area to explore and new events to experience.

title: Layton's Mystery Journey: Katrielle and the Millionaires' Conspiracy - Deluxe Edition Plus
description: An updated edition of Layton's Mystery Journey: Katrielle and the Millionaires' Conspiracy - Deluxe Edition only available in Japan. It adds the option to change to the voice actors featured in the anime.

title: Purple: Director's Cut
description:
It’s 1996.

You play as Randall Purpura, a 23 year old man who has just been released from a lengthy hospital visit for mysterious reasons. He lives in a small studio apartment in LA California.

He meets Mya, his new neighbor who wants to become quick friends with him.

He also meets Tate, the handsome man down the hall. He never seems to be home when you want him to be.

Explore the city, solve puzzles and try to unlock the mysteries of Randall’s past.

title: Conflict FPS
description: A strategic team-based first-person shooter. Battle it out in this fast-paced multiplayer shooter. Several game modes to choose from and a range of different maps.

title: Those Days
description: Those Days is a casual gay adult visual novel about a guy who decides to spend a few days in his family's farmhouse. There he meets Cott, Salmi, and later on, a few other characters that will make his vacation a bit more interesting.

title: RoboKiden
description: RoboKiden is an innovative team-based action game where five players collaborate to control a single mecha in strategic battles. Integrating Web3 technology and blockchain, the game uses the $KIDEN token for in-game transactions and NFT trading. Players can earn and trade $KIDEN, enhancing gameplay with digital ownership and economic opportunities. Developed by The Breach Studios and powered by Elixir Games, RoboKiden offers a unique gaming experience with vibrant characters and dynamic battles.

title: Deep Rock Galactic: Season 5 - Drilling Deeper
description:
Hello Miners, Welcome to SEASON 05 - DRILLING DEEPER!
Management’s got their sights set on mineral riches deeper down toward Hoxxes’ core, which means we’re increasing your depth of operations. You’re venturing down deeper than ever before, claiming unprecedented treasures for the company, and confronting all the lethal horrors that stand in your way.
In other words, it’s another great day at work.

title: House Builder: Medieval
description:
"House Builder: Medieval" DLC for the game House Builder on Steam allows you to explore medieval construction. Here are the details of the three new houses you can create:

1. Water Mill House: The first mills were built around 1 B.C. They were equipped with a water wheel used to grind cereals and produce flour and grains. At this DLC level, you can move into a medieval mill and become a miller!

2. Blacksmith's House: Blacksmiths were important professionals in the Middle Ages. They made horseshoes for horses and also produced barrels, nails, and other useful tools. With the DLC, you can feel like a medieval blacksmith and build your own house, including a workshop.

3. Windmill House: Windmills, powered by wind, were used to grind grains. They were invented in the ninth century in Eastern Persia and spread to England and the Netherlands. At the DLC level, you'll construct a wooden windmill, which will also serve as your home!

title: Five Laps at Freddy's
description:
Welcome to Five Laps at Freddy's, The premier animatronic kart racing circuit featuring you favorite and lovable Fazbear friends! Sponsored by Fazbear Entertainment

Select one of 12 of your favorite animatronic #FNaF characters and race on sixteen tracks set across 4 cups! Each track is based on your favorite locations from Five Nights at Freddy's lore, including Fazbear Hills, Midnight Motorist and more!

title: The Blue Pendrive
description: This is a fan-made adaptation of a story written by ‪Sinuois‬, called "El Pendrive Azul" or "El USB Azul"

title: Etera
description:
Immerse yourself in a boundless adventure at the heart of 'Etera,' an extraordinary journey through an imaginary world.

Explore scenarios rich in detail and complexity, where the thin line between reality and fantasy dissolves. Navigate through environments so realistic they seem tangible, yet surreal enough to capture your imagination with a unique blend of familiar and unexpected elements.

Every moment will mark the pace of your quest, influencing the plot and direction of your journey. Face challenges in a mutable timeline, where the past and the future intertwine.

Indulge in the luxury of experiencing the magic of never-before-seen worlds, where climatic adversities become either a precious ally or a insidious adversary.

title: YeGung
description: This game is a bow action RPG game, so you can advance without developing your character, and you can easily defeat enemies as you strengthen your character. Features include main quests, daily quests, field hunting grounds, reinforcement, and stores.

title: Beauties! They're All After Me
description: In this thrilling romance game, players are a working-class hero meeting six girls: a loli, a mature woman, a housewife, a soft girl, a domineering CEO, and a cute, naive girl. As he gets involved with them, he awakens a cheating system—can you believe it?! Make your final choice now!

title: Lewd Hentai Puzzle
description: A classic puzzle game to lift your spirits. And five beautiful girls will keep you company!

title: Glen: A Dull Journey into the Unremarkable
description: This is a game for dull people with short attention spans. You can probably clock it in 10-20 minutes! You'll perform tasks like paying your bills, watching some paint drying and reading local council regulations. It's dull and relatable. Should you buy it? Well, up to you, but I appreciate you all.

title: 13F
description: You are a tired office worker who has been working overtime until late at night due to a heavy workload and is trapped in a strange office building. You have to get to the first floor quickly and go home to rest, because you have to go to work tomorrow morning!

title: Cassiculus
description: This terrifying first-person horror experience immerses the player into a world of isolation, fear, paranoia and claustrophobia as you make your way through the Oberon Cave. Throughout the game, you will experience atmospheric environments, disturbing audio and horrifying visuals.

title: Dream City
description: A Metroidvania-like decryption game. Players come to a mysterious building with rich and interesting interactive props. Players need to learn to use these props to overcome difficulties and leave the building

title: Pedro Temple
description: An action arcade platformer!

title: Muksha Space
description: A spiritual yoga game that focuses on self-dialogue and emotional experiences. In the space of meditation, players are encouraged to engage in dialogue with their inner selves, contemplate the meaning of life, and understand the true essence of liberation and redemption.

title: I Commissioned Some Bunnies 9
description: I paid artists to hide bunnies and carrots in 15 artworks. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: The Ambush!
description: The Ambush! is an intense and exciting game of strategy and action, where players take on the role of a group of policemen rushing to defend a bank from a group of dangerous thieves.

title: Run Run Boy 2
description: "Run Run Boy 2" is an exciting and adrenaline-fueled game that puts your skills and reflexes to the test.

title: Lens Adventure
description: Lens Adventure is an action puzzle game where you play as Talia, a Magic Academy graduate student. Use the camera's time-space magic to solve puzzles: create platforms by photographing objects and use time magic to undo mistakes. Can you return to the academy before the dorm lights go out?

title: Where Are the Creatures of Mountains and Seas
description: The mythical creatures in the Classic of Mountains and Seas have all escaped. You need to analyze over a thousand characters in 12 Chinese cities, recall over a hundred mythical creatures and races, please embark on an exciting journey.

title: Mazzle
description: Mazzle is a straightforward and surprisingly difficult celebration of the simple beauty of maze and jigsaw puzzles.

title: Wicked Arcana
description: Step into the mystical world of 'Wicked Arcana, where ancient runes unlock powerful magic and hidden truths in this early access demo.

title: Parking Expert 2!
description: Get ready to put your parking prowess to the ultimate test and become the ultimate Parking Expert in this thrilling sequel!

title: Hide and Seek 2
description: Hide and Seek 2 takes the classic game to the next level with new challenges and obstacles.

title: City Rickshaw Transporter
description: "City Rickshaw Transporter" is a fun and exciting game that lets you experience the joy of being a rickshaw driver in a bustling city.

title: Keyboard Tennis
description: Keyboard Tennis, a keyboard-based tennis game, offers both fun and competitive experiences. Players aim to swiftly and accurately return the ball to their opponent using keyboard keys, requiring fast reflexes and precise timing.

title: Quescaper
description: You were thrown into a dungeon with the undead and only a sword was left for defense. Can you get through this underground maze and survive?

title: Steam Spire Chronicles
description: Steam Spire Chronicles is a combo-focused action roguelike set in a fantasy steampunk universe. Fight your way through an ever-changing labyrinth against creatures and automatons alike, picking up unique items that can change how you play!

title: Lovely Traps Dungeon
description: Your quest : Guide a golem through mad dungeons filled with platforms, traps and puzzles. Recover lost madn-- knowledge at all cost (golems are just moulded clay after all)

title: Psychopath Massacre
description: George Dinescu kidnapped you in his home in Romania. Get out alive while utilizing a V.H.S camera to film everything that happens inside. Torture, murder, and dismemberment take place inside the house, exposing the frightening legacy of a serial killer's decade of terror.

title: Pralai Song of The Last Empire
description: Korn Kachakon, a high school student, finds a painting of an ancient emperor at an art gallery. Unfortunately, a guard knocks him unconscious, and his spirit is whisked to the realm of "Pralai," where he's tasked with changing an ancient kingdom's fate.

title: Koi Land
description: "Koi Land" is a highly relaxing idle game. Purchase various types of koi fry, raise them over time, and sell them to earn money! Unlock multiple varieties of koi, listen to soothing music, and enjoy the sight of colorful koi as they accompany you through pleasant times!

title: Teenage Wasteland
description: Teenage Wasteland is a hugely detailed, open world RPG set in the early 2000's! With over a hundred perks, dozens of cliques to help/harass, and hundreds of choices, you can be the teen YOU want to be...

title: Gifted: The Tombs
description: Gifted: The Tombs is a fantasy rogue-like with extraction elements. 1 player local, 1-4 players internet/LAN based multiplayer. Third person melee combat, collect items and gear on each floor to progress lower and lower.

title: Unlighted
description: You will play as a test subject that works for a company called Umbral Alchemy, dedicated to the research of stones with mysterious properties never seen before by humans. Thanks to you they hope to discover the origin of these strange materials, but it won't be an easy path.

title: Eternal Rain
description: Dive down into the ominous world of Eternal Rain, a dark-themed Shoot 'Em Up game that throws you into a relentless onslaught against hordes of nightmarish enemies. Unlock new characters with unqiue powers and survive the everlasting rain.

title: City Find All
description: City find all is an exciting 3D puzzle game for finding objects in a cozy town. There are many objects on the location, there are numerous buildings, benches, signs, and other urban decorations. The player must explore every part of the location to find the necessary items.

title: Morning
description: This is a 2D game. Players operate the mouse, click to explore and obtain props, watch dialogue to advance the plot, and play the role of the protagonist alone in a house late at night, exploring daily and unfamiliar things, and unfolding the truth of her life.

title: Cursedville
description: A party game for 4-10 players. Play as a peasant or werewolf, cooperate with your friends and survive or hunt before all the nights are over.

title: Glow Up 1
description: Glow up the characters for each of the 9 stages, Units are divided into red and blue teams for auto-battle. Click to predict the winning team. If you guess right, you will be able to see the whole of the characters that have been Glow up.

title: I Made Myself a Ship
description: Build progressively bigger, faster, tankier, more agile, more dangerous, more complicated, more projectile-y-ier ships in your goal to destroy and collect everything.

title: Foxy J.A.B.S: Just Another Bubble Shooter
description: Foxy J.A.B.S (Just Another Bubble Shooter) is a simple and relaxing "Match 3 game" for everyone.

title: First Person Stapler
description: Clear targets in your office call center and race to the exit in this ridiculous, stapler-centric target shooter.

title: War Laboratory
description: This is a battle simulation game that uses real maps as combat scenes. The design purpose of this game is to simulate real-life battles in a game like manner, providing military enthusiasts and even military staff with the means to analyze and simulate real-life battles.

title: Rotosaurus Adventure
description: Rotosaurus Adventure is a puzzle game with a twist. Rotate the world to traverse obstacles and find a way into the goal. Manage boxes, avoid spikes, and use other tools in creative ways to overcome mind-twisting challenges!

title: Rogueween
description: Rogueween is a roguelike, bullet hell, top-down arena shooter game where candies grant shooting abilities, treats provide power-ups, tricks offer extra challenges, and you battle waves of Halloween-themed enemies in this action-packed adventure!

title: In Service of the Queen
description: Embark in this paced time and resource management where you coordinate the workers, build and collect resources to perform the task, In Service of the Queen!

title: Startup Quest Bakery
description: Embark on a brief entrepreneurial journey to establish and manage a socially responsible bakery. Obtain permits, prepare the space, choose your equipment, and produce various breads. Aim for profitability while positively impacting society and the environment.

title: My Girlfriends
description: This is a simulated love game, players through dating to enhance intimacy with girls. To upgrade your relationship with a girl.

title: Fix the Robot!
description: With a limited number of levels, every repair task is a testament to your skill and ingenuity.

title: The Real Driver
description: What sets "The Real Driver" apart is its unique requirement: all cars are equipped with a manual gearbox.

title: Feline Survivor
description: Feline Survivor is a rogue-lite game that combines classic Monopoly and Backgammon.You'll travels different planets, defeat countless monsters, and build the perfect map loop and weapon combos in this game of luck and tactics, until you finally find the secret treasure guarded by the monsters.

title: Selenaut Quest
description: A fun and addictive arcade game set in space.

title: Don't Be a Hero
description: This is a story about overcoming challenges and becoming a hero. A total of four trials await you, and you must defeat several powerful enemies in order to pass. Every battle is difficult, you must read the enemy's moves, choose the right aid, and adopt the right strategy to win.

title: Ties: Soul Link
description:
TIES: Soul Link is an Emotional and Brutal 2D Metroidvania, combining Action RPG elements with Adventure Platformer.
An exciting story of resilience and overcoming fears. Explore incredible cities in a world in decline, set in the year 2097, full of secrets and with brutal and bloody gameplay.

title: Chicken with Robot Legs
description: Chicken with Robot legs is a Runner-Vania game where you explore a map and find secrets while constantly moving, your only objective is find a way home. Find upgrades that let you explore further and further while unravel the secrets of this unknown place.

title: Hentai Tales: Backyard 33rd
description: A small town close to the beach. Summer vacation has just begun. While you were enjoying your coffee in this cafe, you fell asleep without realizing it. When you wake up again you find yourself locked in a basement. What will happen there?

title: The Flying Farm
description: Epic Journey to the moon, rescue the Baby Starling! Travel the world and help Barney the farmer to bring back the baby star to his parents in this captivating time management game. This won't be easy, as you'll travel in the sky, in the ocean or on a blazing hot volcano before reaching the Moon!

title: Abuga Warp Zone
description: Play as Abuga through nearly 50 challenging but exciting levels. Warping through and making your way from start to finish. Be careful though, not all warps are there to help you and who knows what other obstacles lay ahead as you progress further. Enjoy your stay at the Warp Zones in StrangePlace!

title: Falling With Ice Phoenix!
description: Falling with Ice Phoenix! combining the classic gravity fall platformer, sprited and high-octane action game, you and the cutie monster girls venture downwards to find the lost orb, facing traps and sexy monster lords ahead, an exciting adventure to the unknown lays ahead...

title: Island, Sex & Survival
description: You began a new life on the mysterious deserted island after drifting there due to a shipwreck, starting from scratch. Building a base, exploring different areas of the island, living alongside various female characters you encounter, and experiencing all sorts of miraculous events.

title: Sweet Office 2
description: Sweet Office 2 - is a simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game with relaxing music accompaniment. After completing the level, you can enjoy the girl's photo in the gallery.

title: Brutus Maximus
description: Embark on a hellish road trip around the Roman Empire. From Teutoburg to Rome, slay anything standing in your way, survival roguelite-style. Unlock new heroes, weapons, and skills to create synergies. Wipe out entire Roman legions in this hack-and-slash, stab, and shoot survivors game.

title: There's No Aliens
description: There's absolutely no aliens! We all know they are a myth and nobody ever seen one!

title: Kittens & Coffee
description: Embark on a tycoon adventure in Kittens & Coffee! Manage a cat-filled cafe, attract feline customers, and build a thriving empire. Customize with special cats, unlock upgrades, and explore quirky achievements. It's a whimsical journey where cats and coffee create a purr-fect experience!

title: From The Ground
description: FROM THE GROUND is a third-person PvP shooter. Play as juicy characters and face off yourself on the battlefield in a wacky universe.

title: Mec Me Loffa
description: Choose the right weapon for the right enemy and defeat Mec, the Final Boss...entra?

title: Cascadence
description: Survive and ultimately escape a foreign world using your creativity to assemble defenses with physics-based building.

title: Tamu
description: TAMU Open your eyes to a dark world and confront your deepest fears. TAMU drags you into a terrifying adventure where nightmares reign and reality blurs with dreams. In this mansion filled with horror and uncertainty at every corner, are you ready to fight for survival?

title: Contained
description: Contained is a monster pet simulator in a sci-fi base. Take care of your monster and use its powers to keep the base running. As it grows, you can discover new skills, moods, resources, and rooms. But beware, this monster can be wild!

title: Rogue Tiles
description: Rogue Tiles merges tower defense with roguelike elements, offering a dynamic experience where you shape the expanding path. Unlock, build, upgrade, and defend against waves of enemies.

title: Roller's Escape
description: Roll, flip, and problem-solve your way through this geometric platformer. You play as a cube that can change into a sphere to roll through levels to reach a goal. Overcome obstacles and reach the finish line. Will you rise to the challenge?

title: Project Hover
description: Antigravity racing game with multiplayer and single-player. Each player can either lose his hover or take over the hover of another player in online full loot PvP mode.

title: Case Zero
description: Case 0 is a short horror game where you try to escape a deranged, all consuming beast as it hunts you down.

title: Get More Fries!
description: "I'm a seagull, and I'm not just after your fries, I'm also gonna poop on humans! You guys better watch out!" This is a 3D game with some action elements

title: Bugtopia
description: In Bugtopia, you can purchase and raise insects to create your own eco-box. Sell them for profit or keep them in the eco-box for continuous idle income. Buy more diverse eco-boxes, decorate them, and enjoy a wonderful summer with the insects!

title: Dokoda
description: DOKODA is a hidden-object puzzle game set in 18th-century Japan. Players assume the role of Komaru, a recent recruit at the Museum of World Civilizations. Komaru's mission is to venture back in time to Edo Period Japan and retrieve a variety of artifacts to give mankind a new hope for the future.

title: Ukrainian Fight Drone Simulator
description: "Ukrainian Fight Drone Simulator" is an ultra-realistic combat simulator for future military personnel and FPV enthusiasts. Improve your piloting skills, learn mission planning strategies, and feel the adrenaline of modern combat!

title: To Hell and Back
description: Traverse the landscapes of Heaven and Hell in search of your loved one's lost soul and rescue them from Purgatory.

title: Awaken: Hentai Dice
description: Awaken: Hentai Dice is an exciting adventure for adults. Magic exists among us, but is not available to everyone. Fulfill the prophecy using ancient dice, bring male magic back to our world and don't get caught by the Inquisition.

title: Evil Corporation
description: Evil Corporation is a co-op horror exploration game. Travel through eerie levels, while avoiding creatures and other dangers, trying to get even with the Corporation.

title: The Shadowed Rune
description: 'The Shadowed Rune' is a challenging roguelike game that you can play solo or in two-player co-op. Combine the power of runes to discover new spells and ascend the tower to break the curse.

title: Truck Manager
description: Create and manage your own truck company. Create routes and transport cargo all over the world while you expand your fleet of trucks and logistics centers. Truck Manager is among the most realistic of the simulator genre - so prove yourself and beat your friends and other real life managers.

title: Battle Grid Arena
description: Ready for a stress-free strategy game with a twist? Battle Grid Arena lets you transform heroes into beasts, gather ressources, build a base, and recruit monsters mid-battle. Engage in tactical combat and humorous romantic adventures. It's strategy gaming with a smile!

title: Nora: In Search of Hidden Ingredients
description: Help Nora find the missing items around her house! Try the regular difficulty mode as well as shadows and dark mode.

title: Who Am You?
description: Who am “you”? Who am “you’”? depends on only the selection of “me”. There would be 7 days to find who you are. You may or may not notice the "I" at first during that time.

title: SirKwitz
description: Dive into SirKwitz: a beginner-friendly edutainment game that makes learning programming easy & fun! Explore 28 puzzles across four topics to master the very core concepts behind programming and develop your problem-solving skills. Ideal for those that think coding & programming are scary words!

title: Runi's Math Castle
description: Navigate the Math Castle solving addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and number matching to earn Gold Stars unlocking Characters and Mini-Games: 3 in a row Tic-tac-toe, Memory card match, timed jumping in Spire Run, and Dance Party patterns. Come play again to beat your high score!

title: King of Snatchers
description: King of Snatchers is a story-driven multiplayer snatching game where players will try to complete an investigative quest by an AI. Through this gaming platform, the AI will be able to gather data regarding a catastrophe set to happen in the future. Players will compete to snatch important data.

title: Sleep Stream
description: Sleep Stream is a roguelite survivor game that exquisitely combines the fun factors of roguelite with the tension of survival. Host a bloody livestreaming to fall asleep with synergy combinations and equipment enhancements to match Layla's various personas.

title: Cats Hidden Around the World 2
description: Find 1500 cats hiding in over 15 iconic locations such as Dubai, Rome or Bangkok in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game.

title: Life of a Thug
description: This game throws you into the shoes of a character struggling to survive in a corrupt ghetto overrun by gangs, mafia bosses, and crooked politicians. This is no ordinary RPG; Life of a Thug is designed for players who dare to delve into the heart of darkness and pay the price of their choices.

title: Unkillable Robots
description: UNKILLABLE ROBOTS is an exciting game set in the distant future, where robots have taken over the whole world and are divided into two camps. Some robots strive to restore order and peace, while others crave destruction and chaos.

title: Biblios: Tome of Darkness
description: Biblios: Tome of Darkness is a fast paced first person shooter inspired by the biggest hits of the 1990s and Boomer Shooter revival. Fight a host of unique and challenging enemies, wield a powerful arsenal of weapons, and search high and low for secrets and lore notes to reveal the mysterious motives of the evil Acolytes of Seth.

title: Demon Still Alive
description: Demon still alive is a metroidvania with brutal action – platformer using skilled combat set in the nightmare world of Demons. Explore, upgrade your abilities , unleashed the power of fire and ice and executes the enemies that stands between you and your destiny.

title: Time is Life
description: Explore Islands and the ocean in a Singleplayer or a Coop adventure. Relaxing gameplay, music and hundreds of unique activities to do. Whether you are an Explorer of the unknown, a Farmer that wants to tend to thousand of crops or someone who enjoys combat through boss battles. This game is for you.

title: Dreams of Sand
description: Solve block-based puzzles, manipulate time, wander through Reverie's dreams in the sand - relive and choose how they recount their life's memories just so.

title: Cosmula
description: Engage in an intense space shooter that you can play singleplayer or multiplayer with up to six players. Play a variety of different spaceships, each with their own unique stats, components, and playstyles!

title: Bober Bros: The Hole
description: [Bober Bros] The Hole is a first-person horror game that puts you in the shoes of a paranoid recluse whose life takes a dark turn when a mysterious hole appears in his apartment. Through this ominous hole, anyone—or anything—could be watching him...

title: Pawn Planet: First Sales
description: Manage your own pawn shop in the weird galaxy. Purchase and sell different items, attend auctions, stop thieves and keep the shop going!

title: Ready, Set, Plumb!
description: Ready, Set, Plumb! is a fast-paced puzzle game, where your goal is to place the pipes on the main board to prevent the toxic leak

title: Bulbs 2.0
description:
Combine color mixing and logic for some puzzle-solving fun in Bulbs 2.0, featuring over 100 stimulating levels to solve!

Red plus blue makes purple, blue plus yellow makes green, and white contains every color. In Bulbs 2.0, you’ll combine the satisfying art of color mixing with logic for a truly stimulating puzzle game experience!

Your board is filled with colored bulbs that will reverse their specific share of light on their own cell, along with the surrounding eight. If you “reverse” a red bulb, a neighboring blue one will change to purple. Any nearby purple ones? Those will swap back to blue! Your goal is straightforward, but challenging: Swap the colors until the entire board is white. With a limited number of moves and more than 100 levels of varying size, can you illuminate your way through the game?

title: The Bucketlist Tourist

description: By playing this product, you will push the limits of fear and go after dark secrets. If you dare, step into this scary adventure and unravel the mansion's dark past!

description: Run your own candy and toys store. Place online orders for supplies, receive them via delivery truck, stock shelves, set prices, take payments, expand, and design your store. Hiring staff and dealing with shoplifters are upcoming.

description: Emiko's Pledge 4 is a 2D platform action game based on the story of a half-demon girl called Emiko, who wants to become the best warrior of the Ettaze state and abroad, as well as protect the weak.

description: Step into the shoes of a policeman in "Amber Alert," a survival horror game. Responding to a late-night call, you find a sinister cult of women abductors. Your mission: rescue a captive girl. Navigate perilous streets, evade cult members, and survive.

title: Macie's Magic Melee

Choose and modify your weapons and defeat fearsome bosses across different environments. Will you survive or die with the world?

description: A puzzle game using magnets. A table puzzle to be solved by using the pulling and repelling forces of magnetism. Place the magnetic pieces and guide them to the goal point.

description: Suddenly, you find yourself standing at an empty ticket gate at Shibuya Station. Exit Shibuya Station, cross the scramble crossing, and head towards Center Street. However, please be careful about any anomalies.

Design a personalized combat style and carve out your own unique builds - in hopes of overcoming the will of an Ancient God.

description: Join the league of hustlers, a secret organization of revolutionaries, cheating card players, swordsmen and detectives. A game that mixes classic adventure games with card tricks, duels and investigation in a plot to uncover the truth.

Choose who helps you solve the mystery. With multiple endings, your actions in flashbacks may even change whodunit, with what and where!

From working as a barista to becoming the President of Antarctica, you can go beyond flipping the table – the world is yours to wreck!

In a 2,5D "Fixed Shooter" based on the old style of the iconic Space Invaders. .. from a time where much less, seemed much more.

description: Defend your home against a bandit invasion using inventive boobytraps as a Trapper, or join a team of three Bandits and try to get away with the loot! Introducing BANDIT TRAP—a fresh 3vs1, chaotically fun, physics-driven online multiplayer game for the whole family.

description: This is an independent development game based on the Chinese folklore "JiangShi", with a 2.5D horizontal operation perspective as the main focus, and features exploration, decryption, fighting, capture and other game features and gameplay.

The player must explore every part of the location to find the necessary items.

Equip a variety of weapons and upgrade your robot as you harvest and collect the valuable scrap from your enemies. Enjoy nearly five hundred thousand possible loadouts for your bot by mixing and combining weapons and valuable quantum gems, creating a unique experience every game.

Master single-screen challenges in top-down 3D style as you take aim at fire your feathered projectile around the chicken pen to gather cobs of corn. description: It's almost time for the holiday season, and you know what that means: FESTIVE DLC!

description: Classic II: Dominique's Curse brings retro-gameplay action to Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night! Featuring a larger map, canon Bloodstained storyline and brand-new gameplay, it's a brand new, old-school adventure. Which ending will you get?

description: Join our Heroes in this top-down 2D action-adventure game as you shoot your way through baddies then rumble it out with a boss fight. Select any stage and show 'em a fight!! Part of a Complete Breakfast!!

title: 10 Gnomes 1: The Rooftops
description: For all of You that enjoyed search for secret items in Submachines, or the bird quest in DayMare Town. This is a game created entirely on the idea of finding hidden objects (Gnomes in this case). You have 10 minutes to find 10 Gnomes – navigate via the normal point and click manner.

title: 10 Gnomes 2: Walk In the Park
description: Second episode in the 10 Gnomes series. Once again your task is to find 10 of those pesky gnomes in less than 10 minutes.

description: An astronomical gambling game. Fight the Olimpians while each Zodiac sign affects your cards differently in a deeply satisfying deckbuilder game. Fight Greek beasts, discover Tarot Cards and climb the Olimpus searching for revenge.

description: A platformer game in which you play as Scorchie, a friendly and hyperactive will-o'-wisp who's able to pass through a variety of obstacles using their dash ability and fire properties.

description: Experience a brand new escape room set in the iconic PowerWash garage! Play solo or in co-op, in VR or flat mode. Solve tricky puzzles, clean away grime for clues, and enjoy new 3D editor props with a rocking new soundtrack.

title: Inspector Schmidt: The Ebbing
description: In this detective RPG, you untangle a thick web of intrigues, lies, and secrets that surround a mysterious death. Find the origin of eerie telegraph signals, question the villagers, decipher the strange symbols that are suddenly appearing all over town - and hide from the danger lurking in the moor.

title: Riddle Tower
description:
Will you manage to help Prince Monkid, dear friend?
Climb all levels to finish the game. In the levels you will find fun riddles, math puzzles and complex rebus. Just be patient because some are really hard.

Solve your daily riddle to climb to the top and if you stuck don't worry as if you use some hints you get riddles and answers to help you continue your journey.

title: Bubsy In: The Purrfect Collection
description:
Is Bubsy a celebrated icon from the mascot wars of the early 90s or a platforming punchline? The team at Limited Run has built a new collection to find the answer. Bubsy in: The Purrfect Collection explores the franchise's troubled history and enduring popularity.

Bubsy in: The Purrfect Collection is a playable history that includes games, artifacts and interviews. All of the games have been carefully updated for modern PCs and consoles using Limited Run’s proprietary Carbon Engine. Along the way the team was able to smooth out some of the games’ rough edges.

At the helm of the project is Limited Run’s Audi Sorlie, a producer, author, Bubsy World Heavyweight Champion and arguably the world’s foremost expert on the furry franchise. Together with the team at Limited Run and Atari, he has created the ultimate retrospective celebration of Bubsy, the 3’6” tall 80 pound bobcat (with a pet armadillo named Arnold). What could possibly go wrong?

title: Demons
description: Demons is a co-op horror card game for 1-4 players. An evil cult tries to unleash an ancient demon and all that stands between them and the apocalypse is you, your friends and a deck of cards.

title: Stickers for You

title: Puzzle Kids
description:
Help your old mysterious grandfather to sort through his basement of relics and put together all those puzzles he hasn’t had time to piece together yet!

You better hurry though because time is running out, and you may have to sacrifice something valuable to keep going.

Puzzle kids is a local multiplayer game where you and three others must work together to finish jigsaw puzzles by picking up and placing down pieces.

But the light is slowly going out and you need to burn things to keep it alive.

Complete a majority of the puzzle to proceed to the next one. In levels with multiple puzzles you have to build the correct puzzle in the correct frame.

description: Cart To The End is a First-Person Multiplayer Game where you must ride all the way to the end avoiding different kinds of obstacles and escaping other players which can kill you and make you suffer.

Build. Flail around wildly. Rebuild. Help Björn the raccoon build the ultimate escape vehicle out of garbage.

*Raccooneering* was made in 5 days in Jaunpils Castle for Castle Game Jam 2023.

title: Airplane Tycoon: First Class
description: In 2001, two years after its German release (and three years after the series' inception), Airline Tycoon First Class was the first installment to be released in English by Monte Cristo. As it was the first game in the series to be released in the United States and the United Kingdom, the publisher decided to remove First Class subtitle from the game box and manuals, though it remained in-game. Features added in First Class include ten brand new missions, multiplayer mode with up to 4 players, new MIDI music, cargo transportation and more.

title: Airplane Tycoon: Evolution
description: In 2002, Airline Tycoon Evolution, second Airline Tycoon re-release was published by Monte Cristo. The game introduced ten new missions, possibility of buying self-designed aircraft (and possibility of sharing these planes via Internet), possibility of hiring aircraft security agents, five new sabotages and more.

description:
Your choices define who you are. But what if you don't make them consciously?

Peer To Peer is a short first-person social experiment where the player gets to experience situations where they'll have to pick which scenario they want to unfold. There is no traditional win-or-lose situation here, the player leaves with a newfound sense of their own personal behaviour.

title: Fighting Force Collection
description: Who doesn’t love a good brawler? In Fighting Force, you and up two three friends have a simple, four step strategy: break things, get weapons, use those weapons to pummel people, and repeat as needed. It’s straightforward streetside carnage with a 3D flair.

title: Grocery Simulator
description: Experience the thrill of managing your own grocery store, from stocking shelves to handling customers, and transforming a small shop into a thriving supermarket. Control prices, Order goods, Hire Staff, Fight with Thieves and much more.

title: Magic Star
description:
Idol development system, popular social music game! Welcome everyone to Nico's singing and dancing world~

Magic Star is a music game with a lively style using the concept of idols!
Gorgeous costumes, personalized mounts, massive music songs, everything you want is here. Scroll down quickly and let Nico introduce it to you, idols!

title: Sealed
description: Sealed is a horror game that will immerse you in a disturbing and mysterious experience. You will find yourself trapped in a haunted hospital, where every shadow and every whisper will remind you that you are not alone.

title: Storyshift Asriel Battle!
description: Finally your little journey through Snowdin has come to an end. But there's still one obstacle on your way. This adorable fluffy monster means no harm to you, but it's your duty to finish his game with you. Give him what he wants!

title: Pokémon Eclesia
description: Pokémon Ecclesia is a Pokémon fangame created by pingupollas. This game combines humorous elements with a serious main plot and innovative mechanics. It is heavily influenced by OT, as well as the games Fear and Hunger and Bloodborne.

title: Nehonobasa
description:
This is a bullet hell shooter. It might be hard.
Defeat all 4 stages + the final boss.
Shoot bombs with the X key. Shooting a bomb into a bomb
will increase the attack range and wipe out all bullets and enemies on the screen.
Also, if you have at least one bomb
even if you get hit, you won't miss because it will be an auto bomb.

title: ChatTDT: Tower Defense Twitch
description: Dive into the dynamic world of "ChatTDT: Tower Defense Twitch" where your Twitch chat becomes an integral part of the action! Designed to seamlessly integrate with the Twitch API, ChatTDT offers a unique and interactive tower defense experience that engages both streamers and viewers like never before.

title: TC!Underfell
description: Welcome to Underfell, an alternate universe of Undertale where the various monsters in the underground are vicious, where the law Kill or be Killed was firmly established. Never has the monster race been so divided before, gangs, mobs, a once united kingdom has now fallen and erupted into pure chaos. Can you survive the horrors of the underground?

title: Tender Frame Cocoon: //Rhapsody of Cross-Pollination
description:
Deidamia Leonte has crash-landed on a desert planet... alongside the leader of the warring faction's elite cell.

The newest chapter in the long-running TENDER FRAME franchise is here.

title: Great Time Trio Remake
description: The events of the game take place after a temporal paradox caused by the Anomaly/Player, this event causes the judges from the Underfell, Fellswap & Storyfell universe to come together in a single timeline to fight the player together.

title: Desktop Pals
description: Desktop Pals is a simple 2D Game which allows you to share your desktop and interact with a cute cat! Scratch the cat when it is looking for love and hear it purr!

title: Kiwi Game
description: KIWI GAME is a game about kiwis. Two in fact. One to be rescued from the evil farmer who thirsts for the sacred power of kiwis, and the other to explore a metroidvania-lite map by gaining new abilities, braving challenges and outsmarting puzzles in order to find the one she loves.

title: Let's Learn Japanese! Complete Collection
description: A bundle of every game of the Let's Learn Japanese! series.

title: 50 Floors: The Paranormal Investigators Prologue
description:
After a conversation with President of Underwood Corporation, you must urgently go to the studio for the shooting of a new episode of the Paranormal Investigators TV show. Unfortunately, the elevator is broken and you need to go through 50 floors on the stairs, but there are 3 simple rules:

1. If there is no anomaly, go down to the floor below.
2. If there is an anomaly, return to the floor above.
3. The corridor is safe, but if it changes, the rules will change.

50 Floors: The Paranormal Investigators Prologue is inspired by games like The Stanley Parable, PT, The Exit 8, and narrates what happened a couple of hours before the events in the Paranormal Investigators.

title: Risk of Rain 2: Devotion Update
description: Packed with an array of exciting content, this free update addresses various item and map bugs across both the base game and the Survivors of the Void expansion. It also includes a super awesome collaboration…..

title: Slot Waste
description: An episode-length first-person factory simulation. Navigate through a series of 10 unique and weird mini-games. What are you producing and who are you making it for?

title: KiwiFlight
description:
A Kiwi looks upon the sky, with dreams to fly, and one day gets a chance to make its dreams a reality when it gets tossed into a world of forgotten warriors and broken dreams.

KiwiFlight is a 2D, Platformer, Metroidvania game, made with the Unity Engine, taking heavy inspiration from Hollow Knight, Ori and the Blind Forest, and the works of H.P Lovecraft.

Was created from a 2-man team, consisting of myself and a fellow classmate. Created for our Final Year Project in the span of less than 3 months.

title: Omega No Sunshine 2
description:
This game is an arcade-collectathon-exploration game where an unknow being is doing its best to avoid the end of his/her world because of the sun disappearing. Through different places the player have to run and collect sun rings to progress ever further. The game include a story, additional content and a rpg oriented dlc. The base game minimum game time is at least about 16hours.

This video game is born after omega no sunshine 1 (2019) made by the galoxyum studio.

title: Starborn Survivor
description: Starborn Survivor is a sci-fi action roguelite where you control a robotic warrior fighting relentless alien hordes. Navigate, shoot, upgrade, and strive to survive for as long as possible! Tailor your loadout and adapt to the increasing challenges in this thrilling bullet-dodging adventure.

title: Fate/Samurai Remnant: Additional Episode 3 - Record's Fragment: Bailong and the Crimson Demon
description:
Mysteriously disappearing children. Rumors of evil spirits in Yoshiwara.
A strange voice calling out to Miyamoto Iori. A suddenly attacking bird monster.

In the midst of all these strange incidents, Yui Shousetsu appears in the form of a child and declares that if nothing is done, Edo will be destroyed.

With the Spirit Font in turmoil, aspirants of the Waxing Moon join together to face a new anomaly.

Among them is a newly arrived Servant, an unrivaled spear-wielder, Rogue Rider Zhao Yun.
“Feel the sting of Zhao Zilong's spear!”

title: Burden of Truth
description: The Burden of Proof saga continues! Step into the shoes of legendary prosecutor Conrad Cross during a pivotal moment of his journey. Investigate crime scenes, solve mysteries using evidence, and make your case in the courtroom. The burden lies with you to unravel the truth!

title: Kiwi Hop
description:
Embark on an exhilarating adventure with KiwiHop, where you take command of New Zealand's diverse bird species and navigate the challenges of survival in the stunning NZ bush. Explore the unique world of native New Zealand birds while enjoying an educational twist – uncover fascinating facts about these avian wonders after every gaming session. Immerse yourself in both entertainment and learning as you hop through the captivating landscapes of KiwiHop!

KiwiHop is completely ad and micro-transaction free for piece of mind.

title: Kiwi In Arms
description:
The kiwi took the arms !

Use your arms to defeat that mighty eagle !

title: Kiwi Climber
description: Can a kiwi climb a mountain?

title: Blinky Bill's Ghost Cave
description: Blink Bill's Ghost Cave is an interactive story book with some smaller games and activities besides the main story.

title: Capture the Intelligence
description: A relaxing night of Capture the Flag turns into a night of terror for the BLU Spy. Crawl through five levels of familiar Source Engine environments and avoid the twisted RED team as you try to, of course, capture the intelligence. Can you survive? Will you capture the fabled intelligence?

title: Dragon Age II: Ultimate Edition
description: You are Hawke, a refugee seeking to escape the darkspawn-plagued land of Ferelden and become Champion of Kirkwall. Rise to power and fight epic battles while making decisions that determine the course of civilization.

title: Tsurikkuma
description: Tsurikkuma is one of the games that can be played on Nico Nico Live.

title: Off Air
description: Jump, slide, and smash your way through an arena of blood thirsty robots in Off Air. A first person shooter where there are only two rule: Survive and Smile for the camera. Use your wits and speed and dodge around waves of enemies in an ever devolving world of chaos and lead.

title: Dream Gen
description: Build your dreams in this polyrhythm designer. Dream Gen is all about crafting relaxing or chaotic melodies, which can be played out for hours on end.

title: Sloppy Forgeries
description: Sloppy Forgeries is a fast-paced, two-player local multiplayer painting game. Each player is given a mouse, a blank canvas, and a few simple paint tools. Each round, a famous painting from art history is revealed. Players race to copy the painting as quickly and accurately as possible.

title: Kingdom's Dungeon Rage
description: The king have been taken hostage and locked inside a Dungeon! A dungeon that changes each time you die or complete a level. Complete in challenging different ways to escape, from becoming invisible, turning the world upside down and a lot more - your only goal is to escape without rage quitting.

title: Supermarket Owner Simulator: Business
description: Welcome to Supermarket Owner Simulator: Business, the ultimate supermarket management experience! Step into the shoes of a budding supermarket manager and embark on an exciting journey to build and manage your supermarket empire. Your adventure begins with the opportunity to design and customize your supermarket from the ground up. From choosing the perfect layout to picking the products that will fly off the shelves, every decision you make will shape the success of your store.

title: 11 Years
description: A 3D marine survival game playing as a Clownfish surviving from harmful human activity in coral reefs.

title: Urban Skater: Skateboard Delivery City Challenge
description: Welcome to Urban Skater - Skateboard Delivery City Challenge, an adrenaline-fueled adventure that puts you on wheels – or rather, a board – like never before! Strap on your helmet, grab your skateboard, and prepare to become the fastest (and coolest) food delivery person in town. Race against time, weave through bustling city streets, and deliver piping hot meals to hungry customers in this fast-paced and exhilarating experience.

title: Te Amo Mamá
description: Te Amo Mamá is a 2D side scroller that exposes players to the (often underrepresented) experience of motherhood. Become a mother hen who guides and protects her chick as they make their way back to their flock.

title: Oak Beats
description: Music Game

title: 2 American
description: 2 American is a dialogue centered side scroller where you play as Ashley Trinh, a first-gen Asian American, who has trouble communicating to her immigrant parents due to a language and cultural barrier. In this game, we highlight the frustration of having decisions made for you and not knowing how to talk to your parents about it. 2 American serves as a window into some of the hardships a child of immigrants born in America might have to deal with in their immigrant household such as not understanding what your parents are saying when they speak to you, being compared to your more successful cousin, and arguing about what career you must have in the future.

title: Illuminate
description: Illuminate is an immersive 2D platformer where one plays as a lightbulb who must endure a journey through the streets of the Mission District. Throughout the game the lightbulb is following his family's trail, who have disappeared from Mission District due to displacement.

title: Radikal Fighters
description:
Radikal Fighters is an exciting action game with vibrant, cartoonish visuals, that offers two thrilling game modes:

Battle Royale: Dive into a chaotic free-for-all where only the last fighter standing wins. Explore the vibrant streets of Radikal City, filled with surprises and hazards. Use your unique perks, weapons, and gear to outsmart and outfight other players in fast-paced, intense battles.

Paint Rush: Engage in an exhilarating team-based mode where three teams compete to dominate the arena by coloring as many dots as possible in their team's colors. Collaborate with your teammates, strategize to cover the most ground, and thwart your opponents' efforts in this fast-paced, color-splattered frenzy.

Get ready to jump into the action and prove your skills in the absurd world of Radikal Fighters!

title: Nightshift Galaxy
description: Play as a freelance mecha-pilot in a satirical anime-scifi setting. Arcade-style combat with transforming-robots, spider-tanks, and high-speed fighter-jets.

title: Crockpot
description: Discussion.

title: Polynya
description: Polynya is an atmospheric quiet walking simulator about taking a walk around a frozen lake with your little kid on a sled. Leave your trace in the deep snow or just lay down and stare into the sky. Maybe something or somebody can be found there behind the snow covered pines. Maybe something awaits in the dark water.

title: Teeth of Glass
description:
It begins with one cut.

You play as Doctor Joshua Hagstrom, as he finds himself trapped in an otherworldly fever dream. Just who is the mysterious patient? How can Dr Hagstrom escape? And will he live to see his family again?

Teeth of Glass is a short point & click horror fever dream, with two different endings.

title: Warframe: Jade Shadows
description: Jade Shadows contains significant spoilers for Warframe! To ensure that all Tenno enjoy the best possible experience, we ask that you allow others to complete the Quest at their own pace, and to please be kind. If you’d like to discuss the Quest after playing (and we certainly expect that you will), please use spoiler tags so everyone can experience it as intended. Thanks, Tenno.

title: Potion Quest
description:
A puzzle game where the player must complete recipes by knocking potions into the recipe area as they drop from above.

You have limited time so must act fast and get the recipes completed.

title: Smaze
description: An NES style fan demake of the hit sony exclusive sci-fi FPS Haze.

title: Where Kiwis
description: Search for 100 Kiwis. A carefully hand drawn scene filled with cute characters. The process is short and won't take up too much player time. You can choose your favorite dyeing for the convenience of color blind players. Extremely easy to achieve.

title: Where Foxes
description: Search for 100 foxs. A carefully hand drawn scene filled with cute characters. The process is short and won't take up too much player time. You can choose your favorite dyeing for the convenience of color blind players. Extremely easy to achieve.

title: Where Birds
description: Search for 100 birds. A carefully hand drawn scene filled with cute characters. The process is short and won't take up too much player time. You can choose your favorite dyeing for the convenience of color blind players. Extremely easy to achieve.

title: Where Ghost Cats
description: Search for 100 Ghost Cats. A carefully hand drawn scene filled with cute characters. The process is short and won't take up too much player time. You can choose your favorite dyeing for the convenience of color blind players. Extremely easy to achieve.

title: Super Bafo Championship
description: On the street in your neighborhood, the biggest Bafo competition in history is taking place. Face powerful opponents in turn-based combat and collect all the cards to be known as the Grand Champion of Bafo.

title: Dogfights in SLZ
description: Smear the skies with pieces of alien spaceships in Dogfights in SLZ, an arcade shoot'em up with a challenging and addictive aerial combat game.

title: One Step to Rest
description: Cross an unknown nation to escape a devastated and scarce place, seeking a land full of resources to bring rest and prosperity to its people, who bet their very lives on your journey. Defeat monsters trying to stop you in a hack'n slash, procedurally generated game!

title: Zilado!
description: Join a friend and travel through the state of Maranhão by train preventing it from stopping because of its broken wagons by solving small puzzles on this co-op platformer game

title: Brotes
description: A kiwi and his brother who is a little plant live their adventures and stuff. You meet nice people, very nice people and people who are a little sassy but who are nice all the same. You hit the A to roll which is super funny. You can also tap on happy birthday.

title: SoulSync City
description: A cyberpunk movement shooter based on momentum and speed.

title: Voxelgram: DLC #1
description: An animal themed DLC pack for Voxelgram with 82 puzzles and 6 dioramas.

title: Beatblock
description: Spin to win, and move your paddle around to hit blocks to the beat. The song revolves around you, and it's your job to keep up.

title: Battle Factory Showdown
description:
Battle Factory Showdown is a Pokémon fan game developed in RPG Maker XP with Pokémon Essentials.
The game is entirely dedicated to the famous Battle Frontier facility "Battle Factory."
Rent a team of 4 Pokémon from over 250 available and engage in an endless series of double battles; will you be able to defeat all the bosses and set a new world record?

title: Auti-Sim
description: This game was developed during Hacking Health Vancouver 2013 hackathon. The player navigates through a playground as an autistic child with auditory hypersensitivity. Proximity to loud children causes sensory overload for the player, impacting cognitive functions. This impact is represented as visual noise and blur, as well as audio distortion. Participants described the experience as visceral, insightful and compelling.

title: F.R.A.G.G.
description: Step into the future of gaming with F.R.A.G.G, the ultimate arena combat experience powered by Unreal Engine 5. Prepare yourself for next-generation graphics, intense multiplayer and singleplayer gameplay, and a universe brimming with excitement and competition.

title: OverField
description: Over Field is a Cozy Miniature World Exploration & Light Social RPG game for iOS, Android, and PC.

title: Bear Warrior
description: Be a hero Bear with sword and bow and kill fat sumo and find hidden golden skulls

title: In the Abyss
description: A platformer with gravity-changing portals.

title: Mobile Dungeon
description: From the creators of Shakes & Fidget, join us in a new epic fantasy RPG adventure. Get ready to accept our new quest and embark on the wackiest dungeon crawler!

title: Logan Kart 8
description: Satiricial Mario Kart 8 fangame featuring bizarre self-insert and parody characters, a wonky physics engine, and a melancholy soundtrack.

title: Mung Daal: Vietnam
description: Satirical fangame based on the classic 2000s cartoon "Chowder", in which the usually goofy father-figure Mung Daal is thrown into the Vietnam war.

title: Farming Simulator 25
description: Farming Simulator 25 floods the fields with a host of new machines, gameplay features, visual upgrades, and even fresh water to grow rice - adding even more agricultural depth and diversity to the family-friendly series.

title: A Trick and a Treat: Dead Letters (And One Other)
description: A Trick and a Treat is a Halloween visual novel featuring two stories: Dead Letters, a horror story in which a man working at the post office opens a letter and learns of something he shouldn't have; and Vamp Me!, a comedic story in which a woman comes home from a Halloween party to see her roommate in the midst of performing a ritual in their living room.

title: The Intern of Christmas Present
description: The Intern of Christmas Present is a visual novel where Pressie's last trial before becoming a holiday specter is turning the heart of Girl Dracula, enemy of Christmas. It is a sequel to the story "Vamp Me!" in the developer's previous visual novel, A Trick and a Treat.

title: It's Just A Prank
description: It's Just A Prank is a first-person horror game about kids playing pranks on each other until a PRANK GOES WRONG. Experience suspense, fear and unexpected twists as a simple joke becomes a nightmare.

title: Aces of Thunder
description:
Experience the thrill of aerial combat like never before with Aces of Thunder, the ultimate flight simulation game with high fidelity graphics and unmatched immersion. The game was made specifically with capabilities of latest generation VR helmets in mind.

The game's physically accurate flight and damage models derived from the popular War Thunder military action game ensure a high level of realism. The battles take place exclusively from the cockpit view to provide ultimate immersion and fully supports HOTAS controls. Aces of Thunder features a set of the most legendary WW1 & WW2 aircraft available to hop in and fly right upon purchase.

title: The Sumerian Game
description: A game of strategy and management. The Sumerian Game is one of the earliest computer games. Developed and programmed between 1963 and 1965, it was designed to teach children math, economy and ancient history. The source code was lost but now you can play it again.

title: The Playroom: Ninja Bots
description: Sharpen those shurikens, it's time to send your AR Bots into action in this virtual ninja training mode for up to four players! Using your Dualshock 4 wireless controller, take control of your own Ninja AR Bot, avoiding traps and flicking ninja stars to achieve Ninja Mastership.

title: The Playroom: Toy Maker
description: Using your smartphone, tablet or PS Vita system, let your creativity loose as your drawings magically transform into toys for your AR Bots to play with. You can create anything you like!

title: The Playroom: My Alien Buddy
description: Take your fun to another galaxy with this new toy coming to life exclusively inside The Playroom. My Alien Buddy comes complete with deformable body, UFO and gravity beams, so you can spread mayhem in your living room! And best of all: no battery required!

title: Reconnected
description: Since moving out of her parents home 5 years ago, Elle has been living as herself with her best friend Roxanne. She works at her job for a majority of her time and lives a decent life. That is, until she receives a message from someone in her past and her life is shaken up once again.

title: Doodle Hunt: Search Hidden Items
description: Doodle Hunt is a delightful seek-and-find game set in hand-drawn cityscapes. Explore charming maps, locate hidden items, and watch them come to life in color! An enchanting adventure for all ages.

title: Lajoy Teckna
description: What lurks in the dark? Survive a shift at the worn-down Rotwheel family storage facility against a slew of murderous cyborgs and hardware malfunctions. Survive the shift and earn your freedom!

title: Hobo Life: Greg's Christmas
description: Someone has stolen all the crack in the city, so you team up with the Brick Guy and try to find a way to bring happiness and crack across the city once more.

title: Korea. IL-2 Series
description: Korea. IL-2 Series is a next-generation flight simulator set during the Korean War. Climb into the cockpit of early jet fighters and shape the outcome of legendary aerial battles.

title: Gundam Versus: Navi - Olga, Atra, Fumitan
Tekken 7: Artist Collaboration Character Panel Set
The Occultist
description: The Occultist is a first-person narrative thriller. You play as Alan Rebels, a paranormal investigator who travels to an abandoned British island after his father's disappearance. Explore GodStone island, face supernatural entities, and uncover long-buried occult rituals.

title: Catalina's Horror Adventure
description: Catalina's Horror Adventure it's a game of terror, shooting, adventure and humor. Our mother shows us a treasured place from her childhood, an abandoned arcade. After trying to turn on the light, our protagonist appears in a totally unknown place; "The World".

title: G-Sector
description: G-Sector is a 3D action game based around hoverboard combat--a hybrid of an extreme game and a third-person shooter. Players control the heroine, Cyra, as she hoverboards through futuristic cities and arenas. Gameplay is based on ramps and tricks you use to build velocity and avoid opponents' shots. Using a chase-cam and a customizable mouse/keyboard interface, G-Sector should be familiar to players of 3D shooters.

title: Anzu Castle Gracula
description: Castlevania-style platformer

title: UAC Storage Surplus Project
description: The year is 2123. The UAC accidentally added 20 zeroes to its order of 1 crate. You are hired to vanquish the menace of the ludicrous amount of crates. Go, little Cratemaster, the Containment Area needs you!

title: Your Journey Begins
description: A 5 level episode for Heretic.

title: Lunar Strain
description: Lunar Strain is a new Moon-themed episode megawad for Doom 2 designed for limit removing source ports (complevel 2) made by the various members of Doomer Boards, led by Matador. There are 22 levels plus a credits map but there are also two curiosities in the MAP31/32 slots. MAP31 is a demo map showcasing the new monsters/props. MAP32 is a color swapped version of MAP13.

title: Road to Hades
description: A 32 map Boom compatible megawad for TNT:Evilution.

title: Two Tone Jam
