You are B4-BY, a sightless maintenance robot in an underground science facility. While you were powered down, calamity struck the facility's populace. For most of the scientists, it is too late.... But one of them has survived, and it is your task to find and save her.

However, something roams the dark and quiet corridors of the facility.

You are not alone.

title: SMOD
description:
SMOD (short for SuperMod) is a single-player modification that adds new effects, weapons, and NPCs to Half-Life 2.

The new content consists of many new NPCs and weapons, new gamemodes, comprehensive customization and tweaking options, new abilities for the player, and new features to the gameplay, such as level randomization and simple branching in the otherwise linear flow of the main episodes.

This is a Japanese modification for Half-Life 2 that certainly throws some suprises your way.

title: Spy Drops
description: Inspired by stealth action from the 90’s, undertake a series of covert ops to save the world from a global terrorist threat. Experience PS generation, 3D stealth action updated with modern effects, randomly generated levels, modern equipment, and head-to-head local multiplayer.

title: .45 Parabellum Bloodhound
description: You play as Reila Mikazuchi; a washed out mercenary whose glory days are long gone. In a last attempt at grabbing life by the horns, she decides to go back to the life, only to realize the real enemy isn’t in front of her gun.

title: Undertale Cyan
description: Undertale Cyan is a Fangame Prequel RPG Based on the Game Undertale. It Follows The Human Child with the Patience Soul; Belle, Who Ended up In the Underground and Tries to Find Her Way Out.

title: Qlute
description:
Qlute is a freeware rhythm game that have a mania-like mechanic.
It's now written in Godot C#.

title: Twiddlefinger
description: Twiddlefinger is a Friday Night Funkin' mod based on the YouTube channel Max Design Pro. The mod has the character playing as Nugget, who is based on the "Gegagedigedagedago".

title: The Obligatory Undertale Yellow Sans fight
description: The Undertale Yellow Sans fight.

title: Rayman Raving Rabbids: Reburrowed
description:
Rayman Raving Rabbids Reburrowed is a fan made project aiming to reimagine the early adventure platformer version and concepts of Rayman Raving Rabbids and make a full experience of the game that could have been, but never was.
It will be an adventure game taking place in around 8 byte-sized open worlds
Each world will have its own challenges centered around platforming, combat, and utilizing each worlds unlockable mount, like a spider that can climb almost anywhere and shoot fire, or an eagle that can fly anywhere and pick up other creatures and mounts, either for a challenge, or just for fun, your choice.
The worlds will be designed so you can freely roam anywhere in the overworld, be it on foot, on a creature mount, or any of the rabbid machinery you may find.
You will fight rabbids, dance with them, and save the creatures of the glade, especially everyone's favorite, teensies, who are trapped in facilities the rabbids have constructed around each world, you must free them and take them with you to be able to summon the creature mount of the world.

title: Monster Ronpa
description:
You've met the freaky fabulous kids of famous monsters in Monster High. And you've seen the despair inducing events of Dangaronpa that ended in ultimate hope. Now get ready for the monstrously despairing mashup of the two: Monsteronpa!

Featuring all new and unique art, and a in depth full length story, Monsteronpa is a love letter to both fandoms that aims to be true to the things that made us fall in love with them. We hope that the love and care that was put into every asset shows through, and that those of you playing enjoy!

title: Tenebra 2
description:
Similar to its prequel, Tenebra 2 is an atmospheric puzzle game with rogue-like aesthetics.
Guide the hapless protagonist to the exit. Poor guy is afraid of darkness and refuses to walk in the dark areas.

title: Hotel Simulator 2024
description: Hotel Simulator 2024 is a game to build and run a hotel empire. Design a hotel, manage staff, satisfy diverse guests, and set winning strategies. This simulation game blends creativity, strategy, and management in an immersive hotelier journey

title: Melo's Cat Cafe
description: Melo's Cat Cafe is the perfect game for players who want to relax in a stress-free environment. Instead of chasing goals, players can simply enjoy spending time with the cats. Observe the cats as they eat and sleep, and find peace of mind in their calm presence.

title: Dumbino
description:
A physics sandbox with dominoes, explosions, and chain reactions at every corners.
The game proposes a solo compaign consisting of solving puzzles by tipping dominoes, and a level-editor designed to create and share you own levels to the community.

title: Blood of Old: The Rise To Greatness
description:
Blood of Old, Indie, Strategy game with RPG elements, with an in depth story.

This is your story! Begin from a young age and make a name for yourself, become a great Lord who keeps his people happy and a epic city builder!

title: Endless Furry Blackjack
description: Welcome to Endless Furry Blackjack! The 5th installment of the "Endless Furry" Series!

title: World on Paper
description:
A dwarf? Crystals? And interesting things? Yes, it is in our game!

Create buildings,
get resources and have fun playing the game!

Genre: sandbox, survival, 2d

title: Empty Mind: Blank Fate
description: You're Engel. You wake up in a basement of a house. You don't remember nothing about your life and you don't know why you are there. You need to discover who are you searching information at the house. A religious painting and some other objects could tell you something about your true life. And remember, you're not alone in the house. There're a lot of people interesting in your virtues. Engel is sceptic with the situation. It seems like a kidnapped but there're powerful and superhuman reasons for his confinement.

title: Triple Bubble
description:
This is a bubble shooting game in the style of Puzzle Bobble. You can choose to play in 2 modes:

* Triple Mode: Levels are wider, and you get 3 bubble launchers to cover more area. You can change your position to other launchers with buttons L & R.
* Classic Mode: The classic, single-launcher experience.

title: The Mystery of the Planet Venus
description: The Mystery of the Planet Venus is a single-player first-person adventure game set on the planet Venus.

title: Chapatriste
description: Chapatriste is an intense FPS that immerses you in an infernal world based on the Spanish Tercios of Flandes. Face hordes of skeleton soldiers in a dark and terrifying environment where survival depends as much on your aim as on your melee combat skills. Fight!

title: Grabage
description:
Play as a mischievous, trash-hoarding raccoon in Grabage – a 3D free-for-all multiplayer platformer. Roll and fling yourself through fun fantasy environments, racing against your friends to collect the most junk. Recycle your trash into beautiful furniture and decorate to your heart's content!

Winner of Falmouth Games Expo 2023 Industry and People's Choice awards!

title: SpiritSweeper
description:
Join teenager Reenie and their spirit companion Oose as you start your (soon to be) successful spiritsweeping business. Explore houses, clear away spirit mess and deck out your treehouse!

Explore houses and uncover the secrets of the people who live there! What will you discover?

Use your trusty spirit brushes to clean away spirit imprints and capture adorable spirits to fill out your bestiary! Clean a lot, or a little - it's up to you!

Customise your treehouse by buying items with your hard earned pocket money! Discover more items while cleaning to unlock them in the shop!

title: What The Floosh Game
description: Get ready for an exciting adventure in "What The Floosh Game", a dynamic, action-packed game that will challenge your skills and reflexes! Navigate through a universe full of obstacles, collect precious coins, and challenge yourself in different difficulty levels. With vibrant graphics, intuitive controls, and an immersive soundtrack, each match will be a unique and electrifying experience.

title: Le pays d'Adibou
description: Here we go, on a journey to the Land of Adiboo! Explore the magical garden and grow some fruit and vegetables yourself, but also enjoy nature at the same time. You can of course bake a delicious cake with that beautiful fruit, but you can also choose to do crafts in Adiboo's house. Or just have fun in the wonder cave and the games paradise. You need a good dose of common sense, courage and a sense of adventure to complete the games successfully. Get ready for hours of exciting gaming fun with your favorite heroes!

title: Lekker Spelen: Origins
description:
Back to the past where it all began. Lekker Spelen: Origins tells the story about a dog and a rat who wake up in a laboratory with many questions. Who are they? Where are they? Where are the scientists? And how do they escape from this laboratory?

A Lekker Spelen game with puzzles, action, co-op, and more than 10 years of references to explain to your fellow player who has never seen Lekker Spelen even though you keep linking all their videos.

title: Arcade Archives: Ninja Emaki
description:
Ninja Emaki is a shooter released by Nichibutsu in 1986.
Take control of the young hero Shinbei and fight to rescue the princess from the evil spirit army.
Pick up scrolls to gain access to 8 different kinds of Ninja Magic. Use them wisely, and they'll be the key to advancing through the game!

title: Soul Sipper
description: Suck the souls of unsuspecting victims to survive in Soul Sipper, a twisted platformer game by Mors, Gaem, and Catonator. Use your straw to propel yourself through 9 levels filled with many different obstacles!

title: Planet Divers
description: Fire up your blasters and smash through any planet's defenses!

title: Hearth Storm
description: Hearth Storm is a turn-based strategy game where players attack and defend using cards. Strategically play to outwit enemies in this Solitaire-inspired game. With 20+ unique classes and dynamic card mechanics, every match offers fresh challenges and endless strategic possibilities.

title: Offroad Masters: Motocross Races
description: Embark on an adrenaline-fueled adventure with Offroad Masters: Motocross Races!

title: Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2024
description:
Step into the shoes of a Border Patrol officer in “Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2024”, an immersive and meticulously crafted simulation game.
This captivating experience throws you headfirst into the world of border security, where you'll face the daily challenges, responsibilities, and crucial decisions encountered by those who tirelessly safeguard borders.

title: Runnero
description: Runnero is an exhilarating endless runner game set in tunnels where players must navigate obstacles, collect points, and seize special items that grant temporary invincibility, double scores, or time slowdowns. As player accumulate points, the pace quickens, intensifying the challenge. Dodge obstacles, gather points, and push your reflexes to the limit in this adrenaline-fueled adventure!

title: Arcana Alchemia
description: Arcana Alchemia is a fantasy visual novel developed by Lump of Sugar. The story follows a student attending a magical academy where alchemy and mysterious arcane powers play a central role. Players experience a branching narrative with multiple character routes focused on romance and school life.

title: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 3
description: The Fuga: Melodies of Steel series has reached its epic conclusion! Dive into this dramatic RPG featuring a brand-new, strategic battle system, enhanced Taranis training during intermission, and tactical route progression and event battles!

title: Super Mario All-Star Attack
description: Bowser has stolen the All-Star from Star Haven, and Wanda, one of the sprixies, has came down from her home to warn the Mario Bros. that the entire Mushroom World is in grave danger, and it is up to them to thwart Bowser's plans before the land is warped by his jurisdiction!

title: Super Mario & The Rainbow Stars
description: Super Mario and the Rainbow Stars is a project that aims to bring the unique traits of the Paper Mario and Mario & Luigi series into a fun 2D platformer. Explore 7 different chapters, discover new partners and unique worlds, and stop Starnox's evil plans! Features: New moves, cutscenes, 3D world map, tons of powerups, a 3 hp life system, partner system, original songs and more!

title: Yoshi Gone MFGG
description: A Yoshi game featuring appearances of various MFGG forum members and some of their custom sprites.

title: Drums of War
description:
In Drums of War you play the role of a hero-leader. As the campaigns unfold the size of your armies can increase by up to 16 varied units. By participating in battles, all of the units become more experienced while naturally getting stronger. Players have the ability to hire new recruits, buy potions and distribute artifacts obtained in battles between fights. Each unit can be outfitted with one artifact and two potions. In addition to common units the player's army can include up to three unique heroes.

Almost every environment object is interactive – one can chop down a tree, set it on fire, or even turn it into an ally using magic. Each unit has its own action points which can be spent for any action – movements, attacks, spells or active skills. The player can randomly move units during his turn.

The in-game campaign editor lets you create custom campaigns, as a series of linked battles, with story text and customized rewards. You can save these campaigns a single file in order to easily share them.

With each unit the player has to make important tactical and strategic decisions. There is no need to remember a great number of each units properties or make complicated calculations – the player should rely on their personal assessment of the current situation. For most of the actions only one mouse click is enough – directing your army is easy and comfortable!

title: Famicom Fighters
description:
Famicom Fighters is a fighting game where various characters throughout the Famicom's and NES's library duke it out with each other!

There's several battle formats: your traditional 1-on-1 fight, tag team battles or teams of 3. Not only can you do your standard versus matches, there's even your traditional arcade mode as well as a survival mode! You can even play with others online! Famicom Fighters also utilizes the original Famicom/NES controls, allowing you to even use a Famicom/NES controller!

However, the question remains as to why they're all together like this. What has brought them here? Who is running the tournament? Who knows...

Are you playing with power?

title: Mario Forever Remake
description: Mario Forever Remake, as the name may imply, is just a complete remake of the famous Buziol Games’ Super Mario Bros. fan game “Mario Forever“, although its main elements differ it from the original and it features more custom content. Mario Forever Remake contains a bunch of never-before-seen additional worlds, like my long-living Letter Worlds Series, or Crist’s Minus Worlds. The game is based on the original Mario Forever versions that are between 2.16 and 4.4, with some little features from 5.0 and 5.9.

title: Luigi Floating on an Egg Over the Sea
description: Enjoy a relaxing ride across the sea with all of your favorite friends.

title: I-Ninja 2
description: Unreleased sequel to I-Ninja, which got scrapped due to the Liquidation of Argonaut Games.

title: Teardown: Folkrace
description:
You’ve been invited to compete in the local folkrace. Can you successfully diversify your business ventures into the world of demolition racing?

Folkrace is a single-player campaign expansion that introduces a ton of new vehicles and a series of destructive racing game modes against computer-controlled opponents. Test your mettle on the track against rival drivers and expand your car collection as you win championships.

title: Eight Dragons 2
description: Eight Dragons 2 is a scrolling beat-'em-up where you, or you and up to 7 friends (local or online co-op), battle to liberate the city from gang rule.

title: International Toe Stubber
description: From the creator of PaRappa the Rapper, find out how stubbing toes sounds in different languages

title: Black Licorice
description: Here come the lil' trick-or-treaters, aren't they adorable? Be sure to give them a lot of their favourite caramel candies. WARNING: Whatever you do, don't stick these kids with that nasty old black licorice left over from last Halloween

title: Nekopara After
description: A new chapter begins with the arrival of the catgirl, Fraise! She seeks advice from his little sister, Shigure and while Fraise feels the relationship between siblings is most important, Shigure priorities the happiness of her catgirls. This sets the stage in the battle between catgirl and girl!

title: Tamaghost Jump!
description:
Snooze your alarm to delay waking up from your nice dream...But the more you snooze, the more you risk your dream turning into a nightmare...

Entry for Ludum Dare 50 Game Jam. The theme was "Delay the Inevitable".

title: Mestres da Pangada
description: Become a Pangada Master! A sweet spot between fighting games, football, and air hockey with a Brazilian flair in a local multiplayer battle (or vs Bots)! Play against your friends on different maps with incredible unique characters and at the end of each match receive tickets and unlock unique skins!

title: Find Cats2
description: "This is a cute game for finding foodie kittens!" A few maps and a chance to find the furry creatures that are cleverly hiding!"

title: Kill/Cure: Beautiful Vice
description: Kill/Cure: Beautiful Vice is a murder mystery visual novel with death game elements. Explore colorful seasonal environments, interact with a cast of fun and flawed characters, and “No, that’s wrong!” your way through thrilling Class Trial sequences.

title: Tamaghost Jump!I Can't Believe It's Not Exorcism!
description:
After months of insomnia, you've tried everything: every pill, herbal supplement, special diet, every snake oil on the market. Nothing has worked. At this point, you're pretty sure you're just possessed, but you need your sleep either way. And, finally, the exorcism candles you ordered from a sketchy website ages ago arrive at your doorstep! Now, it's time to have a chat with the ghosts haunting you and convince them to leave you alone. Can you succeed? Which ending will you get?

A short horror/comedy game, now with 4 encounters and 7 different endings!

Originally made in just under 3 hours for Trijam #152, with the theme "Leave me alone!". Takes about 5 minutes for a full playthrough. Built in Ren'Py.

title: Cakey's Twisted Bakery
description: It's bake or die at Cakey's Bakery, where human children are the secret ingredient to strange monsters' delicious pastries. Find the recipe for survival to escape the bakery and it's sweet and scary staff!

title: Photogeist
description:
Photogeist is currently undergoing a major refactor, with new code from the ground up. Expect a smoother, more reliable experience very soon!

Welcome to Wandering Pines, home of the world's largest pickle statue, four coffee shops, and the world record for the most hauntings in a single town. After many complaints from the townspeople, the Mayor of Wandering Pines began construction on the Belwich Estate, a place for ghosts to live so they don't bother the town's thoroughly spooked residents.

Clara, an intrepid young reporter, finds herself unconvinced that the ghosts are as creepy as everyone claims they are. She has made it her mission to prove to the town, nay the whole world, that Wandering Pines' ghost problem is not a problem at all.

Join Clara in her search for ghosts, friendship and adventure in Photogeist - COMING SOON

title: The Lair of Nekro Neko
description:
Game made for Black and White Jam #8 (Theme: Loop)

In this game you are Salem, a cat trapped in a time loop that will only be undone when he defeats the Machiavellian sorcerer Nekro Neko and saves his friends. For this, Salem will need to face evil creatures that increase his time inside the loop.

The more time he has, the more he will be able to explore the village and get more equipment to face the necromancer cat, but he will have to be careful as his time inside the loop is reduced when being attacked.

title: Oh to be a ghost bringing a scarf to my beloved
description: A cute little mostly point-and-click game about ghosts in love. your partner is cold. bring a scarf to them <3

title: A Ghost Story
description:
Play a ghost that doesn't know he is one.
Solve puzzles, and help him remember what happened.
Hopefully you will meet a cute friend along your way.

title: The Missing Trail
description:
Today's the day of the Annual Halloween Bonfire! But why is it so... quiet?

The Missing Trail is a short visual novel about community, communication, and Halloween! Follow Tom the ghost as he investigates the mystery of the missing forest trail with the help of his new monster friends! But be careful… there may be mischief afoot!

title: Spoonman: Ballad of a Bonehead
description:
It's a typical Wednesday. Your asshole of a boss wants you to go grab a crowbar so you can open the generator room before the hotel you work at goes up in flames. So you head down to the hardware store, but they're sold out. Then you step in some broken glass and cut your foot. Then a homeless dude tries to sell you a crappy robot suit. And THEN a necromancer mistakes you for one of her minions and you're stuck in her creepy witch's hut!

Yep, it's just a typical, crappy day on Pen Island...

title: Twilight Flyer
description:
An epic and endless journey into the depths of imagination.

Play in 4 different arenas, collect rare rewards, and dominate the Sanctuary!

title: Super Mario Funny RPG
description: Super Mario Funny RPG is what it says in the title, a Mario RPG, but funnier. Follow Mario (and Blue Toad) as they venture across 3 different lands with very bland and unoriginal themes, trying to save Princess Peach!

title: Afterlife Connections LLC
description:
Now hiring for Afterlife Connections LLC!

Currently hiring a switchboard operator at Afterlife Connections. You will decide who visits the mortal realm and who must stay. Feel rewarded by seeing your happy clients receive the proper ghost!
Afterlife Connections provides exorcism coverage as well as reincarnation insurances for all full-time employees.
Applying is easy! Simply click 'Run Game' to start immediately!

title: Super Mario Wonderland 1987
description: Super Mario Bros. Wonderland 1987 (also known as Wonderland 87), is a fan game that portrays Super Mario Bros. Wonder in a different way. It's as if the game was released around 1987 after SMB Lost Levels and before Super Mario Bros. 3. The story is completely different from the original game.

title: Post Ghost
description:
It's time to deliver some spooky letters to the ghosts in the neighborhood.

They've been waiting for a long time to hear from their friends and family. Avoid obstacles and angry ghost doggies to make sure they get the right letters.

title: Just Jammin'
description:
This is Just Jammin', a game jam simulator in which you have to control four jammers making a game in 48 hours while trying not to die and deliver the game in time.

Here you will meet Jimmy, our resident nerd, Jane, his mom, Jack a guy that went to deliver pizza and decided to stay, and Jack, who is just dead.

Have fun playing, and take care of the jammers!

title: Super Mario Bros. Wonderland 1987
description: Super Mario Bros. Wonderland 1987 (also known as Wonderland 87), is a fan game that portrays Super Mario Bros. Wonder in a different way. It's as if the game was released around 1987 after SMB Lost Levels and before Super Mario Bros. 3. The story is completely different from the original game.

title: Epic Vampire
description: You must Bite ALL of the people to make them into Vampires. Collect ALL Bitecoins. Use Speed Boost, Transform, and Powerball. Drive a Hearse and Fly as a Bat. * This game has Permadeath, so, If You Die or Quit, You have to start over from the beginning. *

title: Donkey Kong vs. K. Rool Challenge
Epic Pirate
description: Evil Pirate Skeletons have taken over the World ! Clear those Bad Dudes from several progressively challenging levels. * The game features PermaDeath, so, If You Die or Quit, You have to start over again from the beginning ! *

title: Run Away SkyDancer
description: You have escaped the used car parking lot and must run away thru the town to freedom.

title: Warm Potato
description:
A fire sorcerer potato gets home after a long day out in the cold, and we think she deserves a cozy night in. You must help her control her fire powers in order to make dinner, stay warm and have a very comfy end of day.

This is a time management point and click game in which you need to control the lighting, the fireplace and the stove all at the same time.

Made for ludum dare 46 using the keep it alive theme.

title: Wordkour
description: WORDKOUR - Are You a Parkour Enthusiast Who also likes Word Games? Then WORDKOUR is for You!

title: Globe Drone
description: GLOBE DRONE - An Earth Simulator

title: Kitbashers United
description: Bad Dudes are attacking Kitty City. Team Kitty has United to Bash the Bad Dudes. "KITBASHERS UNITED" is a fantastic 'JRPG inspired' game with a turn-based combat system.

title: Multiplayer RPG
description: MULTIPLAYER RPG - The Kingdom is under attack, You and Your team must save the day.

title: Multiplayer Survivors
description: MULTIPLAYER SURVIVORS - a highly advanced multiplayer and single player RPG survival looter shooter game, packed with lots of great maps to explore.

title: Toast Ghost
description: Meet BOO a tiny little ghost trying to convince his buddies how SPOOOKY he is! However the little ghostie bites off more he can chew by scaring a witch that turns him into a piece of toast! Will Boo learn the error of his ways and change back. Find out in this adorable little visual novel! :)

title: SM64RT
description: Fork of sm64pc/sm64ex that adds support for RT64, a hardware-accelerated real-time path tracer.

title: GZDoom SM64
description: Mario from SM64 in GZDoom

title: Fade: A Ghost Story
description: 'Fade - A Ghost Story' is the story of a ghost who travels back through time to try and get back it's lost memories. This short game was made in a week for the GJL Game Parade Spring 2021.

title: Traumatarium: Penitent
description:
A dungeon crawler inspired by the Fighting Fantasy books and Warhammer Quest 1995.

The followup to Traumatarium, Penitent aims to improve on the success of the original, while improving and expanding on almost all aspects. You have three distinct dungeons to overcome, all while managing scarce resources and making hard decisions on when to push on, or use a map to return to the safety of one of the few outposts found in those dark halls.

Traumatarium Penitent takes place well after the events of the original game. The kingdom's knights have broken into two factions: the Penitents, who swore to pay off their sins in defense of the kingdom, and the Ebon Legion, who aim to bring forth again the evil spirits that once haunted the land.

title: Retale
description: You're in charge of the store this week! Stock and clean shelves, prevent thievery, satisfy customers, keep employees working their best and text your needy friend without your manager seeing! Lock in your time management skills in this fast-paced strategy game. Go through 7 shifts of restless retail work, and maybe you'll find yourself on the break room wall of fame.

title: Reflections of Life: The Shattered Timeline - Collector's Edition
description: Can you rescue the Celestial Sisters and restore the flow of time?

title: Jujutsu Kaisen: Cursed Clash - The Shibuya Incident
description: Includes playable characters, character costumes, and additional scenarios for use in Jujutsu Kaisen Cursed Clash.

title: Naruto to Boruto: Shinobi Striker - Season 8
That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime: Isekai Chronicles
description: Experience a slice of the Jura Tempest Federation life with friends

title: Qullusrent3
description: Break through various gimmicks to clear the stage! Clear the stage by moving all the blocks to the designated placement. We hope you will enjoy this unique puzzle game! Try to clear them while struggling to find a breakthrough!

title: Lots of Things 2: Travel and Search - Collector's Edition
description: AviGames presents Lots of Things 2, the second partt in the new hidden object series! Explore a variety of locations and search for hidden objects! Play lots of mini games and solve puzzles!

title: Rotating Roads
description: Rotating Roads is a puzzle game that challenges players to connect paths and guide a character safely through the game.

title: Parking Expert!
description: Parking Expert promises an addictive and immersive experience that will have you vying for the title of ultimate parking expert.

title: Bleach: Rebirth of Souls
description: Awaken the blade within you and reverse your fate in BLEACH Rebirth of Souls! Engage in thrilling battles with powerful sword abilities and characters from this legendary anime franchise.

title: Aunt Fatima
description:
Aunt Fatima is a horror game where you play the role of a kidnapped person by Aunt Fatima and her husband who found a way to escape from the house. Aunt Fatima and her husband kidnap people, force them to stream on the dark web, then kill them and sell their organs on the black market. You are the only one who managed to find a way to escape from the house.

To escape, you need to solve puzzles, collect items that will help you along the way, and find keys to unlock your way out. Aunt Fatima roams around the house, and if she sees you, she will chase you. Try to hide in cabinets to avoid her. Uncover the buried secrets of the house.

title: SM64CoOpDX
description: sm64coopdx is an online multiplayer project for the Super Mario 64 PC port that supports widescreen, uncapped FPS, and has many toggleable options for customization to fit your desired experience. It has multiplayer up to 16 players and an ever growing powerful Lua modding API that allow modders and players to enjoy Super Mario 64 in more accessible and unique new ways!

title: Dondgynns Auv Ye Wyrdd
description: We found a USB stick disguised as an ivory brooch among the many chests of gaudy silks, leaking perfume bottles, and taxidermied macaws that belonged to my late aunt. On the stick was this unfinished game. I managed to convince my 12 thieving uncles that there's no money in game development, so they let me keep the dump of the data while they weathered the brooch to sell as an antique. I thought you all might get a kick out of it. Every summer on Indian Lake there's a new litter of raccoon pups, and swamp stinks to high heaven.

title: Huddam 2 Berzah
description: HÜDDAM 2 BERZAH It is a type of psychological horror blended with Turkish culture.single playercrosswordfearIt is a game in FPS style.You must progress and as the chapter passes, you will find yourself in new places and events..

title: Madoka Magica Magia Exedra
description: Characters from the hit anime series "Puella Magi Madoka Magica" come together! Featuring an all-new story setting and characters from the original ideas of Gekidan Inu Curry (Doroinu), experience the action alongside Magical Girl memories in this battle RPG!

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Dawntrail - Collector's Edition
description: The Collector’s Edition includes Final Fantasy XIV: Dawntrail, the in-game bonus items, Dawntrail Special Art Box, Expertly Crafted Viper Figure, Adventurer’s Cloth Map, the Unending Journey and Adventurer’s Pen Case.

title: Supernatural Rules Suppress Ghosts
description: Can't let the zombies wake up the spell can suppress the waking zombie please observe the first scenario carefully when the environment changes, it means that zombies are about to wake up Using spells to suppress unawakened zombies is counterproductive hold on until all seven lights come on

title: Cthulhu Mythos ADV The Isle Of Ubohoth
description: A horror dice roll adventure inspired by the Cthulhu Mythos. Much like in a tabletop RPG, "abilities," "luck," and "dice rolls" influence the story's progression. The protagonist is cursed on an island in the Seto Inland Sea. Investigate the island, uncover the mysteries, and break the curse!

title: Magia y Demonios
description:
Old-school isometric RPG game with some more modern concepts.

You must challenge the forces of evil by eliminating monsters in a world where evil expands. As evil increases, the difficulty of the game also increases.

title: Schoolboy Runaway
description: “You little rascal! Go study your lessons right now!” said the angry parents, grounding you. Try to outsmart them and find a way to have fun with your friends.

title: Pokémon: Cuerpo de Cristal
description: Pokemon Crystal fan remake with next-gen improvements

title: A Prelude to an Adventure
description:
Hey! If you got about 5-10 minutes, then come and help an adventurer to prepare for a mysterious trip to the Land of the White Elephants. A Prelude to an Adventure is a little interactive experience with light puzzle elements, tons of animations and catchy music. Have fun!

Originally made for LOWREZJAM 2020 and then updated for MAGS August 2020 and then updated again to current version.

title: Don't Worry, I'll Bring the Beer
Hungry
description: Take control of a Boomble, a lively ball of energy with one mission: eat your way to victory. Gobble up orbs scattered across the map to grow in size and power. But be careful, if any of the other Boombles are bigger than you, they'll swallow you whole!

title: OneShot: The Pancake Episode
description: It's the 10th anniversary of OneShot, and Niko has decided to share their mama's pancake recipe with the world! Join them on a special interactive cooking lesson in OneShot Cafe, the coffee shop AU where nobody dies.

title: Karate Survivor
description: Become a martial arts master in this survivor-like roguelite inspired by action movies of the ‘80s. Use your fists, feet, and the environment to fight off relentless thugs. Master powerful combos, enhance your skills, and remember: everything around you is a weapon!

title: From The Mystery Zone
description: You find yourself in a pitch-dark world. Avoid dangerous events, restore memory, and escape from the “Mystery Zone”.

title: Exiler
description: Face demons and occult rituals in Exiler, a gripping horror quest adventure. Perform banishing rites by combining skills and improvised means, uncover eerie secrets, and save innocent souls in a race against time. Be the exorcist or die possessed.

title: Myths are 100% True
description: Myths are 100% True is a Fast-Paced Combat-Platformer that feels like X-Files if it was made by 12 year olds in Windows Movie Maker back in 2008.

title: Deltatraveler: Section 1
description: In Ruins (or, alternatively, Section 1) is the first section of Deltatraveler, taking place in Undertale's Ruins.

title: Deltatraveler: Section 2
description: Oh, Mother (or, alternatively, Section 2) is the second Section of Deltatraveler, taking place in Earthbound's world.

title: Junkfood 3: Wow Wow West
description: Junkfood 3 is an MBF21-compatible Speedmapping Community Project held in Meowgi's Pacifist Paradise Discord Server which features 94 newly designed slaughter levels; This time, with a wild western theme! The basic premise was to make "Junk Food" slaughter (BFG spammy, high monster count maps) where not a lot of time is spent deliberating about layout/detailing/fight design and other things that can bog a mapper down. It's just good BFG fun.

title: McDoomguy's Slaughterific Sample Platter
description: Welcome to McDoomguy's! What can I get you? You're not sure? Well then, might I interest you in our Slaughterific Sample Platter? It's our award-winning 42-course meal crafted by a selection of chefs, world-famous veterans and new tryouts alike. Oh ﻿right, you probably wanna know what the entire gimmick here was. Well, the ﻿participating chefs had a selection of 12 different design restrictions on offer, of which they had to use at least ﻿3﻿﻿.

title: Deltatraveler: Section 3
description: Hell's Forest (or, alternatively, Section 3) is the third Section of Deltatraveler, taking place in the world of GG!Underfell.

title: Spooky Pixel Hero
description: A chilling homage to retro gaming – Rediscover the magic of classic games and retro platformers with a terrifying twist. SPOOKY PIXEL HORROR combines the beloved aesthetics of vintage 2D pixel games with a deeply immersive horror narrative that will keep you on edge.

title: Doomium
description: DOOMIUM is a Community Project of megawad worth of short, explosive, and fun ﻿maps made by collective effort of 25 mappers, ranging from mini techbases to dimension-crossing temples and mysterious realms in search for the purest element of Doom.﻿

title: OverTrip
description: A skill-based third-person shooter, where the thrill of competition meets the world of skill-based token betting and the captivating integration of diverse NFT collections.

title: Helltown: Revival Update
description:
Get ready to experience the chilling horrors of Little Vale like never before! Helltown has been completely remastered with the Revival Update, featuring enhanced environments and animations, reimagined characters, new dialogues, and redesigned gameplay sections.

But that's not all! Not only have the soundscapes been improved, but the game also now features a spine-tingling soundtrack by none other than Ockeroid, composer of the fabulous Crow Country game!

New scares await you in this free update, but will you have the courage to face the terrors lurking in the shadows? Or be brave enough to play through the game's different endings? There's only one way to find out...

title: Omnimancer
description: Roguelite-style game in which you must explore an ancient tomb filled with dangers and practically infinite magic

title: Tides of Tethys
description:
Tides of Tethys is an immersive underwater roguelite simulation game centered around exploring and surviving the uncharted depths of an alien world, while building and maintaining modular outposts.

Players will lead expeditions of Knights into the unknown, in the hopes of rebuilding their long lost kingdom and unifying the houses of Tethys once again.

As they dive further into the Abyss, they will discover compelling new places, uncover lost technologies, and conquer a variety of dangers that lurk beneath the surface.

title: Natsuyasumi ga Machidooshii
description:
Childhood friends Kazamugi and Tsuyoshi, who have just started dating, spend exciting days together until summer vacation.

Developed by doujin circle "Bolze", in this game you play as the girl who has made it her goal to have sex over the summer holiday. She can accomplish this by either being passive or active at various points in the story.

title: Kowai Mono ni ha Futa wo Shiro
description:
Everyone is living covering up something. They pretend not to notice it."

A direct mail from a famous event planning company. It contained a notice of a summer ghost story event called "Hyakumonogatari" and a call for participants.
You, a horror and occult enthusiast, decided to go to the event by yourself.
There, you meet a childhood friend you haven't seen in 10 years and also your current best friend (?). You were happy to meet them so unexpectedly, however......
The lid of your memory is lifted as you are led through a "scary story. What will become of them, tossed about and confused by the past and the present?

title: The Restless Sheep & The Lone Wolf: Woolly Eyes Gaiden
description: The romantic noir visual novel The Restless Sheep & The Lone Wolf returns to Kabukicho in this unhinged simul-quel. Me, Azami, and the whole ragtag gang rampage through five all-new short stories!

title: Chronicle: Rewritten
description:
Chronicle: Rewritten is a recreation of Jagex's original collectable card game, Chronicle: Runescape Legends. The game was taken offline on the 6th of August 2018 and hasn't been accessible ever since. Until now!

This remake is built from the ground up with the goal of having this game playable until the end of time. As long as there is a download available somewhere, you will be able to play it!

title: Soul Park
description: Build an infernal fun park, judge your customers' sins and give them what they deserve: a HELL of an entertainment!

title: Diamond Detective
description: Stop thief! Calling all detectives! The city of Gemopolis has fallen victim to a clever jewel thief. Private eyes have work to do in Diamond Detective.

title: The Man in the Fields
description: The Man in the Fields is a first person horror game based on a ritual of the same name. Once you summon The Man in the Fields, every door and item in your house will be opened. Close everything in time to prevent it from getting in.

title: SpongeBob SquarePants Bubble Rush!
description: SpongeBob SquarePants Bubble Rush! is an Action game, developed and published by Big Fish Games, which was released in 2006.

title: Pixel Gun World
description: Pixel Gun World is a free multiplayer shooter. Play with your friends, classmates, fellow students and colleagues! Fight against other players in PvP mode and try to survive in the Arena mode! Buy and improve your armor and weapons! Become one of the best pro players of Pixel Gun World!

title: Total Extreme Wrestling IX
description: The 9th game of the wrestling booking sim franchise.

title: Minha Casa
description: Awakened in the middle of the night by her own anxiety, Robertha will have to face her own demons beyond her own home.

title: BloodBoarderz
description: Race to the finish line and satisfy your murderous wishes while you go down the bloody mountains dodging obstacles and slaying your enemies!

title: Toon Troops Strategy
description: Toon Troops Strategy, where strategic thinking meets cartoon mayhem! Engage in tactical battles, outwit your opponents, and lead your colorful cast of characters to victory in this charming adaptation of the classic capture the flag style game.

title: Melty Amethyst
description: The full-voiced otome vishual novel that adds colour to ordinary life.

title: Skinless The Horror Story Quest
description: In "Skinless The Horror Story Quest," journey through a nightmarish blend of reality and hallucination. Wake up in a haunting hospital, face your fears in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies, and confront the doctor behind the epidemic. Can you escape the darkness within and without?

title: Run Mr. Robo!
description: They kicked you out of the city and now you want REVENGE!! unlock costumes and kill all the mayor's henchmen in this fast top-down-shooter, but watch out! only 1 hit and you die (unless you equipped the shield of course)

title: Realize Me
description: Main character is a nerd who attends a vocational school, but aims at becoming a scenario writer. He wants a girlfriend, but is afraid to confess his feelings, so he becomes obsessed with game girls instead. One day he starts to play a trial version of a new game and manages to call the heroine to his room. She seems to have an ability to open the gate between the fictional and real world. She looks very friendly, but she's a heroine from a 18+ game, right?

title: Astercys
description: Step into an alternate realm where you traverse through different dimensions, survive spinning battles, and indulge in plenty of pineapple!

title: Kakos
description:
An upcoming card game where you can duel the underground folk. Explore the caves.
Discover the hidden history. But you should NEVER break the rules!

title: Au Revoir
description: Use your investigative skills in this point-and-click adventure to retrieve human minds stored in synthetic brains in 2071. Immerse yourself in a retro-futuristic world with neon-noir graphics from the 90s, and uncover a conspiracy that will challenge everything you know.

title: Kevurah Horror Tale
description: In Kevurah, you drive through a forest where you must reach a funeral that you must organize, bringing the various objects you have in your car into the funeral. All this while something torments and pressures you about the funeral.

title: Touch of Madness
description:
Touch of Madness is a 2D survival horror with 1-bit art. The game is heavily inspired by genre classics, especially Resident Evil and Silent Hill.

Explore the scenarios looking for information and items. Manage your resources through your inventory and survive the horror while trying to uncover the mysteries of the main story.

title: Project Arrow
description: Project Arrow is a 2D platformer game with puzzle environment elements. The game follows the story of an archer cat attempting to find its way home in a strange and mysterious world.

title: Death by Hype
description:
Death by HYPE is a melee Boomer-Shooter focused on fast-paced combat. The game takes place in the middle of the HYPE virus pandemic, and you (as an essential worker) must attend your shift at the beloved restaurant chain KAFC (Karlos Frango Cozinha), to sustain the needs of never-ending HYPEhead shoppers. In an unfortunate-- but predictable turn of events, your coworker bites your hand, and with the imminent infection ready to take its toll, you decide to go out by fullfilling your lifelong dream: taking out your pent up frustration on all your HYPE-ified customers.

Punch, slice, and stab through the maze corridors of the mall. Enter the stores and find out what happened with the other employees and survive as long as you can in this arcade boomer-puncher experience.

title: Winter Winds
description: Winter Winds is a grim fantasy RPG where you play as a mute, recently resurrected sadist with the mission to return the missing sun to the sky.

title: Beauty Jigsaw
description: "Beauty Jigsaw" is a beautiful girl puzzle game with exquisite picture. We recommend that you open this game at your leisure time, while brewing a cup of fragrant coffee, and then enjoy a relaxing puzzle time ^_^

title: Creepypasta Land MV Edition
description: Creepypasta Land MV Edition is the same old Creepypasta Land but with full new graphics, new items, new secrets, new battle system, new maps, extra stories and a lot of new secret stuff!!!

title: Day of Atonement
description: This game is a puzzle based on the Day of Atonement. The player is the High Priest and must complete all the duties for the Day of Atonement.

title: Gilded Gears
description: An action platformer where you are a robot who wakes up in a factory with crazy robots who are definitely not going to be friendly. Escape the factory by using and acquiring skills if you can!!!

title: Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot - Legendary Edition
description:
The Legendary Edition includes:
• Full game
• Season Pass (2 original episodes and a new story arc)
• Season Pass 2 (3 new story arcs)
• 2 Cooking Items that give your character temporary and permanent Stat boosts
• Tao Pai Pai Pillar

Relive the story of Goku and other Z Fighters in DRAGON BALL Z: KAKAROT! Beyond the epic battles, experience life in the DRAGON BALL Z world as you fight, fish, eat, and train with Goku, Gohan, Vegeta and others. Explore the new areas and adventures as you advance through the story and form powerful bonds with other heroes from the DRAGON BALL Z universe.

• Experience the story of DRAGON BALL Z from epic events to light-hearted side quests, including never-before-seen story moments that answer some burning questions of DRAGON BALL lore for the first time!

• Play through iconic DRAGON BALL Z battles on a scale unlike any other. Fight across vast battlefields with destructible environments and experience epic boss battles against the most iconic foes (Raditz, Frieza, Cell, etc.). Increase your power level through RPG mechanics and rise to the challenge!

• Don’t just fight as Z Fighters. Live like them! Fish, fly, eat, train, and battle your way through the DRAGON BALL Z sagas, making friends and building relationships with a massive cast of DRAGON BALL characters.

title: Hipatya in I wanna world
description: Dive into a challenging and exhilarating adventure with "Hipatya in I Wanna World"! Created for the popular streamer Hipatya, this game combines the intense platforming action of "I Wanna Be the Guy" with unique and creative levels designed to introduce newcomers to the thrilling world of precision platformers. Tailored for novices, "Hipatya in I Wanna World" offers a perfect balance of challenge and accessibility, ensuring a rewarding experience for all players.

title: Quest for Jesus
description:
In a pretend educational game about Jesus, you play as Jonas, a guy learning about how awesome Jesus is.

Find Jesus and save another soul, learn about the deadly sins and how to please your Creator.

Though somewhat exaggerated, the game is not made to offend people of any faith or lack thereof, but takes the topic rather lightheartedly. Beware: Even some valid points may occur!

title: The Goddess Robbery
description:
This game is a small adventure (point and click) with two scenes, it can be completed in a few minutes.

Robert Robie's passion is to steal artworks. This time he wants the famous Snake Goddess. Can you steal it?

title: Flow Fox
description: Flow Fox is a fast paced precision platformer game, with some foddian elements to it. You start outside and must run across the scenary to the entrance, where you then must climb across different terrains that will demand you to be fast, precise, and think!

title: Puzznic
description: This version removes the adult content present in the original game.

title: Ginger Shroom Journey
description: Jump into action in this addictive platformer where your goal is to collect as many coins as you can! Harness the power of mushrooms to find your way out. But beware! Traps and monsters lurk around every corner, ready to challenge your reflexes and strategy. How far can you push yourself?

title: Castaway Coconuts
description: FPS Stealth action game starring the Hanks. Eliminate pirates that have invaded the island and also happen to look like Tom Hanks.

title: Outrun
description: After leaving her relationship, Allison stays at a motel where nothing quite makes sense. Later, play as Emma on her night shift - where the story begins. Through Emma's eyes, you'll finally understand the confusing moments from Allison's stay. Enter the mystery - each twist darker than the last.

title: NextWorld2
description:
NextWorld2 is a fantasy MMORPG set in the divided world of Kigan, where two rival kingdoms, Selakim and Quila, struggle for dominance. Players can choose from four classes: Warrior, Shaman, Assassin, and Ezra, and explore a vast open world filled with quests, mounts, dungeons, and large-scale community events.

The game emphasizes real-time combat, crafting, exploration, and both PvE and PvP content. Currently available in Hungary, NextWorld2 has thousands of active players and continues to grow with new content and future international expansion plans.

title: Lost in Limbo
description: Face the nightmares of your childhood and unveil the truth behind your summoning to the realm of Limbo. Fight your way back home with the help of seven deities sworn to be your protectors. Will love be the key to your freedom, or the first chapter of your downfall?

title: BigFool
description: A small little game where your friends and you have a once in a lifetime opportunity: Hunt BigFool. BigFool is an elusive, fearsome creature of the night from unknown origins. Explore the Crimblr Forest and various points of interest, keep an eye and an ear out, and take down this iconic beast.

title: Vyanka's Memories
description: Vyanka's Memories is a platform-style game with metroidvania elements. Vyanka is a monster hunter who was called to her home village to protect it from a vampire. In the confrontation, she loses all her memories and powers and must remember them by defeating monsters in different biomes.

title: Gaggi Clicker
description: Welcome to Gaggi Clicker, the ultimate click-and-collect game! Immerse yourself in the world of "Gaggis" – enchanting little creatures just waiting to be collected by you.

title: Rogue Jungle
description: Rogue Jungle is an Action-Roguelike, where you have to fight & explore your way through a procedurally generated jungle. Find new weapons on your journey and face a Boss Enemy at the end of each run!

title: Spitfire: Moonpies Mission
description: Spitfire – Moonpie’s Mission is a side-scrolling rail shooter musical adventure with a handcrafted world, a musical vibe, and a focus on boss battles inspired by the action hero cartoons of the '90s.

title: Haven: Episode 1
description: After apocalypse humanity lives in a huge complex called Haven

title: The Cell
description: A Free Short Game For Ludum Dare 38

title: Super Hook Girl
description:
Freeware grappling hook game released by QPIC in 2014.
It is a predecessor to New Super Hook Girl.

title: Train Sim World 4: Nahverkehr Dresden - Riesa Route Add-On
description: Experience complex operations out of the iconic Dresden Hbf, with passengers and freight converging to make a hustle and bustle mix of traffic. Be in control of modern traction and explore the countryside of Train Sim World 4: Nahverkehr Dresden - Riesa.

title: Super Hook Girl Gaiden: For Smile Giving Birthday
description:
This is a freeware adventure game released by QPIC in 2017.
It is a spin-off of New Super Hook Girl, and it depicts the protagonist's past.

In-game time progresses as the player performs certain actions, which change the conversation with NPCs, the state of the field, and other aspects of the game.

title: Sumo Rumble
description: Run, eat and fight!

title: Football Referee Simulator
description: Football Referee Simulator—the groundbreaking mobile game that puts you in the referee's shoes! Are you ready to kickstart your career in the lower divisions and ascend to legendary status by overseeing thrilling finals?

title: To The Grave: The Wildlands of Faenora
description: Inspired by strategy RPG classics, To The Grave: The Wildlands of Faenora is a roguelite tactical RPG where you lead a customizable squad in turn-based combat, navigating dynamic paths, battling mythical creatures, and discovering epic loot in a pixel art medieval fantasy world.

title: Old Coin Pusher Friends 3
description: In this installment, there is a Sugoroku themed around the old Japan, with various events triggered by the squares you land on. Work together with other players to defeat yokai, and aim for the jackpot. As you progress in the game, you can enhance your abilities with various upgrades.

title: Berserk B.I.T.S
description:
Train and level up your B.I.T.S (Battle.Intelligent.Teammate.System). Team up with your digital buddy collect battle chips and take on the internet. Battle viruses explore new biomes and defeat powerful bosses!

Berserk B.I.T.S is an idle-rpg, auto-battler, chip-collecting game that runs on your desktop alongside your other applications. Re-position the game so you can comfortably work and monitor the progress of your B.I.T or minimize it completely and let it go in the background!

Collect and craft a plethora of battle chips to be used in real-time during battle. Each battle chip is placed in an ever growing library that you can strive to fill out. Get medals for completing tasks or kick back and spend time decorating your perfect HOME NET.

Level up your B.I.T by dropping them on a mission and taking on the internet, exploring different biomes! Be involved and monitor their battles and use battle chips you've collected in real time and help your B.I.T succeed - or sit back and relax, work on other tasks while you send your B.I.T to handle business!

title: The Legend of the Blue Sword
description: The evil necromancer has taken over the Castle. As the heroic warrior of this land, it is your task to slay this foul sorcerer and banish him from this realm once and for all.

title: The Jumper Ninja
description: The Jumper Ninja is an exciting action-packed game that puts you in the shoes of a skilled ninja.

title: SiMarket: Supermarket Simulator
description: Manage your supermarket in siMarket! Purchase products, stock shelves, serve customers, hire staff, and expand your store. Can you turn your small shop into a retail empire?

title: HolySpirit
description: Holyspirit is a 2D isometric hack'n'slash game. A hack'n'Slash is an action role playing game, like Diablo. You play a Holyspirit, which is an old corrupted soul who has been enlisted in God's army. You must liberate the country from the evil who has been unleashed against the living ones. The game is developped in C++, with the SFML. Official demo announced for 2011.

title: Genshin Impact: Summertide Scales and Tales
description:
Version 4.8 of Genshin Impact, which includes:
• New character: Emilie
• New limited-time area: Simulanka
• New story quest for Emilie
• New outfits for Nilou and Kirara
• New quality of life features
• New main event: Summertide Scales and Tales
• …and more!

title: Sunes Party
description: It's time to arrange a party, Sune thinks as he lies on the bed and thinks. But he can't put together it himself. So you must help him.

title: Last Epoch: Harbingers of Ruin
description:
The Harbingers of Ruin update comes to Last Epoch.

Join us as the fight for Eterra continues with the launch of Cycle 1.1 - Harbingers of Ruin.

title: Bad Omens: 8th Apartment
description: You play as a student named Lisa, who has just moved in with her university friend. But instead of a carefree student life, Lisa faces events full of despair and fear when she is left alone in her apartment number 8...

title: FelisBelus
description: A funny game to represent our pet cats and keep a record and memory of them forever.

title: The Ghosts of Blackwood Manor
description:
The Ghosts of Blackwood Manor is an award-winning interactive horror from Stefan Vogt, the acclaimed author of Hibernated and The Curse of Rabenstein.

Take on the role of novelist Thomas King and his wife Cora as they move into a remote Scottish manor house, just days before Christmas 1986. Seeking inspiration for his next book, Thomas begins to explore the history of Blackwood Manor, only to uncover a dark secret that dates back centuries to the days of the Great Scottish Witch Hunts.

The Ghosts of Blackwood Manor is a complex interactive fiction piece written in Infocom's advanced Z-machine format XZIP. The game has three different endings, a bad, a neutral and a good ending, depending on the player's choices. It is very likely that the player, on a first playthrough, will not reach the good ending, even though it is possible. Reaching the bad or neutral ending first is part of the experience and helps the player understanding the true intentions of some of the NPCs and the impact of decisions made, so they may be reconsidered.

title: Battle Robots: Confrontation
description: Battle Robots: Confrontation is an online PvP shooter in a sci-fi setting. Construct, upgrade and customise your robots, squad up with other pilots and unleash your power in epic battles on maps with many tactical options!

title: Black State
description: A secret group of scientists called the Architects summons you for a mysterious mission. Save the captives and uncover the truth behind a cataclysmic event. But none of you know what's behind the doors. Are you ready to open them?

title: Darum
description: A mystery behind the human mind (free game)

title: 7imit5
description: A RPGMaker Surreal Horror Game.

title: Night Machine
description: We’ve just learned the Moon is a giant alien doomsday factory, which is kind of a bummer. You've been chosen to operate a spaceship into the core and destroy it for us. Think fast, adapt under pressure, and deploy powerful combinations as you fight your way through in this real-time card battler.

title: NBA 2K25
description: Stack wins, raise banners, and make history in NBA 2K25. Command every court with authenticity and realism Powered by ProPLAY, giving you ultimate control over how you play in NBA 2K25. Define your legacy in MyCAREER, MyTEAM, MyNBA, and The W.

title: Sorcero
description: In Sorcero, your goal is to command thousands of units into epic battles while supporting them with powerful spells cast from your mage tower. The game features both a campaign mode and a skirmish mode. In the campaign, players will face a series of challenging skirmishes, upgrading and choosing their spells and units between battles to prepare for the next encounter.

title: East Wood Carnival
description: A PSX retro horror game made by a sixth grader. Your car runs out of gas on your way to an abandoned carnival now infested with danger at every corner.

title: Jeanne d'Arc
description: Experience Jeanne d’Arc, originally released on the PSP, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters. Enter the 15th century, as France and England battle during the Hundred Years’ War. A mysterious and powerful armlet appears on the wrist of a young crusader named Jeanne. Commanded by an oracle from above, Jeanne wields the armlet to turn back the dark invading army to save her homeland once and for all.

title: Ratchet & Clank: Size Matters
description:
A port of Ratchet & Clank: Size Matters, originally released on the PSP, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

The story is about Ratchet and Clank as they are interrupted from their vacation to search for a kidnapped girl and encounter a forgotten race known as the Technomites.

title: Watch Dogs 2: San Francisco Edition
description:
Watch Dogs 2 San Francisco Edition Includes:
The Game
Lithographies
24cm Marcus Figure
Map of San Francisco
SF-Themed Laptop Stickers
Exclusive Collector's Box
Use hacking as a weapon in the massive & dynamic open world of Watch Dogs 2.

title: Fishlike
description: High speed microgames involving fish, fishing, and fishlike activities.

title: The Test of Insanity
description: Ever argued with a squirrel? Welcome to The Test of Insanity by Big Nuts! Dive into twisted puzzles, quirky quizzes, and bizarre mini-games. It's not just a game; it's a brain-bending adventure. Think you can outsmart the madness? There's only one way to find out. Play now and embrace the insanity!!

title: Alessia's Dollhouse
description: Alessia's Dollhouse is a first-person psychological horror game that will take your breath away. In the dead of night, on a deserted road, you take on the role of Darren, an ordinary pizza delivery guy, in a creepy dollhouse filled with sinister secrets. But this time, your delivery address will drag you into an unimaginable vortex of horror.

title: Type To Report
description: This is an I'm on observation duty fangame where you need type the location of where the anomaly is to fix anomalies.

title: Delve into Pawssion
description:
Delve into Pawssion is a NSFW Adventure/RPG combined with mild Visual Novel mechanics, such as building up affection with characters, completing their quests, making choices that can alter some scenes, and rewards or reactions from characters.

This game is heavily based on rewarding the player with NSFW art.

title: Double Dragon Revive
description: Double Dragon Revive faithfully reproduces the thrill of old school side-scrolling action games, with updated controls and difficulty settings for the modern era, and utilizing Arc System Works’ fighting game development experience. Jimmy Lee, Billy Lee, Roper, Abobo, and more will appear in stylish 3D.

title: Emio: The Smiling Man - Famicom Detective Club
description:
Explore an interactive drama full of interesting characters

Continue the adventures of the Utsugi Detective Agency with the return of familiar characters—including the returning protagonist from previous games, and Ayumi Tachibana, who is now playable in certain sections of the game for the first time in the series!

Playing as the investigative duo, you’ll need to learn a lot about the personalities and backstories of the other characters if you want to discover the truth. Who is harmless, and who is keeping important secrets? Ask questions, reference your notes, and make connections—you’ll have to order your thoughts and examine your leads carefully to draw the right conclusions.

title: Astoria: Fate's Kiss
description: Just one kiss will change the fate of Olympus forever.

title: Deltarune: Frozen Heart
description: The end of the Snowgrave Route seen from another place. While Kris gets torn to pieces by a bootleg Mettaton NEO, Susie have to face Noelle, lost in the trance of the Thorn Ring, before she freezes her to death! And who knows, maybe the situation can get even worse than that?

title: Cold Shuulathoi
description:
Cold Shuulathoi is an unofficial mod for Doom II.

Doomguy is sent to an Arctic part of Mars to stop the summoning of a demon called the Shuulathoi. The base looks gothic, and some monsters have taken it over.

title: Digital Dreams
description: Digital Dreams is a acid fueled trip into the digital realm, an assault on your senses, and a dive into an alternate reality. A set of 8 maps, mostly around the micro-slaugter/lock in fight framework, but not shy of Tyson designs or platforming only maps.

title: Monuments
description: Three monumental maps (big, bigger, biggest), at least one secret map and a cosy grove to hang out in after completing the final map. The maps are﻿ combat-heavy ﻿and cont﻿ain elements of slaughter,﻿ ﻿﻿but the en﻿emy counts are n﻿o﻿t out of this world and t﻿h﻿e combat is varied in style and intensity.

title: Paint it Doom
description:
Paint it Doom is a conceptual successor to DIY, in that both are made out of solid colors. The sprites aren't crunched in this one though.

The wad is divided into 2 episodes:
Liberal Arts - which is a mainline progression consisting of 19 maps. Some of the later maps are pretty slaughtery.
Radicalized Arts - which is 3 misfit maps that couldn't be reconciled with my vision.

title: Parallel Doomensions
description: DoomWorld community project of 28 Quake 1 styled maps with bespoken music credits by John S. Weekley and Josie Bullock.

title: Plutonic Visions
description: Plutonic Visions is a 22 map wad for The Plutonia Experiment. Features mostly very short, action packed maps inspired by Plutonia's first two episodes, with some longer ones inspired by the final third sprinkled in for good measure.

title: Voyager EP
description: Voyager EP is a single-player/co-op WAD containing five adventurous, space-themed maps, offering a wide range of gameplay experiences ranging from fierce action to gentle exploration. Each map took direct inspiration from one of the five tracks featured on Tristan Clark's Voyager EP, released in 2021. This mapset was created to show our appreciation for @Tristan and his extremely respectable body of work, musical and otherwise, and additionally to commemorate his 27th birthday this July!

title: Shift 87
description:
Shift 87 is a first person observation horror game.
Keen investigators can find a total of 66 anomalies throughout 3 levels of handcrafted, highly atmospheric environments.

Runs are randomly generated, featuring small and subtle as well as horrifying and unmissable anomalies to provide a gameplay experience that is uniquely different and exciting each time. Players can expect a playtime of around 2-3 hours for a full playthrough.

title: Retail Company Simulator
description: Run your retail company in this free prologue version of the game. Sign contracts with leading brands, order new products, meet customer needs, and never let your customers leave the store empty-handed. Hire new workers, expand your store, and enjoy the growth of your retail company.

title: Mugen Rinne no Irregular
description:
A new story from the point of view of "Usami Sumireko".
In this original story, she joins the inhabitants of Gensoukyou to fight against the evil spirit "Mima" that has suddenly appeared!
Experience an unknown adventure you've never seen before!

title: Les Guignols de l'info… le jeu !
description: Les Guignols De L'Info...Le Jeu ! is a point-and-click game based on a French satirical TV program. You play as a new TV reporter who has just joined the WCI, an information channel. Your goal is to get the best scoop from famous people from various fields such as sports, politics, and movies. Your ultimate aim is to replace the main presenter, PPDA. The game does not have an inventory system; instead, you are equipped with a video camera that has a limited battery. You must record pictures and/or sounds that align with your mission briefing, but you have to make choices quickly as there are many characters to interact with and a time limit. The game occasionally includes puzzle elements, such as creating a "portrait robot" or selecting the right dialogue.

title: World Crafter TD
description:
A highly addictive survival crafting tower defense game!
Gather, craft, build turrets, shoot guns, and expand the land to defend against waves of enemies in World Crafter TD!

title: Step by Little Step
description:
Bring your cat back to the world of the living.
The rules are simple, as they are familiar:
Do not look back.
and everything will be just the way it was before.

title: Planet Coaster 2
description: Dive into the thrilling world of Planet Coaster 2! Construct the theme park of your dreams with an intuitive piece-by-piece building system, as you meticulously craft and customise every aspect of your park down to the smallest detail. From towering rollercoasters to spectacular twisting water slides, let your imagination reach new heights to delight and thrill your guests.

title: Pokémon Hidden Place
description: A Pokémon fangame.

title: Fontemon
description: Fontemon is a Pokémon parody, made with a game engine inside a font. This means the game runs wherever you can install and choose a font. The game is structured akin to a "choose your own adventure".

title: Stress
description: Survival horror adventure game with rpg elements, set on dystopian town under a zombie outbreak of unknown origin. The player must investigate, solve puzzles and fight zombies to survive and uncover the truth behind the disaster. Gather weapons and resources to defend yourself from the "returned" and avoid getting infected and suffering of 'stress', which will accelerate the infection.

title: The Lost Treasures of Infocom II
description:
The Lost Treasures of Infocom II is a collection of text adventure games from interactive fiction pioneer Infocom, published by Activision in 1992. It was available for MS-DOS and Apple Macintosh, and also as a cross-platform expanded CD-ROM version. This follow-up compilation was released following the commercial success of their previous collection, The Lost Treasures of Infocom, which contained 20 of Infocom's most popular games.

The 11 games included in all versions are:

A Mind Forever Voyaging
Border Zone
Bureaucracy
Cutthroats
Hollywood Hijinx
Nord and Bert Couldn't Make Head or Tail of It
Plundered Hearts
Seastalker
Sherlock: The Riddle of the Crown Jewels
Trinity
Wishbringer

The CD-ROM version included three additional games:

Arthur: The Quest for Excalibur
James Clavell's Shōgun
Journey

The package contains an instruction manual reprinting all of the games' manuals, as well as a few pack-in items from Sherlock and Trinity. However, it leaves out the InvisiClues hint booklets from the original games, replacing them instead with a card advertising a pay-per-minute hint line. The package also includes a coupon for the game Leather Goddesses of Phobos, which had not been included in either of the two collections.

The CD-ROM version includes an instruction manual with instructions for all three games, the Book of Hours pack-in from Arthur, and the maps from Journey and Shōgun.

title: Subspace Continuum
description: Subspace Continuum is a player-maintained online shoot ‘em up game enjoyed by people from all around the world - many of whom remain addicted to the fast paced explosive battles! Gameplay is extremely competitive and there are cup leagues, tournaments, cash prize events, a variety of team & squad based competitions. This completely free game also has a pretty interesting player community with its own history which is so in-depth that books could probably be written about it!

title: Vanity Fair: The Pursuit
description: Players follow Lu Yuan through important stages of his life and experience his growth trajectory from youth to maturity. It will take you to relive those decisions that you have never tried to make in reality, and feel the different life brought about by each choice.

title: Late Night at the KWL
description:
Years ago, I worked for a radio station. The KWL.

Strange place.
It didn't run any songs, or interviews, or news. Just stories. Any genre. Any length. So long as it was original.
I was one of the two people in charge of writing them.

We worked nights to have everything ready for the morning recording.

I still remember the night I decided to quit.

title: Cilla
description:
Cilla is a dynamic 2D side-scrolling shooter that immerses players into the complex narrative of humanity's evolution and the endless struggle for survival at any cost.

You will acquaint themselves with Cilla - a mysterious entity thrust into the heart of war. She is the Perfect Soldier. Devoid of pain, fear, and remorse. Her journey intertwines with the harsh present and what seems to be an inevitable future, as endless losses and extraterrestrial threats pursue her at every turn. But what will happen when Cilla faces her most challenging trial - a choice that will change everything?

Game Features:

Narrative Twist: Immerse yourself in the story of the Perfect Soldier in an alternate future universe. Experience her emotions and confront a moral choice that will impact Cilla's fate and that of all humanity.

Beautiful Pixel Graphics: Enjoy handcrafted game landscapes, meticulously designed multi-layered backgrounds, and unique enemies in each level.

Challenging and Dynamic Combat: Demonstrate maximum agility, collect bonuses, evade enemy fire, and study their behavior and attacks throughout the gripping story of the game.

Take up the challenge and determine the fate of the world!

title: An Other Golf Game
description:
An Other Golf Game is not your typical openish world sandbox life-sim survival golf game experience featuring permadeath. Finally, now you can suck at golf virtually as much as you suck in real life.

You'll learn the art of golf on your own terms: picking clubs, assessing the wind, and, of course, tracking down that stray ball no matter where it lands. It’s a game for those who want to discover, adapt, and make every inch of progress on their own.

Beyond the golf course, life goes on—literally. You're living out entire days, where golfing may or may not be part of it, it's entirely up to you. You’ll have to keep yourself alive, managing food, water, and sleep while earning enough cash through odd jobs to keep your golfing dream alive.

It’s a game that tests patience, resourcefulness, and adaptability. If you’re willing to roll with the quirks, laugh off the Early Access growing pains, you might just discover an experience that’s both unexpectedly rewarding and thoroughly unconventional.

Welcome to An Other Golf Game. Good luck out there, and happy golfing… if you can survive long enough to get to it!

title: State of Presence
description: State of Presence is a point-and-click visual novel that toys with the concept of existence and physicality. Players will delve into the afterlife of Kacper Takarski as he copes with his untimely death and the new environment he's found himself in. Exploring an unfamiliar city, Kacper must string together the remnants of his past in order to understand what became of him.

title: Sunky the PC Port
description: An awesome parody of SONIC-PC (by JoeDoughBoi and John-Kun) in which Sunky needs to invite 1 more friend to start a DANCE PARTY!

title: Coded Soul: Uketsugareshi Idea
description: Experience Coded Soul originally released on the PSP (PlayStationPortable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Blaze From Outer Space
description: Blaze crashes upon a planet and needs to find a way to escape from there

title: Y
description: Text-less adventure

title: DeckHex
description: Dark Sci-fi Adventure

title: Class of '09: The Flip Side
description: The final chapter of the Class of '09 VN series... this time from a different perspective! Join Nicole's best friend Jecka as you help her navigate the pitfalls of post-grad life! See what 2009 was truly like in this fully voiced interactive sitcom!

title: Feed Da King
description: An idle clicker game that features moments of active and passive play, with a dynamic window system that allows you to toggle the game on top of other applications and adjust it to your preference.

title: Champion's Ashes
description: Champion's Ashes is a mod for Dark Souls III that overhauls the game by enhancing and balancing various elements. It introduces new gameplay mechanics, such as improved combat and altered enemy placements. The mod also adds new items, weapons, and spells while rebalancing existing content to create a more challenging and refined experience.

title: RandoJumper
description: A precision platformer of a pirate who is out there to prove himself that he can reach the top!

title: Pixel With Your Friends
description: Pixel With Your Friends is a color-by-numbers game where you have to restore artworks pixel by pixel for a museum. You can color the artworks alone or together with a friend online.

title: Assassin's Creed Revelations - Signature Edition
description:
The pre-order version available at North American Gamestop locations.

The Signature Edition of the game includes:
• A bonus singleplayer gameplay mission (Vlad the Impaler's Tomb)
• An exclusive multiplayer character (Ottoman Jester)
• Weapons capacity upgrades (Crossbow, bomb, and gun)
• An animated short film based on the "Assassin's Creed" universe (Assassin's Creed Embers)
• An "Assassin's Creed Revelations" original game score soundtrack

title: Undertale Green
description: Undertale Green is a Fangame project where you follows the fifth human, Olive, the soul of kindness through their journey into the underground, in order to find the king of monsterkind. But will they makes friend on the road ? it's up to you to decide their fate, in brand new areas, and with brand new monsters to discover!

title: Mega Man Sunrise
description: A Gameboy Mega Man inspired fangame. After Dr. Light created a new highly intelligent robot by the name of "Trance", Dr. Wily manages to kidnap her and reprogram her for his evil purposes. It's up to Mega Man to once again put a stop to Dr Wily's evil scheme and bring back Trance to reason.

title: Mischief Castle
