description: This is a Platformer Adventure Game for the NES, with gameplay similar to other platforms of that time. Simple jump and shoot. Navigate five maze levels each with unique enemies and bosses. Find hidden secrets and power-ups.

title: Finding Buddies
description: Daniel has just started his adult life. Despite his sad past, he managed to move on and re-socialize. So many responsibilities are coming and it is up to you to decide how he will handle all of this. The great thing is that maybe you can find some cute guys along your path

title: Tube Noodles
description:
Last night you tried this new "tube noodles" stuff for dinner. It tasted just... ok.

Now, why is your stomach speaking to you? And why does it keep telling you to EAT?

title: House of Torment
description:
Experience the chilling terror of "House of Torment," a gripping horror game where you, Andrew Carter, wake up lost in a dark forest with no memory of how you arrived and only a flashlight to guide you. Desperate for shelter, you stumble upon a mysterious house. Inside, you must uncover the dark secrets of its infamous owner, the renowned streamer Asmongold.

Navigate eerie rooms, solve intricate puzzles, and avoid terrifying encounters, as you are not a fighter. Survival depends on your wits and stealth. With stunning graphics and immersive sound design, your journey through the House of Torment will be a spine-chilling experience.

Can you unravel the mysteries and escape the house? Download now and face your fears.

title: Sonic The Fighters Blitz Hyper Edition
description: Sonic The Fighters Blitz Hyper Edition (STFBHE) is the continuation of Sonic the Fighters Blitz (STFB), a 2D re-imagining of the arcade game Sonic The Fighters created by Restless Dipstick. STFBHE aims to rebalance and expand upon the original STFB.

title: The Last Goodbye
description: In the shadowy fairy tale metropolis of Prava, the world-weary gun-for-hire Lucille - better known on the streets as The Banshee - takes a job from enigmatic entrepreneur Ark McLean. Her target: Bullseye, the deadliest gangster in town. On her travels through the criminal underworld she meets all manner of friends and foes, with plenty of action and intrigue along the way.

title: Ferral Quest
description:
Open world. With different biomes: forest, jungle, desert, wasteland snowy, volcanic. In addition to dozens of dungeons to explore and hidden secrets.
Open world PVE missions, special dungeons.
Raid Bosses and Wanderers to hunt scattered around the world.
Progression from Tier 0 to Tier 10.
Develop your skill tree to make your character unique.
Different buffs and equipment so you can forge your strategy in battle.
Get the best equipment by destroying big bosses in their dungeons.

title: Dooming The Bar
description:
Dooming The Bar is a project centered on bringing the Half-Life 2 beta's City 17 into Doom, composed of a fully playable 8-map journey from the Industrial sector through to Kleiner's lab as per 2001 and 2002 concepts, plus two bonus maps.

You'll see famous landmarks like the Stenographer's Chasm, Terminal Plaza (with pendulum script!), Consulcast, Manhack Arcade (both versions!) and more on your travels.

title: Peacely Online
description:
Embark on an epic adventure in Peacely Online, a captivating 2D top-down pixel art MMORPG. Enter the peaceful world of Peacely, a realm without ego,

Explore diverse maps, complete thrilling quests, and battle fearsome monsters to progress through the game. Collect gear and items from loot drops and customize your character.

Start your journey in Peacely Ville, where you have a cozy home to return to and numerous NPCs to interact with. Alongside loyal pets that aid in your battles and a vibrant community of players to chat with, Peacely Online promises an immersive and enjoyable gaming experience.

title: Virtual Firearm Simulations
description: Virtual Firearm Simulations is a low-poly gun building simulator with over 40 accurately modeled weapons.

title: AI Senshi Neuro-sama
description: A 2D "beat'em up" fan game based on the Neuro-sama universe with hand-drawn graphics and animation, made in 2024 by a solo developer Azzypics.

title: Atelier Marie Plus: The Alchemist of Salburg
description:
A remastered version of the original Atelier Marie Plus, released with the Digital Deluxe Upgrade Pack with upgrade graphics and, for the first time, worldwide.
It is accessible from the Atelier Marie Remake main menu.

title: Was God Birthed!?
description: Explore a lush, liminal museum with surreal suprises at every turn as you avoid your dad with your wits and scooter, and make it downstairs in time to catch the Club Ruby Rave!

title: Nobunaga's Ambition: Kakushin - Power Up Kit
Nobunaga's Ambition: Reppuuden - Power Up Kit
Nobunaga's Ambition: Haouden - Power Up Kit
Nobunaga's Ambition: Soutenroku - Power Up Kit
1987: Rescue in Berlin
description: Will you be able to find the floppy disk and return safely?

title: StreamerBeater
description: It's free, try it ;) Third person souls-like featuring a solid combat mechanic, 5 explorable levels, 3 big boss fights, mobs, cutscenes, unlockables, and a main story.

title: The Case Book of Arne: Interlude
description:
Get a taste of Lynn and Arne's everyday life between cases!
There's a lot more to Lynn's life in the other world than you see in the main story!
Take the curious events at the Lugenberg Festival...
Unravel a new mystery in this Interlude chapter,
which takes place between Cases 1 and 2.

title: WhereHurt
description: Immerse yourself in WhereHurt, a psycho-horror game where reality and nightmare collide. Navigate your home, city, and workplace, racing against time to escape inner demons and societal mental barriers. Can you solve the puzzles and confront your fears, or will you be lost forever?

title: Souvenirs
description: Explore a house in search of Leonardo's memories. Souvenirs is a merge like strategy game, created by a tiny independent French studio.

title: Son and Bone
description: Son and Bone is a fast-paced first-person shooter where you take on the role of Sam Judge, a Sheriff, that after tracking down a notorious bandit who attacked a farm and kidnapped a local, has found himself on an alien world overrun by prehistoric creatures and dinosaurs.

title: Cluminati
description: Test your linguistic skills in Cluminati, a puzzle word game where you decipher clues to unlock passwords and join a secret society. Use your wits while racing against time to advance through 13 challenging rounds of initiation.

title: Street Fighter 6: Year 2 Character Pass
description:
The Street Fighter 6: Year 2 Character Pass includes 4 characters as they are released, Outfit 1 colors 3-10 for those characters and 4200 drive tickets.

The characters included are M. Bison, Terry, Mai and Elena.
Terry and Mai from Fatal Fury will be the first guest characters to appear in the main Street Fighter series.

title: Memory Ghosts
description: A paranormal otome where there's no escape from what haunts you.

title: Big Boo's Haunt
description: This map is based on Big Boo's Haunt from Super Mario 64 but with changes/improvements all over the place (for instance, you can actually see through all the windows, which you couldn't in Super Mario 64).

title: Lethal Lava Land
description: A map based on Lethal Lava Land from Super Mario 64.

title: Shifting Sand Land
description: A map based on Shifting Sand Land from Super Mario 64.

title: Wet-Dry World
description: A map loosely based on Wet-Dry World from Super Mario 64.

title: Snowman's Land
description: A map based on Snowman's Land from Super Mario 64.

title: Tick Tock Clock
description: A Duke map based on the Super Mario 64 course of the same name (and not based on the Mario Kart course of the same name).

title: L.A. Meltdown 2047
description: A large map that reinterprets all of episode 1: L.A. Meltdown.

title: Shrapnel City 2096: Trapped In The Future!
description: Just like L.A. Meltdown 2047 did with episode 1, Shrapnel City 2096: Trapped In The Future! reinterprets all of episode 3 in just one big level.

title: Winterfall
description: After a few days of R&R, Duke Nukem returned to his work for EDF. Now he's a Detective Nukem and his job is to look after the Little Bigville, the little snow town on the edge of nowhere....

title: Pyratel
description: This map is partially inspired by a known pyramid-shaped hotel in Las Vegas.

title: Der Zorn Gottes
description: A map that takes place on an oil drilling platform.

title: Poison Heart
description: Poison Heart is a snowy city / Xmas-themed / hi-tech level that should last you about 50 mins on your first playthrough.

title: Factory Parking
description: A Doom-style map (more abstract and less realistic, among other things) that takes place in some parking lots/garages that have been invaded by the aliens.

title: Precipice Pain
description: A Doom-style map that revolves around a big vaguely hellish rock formation, on which Duke has to "climb" (jump, fall off ledges, etc.) up and down a lot.

title: Metal Eye
description:
In Metal Eye, the player takes the role of a young weapons expert named Findhill. His father was apparently involved in a project that dealt with creating artificial life forms. But recently he has disappeared without a trace. Findhill remained alone, in a small town surrounded by vicious monsters. He wants to become a hunter, just like his father once was, to get rid of the monsters roaming the wilderness, and get to the bottom of his father's disappearance and his mysterious project.

The game is a rather traditional Japanese RPG: Findhill and his companions, who join the party as dictated by the course of the story, wander around a vast world map, visiting towns, descending into dungeons, and fighting random enemies in turn-based combat viewed from a first-person perspective. The party can carry different types of weapons, including various guns (rifles, shotguns, etc.) with expendable bullets. Weapons and armor are shared by all the characters and need not be equipped on individual combatants. The player can also purchase robotic fighters (called "Metals" in the game) in shops, who would then join the party and participate in battles, controlled by the AI. There are scenes with nudity and sexual situations in the game.

title: Metal Eye 2
description:
Metal Eye 2 is set in the same sci-fi universe and is closely related story-wise to the first game. In the future, people have built the floating city Zeron, where the best scientists work on creating androids, artificial human beings who look the same way as real ones. Harvest Corporation is the biggest company that creates androids. The hero of the game is a scientist named Wirg, the father of the first game's protagonist. His work is to train the androids after they have been created. One day, the company building is attacked, and Wirg has to escape. He is saved by a nun and brought into a small town in the middle of wasteland, where his adventure begins.

The game mostly follows a traditional Japanese RPG template: Wirg and his companions (a party of three) explore the top-down world and fight random enemies in turn-based combat in first-person view. The pictures of enemies appear super-imposed on whatever location the characters are currently in, without separate battle screens. The towns have isometric perspective. Like its predecessor, the game has a large world map that consists of many separate screens, often including dungeon-like locations.

title: Yami no Koe II
description: Sayoko sends K off the island to a secluded private academy, where she makes an ally of the principal and begins to influence the students and faculty, slowly degenerating the entire school. However, one of the students is a miko who resists K's influence.

title: Flowers: Kokoro no Hana
description: Ryusei Ryousen is a 2nd year high school student. His school has just recently been co-educated from all girls school. There are only three boys in school and a lot of wonderful girls around the hero. Which one will be chosen by the April?

title: Brutalist
description: Brutalist is a third-person meditative game where you need to follow paths, find passages, solve riddles, watch out for radiation and monitor oxygen levels. And all this is surrounded by an atmospheric abandoned concrete world.

title: Sector 666
description: 10 levels created by modder Skillsaw in 1998 famously his first work.

title: Duke Tournament
description: It has one single-player episode "Annihilation" (of five levels) & a dukematch episode of eight levels.

title: Shocking Twist
description: A new single map by Magnarj

title: MSSP8
description: Typical city level - more city style than O'Boy was.

title: MSSP 9: New Pietniemi
description: A "New LA" type map with some "Freeway" and V5 influences thrown in as well. The map is named after the neighborhood where Mikko Sandt grew up.

title: Chillin'
description: This map focuses on an alien spacecraft and some buildings around where it landed; by the time Duke gets there, there are way too many aliens in the area just kinda chillin'.

title: Sikhl
description: Sikhl is set somewhere in the southwestern USA. There's been various reports of EDF troops getting fired upon by unknown assailants near a vast canyon area. Duke's been ordered to travel there and find out what's going on.

title: Nuclear Plant 2024
description: Nuclear Plant 2024 is a map of Doom: E1M2 but Reimagined!

title: The Immortal Lock
description:
You are Ranger, an operator of the UTJR stationed at a secret, multinational research facility in Finland. You are being deployed to investigate the disappearance of a survey team that went missing beyond the slipgate, cast into the farthest reaches of existence. Yet through the thin veil of reality, you find only a desolate plane of flesh and despair, and a dread voice that beckons your name.

This map is larger than an entire episode, if played in its entirety, and is best experienced in segments. It includes a story, extremely challenging fights, trick jumping, and a vast amount of large secret areas, but is difficulty scaled to accommodate everyone.

title: Site Z-374
description: An expanded version of ExaByt's Quake Brutalist Jam 2 map and now using Alkaline.

title: Missing Coordinates
description: A short map based on Markie's Quake Builder Block 1.

title: 1024 Cement Mixer
description: A short aggressive map within a 1024 player-bound volume.

title: Osterity
description:
Burdensome regulations have long stymied the United Aerospace Corporation's ability to innovate in the energy sector. However, recent pro-business rulings represent a welcome change of pace, clearing the way for us to open an exciting new facility in the Lone Star State. Come on down 'n' see us sometime, y'all!

OSTERITY is a 7+1 map vanilla "mega episode" for the Doom 2 IWAD, powered by OTEX. A 3-episode, Doom 1-inspired megawad squeezed into just 7 maps. The basic formula is to alternate sprawling megamaps with short boss/challenge maps, though the rules are bent a little towards the end.

title: E4M1 remake
description: It's a short map (5-10 minutes) inspired by E4M1. The visuals are kept minimal to stay true to the spirit of the original map.

title: 17 Bucks: Floor 1
description: 17 Bucks is a Friday Night Funkin' mod centering around internet personas and original characters.

title: Memoirs of an Angel
description: A fantasy-themed otome visual novel with stat-building and mini-games.

title: Restless Dreams
description: Before you realize it, dreams have become a curse. Wander through a darkened room and descend into the depths of her mind. A story-driven first-person horror game that leads you into an abyss of anguish and despair. Dedicated to those who once pursued their dreams—and to those who still do.

title: My Buddy Did Something Weird And Now I Have Feelings For Him??!?!?
description:
Can one little thing change the way you feel about someone?

Everything points to 'yes' when Vale and Lawrence's Quality Bro Time becomes a little too cozy…And gay panic ensues.

title: Furitsu Metatopology Daigaku Fuzoku Joshi Koukou
description:
Fumejo is a doujin SRPG where the protagonist belongs to a club at the prestigious prefectural metapology educational institutionwith a 1200-year tradition. Together with allies, they navigate chaotic battlefields involving firearms, swordsmanship, and magic, aiming to rebuild their club crushed by conspiracy. Known for its setting where girls engage in deadly battles, high playability, and well-crafted background music.

Characters gain experience points through combat to acquire new skills. The game employs a multi-scenario system where outcomes vary based on strategic decisions and choices made during battles. Although criticized for modest production values, an abrupt mid-story ending, and a simplistic growth system resembling a prototype version, it featured diverse elements typical of doujinshi, such as variations in character dialogue and designs, and occasional single-image cut-ins. Notably, the game manual was integrated within the game rather than being a separate paper format. A commercialized version released as "Metajo" was released a year later with many mechanic and graphic improvements as well as story alterations such as allowing players to experience the 1200-year establishment until the end.

title: Reines Du Sabbat
description:
Reines Du Sabbat is a JRPG developed by doujin circle Kenix who would later develop Corpse Party, this work became quite infamous on the Japanese internet during the late 90's and early 2000's due to its grotesque content to the point of being "quietly" distributed on freeware sites.

The game takes place in the country of Serfina. In a small hut there lived a girl called Puff, together with her older brother, Lux. Since they've lost their parents at an early age, the older brother had to take the parent role and take care of his little sister. However, one day, Lux suddenly fell ill with a fever of an unknown origin, with no doctor able to help and him gradually losing his strength. Puff heard about a medicinal herb called the Snow Herb that can quickly bring down any kind of fever and went to the forest of Pia to find it. In the forest, being absorbed in the beautiful flowers blooming there Puff lost her uncle.

This is where the game begins and Puff's journey will lead her to witness the cruelty of human beings...

title: Blitz
description: Blitz is a challenging, fast-paced platformer with infinite procedurally generated levels. Build a new unique character each run and fight one action-packed room after another! Dropkick, decapitate, and incinerate your foes. Do you have what it takes to conquer Blitz?

title: Cinematic Mod
description:
What is Cinematic Mod?

Cinematic Mod (CM) is a Half-Life 2 modification, that adds more details and a darker look to the original Half-Life 2 series.

Imagine, a Hollywood producer got his hands on the game. The result would be similar to what the Cinematic Mod is: a graphics blockbuster, redesigned to the typical game to movie adaption with an orchestral soundtrack and beautiful people everywhere.

title: 2121 AD
description: Duke has traveled a century into the future, to the year 2121 A.D. He was invited there not only to fight off the latest swarm of invaders, but also to be a special guest on a Los Angeles TV talk show about time travelers.

title: Arcade Archives: Tinkle Pit
description: "TINKLE PIT" is an action game released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1993. Your objective: Save Tinkle Land from an evil spell and restore peace to the world! Featuring characters drawn from NAMCO classics and deep gameplay for high score competition!

title: Zaggy Car
description: Zaggy Car is an endless journey through the desert where players collect money to unlock new cars. The more money they gather, the faster they go, making it increasingly challenging. Along the way, players can grab special items like double coins or a magnet for a limited time. The goal? Accumulate as much money as possible!

title: Colorama Cubes
description: Try your hand at a unique spatial puzzle game

title: Cola Riders
description: Ride the Cola & Mint Rocket for the craziest experience of your life!

title: Seedsow Lullaby
description: "My mother, my daughter, and me—three sixteen-year-olds on an extraordinary adventure."After traveling through time to meet their sixteen-year-old counterparts, three generations of women set off on an adventure through the Land of the Gods. What could await them at the end of their journey?

title: Baby Boomer 2: 35 Years Too Soon
description: Nobody asked for it, yet the sequel to “Baby Boomer” is out 35 years after the original! This is literally breaking the world record for the longest time in-between video game sequels!

title: Slaughterfest
description: A very hard map filled with all sorts of monsters. Slaughterfest takes place in a seaside town and you start with no weapons.

title: Sludge Plunge
description: Sludge Plunge is a map set in swamp area.

title: Grey Lights
description: A hub-style city map with all the usual urban locations from Shop-n-Bags to Sushi restaurants

title: Close Range
description: Duke is now forced to deal with everything from simple Troopers to fat Commanders using nothing but his mighty boot and tripmines.

title: Naked Dash
description: Duke has been captured yet again! This time things are looking real bad: aliens took Duke to their base and put him in a prison cell. Our hero must survive a venture through the "Naked Dash": a surreal office complex built by aliens for entertainment purposes and filled with deadly traps and puzzles. Will Duke be able to make it through this doomed office fortress which took lives of many men before him? More importantly, will you help him escape?

title: Canyon
description: Survive in the desert by hunting prey, and evolve as you raise your kids and help them reach adulthood. You are a lizard that founded its den after being stranded in a canyon land. There are dangers around that can surprise you and the risk of starvation is looming over you and your children.

title: Elemental Cube
description: "Elemental Cube" takes you on a challenging and thought-provoking journey through a magical world. This single-player puzzle game consists of 50 unique levels, each requiring players to overcome obstacles with strategy, logic, and creativity. At the heart of the game is a mystical cube, with each face representing one of the four fundamental elements: fire, water, earth, and air.

title: Ruinas
description: Duke has gotten lost and ended up in some unknown ruins plagued by aliens. Duke will have to manage to find his way out of the ruins.

title: Hostile Terrain
description: This map is based on a Quake map all the way from 1997 called F**ing hostile.

title: Pjsloth1
description: A simple layout built into outdoor terrain with a heavy focus on combat.

title: Rooftop Rascal: The Alley Cat
description:
In "Rooftop Rascal: The Alley Cat," you control a clever alley cat navigating city buildings' fire escape stairs to the rooftop goal.
The gameplay centres on precise jumps, avoiding (possible) obstacles, and quick thinking.
Your goal is to climb as high as you can, reach the rooftop, and beat the game.

title: Racing Bros: Mafias Revenge
description: Welcome to a new racing bros party adventure that will challenge your skills once more. Try the epic extraction challenge across the world or fight against your friends in crazy party modes. Are you ready for some more racing bros?

title: The Aztec Ruins
description: Aztec temple inspired map.

title: Tropical Alien Massacre
description: Small city map located on a tropical island.

title: Duke 3:16
description: Duke is off relaxing in a secret location. The aliens have infiltrated EDF headquarters and taken key leadership hostage. The ransom is the location of Duke.The aliens are methodically cutting off all escape routes. The only way left out is through the tunnel at the railstation.

title: Duke 6:8
description: Duke 6:8 picks up where Duke 23:4 left. Duke must find his way through a dam in order to exact vengeance on his treacherous EDF buddies.

title: Duke 12:12
description: Duke is back in town after having cleared a nearby dam of alien scum in Duke 6:8.

title: Puzzle Dungeon!!: Earthmage Erin
description:
Puzzle Dungeon!! is a series of games where fantasy classes solve puzzles themed after their abilities!

In Puzzle Dungeon!!: Earthmage Erin, play as Erin, an Earthmage with the power to control gravity. Solve 30+ puzzles in themed dungeons to rescue Erin's lost goats and bring them back to her farm.

title: Jade Base
description: This level is a sequel to the Alien Planet. Duke arrives at moon of the planet Jade.

title: Mind Storm
description: This level is inspired by other bizarre-like levels:Asylum, Bizarre, Phantasm

title: Transport 2
description: This map is a sequel to jade base. It's a large, sometimes difficult level which should provide a challenge to even the most seasoned of players

title: Dawn in Arctic
description: In the end you stand on the cliff... silence... after the battle sun has risen... It is the very end...

title: Alien Space Station
description: Duke infiltrates an alien space station in orbit around Earth. His job is to kill everything that moves and take out the control room.

title: 15 Minutes
description: Reality shifts. Time loops. You're trapped underground with only 15 minutes and something’s changing the rules. Spot the anomalies. Find the way out before the map turns against you or you might just run out of time. What you see may not be real.

title: Popcorn Fever
description:
Popcorn Fever is a “suika game” featuring popcorns, developed by Yunicorn Studio !

Need a coffee break, stuck in a long commute, or just want to pass the time? Start a game and merge as many popcorns as you can!

Aim, drop, and merge the popcorns to score points. Customize your game by unlocking unique and surprising powers. Find your own style and climb the leaderboard !

Will you reach the top of the best player pantheon?!

title: Nordhold
description:
Build a city and defend it in this Tower Defense game blending Roguelite mechanics with turn-based building Strategy. Choose your hero, utilize synergistic tower upgrades, and face epic battles in procedurally generated landscapes.

Nordhold is a tower defense game for strategy enthusiasts who crave high replayability through endless combinations. Build and manage a cozy medieval Nordic village while enjoying deep tactical gameplay that doesn’t require extensive learning.

title: You Have To Climb Out
description: A short puzzle/story game about a frog who has fallen into a cave after digging too deep

title: Bou's Revenge
description: A short 3D horror inspired by Pou the famous mobile game. the game starts with you taking care of Bou but then things starts to get weird...

title: Arc Nova Base
description: A huge space-station where things have gone awry

title: Underground Fortress
description: The sequel to West Alien Train.

title: West Alien Train
description: Duke must find an alien semi-organic train that is heading west and wipe all those aliens before they trash the next city

title: Alien Sanctuary
description: An alien base on a distant planet.

title: The Sub Shop
description: Duke finds himself in a rocky area close to the sea.

title: Seaquest
description: This time Duke is sent to some sort of a submarine base. The alien vermin has taken over a fortress by the sub base and it's your job to cleanse 'em out.

title: Wang Nukem
description: An urban map with a street section and a train station inspired by Shadow Warrior.

title: Castle Karthenfrost
description: A Medium-to-large Knave map which uses Arcane Dimensions, set in the cold wasteland realm of Karthenfrost. Has a moderate amount of monsters.

title: High Noon In Akhetaten
description: A Quake map largely based off of Serious Sam's Karnak level.

title: The Monastery of Mount Cinburron
description: Command noticed an anomaly in their Slipgate network. After sending a few scouting parties into the anomaly, none of which have returned, they are starting to fear the worst. They sent you in to investigate the anomaly and report your findings upon your return.

title: Silver Gene: The Mutia Chronicle 1
description:
The protagonist, a university student named Yuji Shibata, encounters a naked girl crouching in a garbage dump one night. The girl has animal ears and a tail, unlike a human, and she has lost her memory. The protagonist names her "Mii" and takes her in, helping her to regain her memory. Who exactly is she?

This game is a remake of "Radical Sequence" the first in the Gao Gao! Series released by Four-Nine, consisting of 8 chapters and progresses as a traditional ADV where you make choices. the game featured command selections like "look" and "talk," like many other PC-9801 ADV but in this revamped entry commands have been removed for smoother progression.

title: Yuugao
description: Infamous doujin game also known as Cruel Kanon.

title: Honkai: Star Rail - Finest Duel Under the Pristine Blue
description:
Version 2.4 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New characters: Yunli and Jiaoqiu
• New path for March 7th: The Hunt
• New Trailblaze Continuance: Finest Duel Under the Pristine Blue
• New area: The Shackling Prison
• …and more!

title: Murder in the Maze
description: Play as Mappy , as you go from game to game, looking for clues to solve the murder of Pac-Man!

title: Alter A.I.L.A. Genesis
description:
Alter A.I.L.A. Genesis is an expanded and heavily reworked remake of the original Alter A.I.L.A., with a completely redesigned combat system and the multiple story paths removed in favor of a single, longer, slightly more humorous storyline.

The game takes place in a post-apocalyptic world. You play the role of a young man known as Leon, who seeks to survive in the harsh environment he is brought into.

Exploration is done mainly via a side-scrolling view. In certain areas, an exclamation mark will sometimes appear, indicating the presence of hostiles. Press Z when this happens to initiate battle, or wait to let it pass. Sometimes battle will be unavoidable. When walking, enemy encounters won't occur.

The battle system revolves mainly around each character's Abilities, which are a set of commands specific to that character. Abilities require AP and EX to use. AP is gained every time a character takes a turn.

title: Waco Resurrection
description: Revisiting the 1993 Waco, Texas incident, gamers enter the mind and form of a resurrected David Koresh and advance towards salvation or destruction by wielding weapons, collecting followers and voicing messianic messages.

title: Train Sim World 4: LIRR Commuter - New York: Long Beach, Hempstead & Hicksville
description: Time to truly experience America's busiest commuter railroad in Train Sim World 4! Return to Long Island and delve deep into an enhanced New York - Hicksville, now including the Long Beach branch, new lighting and skies, overhauled signalling, an all-new bustling timetable, and the LIRR M9!

title: Unravel Trigger
description:
The Frost Neutral Territory - a buffer zone between the superpowers of the Karg Federation and the Vilcar Empire. A tourist hotspot, yet a melting pot of constant conflict with its diverse immigrant populations.

Sakaki Kai, the protagonist, is an investigator at the Trigger Detective Agency based on this neutral ground. His mission? To track down his childhood friend Yuzuriha Saina, who vanished during the last great war.

While there have been scattered sightings of Saina in this area, her trail has gone cold.

Then, from a hilltop overlooking the city, Kai crosses paths with Millie - a young girl reaching up towards the sky. Much like Saina from years past, Millie laments the endless cycle of violence and yearns for peace. This meeting isn't just a big deal for Kai or the neutral district—it will shake things up for the whole world.

A tale of confronting lost pasts to stride towards a new future - the curtain rises here.

title: Filler
description: The aliens have taken over another city and it's your mission to kill them all and find your way to the bus station, hop a bus, and get out.

title: The End of the World
description: Yet another city at night - except this particular one is under a pretty fucking serious type of attack. You wake up to an alien ship having just crashed right down your apartment building.

title: Wide Awake!
description: A city block at night. Local amenities include a swimming pool, apartments, a grocery store, a sewer system and more. Duke wakes up in his hotel room, finds out that the city is under attack.

title: Tit-E-Bar
description: It's a direct continuation to Koodbool, but way closer to the original Duke 3D base level format with a layout-centric theme, falling under the Old Limits and with a non-Euclidian progression inspired by Lunatic Fringe.

title: Downtown Ride
description: A medium sized city map.

title: SM64 The Green Stars PC
description: A port of SM64 The Green Stars playable on PCs.

title: The Last Pissed Time
description: Duke is held hostage in a prison cell by those alien bastards. He must escape and shut down their power plant.

title: Koodbool
description: Neo L.A.: the distant future of 2024. Retired for eons since a series of legal disputes, Duke Nukem is off to a literal fresh start, festively spending Christmas eve alone, homeless and panhandling.

title: Hostile Waters
description: Once more duke finds himself in the middle of a hostile situation, this time aboard a half flooded nuclear submarine, grounded on the rocks in the middle of the ocean on a dark stormy night.

title: Big Orbit
description: A large starship orbiting earth which duke will dock within a shuttle

title: Quest
description: Duke Nukem mysteriously lands in the Underworld. This world is very different from our world. There are no police, no beer, and no girls. Duke Nukem has to find his way out. The only way out is through the demonic portal, can he survive?

title: Apprehension Arizona
description: A map set around the Arizona desert in which Duke must infiltrate a former EDF base that has been overrun by alien maggots.

title: Baptized In Lunar Dust
description: A linear moon base map. The sequel to Apprehension Arizona.

title: Downtown Journey
description: An entire new episode for Duke Nukem 3D Atomic made in a Pentium MMX.

title: Duke Craft
description:
Duke Craft is a combination of DN3D mechanics and Minecraft-like level design. The story is simple - aliens stole Duke's hard earned diamonds and he has to get them back.

The map includes some features taken from Minecraft, like crafting or using of torches to light the areas.

title: Duketroid
description: A conceptual Duke map which replicates the fundamental game design concept behind Super Metroid, Castlevania: Symphony of the Night and many others in that genre.

title: Siebenpolis
description: A city at night with mostly vertical action and a yellow GB-esque colour pallette.

title: Duke 2070
description: Made for the 9th annual map contest of Duke España. It's a very large city from the author of the Doom II Planisphere (extremely large city) levels.

title: The Rock
description: You are on a island prison and have to fight your way through from the front gate right into the heart of the prison

title: Turnpike
description: A (very loose) remake of the classic Duke 3D episode 3 secret level by Allen Blum, "Freeway", originally started during a Duke4.net "mappening"

title: Salvage Title
description: A speedmap in an urban, junkyard & drive-in theather-themed level, with emphasis on layout & flow.

title: Bloodstone Courtyard
description: A short doom-style level.

title: Mega Plaza Shopping Center
description: Aliens captured a shopping center in Los Angeles.

title: Anorak City
description: A grand city map while being the sequel to Happy Hangover and the prequel to Bottles to The Ground

title: Daggers Cavern
description: Duke comes across a pirate hide-out in an underground cavern.

title: Supa3
description: Another city map, covered in beautiful snow!

title: Supersonic Mario
description: Supersonic Mario puts Mario from Super Mario 64 into Rocket League.

title: Duke Mansion
description: Haunted Mansion community CBP map in the spirit of Halloween.

title: Bridge Between Two Islands
description: Duke's mission is to destroy the big gun on the top of the island.

title: Doombox
description: Doombox is a survival bullet-heaven roguelike where a bazillion creatures emerge from somewhere. Craft a bunch of nifty guns, wear silly hats, and kill the crap out those creatures with over-the-top builds all fueled by the power of your DOOMBOX

title: 2-Hour Community Build Project
description: A community project with the simple rule: No more than 2 hours to add to the level. The end result was this large, incredible map.

title: Community Build Project 9: Halloween-2020
description: A community map that is similar to an episode, separated by portals.

title: 1.5-Hour Community Build Project
description: Compared to previous 1/2-hour CBPs, which had several people working on a single map, this 1.5-hour CBP had several people each working on their own mini maps.

title: Suburban Hive
description: Suburban Hive is a large map which owns hundred aliens to blast

title: Suburban Hive II: Crimson Moon
description: Crimson Moon is the sequel to Suburban Hive, made by dozens of talented mappers.

title: Zombie Harvest: Survival Farming Simulator
description: Grow Your Farm. Survive the Apocalypse. Defend Against the Undead.

title: Verdoria's Kingdom Quest: Magic, Battles & Sorcery
description: Discover this exciting visual novel where brave heroes unravel ancient mysteries and spells. An epic journey you won't want to miss!

title: Which Kanji? So Fancy!
description:
Where is the flower labeled “仙人掌” in the illustration?
Let’s learn KANJI, even difficult ones for Japanese people, in a fun way through this game!

title: Viking Heroes V: Collector's Edition
description: Embark on a festive journey as the vikings prepare for Yule!

title: Vac Attack
description: Hoover them up!

title: Urban Warfare: Assault
description: Embark on a heart-pounding journey of combat and strategy in Urban, a third-person solo shooter that pits you against the world's most dangerous terrorists.

title: Toon Roads: Superbike
description: Choose your superbike, twist the throttle and LET'S GO, let the race begin!!!

title: Sugoi Girls: Kinky Knight
description: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!

title: Suddenly an Ogre
description:
Relive the magic of classic gamebooks.
Step into the adventure: Your story, your ending.
What path will you choose?

title: Stars, Stripes and Subgames: Collector's Edition
description: Immerse yourself in a world of subgames captivating and diverse subgames!

title: Spy Guy Animals Junior
description: Find hidden objects and learn interesting facts about animals from around the world!

title: Slot & Learn Country Names in Kanji
description:
How to Write “Argentina” in KANJI?
Learn Country Names in KANJI with a Fun Puzzle Game!

title: Sportitions ’24
description: Sportitions’24 is a game with cool graphics to entertain the whole family and friends, encouraging self-improvement and competitiveness in fun athletic events.

title: Scoop it! Goldfish
description:
It's time for a carnival game classic: goldfish scooping!
Scoop as many as you can and become a master!

title: Monument: Invasion
description: Old-school first person shooter

title: Puzzle Playground
description: Adventure Awaits in Every Puzzle!

title: Racing Car Chaos: Extreme Stunt Showdown
description: Embrace the Chaos and Conquer the Stunts!

title: Neckbreak
description: Fight your way out in this dirty retro-styled tactical FPS.

title: Offroad Truck Simulator
description: Are you ready to embark on the ultimate offroad adventure?

title: Photographic Memory Test
description:
Memorize a photo in 1 minute and answer the quiz!
Your memory will be tested with a very difficult quiz.

title: Project Drift Japan Challenge
description: Unleash Your Inner Drift King on Iconic Roads!

title: My Virtual Pet
description: Adopt a cute and friendly virtual pet

title: Mystery Detective Adventure
description: Mystical events haunt locals.

title: Grandma Cleaning Simulator: Family Business Tycoon
description: Clean, Build, Prosper: Sweep Your Way to Success and Family Fortune!

title: Harvest Days
description: Your Dream Farm Is Waiting

title: Hole Theory
description: Eat everything

title: Hentai Solitaire
description: 120 solitaire games with hentai cards.

title: Musician Simulator
description: Make your career as a musician. Start as a street singer, become DJ in local pub, organize concert at a local hall, play at a largest music festival in your country. Create your own live music using musical instruments. Sing using real microphone in karaoke mode. Become a worldwide known musician.

title: Hentai Girls: Amazing America
description: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!

title: Hentai Academy
description: As a professor in a school for troubled teens you’ll have one goal - to teach, but what will you do when a troubled heart comes your way?

title: Hellpit 3D Platformer
description: Unique Traps, Endless Challenges – Survive in the HELLPIT!

title: Hollow Police Emblem: The Visual Novel
description: A visual novel where a detective must solve intriguing criminal cases while navigating the complexities of his personal relationships.

title: Let's Aim Shooting Gallery
description:
Gear up for a carnival game classic: shooting gallery!
Hit as many targets as you can and become a shooting gallery master!

title: Starslave
description: An Egyptian ruin with a dark secret. Contains a story, lots of quad runs, randomized elements, and plenty of secrets. Runs on the Copper mod, which is included.

title: Construction Simulator: Customization Kit
description: The construction site is your runway, so pimp your helmets and bring some color to your construction work! The Customization Kit contains additional styles for your personal protection equipment. Customize your helmets with 9 different fun and colorful designs, ranging from fiery flames to classy dots, and choose from a selection of ear protection and glasses.

title: Torture Jam 1
description: The God of flesh and desire has such sights to show you. But in order to be granted that privilege, he demands tribute in form of good suffering. He has graciously given Map-Center's community time to create a Strogg inspired torture maps worthy of his magnificence. Featuring seven new maps, a hub level, final boss and several intermissions.

title: Boss Speedjam 1
description: A short expansion, featuring a hub level and several new maps where each boss encounter is more than just shooting a bullet sponge.

title: Blake Turner: Ace Attorney
description: A little girl is found dead at the foot of a cliff, but her body suffered such injuries that it is not identified. A clumsy witness, a shabby prosecutor and a sharp attorney may lead to a "Not Guilty". Then who did really kill her?

title: NTE: Neverness to Everness
description: NTE: Neverness to Everness is a supernatural open-world RPG developed by Hotta Studio. The story begins in the city of Hethereau, where you play as its first "unlicensed" Anomaly Hunter. You'll join the crew at Eibon, a rundown antique shop that keeps the lights on by taking Anomaly commissions from anyone willing to pay. Alongside a diverse cast of extraordinary companions, you'll unravel urban mysteries, ride out adventures full of laughs and heartbreak, and write your own stories in the neon-lit streets.

title: So Many Words
description: Find the hidden word, each word guess is met with feedback indicating the correctly positioned letters. This is a word game that requires mastery of the English language, logic and a bit of luck. Choose to test your skills with words ranging from 4 to 9 letters in length.

title: ShedHorror
description:
You've cornered yourself in a tiny shed in an attempt to hide from the creature that has been hunting you down. Now your best chance at survival is to keep the creature at bay from within the shed until dawn. However, all you have to work with is a flashlight and your ears.

This game contains an abundance of RED. If you're suffering from erythrophobia, you'll have a stroke playing this game.

title: Hexual Deflection
description: Hexual Deflection is a minimalistic Multiplayer Arena RTS with Tower Defense Mechanics where you do not only defend against enemy units with towers but also send your own units onto enemy towers. description: Rogue is a dungeon-crawling adventure originally developed in the early 1980s, known for introducing procedurally generated levels and permadeath, which defined the "roguelike" genre. In this game, players explore the Dungeons of Doom, battling monsters and collecting treasure in a quest for the Amulet of Yendor. The Nintendo Switch port recreates Epyx's Amiga version, featuring pixel-art graphics and optional CRT filters for a retro aesthetic, along with background music that can be toggled on or off. This version stays faithful to the original gameplay while utilizing modern hardware for a smoother visual experience.

The current version has around 5 hours of content, featuring an original soundtrack of 15 songs, over 50 beautifully drawn backgrounds and fully-illustrated CGs, and nearly 100 unique character sprites.

description: Steal a briefcase!

title: Drop Pockets
description: The billiards roguelike. Strategic, physics based combat against Pool Sharks who don't play by the rules. Pocket your balls and clear out your opposition in this chaotic game of pool!

title: Cartenstein
description: A short story about being a master Card Collector.

title: My Assassin Bodyguard
description:
You grew up as a part of the Time Vessel Association. One day, your friend goes against the group and is killed, making you realize how insane the Association actually is. They never cared, and never will. You want out of it, so you decide to leave everything behind and run away.

Little do you know, they send a famous assassin after you. Can you make it out alive and maybe seduce the infamous Toji Fushiguro along the way?

title: A Grave Mistake
description: You're a gravedigger out digging graves, but you accidentally summoned an apocalypse, oops! Do you have the smarts to take control of the situation and stop the cataclysm?

title: Interstellar Interruption
description: Scifi Mystery

title: Morning Shift
description: Short Adventure Game

title: Toiletisia vs. Evil
description:
Have you ever dreamed of playing a video game about a toilet who battles devil worshippers?

Then today's your lucky day!

This is a game about a beautiful toilet police officer who has to deal with an evil cult that summoned an ancient evil demon in a creepy mansion.

title: World Weaver
description: Confront the World Weaver

Starring Cristobalín, a somewhat lazy student who must prepare for the Conquest of Granada if he wants to pass his History class. While studying in the library, he falls asleep and begins to dream something "incredible." A fun adventure, lacking in humor, and through which you'll also learn about the Conquest of Granada.

title: TWHL Tower: Source
description:
TWHL Tower: Source is the follow-up to the collaborative mods TWHL Tower and TWHL Tower 2. Each level is made by a different creator with the only limit being the size of the map. Other than that, every floor has unique and varied gameplay ranging from puzzles and platforming to intense combat sections.

TWHL Tower: Source expands on the previous mods by using Half-Life 2's Source engine together with the community made Mapbase mod to allow for even more unique gameplay possibilities. The mod features 18 floors by 15 different authors, 5 unlockable bonus maps, and over 20 in-game achievements for those seeking extra challenge.

title: Cupid's Chatroom
description: Find your true love with the help of Cupid's chatroom, a mysterious server that won't let you leave!

title: The Ice Cream Culprit
description: Your girlfriend's limited edition ice cream has been stolen! Was it you? Will you help her find it? All that is to be decided by 4 different endings.

title: Crash Bandicoot World
description:
Crash Bandicoot World is a Crash Fan-made game made by me
Looks like cortex have a new plan and crash have to stop him once again before it's Too Late
Join Crash in his new adventure !

title: Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea: Amaranthine Moon
description:
Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea: Amaranthine Moon is the otome standalone sequel to Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea, a Victorian vampire visual novel previously released in 2021. This visual novel is set around 5-6 years after the events of the first visual novel, following Lucie as the main character now that she's an adult.

Determined to make her own destiny as she turns 18, the young head of her family Lucie plunges headfirst in the conniving world of business dealings. Before she's able to seal the deal on a revolutionary treatment to vampirism, her business partner suddenly dies. Lucie finds herself embroiled in the middle of the mysterious death of her former partner and an event from a decade prior...

title: 124 Handle of the World
description:
Ever got that eerie feeling when you're in a bus, late at night? Ever thought about how much stronger that feeling must be when YOU'RE the driver? What may driving with the bus empty late at night feel like? This thought is what set me up to make this game.

In a PS1 style setting, you are a bus driver completing your night shift. You are getting tired, getting the last people off the bus to their destinations, until you're all alone. What might happen?

title: Founder of the Final Cult
description: Can you survive against crazy cultists and be the last cult standing?

title: Zort
description: Zort is an action, adventure, and horror game that can be played with up to 4 people. Explore maps with your friends and have fun while escaping from various creatures. Experience a realistic horror experience with in-game voice chat with your friends!

title: SNK vs. Capcom: SVC Chaos
description:
SNK and CAPCOM legends clash in this star-studded crossover fighting game!
The 2003 arcade hit SVC CHAOS is back and better than ever!

SVC CHAOS—a dream match of epic proportions! Worlds collide as 36 iconic characters across various series from SNK (mainly THE KING OF FIGHTERS) and CAPCOM (mainly STREET FIGHTER) do battle in a frantic fight to the finish! Brand-new rollback netcode and tournament modes allow for fun, fast-paced online matches—all while still retaining the classic visuals and controls of the original fan favorite. Also comes with a hitbox viewer and a gallery mode! Rise up and throw down with players all around the world in this new evolution of the SVC CHAOS legacy!

title: Just Pizza
description: Welcome to Just Pizza, a game that turns your love for pizza into an exciting and rewarding experience! This game is all about clicking on a pizza to earn more pizzas. The more you click, the more pizzas you get. It’s as simple and fun as that!

title: Keyframes
description: Between exams, friendships, and figuring out what a savings account is, college might just be one of the busiest times of your life. No one said adulthood was going to be easy, but it’ll be a little less painful to navigate with your two best friends by your side... and three new chance acquaintances, who happen to be the right people at the right time.

title: Locally Sourced Anthology I: A Space Atlas
description: Locally Sourced Anthology I: A Space Atlas is a collection of 8 experimental games, each developed by a different indie team, with each game focusing on a different

title: Thunder Jaws
description:
8-bit home computer conversions for Atari's ThunderJaws.

These conversion are single player, and features 4 levels instead the 13 levels available on the arcade version.

title: Termination Mental
description: Small base level, a remake of the original Termination Central (E3M1).

title: The Palace of Fear
description: A dark turtlemap remake of e4m4. Uses Quoth entities, so you need that mod installed.

title: Data Download
description: A map built with no more than 256 brushes. Your mission is to download some data, but there are a couple of enemies who try to prevent that. Fast and frantic non-stop action.

title: Amphitheater Of Abaddon
description: Small to medium-sized Wizard-style level. It is the follow-up to The Subterrestrial Hangar and as such again features three distinct route choices.

title: Catatonic Fits of Despair
description: Medium-sized spacious metal/runic-style fortress.

title: Shut Up, RPG!
description: Medium sized chain map by Than, Gibbie, RPG, Nightbringer.

title: Temple of Quake
description: Small to medium-sized runic-style temple with a graveyard in rocky surroundings. The level can be finished fairly quickly, but in order to visit all areas and get better equipment it requires exploration and secret-hunting.

title: The Slipgate Massacre
description: Remix/remake of the original E1M1 - The Slipgate Complex, but larger and more spacious, with many new and expanded areas.

title: The Subterrestrial Hangar
description: Small idbase level set in a miliary base/hangar. It features three distinct route choices: normal combat, permanent quad damage, and slime maze, and is supposed to be the first map of an episode focusing on these route mechanics.

title: 99 brushes or less
description: Speedmapping pack featuring six SP levels.

title: We got bored lol
description: Six small ~2-hour speedmaps + a start hub, all following different themes and based on the Copper mod (included). It comes with a custom music track.

title: BigMcGee
description: 14 speedjam SP levels made on a 64 unit grid, three custom skyboxes, and four music tracks.

title: Blood Foundry
description: 3 vanilla speedmaps made by Egg Boy.

title: Reconditus
description: Reconditus is a 4 map (+ epilogue) mapset that takes place in a world where temple-like structures have been slowly assimilated by tech/alien stuff.

title: Something Bad is on the Moon
description:
Found Footage: Apollo 17

The Apollo 17 mission was the last publicly disclosed mission to the moon.

Since then, numerous missions have been launched in absolute secrecy.

Something very bad happened on Apollo 17, and we recorded it.

title: Left 4 Dead 2: Alien Trilogy
description: A custom campaign for Left 4 Dead 2 based on the video game Alien Trilogy.

title: Legends of Kailrate
description: Help Kailrate defeat enemies as the waves progress. Be careful of bosses, they are sometimes dangerous!

title: Hexagod
description: A minimalist roguelike village builder where you place hexagon tiles, manage resources, and command your villagers.

title: Pong Consoles Simulation
description:
These are simulations of some of the most popular Pong consoles from the 1970s. The consoles included are:
Atari Home Pong (C-100)
Atari Super Pong (C-140)
Coleco Telstar
Nintendo Color TV-Game 6
Nintendo Color TV-Game 15

title: MultiVersus: Season 2 - Back in Time
description: In Season 2 unlock Samurai Jack through the new battlepass, and explore a new set of rifts to unlock Beetlejuice. There will also be new unlockable cosmetics, the Water Tower stage, and the return of ranked mode.

title: Vectic: Boosted
description:
Vectic: The motorsport of the future.

Every year the Vectic League draws millions of fans from all over the world.
This season you will not be one of them.
This season you will be a contender.
Race with skill, speed and daring to claim your place in the record books as a Vectic legend.

Vectic uses a turn based system to bring you a new racing experience. To be victorious is to be not only the fastest but also the smartest. Gain the edge by picking your way through obstacles, optimising corners or landing the perfect hit with a laser beam. Prevail on over 40 hand built race tracks.

title: Bonk Jam!
description:
Ranger has gotten a hold of a new melee weapon: the Bonk Hammer!
The Hammer allows the player to jump higher, move faster, and fight harder!
This mod (built on Copper) also includes two additional monsters: our good friend the gaunt from Quoth (with reworked code), and Dwell's brute! Across the set of maps, you will encounter Bonk runes, which can be used to purchase awesome skins for the new hammer in the start map.

title: Tremors: Rebirth
description:
A video game movie that allows you to experience Tremors.

The map is huge and full of stuff from the first movie!

title: Deliver to When You Came
description: Deliver the meal. Don't become one yourself. An open-ended puzzle platformer based around physics and AId

title: World Domination wit Cam
description:
World domination is not easy. Join me as we figure it out together. I think it kind of goes like this, yeah that's the way, you're killing it!

A sort of boss battle, sort of actiony game, but don't worry, you can't die! Move the mouse around to trigger actions with the beat.

title: Sudo K.O.
description: Fill sudokus to fight against monsters and gain better loot as a reward. How far can you go without perishing? Claim your spot on the online leaderboards!

title: Eternal Fighters
description: Dive into Eternal Fighters, a fast-paced 2D fighting game that blends classic arcade action with modern dynamics. Choose from a roster of ninjas and warriors, each with unique abilities, and master modes like Arcade, VS, and Online. Prove your skills and become the ultimate Eternal Champion!

title: Snow Bros. Wonderland
description: Boasting gorgeous 3D isometric graphics, Snow Bros. Wonderland has the brothers defending Snow Land from The Great King of Evil! Armed with an endless supply of ice pellets, gamers can turn monsters into snowballs which can be kicked to destroy a whole horde of enemies! Chain your attacks to defeat several bad guys at once and use your snowball skills to take down massive bosses.

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Additional Character 14: Queen Dizzy
description: Adds Queen Dizzy to the roster of playable characters
1024³ 6 SP maps by efdat, Hrimfaxi, neg!ke, and Spirit

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Additional Character 15: Venom
description: Adds Venom to the roster of playable characters

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Additional Character 16: Unika
description: Adds Unika to the roster of playable characters

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Additional Character 17: Lucy
description: Adds Lucy to the roster of playable characters

title: A Better Tomorrow
description: Join the green revolution! Relax and learn about clean energy in this cozy, minimalist 2D city-building strategy game. Build windmills, solar panels, and more to provide energy to villages and cities while protecting the environment. Let's work together to make 'A Better Tomorrow'!

title: Feindlich Sewers
description: Medium sized castle / medieval sewers map with Makkon textures. Requires Copper v1.19+ (NOT included). The author's first release.

title: Null Bearing Redux
description: Large industrial dock-themed map with lots of exploration, using Makkon and MG1 textures. This is an updated overhaul / redesign of the author's previous release Null Bearing (2020).

title: Big Boy's Birthday Party
description: Large, open medieval castle with courtyards, a throne room, a wine cellar, and a dungeon.

title: Hard Driven
description: Medium / large-feeling metal sci-fi playground with Makkon3 textures. "Big Boy is defragging his hard drive. He must be stopped."

title: Under A Stone Blanket
description: Small tomb / crypt brick map built within a 1024^3 volume, textured with Makkon and based on Progs_dump (included).

title: Low Gravity
description: Two-day speedmapping event following a "low gravity" theme with 10 small to medium-sized levels and a start hub. It runs on the SMP mod (included) and comes with a custom skybox and a music track.

title: The Doomed Cathedral
description: Medium-sized cathedral with a base area.

title: Io. Loki Patera.
description: Large industrial sci-fi map with some Doom and Makkon textures, a few hundred monsters, and lot of secrets.

title: Io. Brimstoneburg.
description: Large lava castle / tomb map for vanilla Quake.

title: Io. Lava Cleaning Base
description: Large industrial factory/refinery level with a few arcane elements.

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Blazing Edition
description: The Blazing Edition of Guilty Gear: Strive includes the base game, the 4 Season Passes, the Ultimate Edition Content Kit and the Guilty Gear 25th Anniversary: Special Additional Color Pack.

title: Azrael on the Boundary of Life or Death
description:
Rihito Souda has just started working for a major construction company in April.

Even though he is assigned to a different deparment than the one he was hoping for, he meets a senior employee by the name of Reimi Nagashima, and he slowly begins to fall in love with her.

He has a rewarding job, kind parents, and awesome friends.... All of these things seemed ideal, until one day he begins to have terrifying nightmares.

The frequency of these nightmares increases with each passing month and slowly begins to consume his life.

title: Ultimate Puzzle Adventure: Robots
description: Dive into Ultimate Puzzle Adventure: Robots with 60 playable images and three game modes. Customize your puzzle piece count and enjoy unlocked levels from the start.

title: Cyber Racers: Retro Neon Punk Drift
description: Neon Lights, High Speeds: Unleash Your Inner Racer in Cyber Racers: Retro Neon Punk Drift!

title: Jewel Fight: Heroes of Legend
description: EMBARK ON A HEROIC QUEST IN "JEWEL FIGHT"

title: The Legend of the Dragonflame High School 3
description: This is the third installment of the Beat 'em up series in which Ryuichi and his friends fight with the motorcycle gang in Yokohama!

title: Npool
description: A classic game of pool on your Nintendo Switch – play with a friend or hone your skills vs an AI opponent.

title: Hentai Girls: Summer Sweetie
description: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!

title: Search and Rescue: Mount Rainier National Park USA
description: Welcome to Search and Rescue | Mount Rainer National Park Washington USA

title: Free Chess: Soviet Set
description: 1950s Soviet Latvian Chess Set

title: It Could Happen to You
description: Your peaceful holiday is interrupted when the small village you’re visiting in becomes terrorized by strange lights on the sky and enigmatic men in black. Some villagers have gone missing, everyone is afraid. Dive into a thrilling adventure with branching narrative and a unique visual style.

title: The Biggleboss Incident
description: There is NOTHING sinister happening at Biggleboss Inc. Or at least that’s what the company motto says. Tom doesn’t have time to debate semantics, though; he’s dangerously late for work – and he hasn’t even started his big Project AGER pitch. …Or is that just what they want him to think?

title: Vengeance Hunters
description:
Vengeance Hunters is an adrenaline fueled Neo-Geo hardware developed beat’em’up that lets you and a friend in local co-op fight mutants, zombies, punks, gangsters, lab techs with bombs (you read that correctly), suited mystery men, cyborgs and more across multiple stages, sub-levels and secret areas.

You'll be focused on fast and frantic action, combos and even a small bit of story. Vengeance Hunters features an amazing OST as well as incredible pixel art. Combat isn't the standard era combat that you've seen over and over since the 90's. Each playable character has their own Signature Move and style that will greatly change how you play.

title: Exodus: Creepy Time
description: Join the battle in the dark world of the Middle Ages, shrouded in evil and magic, as brave knights, each of whom fights to save their native lands from mystical threats. "Exodus: Creepy Time" is an exciting shoot 'em up with a top view, combining elements of roguelike and arcade games.

title: The Traveler
description: Lost and alone in a cave, you start your adventure jumping and ducking your way through enemies and different environments. Collect coins to upgrade your player & unlock new abilities. Maybe then you'll find the ancient relics that start to reveal how you got here, and maybe...the way out.

title: Solitary Sentinel
description: Welcome to Solitary Sentinel, a captivating single-player roguelike tower defense experience where you must defend against constantly evolving enemies by upgrading a single tower. Enjoy simple controls, and deep strategic gameplay as you fend off the relentless onslaught!

title: Stellar Larceny
description: Embark on a cosmic heist in this zero-gravity adventure! Maneuver the galaxy as a sentient robot armed with a magnet, jetpack, and gravity boots. Your mission? Infiltrate facilities, find parts, and return life to your friend - while running from a mysterious company intent on shutting you down.

title: Fakutori
description: Fakutori is a laid-back and colorful automation game; place machines, discover new elements, and try to craft the elusive legendary blocks! No limits, no pressure, just blocks!

title: Heartspell: Horizon Academy
description: Match gems, level up, and date wizards in this match-3 visual novel with a lot of heart and a little spice. Form deep relationships with faeries, sirens and werewolves, each with their own endearing personalities and challenges. Make choices that affect your relationships, and their destinies.

title: No spikes, please!
description: Avoid the spikes, reach the flag.

title: Submergent
description: Explore and navigate an underwater cave in your submarine.

title: Good Soup
description: Play as a mischievous ghost in this cozy point-and-click adventure! Follow Amber, a "girlfailure" culinary student, through her daily routine. Interact with her world to improve her day, make her life harder, change her future, or simply give her a good scare. Every choice is in your hands!

title: Whiskerwood
description: Establish a home for your industrious mice under the oppressive paw of your cat overlords in this city builder featuring complex simulations, intricate production chains, and the age-old rivalry between cat and mouse.

title: A Candle to the Unknown
description: A child is sent to an abbey, leaving his ill mother alone.

title: Niraya of
description: "Niraya of " is a Japanese horror game inspired by the Buddhist beliefs. The game focuses on a unique system where players "avoid" the attacks of various monsters. This, combined with the fear of exploring eerie environments and solving puzzles, is a major draw of the game.

title: Slime Scramble
description: Become the ultimate slime! Eat green slimes to grow, dodge the red ones, and see how big you can get in this cozy yet challenging slime scramble!

title: A Walk in the Park
description: There is a fireworks event in the evening and your friend knows just the right place to watch it. All you have to do is get there through this perfectly normal park. Just follow the arrows and you'll reach your destination. Eventually. How hard can that be?

title: Street Fighter 6: Return of Shadaloo
description:
Get the most out of Street Fighter 6 with the Fighting Pass!

This month's theme: Return of Shadaloo

Free rewards are available now for all players, as well as access to premium rewards for 250 Fighter Coins. Also, starting this month, special effects for the New Challenger screen are included in the rewards!

Rewards include avatar gear, emotes, music, stickers and wallpaper, and the theme will change every month. Don't miss out since rewards are available for a limited time!

Note: The Fighting Pass can be purchased from the in-game shop using Fighter Coins. Avatar gear is cosmetic only and does not affect character fighting attributes.

title: Payout: Shop Simulator
description: Build and manage your shop, deliver physics-based products using Van, Forklift and Truck. Hire workers to speed up your progress

title: Merge Marbles
description: Merge Marbles is a relaxing puzzle game where your goal is to merge as many pairs of the same coloured marbles as you can. Each time you merge a pair it creates the next tier all the way up to the big pink marble. Try your best to merge the pink marble to clear as much space as you can!

title: Elden Ring: Dark Moon
description: An overhaul focused on new content and fashion souls, based on Elden Ring: Shattered

title: Dungeon Beach
description: Cute and sexy seaside random dungeon action

title: The History of Magic Tower: Opening
description: "The History of Magic Tower: Opening" is a fantasy adventure game based on the "Magic Tower" game mode. This work is set against the backdrop of various traditional magical tower worldviews and tells the story of events that occurred before the time point of the classic game "50-layer Magic Tower".

title: This Company of Mine
description: In the urban workplace, you will hold great power and it's time to decide the fate of others. Eliminate those guys you don't like and hire those you like. This is a company that belongs to you!

title: Kioku Hanabi
description: Remember the color, location, and timing of the fireworks that were launched, and try to launch them in the same way. Although the rules are simple, it is deep and you will be drawn to the beautiful visuals.

title: Rangarok End Girls
description: Girls, resist the world and burn your lives! Full-voice stylish action!!

title: Ten Seconds Hero 1
description: Open world,RPG,Build,All Monster and NPC can be controlled.

title: Fushigi na Sekai no Kankou Nikki
description: This game is finding them and trying to clear the game. I can't give away any secrets, so I can't give you any detailed explanations. You'll just have to buy it! Tom: "But it's only available in Japanese language. Is there no English version?" "sorry. then I took an arrow in the knee... "

title: Do Not Look at the Moon
description: The moon, once serene, now portends doom. Air raid sirens blare, TVs warn: "Do not look at the moon." Your world's turned upside down. Messages flood in, all asking: How to survive in this world of bizarre rules?

title: Employee Rules of the Night Strings
description: This is a bartender simulation game. While mixing drinks that satisfy customers, you also need to carefully identify whether the guests in front of you are human or something similar to human.

title: Macabre no Zantou: Remnants of the Macabre
description: Navigate 1980s Japan as a schoolgirl in this Junji Ito-inspired horror game. Each choice shapes your fate, leading to safety or deeper into the macabre. Uncover hidden horrors in an urban street filled with sinister details. Will you find your way home, or be consumed by the unknown?

title: Dwelling
description: In "Dwelling," a police officer investigates terrifying events in an abandoned school. Uncover the truth, survive the horrors, and solve the mystery hidden within each floor.

title: Dino Tribe: New Era
description: Create your dino chief, lead your tribe. Survive waves of enemies, explore and settle on foreign islands. Find a way to avoid extinction!

title: Jumper, Jumpy Time Attack Adventure
description: Jumper is a 2D platformer arcade style, the goal is to stay alive as long as possible, jump on as many platforms as possible but be careful for traps ! As the score is increasing so is the difficulty and the speed.

title: Private Mining Company
description: Private Mining Company is a tower defense game with perma-death and extraction elements. Keep your soldiers while you complete contracts, as long as they aren't killed. Make money defending mining outposts on hostile alien planets. Balance mining upgrades and growing your army.

title: Nucleuz Underground
description: The planet is dying, a team has been created that has to go underground, in the exile of the machines and hit the core. Only in this way, humanity will be able to survive and we have the mission to do so every day. A classic 2D platform game, in a dystopian and survival future. Join the team. Now.

title: Field of the Dead
description: Field of the Dead is a post-apocalyptic sci-fi horror game where you battle undead and mutants with space weapons. Level up, fight bosses, acquire rare gear, and explore infested areas to uncover the apocalypse's secrets. Supports single-player and up to four-player multiplayer.

title: Herta's Chess Game
description: Herta's simulated universe network is interconnected throughout the universe. Pack your luggage and enter Herta's world with your friends. In this fan game, you will use the simulation data of each original character to have a strategic showdown with Herta.

title: Carpe Noctem
description: A yuri visual novel about a vampiress and a monster hunter falling in love in Victorian England.

title: Flappy Horse
description: This is a game where you guide this crazy looking horse through hurdles to try and gain the best score you can! As you Flap through the game you collect sugar cubes which you use in the shop to buy upgrades to get even better scores an even more sugar cubes.

title: Floors
description: Embark on a procedural liminal journey filled with eerie, unfriendly faces. Walk, explore, and descend to the first floor to escape. No monsters will chase you, but they can watch and appear when you aren't looking. This can evoke a fear of an endless labyrinth and create a sense of anxiety.

title: Dorf the Dwarf
description: Dorf the dwarf is a puzzle game which replicates the classic game Zeek the Geek. You play as Dorf, a dwarf adventuer, who dares into the dungeons of Koganusân , ruins of a dwarf fortress, to loot treasures, while avoiding ghosts, elephants and deadly traps, and solving puzzles.

title: Oh, honey! Anime clicker!
description: Welcome to Oh, Honey! Anime Clicker!, a simple clicker game set in a delightful anime-style! In this game, you'll tap to accumulate points.

title: Gears Unchained: The Rise of Revolution
description: In a futuristic city under dictatorship, a brave mechanic with an illegal electronic arm rises up against the dictator. Face dangers, unravel intrigues and overcome deadly obstacles, approaching an epic final showdown.

title: Find Colibries
description: Test your attentiveness in the captivating world of Aztec jungles in the game Find Colibries and find all the hidden birds!

title: Mushroom
description: Mushroom is a clicker game. You will see the visions after eating poisonous mushrooms. You will get a mushroom every x hours. Collect more to win the world.

title: Dice Dice Dice
description: This is a casual deck-building game based on dice rolling. Players will rely on their choices and some luck to achieve victory.

title: Laser Sounds
description: You are a mercenary hired by the Space Company to inspect the space station, which has not been heard from for years, because of the news you have received that some experiments are being carried out. Your goal is to clear everyone from this space station.

title: Simulation: Catalyst
description: In this game you can enjoy a semi-causal 2d platformer while fully immersing yourself in a 3d parallax environment.

title: Toilet
description: A casual puzzle game. Go to the toilet, one must also strategize.

title: Red Nose Guy The LegenDairy Quest
description: Red Nose Guy: The LegenDairy Quest is a modern and high-energy revisit of an arcade classic.Join Red Nose Guy on an adventure through the city's various neighborhoods and discover his colorful and absurd universe!

title: Links Quartz
description: A turn-based RPG with mysterious graphics in which dot-picture characters move through 3D space. Use the “Shift” command to change the character's standing position to gain an advantage in the battle.

title: Young Detectives: Holidays
description: Dive into a world of colorful discovery with the ultimate spot the difference game designed for young minds! Your mission is to identify the subtle distinctions between seemingly identical scenes.

title: Poodle Clicker
description: Free to Play Poodle Clicker is a game full of stylish Poodles and original Music, mostly melodic metal songs, but there are more!

title: Colo Moon
description: This game is a highly difficult mountain climbing physics action game. All you need to do is one click and force roll.

title: Cheese Collector
description: Cheese Collector is a fun and addictive clicker game where you collect a variety of cheeses! Click to gather cheese and expand your cheesy collection. Every 150 minutes, you'll receive a unique cheese to add to your stash.

title: Graphwar II
description: Graphwar II is an artillery game in which you must hit your enemies using mathematical functions. The trajectory of your shot is determined by the function you wrote, and your goal is to avoid the obstacles and your teammates and hit your enemies. The game takes place in a Cartesian Plane.

title: Psychological Operation
description: Experience the intense action of a Romanian Mafia Boss in this gripping action-adventure game. Fight the government, police, and elites after being stripped of all your power and wealth. Sail the seas, drive through mountains, fly in the sky, and break into top-secret labs to beat the Matrix.

title: Exodus: The Rise of Chaos
description: You wake up trapped in your own mind, a mental prison filled with fears and distorted memories. To survive and understand the true nature of a Global Apocalypse, you must first confront the inner demons that haunt you.

title: Restless Nights
description: Restless Nights is a singleplayer survival horror game. Beat the game by learning and adapting to new threats added each night. Will you get a good night's rest? Or will you fall to the demons that lay behind shadows?

title: Prime Agents
description: A first person shooter entangled with magic.

title: Elementalist
description: A puzzle platformer where you collect Elements and use their powers to move around in various ways. Each Element you collect becomes the next one you use, so pay attention to the order!

title: Glitch of The Game
description: A small indie rpg/puzzle game where you will need to figure out various glitches and exploits in order to defeat The Big Bad.

title: Highway Hijinks
description: Highway Hijinks is a roguelike endless runner that takes place in a futuristic post-apocalyptic world controlled by a mysterious artificial intelligence. Discover wacky items, race against computer opponents, and upgrade your vehicle with powerful gadgets to get as far as you can.

title: Bass Defense: First Memorythms
description: In Bass Defense's rhythm-based and action-packed 'Soundwave' game mode, you must hit the correct buttons in time with the music to clear your NMYs and save your base with the help of your upgradable power-ups or your sense of rhythm. description: A Dwarves Day is a 2D adventure game with platformer-style gameplay. You play as a dwarf who finds himself tricked by greed into tumbling down a treacherous hole by a pesky goblin. You must delve deep in search of a way out and get back to that gold! Just a typical day in the life of a dwarf.
