description: Whether you're a seasoned gamer looking for a new challenge or someone seeking a relaxing yet engaging experience, Cross Bow Quest promises to deliver an unforgettable adventure. Sharpen your skills, find your zen, and take on the quest of a lifetime.

description: A shooting class casual small game. When you are sleeping at work, other people will approach you. So you have to fire through the control of the cannon to control others to get close to you. When you make it to the end, you will be awarded the Master Fish Medal.

description: This is a parkour game where players need to control the bride and groom in a race, dodging vehicles and obstacles along the way, while collecting plenty of hearts.

description: Get ready to dive into the colorful world of emojis like never before! In Emoji Clicker, your mission is simple: collect, upgrade, and dominate with the most diverse and powerful collection of emojis!

description: A sci-fi RPG adventure. Start in modern times and explore infected areas on Earth. Travel back in time and annihilate the void. Numerous monsters and dungeons await you.

description: Block Tower TD 2 is a strategic game in the roguelike style with original innovations. Build worlds from blocks, choose random upgrades, each game will be unique.

description: Prowl homes, explore neighborhoods, overcome random encounters, reveal dark secrets, and make difficult choices as a newly-risen vampire in this text-heavy visual novel. Make friends and enemies while surviving this new life in which one night you are the predator, another - the prey.

The villa hides a huge conspiracy, players will face different emergencies to choose different ways to respond, and different ways to respond will determine the final outcome.

Ren Xing as a real estate agent (thought at the time), came to a villa for field shooting, but accidentally fell into a horrible plot, players need to choose how to escape the villa. Finally through different choices to start different game endings. Whether the puzzle can be solved, or forever trapped in the villa, depends on the player's search and choice during the process.

Slacker Ari Buktu only pokes his head into Professor Raventhorpe’s lab for extra credit; seconds later he’s hurtling through history on a reckless mission to steal a legendary tiara and fix the professor’s love-life. Each stop opens a new era, a bigger puzzle, and the shadow of a rival tomb-raider who’s always one jump behind…

A demon who claims to be an "Exile" blocks your apartment, demanding you to escape within the stipulated time, otherwise, you will face certain death. But will the demon really keep his promise? What is the demon's purpose after all?

description: New Haven is a utopia under a red moon, turned into a dystopian nightmare. You are a prisoner with no name, waking up in the middle of an emergency. Fight for survival guided by an enigmatic voice in your head, explore a falling world, solve puzzles, and unravel dark secrets.

title: HeartWare
description: Yours decisions matters, leading to multiple unique endings that reflect your influence on Iris’s fate.

title: The Lost Gallery
description: Works of art are attacking people, turning an exhibition into a bloodbath in a single night. At the same time, you – a phantom thief – happen to be there to steal a valuable masterpiece.

title: The Curse of Elmwood
description: You hear quiet whispers from deep inside the house, but no one sees. You begin to feel that you are not alone in this house. Curse of Elmwood is an atmospheric horror where you find yourself trapped in a gloomy 18th century mansion, steeped in mystery and horror.

title: Forgotten Bunker 1939
description: step into the boots of Private Jacob, an American soldier caught in the fury of a World War II bombing raid. Desperately seeking refuge, Jacob stumbles upon a terrifying mysterious bunker, which turns out to be a demonic time portal.

title: Royal Revolt Survivors
description: Thrilling 1-4 players co-op survivor gameplay combined with stunning graphics, where powerful Warriors battle through hordes of vicious enemies using a blend of melee and ranged weapons.

title: Frog Holm
description: Unexpectedly, you become the owner of a pub that has seen better days. During the day, set sail to explore a variety of new islands, each with its own unique treasures and ingredients for your cocktails. Can you restore the pub to its former glory? Dive into this charming adventure and find out!

title: Mini-Tank Arena
description: Mini Tank Arena is a 4v4 multiplayer battle Arena shooter, play on different maps experience the battle styles of each unique tank, and see how each tank can synergize with other tanks to help elevate the playing field.

title: Containment Breach
description: Containment Breach is a wave-based zombie survival game with a unique shooting mechanic. Earn points to unlock doors, buy and upgrade weapons, perks, and equipment. See how fast you can escape the facility or choose to stay and go for the highest round possible.

title: Master of Love
description: Single and unemployed, 33-year-old Jun-Ho finds himself transported back in time ten years. He takes the chance to romance five women from his past – and get it right this time. Unlock five unique endings in Master of Love, an FMV game that offers the ultimate K-drama experience.

title: Aotenjo: Infinite Hands
description: The Mahjong Roguelike. Aotenjo is an deckbuilder where you will use Mahjong styles all over the world to beat innate threats, play different Patterns and combos, reach the "bottom" of Aotenjo, and discover ancient secrets....

title: Morimens
description: Morimens is a roguelite card-battling game set in a world inspired by the Lovecratian mythos. Something is wrong with Kadath. Bond with hauntingly beautiful Awakeners, build a deck from the remnants of their power, and push deeper into the mist—where the events get stranger, the cards get darker, and the truth is something you may not survive knowing.

title: Robabekya
description: You envision a futuristic scenario where humans coexist in an open world alongside robots disguised with human-like skins, equipped with dynamic and adaptive system where AI learns from previous engagements, adjusts tactics, and becomes increasingly proficient in combat scenarios.

title: Circle TD: Defence War
description: A tower defense game.In the wave after wave of enemy attacks like a tide, constantly configure defense tower ties, player talents, props and equipment, build a powerful defense position, and eliminate the enemy before they fill the map!

title: Inventory Quest: Hero's Hoard
description: Inventory Quest: Hero's Hoard is a short and fast-paced inventory management and loadout optimization game. The player must upkeep a hero's loadout from random item drops and try to survive as long as possible to achieve a new high score.

title: Hypno
description: Mind melting audio-visual orgasm! A game of quick reflexes, precise timing and fast-paced strategic decisions at higher levels with simple enough mechanics anyone can grasp, yet with enough depth only few will ever truly master.

title: The Supper: New Blood
description: Do you hear the doorbell, Stewie? Your first guest is here...and something tells me they’ll never leave this motel...

title: Can't Revert
description: Can't revert is a first-person psychological horror game. You repeatedly find yourself in a house where your wife and son are dead. Discover hidden clues in the house and uncover the secrets of their deaths. Experience the constant tension and fear in the repetitive space.

title: Szikra
description: A relaxing, 2.5D side-scrolling short game set in a unique steampunk/fantasy environment. Find your way through vast fields, magical forests, and giant gears in a steaming factory to reach the twisted circus where your friend is locked up. Jump, find switches, push boxes around to get there.

title: Save
description: Save is a survival deep sea horror game for 1-4 online co-op game, sets in the eerie depths of an abandoned 6,000-Ton Ship 'SENARA', where every shadow holds a secret, and every corner could be your last. Unravel the mysteries and safely escape avoiding relentless threats that prowl in the darkness.

title: Express Car Wash Simulator
description: Use colorful soaps and enjoy the satisfaction of a perfect clean. Collect rare vehicle cards to unlock iconic rides, add new services to your shop, and expand your craft. But stay sharp - taking down non-paying customers with a tennis ball gun is all part of the job!

title: Sigma War Notes
description: This is an ACT action game that can achieve a satisfying sense of impact through simple operations.

title: Idol Party
description:
“WOW,you can really dance!” Welcome to IDOL PARTY. Immerse yourself in dance and song to find friends in this social game. Charm your love with moves and melodies, pledge togetherness, marry, and start a family. Tired? Farm or play mini-games for endless fun!

"Idol Party" is a music game with a lively style using the concept of idols!
Gorgeous costumes, personalized mounts, massive music songs, everything you want is here.

title: Guns are Funs
description:
Guns are Funs is an arcade game that combines elements of a shooter, runner, and tower destruction. Immerse yourself in the world of toy soldiers who wage fierce battles for power and influence in the room. Bright dynamic battles, unique missions, and a variety of game modes await you.

The story campaign is divided into chapters, each offering distinct missions that challenge your skills across different aspects of the game. And if you're looking for some non-stop fun without the narrative, dive into the sandbox mode — where you can explore all game elements and compete for the highest score.

Assemble your army of toys, crush your enemies' towers, and prove that even the smallest soldiers can become the greatest heroes!

title: Before Exit: Supermarket
description: Before Exit: Supermarket combines features from roguelike with walking simulator. As Supermarket employee you clean up damaged items, wipe up stains, and turn off the lights. Your task is close the store behind you, hoping that all tasks have been completed.

title: Holiday Farm
description: A sandbox game that simulates life on a farm. Experience life, growing vegetables, raising animals, diving in mineral water on a happy island.

title: Try to Survive Today
description: A three-dimensional shooter with an isometric camera or a first- or third-person view. You in a fur suit shoot all sorts of devils and robots spawning from everywhere. By gaining experience for destroying enemies, collecting their souls, you upgrade your tree of characteristics

title: Anomalum
description: You’re trapped in an endless nightmare. Observe your surroundings carefully and check the clock to escape from Anomalum.

title: Hexeract
description: Roguelike deck-building game on hexagonal tiles. Enjoy a dopamine-boosting experience by maximizing the synergy of your deck and tiles.

title: Rebirth! New Lover
description: Song Xuan unexpectedly traveled to ancient times, where he met several emotional partners who sincerely treated him. There are Qing'er,Xiaobai, Gu Qiuhan,Lin Miaoxian and Mingyue Rao. He had so many humorous and sweet love stories with them.

title: Savior Quest
description: "Savior Quest" is an ARPG with a behind the scenes perspective. By taking missions in the main city and challenging various powerful boss, players can obtain random equipment with various entries.

title: Unreal Wukong
description: " Unreal WuKong" is an open-world action RPG based on the classic Chinese mythological novel, "Journey to the West." You will play as the Monkey King, Sun Wukong, embarking on a perilous and wondrous adventure to save the world by vanquishing demons that have traveled from the future.

title: Lightracer: For Judge
description: In a dystopian future, as The Judge with immense power, you journey through space to find hope in a divided society. This sci-fi adventure explores hope amidst adversity.

title: Sword & Seek
description: Sword and Seek is a cozy fantasy hidden object game set in a medieval world, where players embark on a journey to receive the blessing of the goddesses to become adventurers.

title: Dual Eclipse
description: Restore order to the cosmos by seeking out a Prismatic Dragon imprisoned in the stars. Delve into dungeons, evade traps, and discover secrets. Seek adventure as one of three classes in this trick-taking RPG.

title: Ninja Monkey
description: Battle waves of bees, choose upgrades each round, and defeat challenging bosses. Unlock new classes, maps, weapons, and abilities while refining your build and mastering platforming skills!

title: Pirate Hunter: Somali Trap
description: In the middle of the South Pacific: modern pirates are making the waterways that are so important for international trade unsafe. In order to deal with this ever-growing threat, a mercenary group called The Pilgrims appears on the scene, earning their money with protection missions...

title: BeYourCat
description: "Be Your Cat " is a real love game,like an experience in life, one interesting dream. We all wish we had superpowers, but what would you do if one day you had superpowers, but not like Superman? What will you do with your limited abilities? How does it affect and change the people around you?

title: Click Painter
description: Click Painter is a Minesweeper-like puzzle game with colorful pictures, comfortable rest, and new ideas.

title: Darwin
description: Enter a tough-as-nails retro old school trip, Darwin is a daunting gauntlet of a speedrunning platformer. It requires the player to move fast and be agile, but to also be prepared to die. Again. Again. And again. Can you survive the trials in Slugtopia, defeat the nasty Wormilon, and make it home?

title: The White Room
description: Locked in the white room and you are slowly losing your mind. Not sure what is real anymore and you must escape.

title: Into the M.A.W.
description: In this action-packed co-op adventure, four players must unite to crew a spaceship through a web of interconnected story missions. Choose your role—Captain, Pilot, Gunner, or Engineer—and make decisions that shape not only your journey, but the future of a galaxy on the brink of war.

title: GreenWood Defense
description: Defend your captain using units to fight off invading frogs. Level up your units to unlock their new abilities, purchase upgrades, and gain special abilities to win battles against the invaders.

title: Age of Defense: Prehistory
description: The most addicting tower defense game, packed with monsters and tough defenders, all of which fit perfectly into the cartoonish environment. Prehistory is a prologue for the main story Age of Defense.

title: Cosplay Crisis: Succubus Invasion
description: Cosplay Crisis is an Action roguelite bullet heaven with an animecon theme. A Succubus, intent on winning the Convention's cosplay competition, charms the men in attendance to destroy her competition. Now the girls must take up arms to protect their costumes, or be stripped and sent home blushing!

title: TCG Card Shop Simulator
description:
Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.

TCG Card Shop Simulator is a trading card shop simulation where you sell card booster packs to earn money and build your card shop business.

title: Kemopop!
description: Fast puzzles, cute boys~! A food-themed physics puzzler where you undress your waiter. A kemono game, by kemono artists.

title: Backrooms The Company
description: backrooms horror game

title: Temporal Titans
description: Temporal Titans is a Tower-Defense game with Time Travel. Send mechs back to previous waves to prevent your defeat, and protect your salvage team from the monstrous Krell as you scavenge the ruins of a lost earth. Rewind, rethink, and reclaim the future!

title: I'm Not Crazy
description: I'm Not Crazy is a surreal top down puzzle adventure game. Solve puzzles, explore and play micro games.

title: Short Snow
description: SHORT SNOW! Realistic open-world survival experience, you find yourself lost in a vast, snow-covered forest after a harrowing plane crash. With temperatures plummeting and hunger gnawing at you, will you succumb to the forces of nature, or will you conquer the frozen wilderness? The choice is yours!

title: Yokai Rescue
description: Ascend through a futuristic tower in this fast-paced action platformer. Use your Yokai abilities to move swiftly in the air and pierce through your enemies to defeat them. You are the last Yokai capable of saving your people and liberating your homeland from the Selvo robot control.

title: Gravity Sphere
description: Gravity Sphere is a 3D puzzle game where you use gravity fields to manipulate and guide projectiles through increasingly difficult levels. Strategize, aim, and solve challenging puzzles in a futuristic, physics-based environment.

title: Carl und Cari: Trubel in Tierstadt
description: Jump into Carl and Cari: Trubel in Tierstadt, an interactive educational game in which you have to help Tierstadt and its animal inhabitants with their jobs in order to save the big town festival. Get to know different training jobs and their training opportunities in a playful way.

title: W.O.T.E: Waking On The Endtimes
description: Embark on this journey with W.O.T.E, an action-adventure game with simple and captivating visuals. Norah is in a world overrun by strange creatures, full of challenges, secrets to uncover, collectibles to find, and missions to complete to restore peace. Available in Portuguese (BR) and English.

title: FFS, Another Northern Duke?!
description: There's only one goal here: survive. Seduce the Duke?! Expelled from the modern world into a novel, you occupy the body of a minor villainess, on her way to marry the beastly Duke of the North. (Why does that sound familiar...) A Fantasy + Romance + Slice-of-Life Otome Visual Novel.

title: Barrok
description: An arcade racing game in which you try to be first by beating other competitors.

title: Spammerina
description: Ever wanted to just Spam a bunch of Spells? Discover and Enhance your new favourite spells to slay a myriad of monsters! Loot, Explore, and Uncover the Secrets of The Dark Continent! Blast beasts with Blood magic, Divine Judgement, and more! The Dark Continent is waiting...

title: Project Unknown Designation
description: Meet your friends at their cabin in the woods. What lies ahead?

title: Swordia
description: Traverse Swordia, a community-driven MMORPG with skill-based progression, PVP, PVE, and endless possibilities. Inspired by the classics, experience a mix of dungeon crawling, farming, mining, and more. Help development with your choices and feedback.

title: Yin-Yang Ping-Pong
description: Something to look at.

title: Turte
description: Turte is a simple yet engaging game where players click on a turtle to increase their score. With straightforward mechanics and an easy-to-understand interface, Turte offers an enjoyable experience for players of all ages.

title: Kioku
description: Reclaim the memories you lost, fight for what is rightfully yours. Explore worlds that seem familiar but not quite. You progress through places that resembles memories you once had. Push forward until you find the reason you're here.

title: Tempter
description: "Tempter" is a suspenseful first-person horror game that shows how humans can be even more dangerous than demons when they gain power. It centers on the struggle to save one's soul against a demon after breaking a pact.

title: Lusófona Games Collection 2024
description: Lusófona Games Collection 2024 is a curated bundle showcasing the best student projects developed during the past academic year at Lusófona University. Play the games and take a behind-the-scenes look at our students' journey to becoming the next generation of videogame developers.

title: Wanted: Yokai Uprising
description: Wanted: Yokai Uprising is a cooperative first-person shooter. Take down waves of yokai solo or with a partner. Choose between two mercenaries with unique play styles to complete the mission assigned to you and defeat the city's most wanted boss.

title: Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond
description: Prove your political brilliance in a grand strategy like no other: pick any contemporary country, set up your government and navigate the pitfalls of domestic and international politics. A glorious destiny awaits - the domination of not just the Earth, but the whole Solar system!

title: Exposure Office Simulator
description: Exposed Office Simulator is an office touching game. By touching the breasts and other parts of the body, the game makes you feel as if you are touching them, as you become animated by touching them.

title: The Rolling Room
description: Unleash your creativity in "The Rolling Room," the ultimate design and decorating game! Transform ordinary rooms and unique spaces like camper vans and buses with stunning realism.

title: Metal Bunny
description: Feel the thunderous beats in your bones and let the electrifying guitar riffs guide your way. It's not just a game, it's a headbanging adventure!

title: Jellies of the Deep
description: Explore a dreamy, hand-drawn world where little deep-sea jellies roam. Jellies of the Deep is a relaxing, hidden object and spot-the-difference game in one.

title: Keyboard Souls
description: Oh my friend, are you one of the strongest typists in the world? Come and try this typing rouge shooting game, practice and become more stronger. Finally you will prove yourself.

title: Mad & Max: The Best Survival Game with Zombies and Dinosaurs
description: Welcome to the Apocalypse! Do dinosaurs rule the earth? Not only them, but also zombies! Why? Because they can.

title: Itsy
description: Itsy is a heart tug the length of a bus ride. A narrative climb up the waterspout about the struggles of Autism-burnout. Play for story (progress saves), or endlessly & conquer the leaderboard. You ever felt endlessly stuck? So has the Itsy Bitsy Spider. Together, can you both help him out of it?

title: Moon Tower
description: Play as a mechanical being, defeat all enemies, and retrieve the crucial item. Moon Tower is a fast-paced game where you must constantly dodge enemies and eliminate them within each room. Gain different abilities to strengthen yourself and enhance your power.

title: Anoxia Station
description: After a supervolcano eruption, Earth has become uninhabitable and humanity is on the brink of extinction. We need to go underground. Anoxia Station is a dark strategy game in which you manage a mining station and fight for survival, extract resources and take life or death decisions over your crew.

title: Obi3011
description: This is cyberpunk themed, pixelated love adventure text game. A rainy encounter and an inevitable cohabitation lead to a journey of mistaken identity. As a robot, your funny love adventure story with your beastmen partners unfolds from here.

title: Avian Enigma
description: Avian enigma is a sci-fi visual novel game featuring in a world where birds have become extinct. The story begins with a young man working in a factory accidentally saves a bird. Soon, a girl who has a mysterious relationship with birds appears in front of him. A romance with a tiny twist begins.

title: The Last Ramparts
description: Humanity Has Been All But Destroyed. Find The Last Remaining Few And Protect Them. Discover Unknown Places Along The Way.

title: Aesthetic Clicker
description: Aesthetic Clicker is not your average clicker game! Click the sun to get collectable items from time to time.

title: The Last Hollow
description: Step into the mysterious world filled with secrets, puzzles, and challenging paths. Embrace your destiny as the chosen hollow from a forgotten dark land to save dark hollows waiting for salvation.

title: Until Oblivion
description: Until Oblivion is an atmospheric narrative game that follows 17 year old nobody Emma Wilson as she tries to rekindle a dying relationship in a dying world. Join her in an increasingly nightmarish Halloween party and find out if anything (or anyone) is worth anything at all.

title: Bigfoot Life
description: A simulator game where you live life as Bigfoot. Catch fish, forage for mushrooms and berries, build shelters, and more. Survive and live your best Bigfoot Life.

title: Izgub 2001
description: You decide how a civil war in the country of Izgub is supposed to end. Visual novel with strong themes of war, political violence and moral dilemma.

title: Skeletal Skism 2
description: War rages on between the undead... All for one sole purpose: to determine the ONE - TRUE - SKELETON - KING. Do you have what it takes to claim the crown?

title: Oceanlust: Erotic Descent
description: Who can say no when the opportunity of a lifetime drops into their lap? A submarine tour of the world’s most famous shipwreck alongside the sexiest girl you’ve ever met. Sure, there were a lot of waivers to sign but it’ll be fine. They know what they’re doing… Right...?

title: Hour of Survival: Zombie Craft
description: Navigate a post-apocalyptic world, where every decision can mean life or death. Scavenge for food, water, and supplies to keep your character alive in the face of constant danger.

title: Haunted Elevator
description: Play as a photographer compelled by a haunted elevator to uncover a tragic story. Find dark secrets about your company, using your camera and choices to seek justice or follow a darker path. The outcome is in your hands.

title: Tempus Triad
description: In Tempus Triad, dive into an ancient first-person horror scenario where a scientist is thrust into an era where huge predators dominate the land.

title: Too Angry To Die
description: Take control of Gideon Rageblade in this action-filled clicker game. Click to destroy endless waves of enemies, face epic bosses, and earn unique drops. Embrace the rage and irony in a quest that proves dying once was just a fluke—he's too angry to die again.

title: Love in Space
description: It is the year 2009. A short time after "the incident". Mankind has fled the scorched crusts of planet earth for a better life in space. Those unlucky few who still reside on earth are forced to live beneath the sea in leaky metal domes. This includes you... 50% Visual Novel - 50% Karaoke-Musical.

title: Corn
description: Corn — the interactive clicker featuring America's favorite fruit, brought to you by the developer of Cuckold Simulator. Buy corn, collect corn, trade corn. We love corn!

title: Day Off: Moonriver Incident
description: An atmospheric 2D top-down shooter with an open world and physics. Step into the role of a police officer from an old horror movie. Discover what happened in the town of Moonriver. Use your brain against zombies - create barricades with the furniture, stay quiet, or unleash full-blown action!

title: Huntin' Ducks
description: Arcade shoot-em-up roguelike with a unique combo mechanic. Variety of items to choose from. Endless, play as long as you can survive.

title: The Test Game
description: Escape from an abandoned island by collecting points, food, and resources. Fight to survive. Discover the underwater world and get the best high score to unlock various in game achievements. The Test Game, my first game ever!

title: Inspection Report
description: Inspection Report is a horror / point & click game focused on exploration and dialogue. Fulfill your duties as a building inspector and uncover the secrets of an abandoned property in total dark using only a flashlight.

title: Fluffy Sailors
description: Fluffy Sailors is a charming action-roguelite where you fight in thrilling real-time sea battles between adorable animal pirates. Fire them at your enemies, capture their ships, and fulfill Her Majesty's royal mission!

title: On a Journey RPG
description: A Golden-Age of 2D JRPG's returns with Turn-Based Combat & Retro-Inspired Graphics! Adventure across the world, meet new friends and unlock powerful Summon Monsters as you battle against a truly formidable enemy in this Story-Rich JRPG

title: DinoTribe
description: Create your dino chief, lead your tribe. Survive waves of enemies, explore and settle on foreign islands. Find a way to avoid extinction!

title: Lunar Nightmare
description: Lunar Nightmare is a retro-inspired sci-fi thriller, set on an abandoned Moon base, where you have to solve the mystery behind missing crew members, ancient discoveries around deep down the Lunar surface, rouge-AI trying to control your fate and ghastly androids to revolting against your command.

title: Sim Solver
description: With the help of a companion, the program charged with running these simulations. You'll debug viruses by solving puzzles, shooting your way through hostile code, platforming around any number of obstacles, and exploring areas for key items that take you deeper into the simulation!

title: Glowie Rammer
description: The glowies are out to get you! You just run them over, that's what you do. Fast-paced racing meets spine-chilling horror. In this endless runner, you are not just racing against time but also against the ones who glow in the dark.

title: Collectibles!
description: Collectibles! — a true paradise for collectors! Collect unique items, share them with friends, and show off your achievements on the leaderboards!

title: Cut the Birch
description: Take on the role of a hero whose main task is to cut down birch trees and destroy enemies. Use an axe and magic to do this. Acquire items and improve skills.

title: Robin: The Twisted Timber Trail
description: Join Robin and navigate narrow wooden paths, solve puzzles, and help animals and villagers as you uncover hidden trails and secrets.

title: SCAD
description: Scad is an action packed roguelite apocalypse adventure. Fight against zombie hordes, craft & upgrade new weapons and prepare for new missions.

title: Asylum Revenge
description: "Asylum Revenge is an action and horror game set in an asylum. Players will follow Jessie Frost on her quest for revenge."

title: Paw Paw Death Festival
description: A simple job to execute sinners in a surrealistic way! Three casual party modes for free thinking and creative dark humor + with a great ridiculous comment function to get the audience together on your live streaming.

title: City Park Play Date
description: City Park Play Date is a kinetic (linear) short story. It is a true AVN, but linear by design, telling a very specific story. You play as James, the protagonist of our story. James is lucky in life, but not in love. Our story explains how that changes for him and opens his eyes to what is possible.

title: Echoes of Dread
description: Echoes Of Dread is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore the mansion, solve puzzles, and uncover the secrets hidden within. Prepare for unexpected encounters with terrifying entities. The game features an intense atmosphere, non-linear storytelling, and unique moments of horror.

title: Gwihyang: Homecoming
description: "Gwihyang" captures the traditional image of Korea, giving it a new experience. A tense adventure unfolds in which you escape the threat of monsters in the changing space and use items to escape. Hope you can enjoy fear and fun at the same time through this "Gwihyang" with Korean sentiment.

title: Influencer Boxing
description: Step into the ring with "Influencer Boxing," a thrilling game featuring 12 of your favorite social media stars. Each influencer brings their unique style and charisma to intense boxing matches, set in dynamic, visually stunning arenas

title: Taking the Cross
description: Taking the Cross allows you to control Christian Armies fighting for the holy land, inflict crushing defeats on your enemies and win glory for the faith!

title: Geometry Dabs: Save the World
description: Geometry Dabs, a dangerous drug, has brainwashed countless individuals into becoming mindless slaves for its creator, RopTob. The exact purpose of RopTob's control over these victims remains unclear, but it surely cannot be anything good. Your goal is to rescue these people from RopTob

title: Spinners
description: Spinners. You get dropped a spinner every 2 hours 5 times per day. Each spinner is also made by the community in Discord. Come hang out with us and let's grow into something fantastic. Compete with friends, win the most unique item and become a spin master!

title: Game of Squares
description: Squares is a pattern matching 2D game inspired by the Rubik's cube,. Customise the game's rules to your liking. Challenge yourself by getting faster.

title: Net.Crawl
description: Net.Crawl is a puzzle rogue-like about White Rabbit lost in the unfriendly cyberspace. Dive deep into the bizarre digital world and outsmart dozens of unique Cores(mini-bosses). Short runs, deep strategies, crazy combos and a ton of replayability.

title: The Adventure of Popo
description: Join the adorable polar bear Popo on his adventure! Use shakes strategically to evade enemies and collect hints to overcome obstacles. Will Popo safely reach the polar bear village?

title: Ball In The Box
description: Move platforms to get the ball into the box in a challenging minimalist physics puzzle

title: Anomalous Adventure
description: Slay monsters and explore procedural worlds in this old school hack and slash Mini-RPG set in a fantasy world. Battles are a combo of turn based and real time elements. Block enemy attacks and enhance your own using active abilities.

title: Market Master Simulator
description: Take charge of a bustling supermarket in Market Master Simulator. Manage staff, inventory, and product creation while mastering advanced energy systems. Navigate challenges in this dynamic simulation game now in Early Access.

title: Inertial Craft
description: "Inertial Craft" is a simple-to-operate racing game in a cyber world. You can experience a thrilling race with the strong and inertial behavior unique to a craft floating off the ground. Enjoy unique behavior and UI for each craft.

title: GymBro
description: GymBro – is a clicker game that immerses you in the world of sports and lets you click a kettlebell! Quickly join our community, play the mini-game where the main object is a kettlebell, change its appearance through the inventory, and earn rewards... Of course, in the form of kettlebell skins!

title: Lefty
description: A cozy 3D puzzle game where Lefty, a left-handed character, navigates whimsical mazes by only moving to the right. Experience unique mechanics, culturally inspired gameplay, and increasing puzzle complexity, perfect for fans of casual, cozy, and puzzle games.

title: Deliberate
description: In this game, you're transported into a mystical forest brimming with the whimsical charm of cartoonish pixel art.

title: Lore of the Frog
description: You are a frog archaeologist on a journey to the elusive Frog island. Cozy hiking adventure in a magical forest with casual puzzles, ancient frog statues... And put hats on frogs!

title: Exit Station 7
description: You entered a train station and appear to be stuck in a loop. Multiple levels to test your observation skill. See if you have what it takes to escape the loop!

title: Minced
description:
Explore the Minced Meat Processing Co. facility, a place drenched in darkness, secrecy, and dread. Your mission: uncover the chilling secrets hidden within. But beware, meaty entities are prowling the shadows, and you must avoid them at all costs.

Solve puzzles, gather clues, and piece together the factory's nightmarish history to find out what really went wrong...

title: Ooga Booga: Troubles in Time
description: Get ready for an exciting adventure in "Ooga Booga: Troubles in Time"! Choose your character and travel through different universes to defeat the forces of evil, the enemy is waiting to beat you up! Try the best controls for platform games. Jump over obstacles to pass the level. Fight against a multitude of enemies in different scenarios. Escape from the rolling stone down the hill. Ride the pig and dodge the thugs. Talk to the characters to defeat the final boss. BEWARE, the enemy wants to trick you, don't fall into his traps. Prove that you are the chosen one!

title: Botan's Bird Beats
description: Botan's Bird Beats is a fanmade game based on Shishiro Botan. The game has you play as Shishiro Botan and you shoot birds in beat to the songs playing.

title: Poketale
description: It's been 70 years since Frisk freed the monsters from Underground. However, the monsters are no longer the same: after an event in which a light illuminated all of Ebottia, all the weak monsters were transformed into Pokémon, causing society to have to adapt to the new creatures without intelligence and with powers beyond their control. all understanding. Can you discover the secret of transforming monsters into Pokémon and become the new Champion of Ebottia?

title: Sclash: Sakura

title: Tidal Nexus Online
description: Tidal Nexus Online is a submarine themed old school open world MMO. Fight with monsters, trade and collect valuables in the depths to upgrade your sub. Join clans, participate in world events, make friends and enemies along the way.

title: Touhou Danmaku Kagura: Phantasia Lost - Touhou Mystia's Izakaya Collab "Beneath the Purple Cherry Blossoms Once Again"

The in-game music 『Beneath the Purple Cherry Blossoms Once Again』 from the popular restaurant simulator 『Touhou Mystia's Izakaya』 will be playable in this new added content. Don't you miss it!

You need to earn more coins by continuously selling bread to animals customer, thus unlocking more types of ingredients and other rarer animals.Unlock more of their stories and collect items as well as stickers to learn the stories behind them.

Summer-themed DLC for Chrono Ark, featuring a new, optional boss with her own substory, new equipment and relics, as well as swimsuit skins for Lucy and 5 investigators, with accompanying VFX.

The investigators obtaining a new skin are Azar, Charon, Huz, Pressel and Trisha, with Sizz slated to receive one in a future content update.

title: Galactic Starfire: Squadron
description: Galactic Starfire: Squadron is a Future Sci-Fi Space Shooter game set in different environments around the universe. Complete the challenges and stay alive as you progress through the different types of levels.

Only paired animals could survive after thawing. The expedition team needs your wisdom to help match these animals and restore life to the planet.

description: Bend the rules of time to your while to outsmart and out-think your opponents. Fun 4-player co-op strategy card-game which will leave you on the edge of your seat!

At the same time, you can also meet Taoist priests, farm and build, recruit young brothers, and fight against enemies together

description: Run a mysterious thrift shop in a story-rich Visual Novel. Meet eccentric customers, uncover hidden illusions, and unveil the sinister secret of your shop.

description: Embark on a quest to unite the forest against the tyrannical king in an hour long, turn based RPG epic! Soul of the Forest was created by a team of 55 students over the course of 2 semesters as a case study of modern turn-based RPGs.

description: The Pirate's Quest - You go in search of exciting adventures and ancient treasure hidden on a mysterious island. You will explore dangerous seas, coves and ancient ruins in search of a treasure map, face competitors and fight sea monsters.

description: This is a relaxing, single player PC survival game where you can chop down trees, hunt, or build cabins to see how long you can Survive with wild animals and ai enemies throughout the large and beautiful map.

description: Amy is pulled into a dimension of labyrinths by the villain Ayashii Meiro, who mysteriously appears on her TV. Now, Amy must solve the puzzles of the labyrinths and defeat Ayashii Meiro to return to her world, collecting fragments of her soul along the way.

Racers Joy, Fear, Anger, Disgust, and Sadness are revving up their engines to take you on an emotion-filled racing challenge.

title: Film Morbid
description:
You wake up in a small and messy room. There's a storm raging outside, with the lightning illuminating a projector in the middle of the room. You investigate the projector, which surprisingly is still equipped with a film reel. You get it going, but you're not sure if that was the best decision...

Do you have what it takes to escape the room and it's looping projector?

Film Morbid is a game made by Point Vertex, during the 8th Black & White game jam. The development of the main game took 10 days.

Crawl your way through the levels and use evil fireflies to your advantage!

As the protagonist, you leave your foster parent's home one day and embark on a journey as an unknown wanderer.

In a world where the motives of numerous NPCs intertwine, and cooperation and betrayal collide,

you become a part of this world and can live freely as you choose.

title: 3D Pets: Splat! The Cat
description:
3D Pets: Splat! The Cat is one in a series of nine virtual pets released by Neechez Innovation Limited.

All the games play in a similar manner. When installed the player has two new programs in the Windows Start menu, hatch.exe and, with this game, pcpet.exe. All creatures are first hatched, there are nine cats to hatch but only one can be alive at a time and the game only allows the player to hatch egg number one when the game is first played.

Each virtual pet needs at least ten minutes attention per day and if treated well it lives for sixty days at which point it becomes an egg again at which point a new egg is hatched and the process of training begins all over again. The game screen consists of a background around which the cat moves, in the upper left is a fish skeleton which is a hotspot for the game control menu, in the upper right is a question mark which opens the in-game help. The game control menu comprises a series of numbers and icons, the numbers show the cat's current status, some of the icons move the player from one location to another while others turn the cursor into one of the cat's toys.

The game is basic and quite easy to play, thought buttons appear over the cat's head showing whether it's hungry or wants to play. When in the kitchen the player can open a cupboard to get cat food, or they can open the fridge to get milk, to put into the feeding bowls. In the TV room the TV can be turned on to entertain the cat and if the fire is lit the cat will fall asleep in front of it. If the player is unable to play with their pet for a few days the game has a 'babysitter' function which automatically cares for the cat until the owner returns. The game also allows the player to play 'Connect 4' with their pet.

title: 3D Pets: PC Pup
description:
3D Pets is a game where the player takes care of a variety of different creatures.

Each 3D Pet begins its life upon hatching out of an egg (yes, a dog hatches out of an egg!) and must be cared for at least 10 minutes per day. If you are unable to play with your pet there is a babysitter feature that does so until you return.

PC Pup is the second half of the first volume in the series, alongside Splat! The Cat.

Once you name your pup, you are free to explore a handful of interactive rooms including a bedroom with a stereo, bathroom with medicine in case the pet gets sick, living room with a television, and a garden where your pet must be trained to 'do its business', as well as others. Little thought bubbles will appear over PC Pup's head indicating what he wants the player to give him, or how he is feeling.

At the end of the pets lifespan, you will see him shrink slowly and then be presented with an 'Angel's Certificate' with stats about the pet's care listed. You may then hatch your next pet and let the circle of life continue.

description: Warrior Prime Minister Lidia Sobieska joins the tournament! Lidia is not only a world-class karate champion, but also one of the political world's most passionate foodies. Osu! Lidia will show you what she can do in TEKKEN 8 for the people of Poland.

title: The Bridge to Yesterday
description: Step into a beautifully crafted world, where you'll embark on an emotional journey filled with intrigue and danger. Explore the touching relationship of two sisters, their struggle for survival, and their unwavering determination in a world where the past crumbles and the future is uncertain.

description: "Bagel" is an exciting multiplayer online game. While civilians fight strategically to stop the Enemy, the Enemy does not hesitate to shout to hunt down civilians. Collect weapons, choose your class, and embark on a competitive school adventure!

title: Parts of the Elephant
description: Weird things are happening in the Elephant Hotel. It's getting late, you're getting drunk, and moments in the lives of strangers are scattered around you like spilled puzzle pieces. Can you put it all together?

title: Furry from Outer Space

title: Dungeons & Furries
description: ✨What's more alluring than the charm of fantasy worlds? Answer: the same, but with sex. The more sex and magic, the better. Choose your character’s gender, solve match-three puzzles, enjoy the fully voiced animations, and find out how your story ends!✨

title: Furry Fairy Tales
description: ✨Beloved classics in a spicy, furry wrapping. ✨ Adult fairytales with steamy beginnings and happy endings! Choose your character’s gender, solve match-three puzzles, enjoy the fully voiced animations, and find out how your story ends!

description: This is a murder mystery visual novel where you take the role of the detective. Search for clues, make discoveries, and talk to other characters to find out what is truly going on on the Murder Express.

title: Parking Tycoon: Business Simulator - Seaside Business
description: Dive into Miami's vibrant Seaside District in the expansion for Parking Tycoon Business Simulator! Enjoy stunning ocean views, manage a surfboard rental shop, and implement high-tech parking solutions. Build your empire and become the parking tycoon of the sunny waterfront!

title: Turbo Pulse Race
description: In the game, when you drift, you increase your level with the points you earn and unlock cars accordingly. With fast and fluid gameplay, your mistakes might not leave cars behind you.

title: Shamania
description: Shamania is an open world survival game. Get ready to farm, craft, build and fight, but with a unique feature: use your shamanic skills to your advantage in creative ways! Survive in this sandbox with your friends in CO-OP mode.

title: Timeless Tesseract
description: Introducing Timeless Tesseract - The First 3D Parkour Platformer That Lets You Control Time! By Captain Tesseract

title: Brawlers of Duality
description: Brawlers of Duality is an arena fighter where damaging enemies launches them harder. Launch enemies into obstacles to defeat them using martial arts, magic and technology. Battle in 1v1, 2v2, and a mode where you collect loot to power up and fight in a free for all.

title: Herald of the Mists
description: A narrative-driven RPG where every dice roll shapes your fate. Step into the role of the Queen's Herald and traverse a mist-shrouded realm to uncover the fate of her lost army. Will your choices uphold loyalty, or lead you down a path of betrayal? The secrets of the mists await.

title: Roulette Simulator 2025
description: Roulette Simulator 2025 offers players an incredible modern Roulette gambling simulation. Experience the emotions of gambling in real-time as you try to beat the roulette wheel as you bet on each spin.

title: The Bad Boy's Cars
description: Welcome to The Bad Boy's Cars game, where dominance is the name of the game.

title: Rework
description: Build fantastic contraptions in this open world sandbox, set in an expansive forest with ever changing climate. Protect your base from enemies and work together with friends to discover the secrets hidden beneath the surface.

title: Alter Age
description:
Embark on an unforgettable adventure with a party whose ages change!

Arga has been training daily to prove himself superior to his father, who holds the title of the strongest man in the world. During this process, he awakened the job "Soul Alter," a unique skill that changes the states of himself and his companions between adult and child. Sometimes a young man, sometimes a boy, he faces great trials with his companions.

Alter your team in turn-based battles between adult and child states to alternate between attack or support types! Utilize a wide range of formations and elements, including equipment and passive skills, to strategically navigate battles.

Explore a vast expanding world depicted in beautiful pixels, from puzzle dungeons to detour dungeons! Collect ingredients while walking around to cook meals, take on special quests limited to the child state, and fully enjoy every corner of the world of Alter Age!

title: Genshin Impact: Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn
description:
The fourth major update of Genshin Impact, known as Version 5.0, which includes:
• New characters: Mualani, Kinich, and Kachina
• New region, Natlan
• New gameplay mechanics: Saurian Indwelling and Nightsoul’s Blessing
• New main story quests: Archon Quest, Chapter V - Act I & II
• New quality of life features
• …and more!

title: Good Luck Seducing an Ace Witch
description: Jo Arcour, after finishing work, gets kidnapped by a witch in order to be chopped up in the potion as the main ingredient! Depending on your choices he might die or find a new friend.

title: Koibito no Nazo: Lover's Enigma
description: In Lover's Enigma, you investigate your husband's mysterious death while balancing complex relationships and personal trauma. Navigate a web of secrets involving a hidden cult and key characters. Your choices shape the story and lead to multiple endings.

title: Tekken 8: Heihachi Mishima
description: Heihachi Mishima is the third DLC character for Tekken 8 planned for release in Autumn 2024 alongside a free story update for the game that includes his return to the narrative and reveals his place in the ongoing events.

title: Moon Ghost
description: 2199. Androids resolves the regrets of "ghosts", human souls, in the "Garden" lunar base.

title: Love Letter: First Draft
description: Summer break approaches. With wishes unfulfilled, Danielle strives to find fellow students to attend Romance in Literature with her. If she can't, she may never be able to study Romance and Love at all!

title: Dark 7
description: Dark 7 (sometimes styled Dark7) is a ZDoom mod created by Bryant Robinson (Gunrock).

title: Risk of Rain 2: Starstorm 2
description: Starstorm 2 is a work-in-progress adaptation of the Risk of Rain 1 mod "Starstorm". It currently features four new survivors, three new monsters, over 20 new items and equipment, and numerous new challenges to shake up your runs.

title: Risk of Rain 2: Aetherium
description: Aetherium is a variety pack mod for Risk of Rain 2 that adds in a wide range of items, equipment, artifacts, and more!

title: Dong Dong Never Die: Judgment Day
description: Dong Dong Never Die, the cult classic fighting game originally released in 2009, makes its triumphant return! Truly, Dong Dong never dies. Judgment Day is a massive overhaul of the entire game that makes radical changes to every character and the game systems. It is the culmination of about 20 months of intermittent work, and we think that it's evolved into something really special.

title: Ace of Gifts
description:
Ace of Gifts is a visual novel about a date between girlfriends. Visit the various stalls at the city's annual holiday market, browse the products and balk at the prices. In between stalls, the couple discuss their relationship, as well as the obligations and expectations of family over the holidays.

It's a cold December afternoon, and Sophie has just received an out-of-nowhere text from her girlfriend, Annette, inviting her to the seasonal holiday market. Sophie's elated to attend, but can't help but be a bit worried. Usually, these sort of dates mean that Annette has something on her mind...

title: Date Everything!
description: Date Everything is a sandbox dating simulator set in the comfort of your own home, featuring 100 fully voice acted datable characters! Let the romance flow between your bed, smoke alarm and… Overwhelming Sense of Existential Dread? Are you ready to Date Everything?

title: Carlos and the Dark Order Mystery
We'll Be Alright
description: Jonghyun, a strange cafe owner, runs the Zodiac Cafe with a side business in the back. He tells fortunes from reading tea leaves for curious customers- who lean more supernatural than not. Even mythological entities want to know how their life will pan out!

title: Holonomy
description:
"Holomony" is a short kinetic visual novel about two adventurers getting trapped in a shifting dungeon-- are they in over their heads?

- Made by ekkoberry as part of O2A2 2024 - Visual Novel Jam

title: Cyberwave
description: Fight Endless Waves of Cyber-Mutants in an ever evolving combat simulation.

title: Inversed
description: A short, interactive visual novel set in the mid-19th Century, in which a poet fights against time as she's writing the most important work of her life. Poetry is the answer, but what is the question?

title: Monochrome Pixels
description: Can you bring back the colors into your life?

title: Exiting the White Room
description:
An owl, a goat, and a wolf live in a white room. They’ve been stuck there for a long, long time. One day, the owl wakes up with a fleeting recollection of the day prior. You, the owl, tries to recall what happened.

A short mystery game where you try to uncover what happened to you and your surroundings the day prior.

title: BoyKisser Clicker
description: Click on the Boykisser and take over the world.

title: Angelic Syndrome
description:
The isolation facility "Bird Cage" is a mysterious place like an urban legend, which is different from the world.
It was supposed to be a place that had nothing to do with the 12-year-old Angel, who had never been ill, but the snow-white feathers on the girl's arms robbed the girl of her freedom without any warning….

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Invasions - Season of the Huntress
Toree Missions
description: 24 small but tight challenges that use the traditional 3D Platformer Gameplay of Toree in unique and new ways to give a final spin to the known formula.

title: Toree Jumbled Jam 2
description: Four levels that remix the themes seen in Toree 2 in new and interesting ways. Including some new chiptunes as well as some old songs. Worth mentioning: Those challenges are only for those who really know how to handle Toree! Hard as a beak!

title: Puzzle Drop Carnival
description:
More than just another puzzle game. Puzzle Drop Carnival highlights the fun part of puzzle-solving.

Who does not love the good old 'Tetra'-style mechanics? With “Tetra Mode”, the jigsaw is now tetra-saw! Try out Tetra to find out the perfect combination between jigsaw style and 'Tetra'-style games.

title: Halloween Revenge
description: A short horror game inspired by trash horror movies from the 80s. Mixing weird horror with comedy and weird characters. This mix results in a nostalgic game.

title: Jägermörder 1: Chemical Lab
description: Jägermörder 1: Chemical Lab is a single-level PWAD designed by Derek MacDonald (Afterglow) for Doom II. It uses the music track "Damage Assessment" by Mark Klem.

title: Castle Crashers: Painter Boss Paradise
description:
We used to be enemies. We used to destroy the world around us. Now, we create!
The DLC will include:
Steam workshop capabilities – create your own knight skins, choose your magic, and share with the world!
New official character: play as Paint Junior, use your imagination, and unleash powerful art to vanquish your foes!
New player and weapon artwork for all official playable characters (with an option to toggle on or off).
Endless knightly possibilities – if you aren’t feeling creative, choose from thousands of community characters or preloaded characters created by our team!

title: The S.H.O.W.
description: Fight your way through hordes of hungry pigs, and find the truth behind the motives of the swine.

title: Crysis Maximum Edition
description: Crysis Maximum Edition includes Crysis and the new sequel Crysis Warhead. This epic story takes players into a changing environment, forcing them to adapt their tactics and conquer battlefields ranging from newly frozen jungles to gravity-free alien environments. Includes multiplayer such as Crysis Wars, a new multiplayer experience featuring new online game modes and 21 maps. 7 new maps are available for online combat.

title: SJS1: Streets Of Fear
description: A demon-overrun town. Originally this map was meant to be a part of an expansion to Bloodrust.

title: SJS2: Outpost
description: A dark tech themed map

title: Fervent
description:
A short, VHS - style horror game where you step into the shoes of a paranormal investigator. As you venture into the eerie Fervent Campsite, you'll uncover mysterious obelisks with cryptic symbols, abandoned white tents, and an unsettling ritual book.

Average playtime is 10 minutes.

title: Flutter of birds II: Tenshi-tachi no Tsubasa
description:
The miracle happens again... in another country-

The son of an Englishman and a Japanese woman, our main character is Shin'ya. Having grown up in his father's native land, he wanted to visit the homeland of his mother, who died when he was young. White snow covers the town of Kuramachi. His other hometown, the last trace of his mother. That is where his father and mother met and were married. And the time comes when Shin'ya's wish is granted. His aunt Miyu says she'll look after him at her church..

In his mother's hometown, Shin'ya injures his leg and goes to a clinic. As Shin'ya stays in the small, snow-covered town, waiting for his leg to heal, he encounters various young women.

title: Hayato's Journey
description:
Hayato's Journey is a SEGA Mega Drive / Genesis homebrew game that works like an unofficial spiritual sucessor of Kenseiden, a cult-classic SEGA Master System game.

Hayato's Journey is the first full SEGA Mega Drive / Genesis game powered by the Scorpion Engine by earok.

- New male character Victor with two outfit
- New female character Emillia with three outfit
- New variants of Cat and Dog

- New room

See if you can discover the secrets of the park if you're up to it... And always remember to HAVE FUN!

title: Super Monkey Ball: Banana Rumble - Sonic
description: Gotta go fast! The iconic Sonic the Hedgehog joins the party.

title: Tribute to Shadow of the Colossus
description: Tribute to Shadow of the Colossus, also known as just 'Tribute', is a passionate Brazilian fan project dedicated to honoring the timeless masterpiece that is Shadow of the Colossus by remaking it on PC and not only restoring all the cut content, but also the ideas that Team Ico could not even began to program due to time constraints. With a soulful dedication, Team Tribute is bringing to life to all the unused colossi —Griffin, Devil, Phoenix, Roc, Saru, Sirius, Spider, Worm, Yamori and Evis— infusing them with the essence of the game's original vision.

title: Beyond the Forbidden Lands
description: Beyond the Forbidden Lands is a non-profit fan-made PC remake of Shadow of the Colossus with the restoration of cut content as a major focus, including the Unused Colossi and removed areas from the game. The game will provide the option of playing as close to the original Shadow of the Colossus as possible, along with the inclusion of a 'Story Mode' which is set before SotC.

title: Shy Guy Surfing
description:
Slide, jump, and float over the ocean in this arcade-style fangame by LucasPucas. With over a dozen unique areas, rip-roaring rival battles, and a brand-new New Game Plus mode, the world of Shy Guy Surfing is packed with content like never before!
Travel across the wild seascape and face off against bosses in Journey Mode, or shoot for a high score in Endurance Mode.
Jam to classic music from the Mario series and more, arranged by an all-star cast of chiptune artists!
Customize your experience with a wide selection of screen borders and unlockable costumes.

title: Artus Against the Demon of the Museum
description: Artus Against the Demon of the Museum is a point-and-click adventure game designed as an educational game to teach children about classical paintings, their history and creators with its main character Artus de mouse.

title: Toolkid Creation
description: Toolkid Creation from Emme studio is an educational game offering kids a set of activities to create art piece on their computer and learn how to start DIY in real life as well.

title: Duskfade
description: Duskfade is a colorful adventure in a world where the torments of the past haunt you. Battle against your memories in a dizzying dance to fade the shadows of the dusk.

title: Fort Boyard: Millennium
description: Trapped in the heart of Fort Boyard, you will have to try to escape by solving many puzzles and avoiding the traps of Arok and his evil creatures. The game uses the fort from the famous TV show of the same name in a platform/horror style.

title: Pinko Linko's School
description:
Pinko Linko's School is a game I dug up not too long ago when I was visiting my grandparents. I found it while searching for some old tennis equipment in there storage. The box indicated that it was made in 1998, and yes, you can truly see that it is from that era. The first Doom game also came out in 1998, so this must have been some kind of kids-learning-toy-doom-clone. Anyway, I got it running and managed to rip the files, so here they are!

Side note: I rebinded all the keys from being the arrow keys to wasd, also there were some things in the game that were kind of [REDACTED], but that might have just been me. When you are done with the game you can take a look in the YouWon folder, I left [REDACTED] in there,

title: The Woods Have Horns
description:
Welcome to Camp Shelterlake! Enjoy a beautiful view, take a walk on the woods, and don't be brutally mauled by the legendary Goatman!

Do you have what it takes to survive this pixel-art gorefest?

title: Stealth Kill VR Missions
description: Welcome to D.A.R.P., Operator. You have been chosen to prove your Infiltration, Weapons and Explosives skills throughout various objectives in this Physics based Stealth Action VR Game. Candidates unable to comply or show signs of weakness, will be terminated immediately.

title: Jefe, La Cuenta
description: Sisebuto has a problem. He likes to drink a lot and pay very little. And today, the trip home is going to be fun. Everything is going to go from bad to worse.

title: Barista
description: This game was created for the "Games for Blind Gamers" game jam.

title: Super Monkey Ball: Banana Rumble - Axel
description:
Axel from Crazy Taxi Joins the Rumble!

Enjoy playing as Axel in either Adventure Mode or Battle Mode!
As Axel, you'll be picking up Coins instead of Bananas!

title: Foxo's Fun Schoolhouse
description: Foxo's Fun Schoolhouse is an educational fun game where you have to find comics for a friend! Foxo, the main teacher will help you with your adventure. It won't be an easy though!

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak - Voice Set
description: This set includes the following DLC: Holo Core Voice: Renne Bright, Holo Core Voice: Judith Lanster and Holo Core Voice: Barkhorn.

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak - Bonus Set
description: This set includes various cosmetic DLC and some consumable item sets.

title: Sudoku Infinite
description: A typical sudoku game with an endless supply of new Sudoku puzzles to solve.

title: Super Monkey Ball: Banana Rumble - Beat
description:
Over the Hood, Through the Streets - Beat from Jet Set Radio Joins the Rumble!

Roll with Beat in either Adventure Mode or Battle Mode!
Pick up Spray Paint Cans instead of Bananas as you skate your way through each stage.

title: Lots of Cats in Every Moment
description: “Lots of Cats in Every Moment” is a game where you find hidden cats while romance unfolds!

title: Lots of Cats in Every Moment: The Whereabouts of the Photo
description: “Lots of Cats in Every Moment: The Whereabouts of the Photo” is an expansion pack that contains the latter part of the story from the base game.

title: Forestrike
description: Forestrike is a tactical kung-fu fighting game with a supernatural twist. Use your 'foresight' ability to visualize fights before they happen and hone your skills then rumble in reality, where defeat means starting over from scratch.

title: Pirates of the Caribbean: New Horizons
Wayne's World
description:
Wayne's World is an adventure game based on the movie with the same name. The game itself is a classic point and click adventure, and should not be confused with the platform game based on the movie.

You play both Wayne and Garth, and you can switch between them at any time. The plot is simple; In an attempt to save their tv-show, Wayne and Garth decide to hold a pizza-thon (a charity show with a pizza-theme) in order to raise money. In order to be able to hold the pizza-thon Wayne and Garth must embark on several quests to collect items and hire people they need for the show. The adventure includes participating in babe-jeopardy, joining a biker's gang and baking pizza. The graphics are in 2D and the sound contains several samples from the movie.

title: Ogre Labs
description: Ogre Labs is a single-level PWAD for Doom II by Russell Pearson. It is a very large tech-base themed map for limit removing ports and uses the Doom music track "The Imp's Song" by Robert Prince.

title: Carpathian Skies
description: A downloadable visual novel for Windows, macOS, and Linux

title: Tactical Strike: Special Forces Shooter
description: Your mission is to eliminate enemies, free hostages and defuse bombs to ensure safety and peace in an exciting first-person shooter!

title: Looped: Love at first sight
description: Looped is a short interactive story told through hand-drawn animation. Guide Him and Her through the chapters of their story by solving peaceful mini-puzzles and find a way out of the

title: Gallop Racer Online
description: Gallop Racer Online was a Windows-based online game released only in Japan, based on the same series.

title: The Well of Heaven-Reaching
description: the Well of Heaven-reaching is a platforming game. Choose from a variety of jumps where you'll need to make your way through traps and obstacles to reach the top of the Well of Heaven-reaching.

title: Love Curse: Find Your Soulmate
description: It is a girls' love visual novel set against the backdrop of college and the workplace. The protagonist carries a love curse and is searching for her true love. However, as events unfold, she finds herself facing even bigger challenges...

title: End's beginning
description: 'End’s beginning' is a Japanese-style fantasy romance visual novel. As Carter Evan, uncover the truth behind his death and Shermanland's fall. With a nearly 300,000-word script, experience four unique relationships: Brother and Brother, Monarch and Knight, God and Follower, and Vampire and Prey.

title: On All Clear Days
description: A short visual novel set in the post-war world

title: The Walls Still Stand
description: Step into the eerie Kowloon Walled City in "The Walls Still Stand", an indie horror walking simulator. Complete daily tasks, uncover dark secrets, and explore with 3D spatial sound. Think critically to unlock all six endings in this 1-2 hour journey. Can you escape the city's grip?

title: Tritime Space
description: A stand-alone monster-killing game that performs action strikes and releases cool skills according to the beat of music: -- You can sense energy from the rhythm, and the energy will be transformed into stronger power!

title: Monster Commanders
description: Turn-Based Sci-Fi Strategy Game

title: Wayfarer
description: Progress thought labyrinthine caves and solve entertaining puzzles. Explore this incredible adventure where loneliness becomes your closest companion as you search clues amidst stunning landscapes and ancient ruins.

title: Cute Socks
description: Cute Socks is an interactive story about an eighteen-year-old girl who is home alone. She quickly sheds her clothes and begins playing around the house in just her socks. When her friend Julia arrives, their friendship turns into a budding lesbian relationship full of happiness and multiple orgasms!

title: Neon Express
description: Take the helm in this cyberpunk uber driver narrative mystery. Traverse the city delivering contraband and nefarious passengers. Rekindle old contacts and reconnect with an underworld you were trying to leave behind.

title: Recursive Riftfall
description: Explore dungeons, collect loot, and avoid dangers in this exotic looter! Play solo or with as many as the host can handle. Power your ship and yourselves with the resources you find to ensure your continued survival.

title: Balkan Bloodbath
description: Become the next great dictator to forge a new Balkan Empire. Navigate the intense world of international trade and the stock market, use cunning espionage tactics to disrupt opponents, and overthrow and conquer your enemies. Your mission is to infiltrate the hotel and recover evidence of their involvement in the data leak by
a) retrieving their suitcase for evidence and
b) obtaining the target's brainbox for analysis
Further details are on the chalkboard, and be sure to check your notebook.

The game revolves around an ancient dark entity, a malevolent spirit that invades the protagonist's dreams, aiming to terrorize and eventually capture their soul.

title: Pug'llector
description: Pug'llector is a clicker game where you can invest into various upgrades, buy backgrounds and all about collecting a diversity of pugs, you'll get pugs while you play. Become a Pug'llector yourself.

description: At the heart of the gameplay lies a hungry rabbit whose determination knows no bounds.

description: The main character finds himself in a dark abyss where darkness and light merge, creating a world of mysteries and dangers. In this intermediate dimension, he encounters demons, angels, and creatures that belong to neither world.

description: Shadow Falls is a first-person horror game, where you explore a mysterious farmhouse deep in the forest, solving eerie puzzles and uncovering secrets that reveal the thin veil between the world of the living and the dead. Delve deeper and uncover the sinister forces that led you here.

title: BirdLingo: A birdsong learning game
description: Welcome to BirdLingo, a game designed for honing your bird song recognition skills. Immerse yourself in a cute and relaxing atmosphere as you learn the songs of the 44 most common birds in Europe.

description: Embark on a journey through tunnels, caves and ancient temples, solving puzzles and fighting all kinds of hostile creatures. Be smart - avoid traps and think carefully. They say it doesn't hurt ;)

title: Slap That
description: Slap almost anything blocking your way in order to go deeper and deeper and discover what is going on in this world!

title: Sports Hero
description: Step into the world of Sports Hero, where the thrill of competition meets retro-style visuals and addictive gameplay.

title: Monster 3
description: Monster 3 is a puzzle video game in which the player pushes boxes around in a warehouse, trying to get them to storage locations.

title: Boundary Master
description: In this game, you will step onto a desert land scorched by the scorching sun

description: Think of your favourite sports management game, now imagine it's about cricket. Pretty cool right? Now imagine instead of all those boring features your club was managed with a deck of cards! Wow that sounds like a pretty cool game. Welcome to Cool Cucumber Cricket Manager.

title: Magman
description: the new foddian on the block

title: Gorble
description: Gorble is a short marble-based dungeon crawl.

title: MushroomJump
description: This is a casual parkour game where you are a mushroom. Control it to continuously jump upwards to reach the finish line without saving points, so be careful not to fall or fall.

title: Smashing Simulator Idle
description: Incremental game about smashing with unfolding gameplay and two prestige layers.

title: Stellar Return
description: Can you make the right choices and unravel the secrets of this alien world.Your cosmic adventure awaits! Embark on a unique space adventure.You take on the critical role of a remote mission controller. Your task? Guide a stranded astronaut who has crash-landed on a mysterious alien planet.

title: LoveAndComplex
description: LoveAndComplex is a simulation game set in college. Like any other simulation game, you can watch all sorts of endings by your choice.

title: Pub Sim
description: You've just bought your first Pub. First steps are to clean it, stock it, set your markup and let in the Patrons. Keep the drinks flowing and try not to shortchange anyone! If you keep it going long enough you might just earn enough to spruce up the place, hire staff and expand the premises.

description: A sci-fi fantasy 2D Platformer. Story rich.

description: Earthbound Dimensions is a fanmade unofficial playable reimagination of EarthBound/MOTHER 2, but translated and adapted to modern 3D systems.

description: Enter "Sooty's Rest," the forbidden forest where the legendary fire prevention mascot, Sooty The Bear, is real. Use your compass, flashlight, and survival skills to escape his pursuit. Navigate, hide, and outsmart Sooty in this thrilling wilderness survival horror game. Can you make it out alive?

In this futuristic racer, players can choose from a selection of five tracks and two game modes. Pilots operate a machine equipped with an anti-gravity engine and race through a high-speed thrill of up to 400 km/h.

title: Phantom Ten
description:
A horror game to find the anomalies.
You only have to follow a one-way corridor.
There are no items to collect, no puzzles to solve, and no hiding, running, or fighting.

description: Vile Flesh is a solo megaWAD in a fine classical tradition, following the journey of a lone soldier over the course of 32 maps as he fights through a beleaguered Earth, the netherworld, and back again in a bid to foil Hell's latest genocidal machinations and, once again, save our world. Lovingly and carefully realized, nicely polished, and decked out with a cool, laid-back custom soundtrack of the author's own making

title: SM192: Rooftops
description: Five speedjam levels, custom skyboxes and a music track.

title: SM177: Escher
description: 4 Escher Maps by Cocerello (Quoth), Doomer, digs, and Shamblernaut

description: Small map with a unique Tron- or cyberspace-like texture theme.

title: Digs01
description: Oldschool episode with nine small to medium-sized levels including a start map and a secret level. The maps are around id quality in terms of construction, style and gameplay. It also features a new rocket enforcer enemy type.

title: You VS Drugs: Education & Prevention
description: 'The Enemy' can enslave anyone, anywhere. By taking on the role of real-life Agents who exist in our brain and embarking on an adventure that will defy your imagination, you will be empowered to better protect yourself, and the people you love —if you have what it takes!

title: Lake Of Roaches
description: Created for the 7-day Fishing Jam. Pay a visit to the Lake of Roaches.

description: A two-player competitive pong rpg! In addition to playing pong, both players also gain XP/gold that can be used to level up, spawn units, make buildings, cast spells, etc.

title: Ikusa Miko: Vestal Virgin
description: Ikusa Miko: Vestal Virgin is a simulation game released by AliceSoft. The game tasks the player, who was a vengeful demon hunter, with the growth of a warrior shrine maiden girl, after she has inherited your demon slaying powers. The game hinges on the player’s ability to foster her schedule which seeks to build her physical and mental attributes.

title: C.O.Ś.
description:
C.O.Ś. is a 3D futuristic sci-fi horror game focusing on feelings of isolation and fight for survival.
During its gameplay player learns the history and secrets moving alone through an abandoned space station.

title: Somewhere in Hell
description: Somewhere in Hell is a mod inspired by Krinkels' Madness Combat mainline flash series. Featuring over 15 weapons, 3 playable characters, and a whole lot of violence.

title: Train Lovers
description:
Two lovers sitting in a train trying to fix their relationship before the ride ends. Can you help them and reach the best of the 3 outcomes?

Global Game Jam 2022 Entry

title: Croatan
description: The last place truly beyond the reach of intergalactic capitalism.

title: Memory Quickie: Fruits & Vegetables
description: Dive into a fresh and vibrant world of fruity fun with the 'Fruits & Vegetables' expansion pack.

title: Defend It!: Machinegun
description: In this DLC, you will receive a new ally that will help you defend your base. And bonus, you will be able to shoot automatically.

description: An anecdote adventure game for the MWLC.Play as the heroine, Green, and have fun experiencing that day when you were a student while constantly making all sorts of trouble (?).

description: The Nemesis DLC lets players decide which pair of Divisions should come next. Each Nemesis DLC features 2 new Divisions and several new units. This Nemesis DLC will be voted on by the WARNO community at a future date.

description: This DLC unlocks Makoto the Sharp-tongued Medic as a fully playable character for Cafe Maid - Hentai Edition.

title: Short Sad Stories: A Night Out
description: A Night Out tells about a random night in which Alice finds herself alone at home, with no plan, trapped by circumstances. But before getting desperate, she decides to go out to a nightclub and party on her own, whatever that turns out to be.

title: Dragon Daughter
description: Aurora is a famous healer who lives in a place known as the boathouse and hides a dangerous past that comes back to haunt her. As the last of her kind, Aurora is being hunted and now so is her daughter Alma. To survive, she will need to master her powers and fight for those she loves.

description: Just like your homunculi, we’re breathing new life into My Lovely Daughter! Featuring brand new artwork and support for 4K resolution, this gothic fantasy is darker than ever!

description:
From the developer, Inusuku, comes a fun-filled expansion DLC for the hit game Living With Sister: Monochrome Fantasy!

This expansion DLC adds a ton of new content, and some quality of life features.
Features:
- Many Additions to the Main Story and Side Events
- New Quality of Life Features Including an Album
- New Art
- And More!

description:
An immense beast walking, someone who is not you sleeping in a house - things you've seen, heard, the last piece of a strawberry that you must remember to keep existing.

MARMELADE is a point-and-click visual novel about an inner chaotic world, memories and a sword, about being Jam and choosing your route.

title: Anchor: The Last Hope of the Brilliant Ocean
Wake Up Magical Girl
