description: This game is a “Find the Difference” game set in the Korean subway system. At the start, you will board the normal 0th train. Once you move to the 1st train, the real adventure begins. From the 1st train onward, you need to find differences from the 0th train.

title: I am Sorry
description: "I am Sorry" is a game where you investigate objects and solve puzzles to uncover the story. Become a janitor, clean the house, and uncover the hidden truths of the story.

title: Mages of Osmea
description: Mages of Osmea is a top down spellslinging RPG where you create your own spells to defeat corrupted monsters. Fight through waves of monsters and bosses, completing objectives in singleplayer or with friends.

title: What's the Point?
description: Experience the ultimate existential crisis simulator! Our FPS-loving indie studio took an unexpected detour into philosophy. Push a metaphorical boulder, question life's purpose, and maybe find meaning (or just sore muscles). It's Sisyphus meets game dev madness in our debut title.

title: Thebes
description: Deploy your pawns, plan your strategy, and make your way through the sunlit plains of Thebes to destroy the enemy fortress, but keep an eye on the fog of war, as enemies might catch you off guard and destroy yours. Activate the abilities of the pieces to gain various advantages during your turn.

title: Closed World
description: HD-2D Dungeon Exploration JRPG. Strengthen your weapons and armor with obtained materials and acquire hidden skills across the land to delve deeper into the world. Conquer complex labyrinths, break the seals of the world, and aim for the land of ancient legends!

title: Domain Owner
description: This game takes you into a pure strategy arena, with simple yet elegant graphics.

title: Kick Them All
description: Self-defense is not a crime—it's a necessity!

title: Stock Stack
description: "Stock Stack" is a simple game that simulates stock investment and it can be used to educate or compete with your friend Maybe whoever know about investment market more can be a winner because this game reflects the working principles of the real stock market. (not at all!)

title: Rabbit on Skateboard
description: Welcome to the world of rabbits and carrots! In Rabbit on Skateboard

title: Black Submarine: Deep Seek
description: Descend as the AI mind of a cutting-edge submarine, tasked with safeguarding mysterious waters. A narrative-driven tale blending sci-fi, underwater mythology, and a chilling exploration of Artificial Intelligence’s moral evolution.

title: Can You See What I See?: Dream Machine
Silent Scream II: The Bride
description: Jessica would never imagine that her big day would turn out to be a nightmare; they had an accident and Jonathan McNealy, her husband, is missing. Things just got more and more bizarre when she encountered a mysterious girl who seemed to be leading her to Jonathan. Jessica had a feeling that the girl was connected to Jonathan. Did she cause the car accident in the first place? Return to the abandoned mansion and search for clues in Silent Scream II : The Bride.

title: Fright Chasers: Director's Cut
description: When rumors of an abandoned movie theater and the ghosts that can apparently abduct the living there appear on your blog, you eagerly go to investigate. When you arrive, you quickly find truth to the tales as you encounter specters from the very movies shown in the theater! Can you navigate your way through dangerous films to save the living in time? Find out in this thrilling Hidden-Object Puzzle adventure!

title: Fright Chasers: Soul Reaper
description: Prominent people in the town of Glenville have begun disappearing. After receiving an anonymous tip, you learn that the disappearances may be the work of a supernatural killer. This sounds like another job for the Fright Chasers! Can you solve the mystery of Glenville and stop the murderer before they claim any more victims? Find out in this bone-chilling hidden-object puzzle adventure game!

title: Diablo IV: Season of the Infernal Hordes
description: The most ferocious demonic forces have erupted into Sanctuary. Combat demonic hordes in the new Infernal Hordes feature in both Seasonal and Eternal Realms. Pursue new hellish powers with over 50 new Uniques and Legendaries. Cross paths with Lilith’s followers who warn of Sanctuary’s imminent demise at Mephisto’s hand. Pursue new rewards through the Battle Pass, Season Journey, and a new Seasonal Progression.

title: Fading Faith
description: Fading Faith is a Historical Fiction Dungeon Crawler featuring a challenging blend of exploration, survival and historical learning.Explore the dungeons beneath medieval Jerusalem where philosophers and mystics from across history now stand as testaments to their failed quests.

title: Silent Still
description: Silent Still is a short first-person psychological horror game about sleep paralysis.

title: Thou Shalt Not Kill
description: "Thou Shalt Not Kill" is a VHS-style first-person walking simulator horror game. You play as Angel, a girl traveling through the forest who finds a VHS tape lying on the ground. She starts watching it, only to discover that the footage is unsettling and tells a mysterious story. As you watch the entire tape, you realize this is no ordinary VHS footage, and you are shocked by its revelations.

title: Blood for the Old Gods
description: Play with up to 4 players local or online, in Blood for The Old Gods. A flintlock fantasy rogue-lite where you shoot, summon, and survive your way across the war torn countryside, once quaint villages, and sprawling industrial towns culminating in the final showdown against the New Gods.

title: Millennia: Ancient Worlds
description: The Ancient Worlds expansion for Millennia has new options and gameplay choices for the early parts of the game, with new abilities and experiences, a new National Spirit and a new government type.

title: Knee Deep in the UnDead
description: Designed to recreate the feel of Knee Deep in the Dead as a short and simple E1 replacement.

title: F_Episode 2
description: Complete replacement for episode 2 of Doom

title: Realm of Shades
description: Realm of Shades is a episode replacement PWAD for Doom II created by Pedro Francisco Puicón (NokturnuS). It is NokturnuS' first public release, and is an episode containing seven levels utilizing some custom textures.

title: Spire
description: This is a five map hub for Zdoom (recommend playing in GZDOOM). The Gameplay is largely arena based with some hard fights thrown in to try and challenge players.

title: Heroes' Tales
description: The project from iddqd.ru the community, basis of which are maps, made in a speed- mapping course, on which only 4 hours were allowed (each speedmapping contest - 4 hours length). Of the 33 maps in this megawad, all but 14 were part of these speedmapping contests.

title: Auto Legends
description:
Auto Legends is forged from the passion of car culture.

Immerse yourself in an authentic automotive experience where high stakes pink slip racing meets endless customization. Race and tune your car with real-world performance and visual options, creating the perfect ride that expresses your unique style.

Connect with fellow enthusiasts in an automotive social network. Challenge friends and rivals, join exhilarating car meets, and proudly showcase your latest build. Take your passion to the next level by creating parts, tuning rides, organizing events, or buying and selling cars to become a true tycoon in the car world.

Auto Legends offers multiple paths to greatness. Whatever route you choose, your legend begins here.

Unleash your inner car enthusiast with Auto Legends!

title: Tattoo Tycoon
description: Become a tattoo artist and manage your own tattoo parlor. Find the perfect designs for your curious customers and turn their vague wishes into amazing skin art. Grow from a small personal studio to a multi-parlor business throughout the different districts of Tattuga Bay.

title: The Eternal Life of Goldman
description: The Eternal Life of Goldman is a vibrant yet dark platformer adventure that weaves together legends, fairy tales and myths. Explore a vast hand-drawn Archipelago, inspired by ancient fables and depicted in classic frame-by-frame animation, and defeat a mysterious Deity!

title: Wreckfest 2
description: Ready for mayhem? Wreckfest is back, offering the best in full-contact racing with unrivaled destruction! Witness head-to-head battles as you tear apart rival vehicles bit by bit. Powered by the enhanced physics engine, developed by the creators of Wreckfest & FlatOut!

title: Way of the Hunter: Lintukoto Reserve
description: Welcome to Lintukoto Reserve, a Scandinavian gem where the wild and serene blend seamlessly. This vast reserve offers a vast array of biomes and breathtaking landscapes that will captivate nature lovers and wildlife enthusiasts alike.

title: Kletka
description: Kletka is a co-op horror game about going down in an elevator that is trying to eat you. Feed the elevator, explore deadly floors and descend deeper.

title: Midnight Murder Club
description: Heart-pounding and hilarious multiplayer FPS fun. Trust your senses and overcome your fears as you’re armed with a flashlight and a revolver, then set against your friends in a pitch-black mansion with surprises around every corner. Hide, seek, & shoot in the dark.

title: The Mortuary Assistant: Definitive Edition
description:
Darkstone Digital is bringing more scares, more lore, and an endless embalming-only mode for those more interested in Rebecca's day-to-day work without the worry of being scared on August 2nd with The Mortuary Assistant: Definitive Edition!

Along with this free update to owners of Mortuary Assistant on PC and Nintendo Switch, the Definitive Edition is also going to be available on consoles! The Mortuary Assistant: Definitive Edition comes to PlayStation and Xbox on the same date with some new content too!
- Embalming only mode - embalm unlimited bodies
- New Haunt Events
- Additional Lore
- New bodies to embalm
- New Valentine's Day seasonal event (Stop by the mortuary in February)
- New achievements
- Multiple Bug and Stability Fixes
- Performance Improvements

title: Barbie Project Friendship
description: Get ready for the ultimate Barbie gaming adventure as Barbie and Barbie work together to save a beloved Malibu landmark, the Malibu Waves Community Center! Join them and their friends on a fun adventure to transform six spaces into fabulous spots like the Pet Salon, Campsite, Tech Lab, and more.

title: Oh My Lord
description: Manage your medieval fantasy city, balance resources, and navigate the demands of different factions. Unlock new characters to join your city and help maintain order.

title: Pen to Paper
description: A visual novel journaling game hybrid about charting a traveller's journey.

title: Labor Power
description:
Grindstone, Inc. is an awful place to work at. But you can't organize a strike all on your own. You will need the help of your NPC coworkers — even if you have to physically pull them away from their screens.

Labor Power is a small Pikmin-inspired game dedicated to class solidarity and the betterment of working conditions. Labor Power took first place at Gamedev.js Jam 2024 (theme: Power)

title: Fate/Hollow Ataraxia Remastered
description: Remaster of Fate/hollow ataraxia, a Japanese visual novel game and the sequel to Fate/stay night.

title: Panzer Corps 2: War Stories - Fall of Poland
description: An expansion for the WW2 turn-based strategy. In Panzer Corps 2: War Stories - Fall of Poland we can take control of Polish units during the German offensive in 1939. The add-on introduces various gameplay changes and the option to change real historical events.

title: Card Chronicles: Devious Deck
description: Card Chronicles: Devious Deck merges roguelite gameplay with deckbuilding strategy, where every card played comes at the cost of the player's health points. Collect cards, build unique decks, battle fierce monsters and prove yourself worthy, while carefully managing your health. Uncover the truth, immerse in a gripping adventure as you ascend the Tower of Legends, where every decision matters and defines your path forward.

title: X-Out: Resurfaced
description: The underwater shoot ‘em up from game developer Rainbow Arts is finally returning in a faithful remake completely rebuilt from the ground up and greatly improved. The sprite work of yesteryear has not only been remade into modern high-resolution sprites but also expanded with particle and lighting effects.

title: Pokémon Keishou
description: Kyujitsu Island is in peril. As the aging Lord's power fades, the island descends into chaos. You, a chosen descendant, must embark on a perilous journey to become the new leader, the Keishou-sha. Battle rival clans, conquer the elements, and uncover ancient secrets to restore peace to this once-idyllic land. A shadow clan lurks in the shadows, seeking to exploit the island's turmoil. Can you overcome them and become the island's savior?

title: Ruin of the Fae Realm
description: A weekend + a few days jam map made for the cohost mapping potluck mapjam with theme of 'flow'.

title: Replicon
description: Medium - size base map for Arcane Dimensions.

title: The Nullspace
description: Originally 'The Nullspace', was a map submitted for Quake Brutalist Jam 2 by ExaByt. This is an expansion of it into a mini-episode consisting of 4 maps (including the original Nullspace, slightly updated/rebalanced), and a start map.

title: Up Up & Down!
description: Each of Us Builds His Own Path!

title: Mind Her Manor
description: Action-adventure game with management elements where you play as a young fox trying to escape the manor of an evil witch.

title: Gensou Ningyou Embu Gaiden: Yuki-chan no Shugyou
description:
Based on the Touhou Puppet Dance Performance, the game focuses on combat with Yuki as the main character.
Using a party of prepared dolls, the player takes on NPCs who, unlike in the main game, are more human-like in this puzzle-like mini-game.

title: Slime Shoot
description: Slime Shoot is an isometric shooter where you control a slime fighting off the bad guys who have overrun the slime kingdom. Every attempt grants coins to spend in the shop for new weapons, passives, cosmetics, and abilities.

title: Murder on the Spaceship Altair
description: You play as the Master AI of the spaceship Altair and end up partnering with Flem in order to solve the mystery. Issue commands to Flem and investigate the ship. Depending on the command, you may be able to communicate with the crew through physical contact and the like… Interact with the crew through various means and strengthen your relationships.

title: Angelian Trigger
description: Angelian Trigger is a 3D shooting game in which you run through the screen while shooting down enemies.

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Cyrax
description:
A gender swapped version of Cyrax from an alternate timeline has been announced as a playable DLC character in the Khaos Reigns expansion.

The original version of Cyrax is part of the base game's Kameo roster.

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Sektor
description:
A gender swapped version of Sektor from an alternate timeline has been announced as a playable DLC character in the Khaos Reigns expansion.

The original version of Sektor is part of the base game's Kameo roster.

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Noob Saibot
description: Noob Saibot has been announced as a playable DLC character in the Khaos Reigns expansion.

title: Choson Janggi
description: Choson Janggi is a video game version of Janggi, a traditional Korean strategy board game, developed for PC by Korea Computer Center.

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Ghostface
description:
Ghostface has been announced as a DLC guest character in the Khaos Reigns expansion for Mortal Kombat 1.
No release date was announced but the expansion will include a 1 week early access period for the character.

title: Mortal Kombat 1: T-1000
description: The T-1000 embodies the ultimate evolution of assassination technology. This pack includes playable character the T-1000, including all new move-sets based on Terminator 2.

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Conan the Barbarian
description: Conan stands ready to defend Earthrealm against the vile beings that mean to conquer it. This pack includes playable character Conan the Barbarian, including all new move-sets.

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Khaos Reigns Story Expansion
description:
A New Reign of Khaos unfolds in Liu Kang's Era.

The Khaos Reigns Story Expansion continues the Mortal Kombat 1 story and is exclusive to the Khaos Reigns Expansion package.
Also available through the Khaos Reigns bundle which includes the Khaos Reigns Expansion and Kombat Pack 1.

title: Guns of Fury
description: Guns of Fury is a retro-inspired action platformer that combines the run & gun and Metroidvania genres. Explore a vast interconnected world, gain new abilities and weapons, battle epic bosses and stop the plans of an evil corporation before it’s too late!

title: Siren Head: The Arrival
description: Siren Head: The Arrival is a horror mod for Minecraft which adds in Trevor Henderson's iconic monster "Siren Head" into the game. During regular gameplay, Siren Head roams around the world and stalks the player. Watch out, you may hear him before you see him.

title: Hoshizora no Memoria: Wish Upon a Shooting Star HD
description: HD release of visual novel Hoshizora no Memoria: Wish Upon a Shooting Star.

title: Godfall: Primal Update
description: Primal Update offers more challenging content and introduces a new loot category called Primal items. Ascension levels let you power up even after you’ve reached the level cap, granting you new Ascension Powers and Ascension Bonuses. Improved Tower of Trials. Revamp of Dreamstones 2.0. This content update also includes various bug fixes, player weapon refinements, co-op tech enhancements, and QoL improvements.

title: The Anomaly Project
description: Your goal is simple, spot anomalies to escape. Play alone or together with up to 8 players in online co-op. Make the right decisions to advance to the next level, or risk being reset to the beginning!

title: Aether Singularity
description: Take on the role of a special agent and fight against digital demons from the Aethernet with your Daemon partner. Something's gone wrong in a prominent research facility, and you and your squad have been deployed to uncover the source of the demonic threat that's been unleashed. Destroy all demons!

title: Chivalry 2: Regicide Update
description:
Chivalry 2’s Regicide Update introduces the Team Objective Map – Regicide at Trayan Citadel, the new Goedendag weapon, a new Campaign, quality of life improvements, and more.
Update Highlights
New Team Objective map – “Regicide at Trayan Citadel”
New Campaign Pass – “Regicide”
New Character Bundle – “Agatha Rebel Knight”
New Weapon – “Goedendag”
Combat Changes
QoL Improvements

title: 101 Cats in Ireland
description: Find and discover 101 cute cats hidden throughout the Ireland landscape in this hand-drawn hidden object game. Can you find them all?

title: The Lights Went Out
description: "The lights went out" is a short horror experience with a bizarre story narrated by the victim himself.

title: 101 Cats in Shanghai
description: Find and discover 101 cute cats hidden throughout the Shanghai landscape in this hand-drawn hidden object game. Can you find them all?

title: 101 Cats in Mexico
description: Find and discover 101 cute cats hidden throughout the Mexico landscape in this hand-drawn hidden object game. Can you find them all?

title: 101 Cats in Berlin
description: Find and discover 101 cute cats hidden throughout the Berlin landscape in this hand-drawn hidden object game. Can you find them all?

title: The Scarlet Cascabel
description: Originally released as part of the Thief: The Dark Project 20th Anniversary Contest, The Scarlet Cascabel (v2) is an improved version of the original fan maps that adds new content and applies many gameplay fixes

title: Solid Chunks
description: Step into the thrilling world of "Solid Chunks" where your keen eye and dedication are the keys to our society's success! In this fantastically hand-drawn comic book realm, our noble humanoid fly overlords have bestowed upon us the great honor of collecting their precious poo.

title: Everseeker: Little Critters
description: Everseeker is a Hidden Object game and a charming exploration and discovery experience where your goal is to find 100 small insects hidden in a picturesque town of cute rabbits. All the artwork is carefully hand-drawn, providing a relaxing and immersive atmosphere.

title: Click on Clocks Together
description: Can you and your friends find all 100+ clocks in this panoramic level? Difficulty: Medium

title: Marine Battles
description: Marine Battles is an online PvP Battleship game that allows free placement instead of placing ships in a grid and real-time battles as opposed to the classical turn-based gameplay.

title: FlatOut: Ultimate Carnage Collector's Edition
description: This new Collector's Edition of FlatOut Ultimate Carnage contains bug fixes, achievements, improved loading times, cloud saves, more languages, and digital goodies; all free for the original owners of FlatOut: Ultimate Carnage!

title: Ninja I & II
description: Master the art of quick reflexes in Ninja I & II!

title: Recycling Tycoon: Junk to Gems
description: Grocery Store Simulator is an immersive simulator that is all about retail, go big or go bankrupt! Everything is in your hands

title: Renovation Simulator
description: Start simple, grow your skills and be the best renovator in the business. Clean, repaint, restyle, and redecorate your way to success. Inside and out.

title: University Tycoon: The College Management Simulator
description: Build and manage a University, with realistic curriculum scheduling, reputation system, and a multiple building campus

title: Vending Machine Business Simulator
description: Build your business! control every aspect of a thriving vending machine business. Buy, place, and restock machines to increase profits. Do you have what it takes to manage, expand, and dominate the vending industry?

title: Solar: Survival Space Battle Simulator
description: In SOLAR, you survive in space, expand and customize your fleet, and battle enemy fleets and up to 12 bosses. With tactical decisions and rewards, you optimize your spaceships for epic battles.

title: Streamers Cleaning Simulator
description: Restore order and cleanliness to the rooms of famous Gaming Streamers after their epic gaming sessions. Find artefacts, explore streamers life. Play co-op with your friends.

title: Signal Control Simulator
description: The job of a "signal worker" is to protect the safety of Japan's railways behind the scenes. Operate the interlocking panels to safely and accurately operate trains that run in seconds. You can experience the work of a signal attendant, which is essential for safe railway operation.

title: Train Simulator
description: At the end of the 1800s, make a difference in the railway industry with your own train. Customize your train and offer luxury and comfort to your passengers. Grow your business with interstation travels, profitable contracts, and new wagons. A relaxing and enjoyable adventure awaits you.

title: Pickup Trash Simulator Remastered
description: Pickup Trash Simulator Remastered Is A Game About Picking Up Trash In A Park Because You Love The Environment. Picking Up Trash Is Fun For All Ages Kids And Adults Alike So Pickup Some Trash And Have Fun.

title: PowerWash Simulator: Muckingham Files - Part 4
description: Cool off with sudsy, high-pressured water this summer in PowerWash Simulator's latest Seasonal Special. Take a vacation from Muckingham's mainland to clean up the sun deck of Crab Bay's cruise liner following a messy departure.

title: Road to Champion: Boxing Simulator
description: "Road To Champion: Boxing Simulator" is an exciting simulation of the boxing world. Shape your career, decorate your home, customize your car, and fight your way to becoming a champion!

title: Sauna Simulator
description: Run your own sauna: buy a room, equip it with an oven and start earning money from it. Hire employees, ensure safety and, of course, have fun!

title: Scary School Simulator 3
description: Walk into a horror anime stories, solve dark mysteries, and escape from the ghost!

title: Scouting Simulator
description: You can explorer different studio sets in this game, and using a virtual cinema camera to help your picture design.

title: Secret Number Simulator
description: The numbers?! What do they mean? Can you find them all? Simulate the experience of searching for secret numbers by playing Secret Number Simulator today!

title: Security Simulator: Nightshift
description: A spot-the-difference-horror game; you use a camera system to locate and report disturbances and thieves, but you can't stay in the cameras the whole night. Getting up from your office to patrol is necessary to keep thieves at bay.

title: Sewing Machine Simulator
description: Play as a prisoner in prison and operate a sewing machine. Use various methods to make him operate faster!

title: Forever World Cup Simulator
description: The simulator lets you select 50+ tournaments at the same time, including EURO, World Cup, Nations Leagues, and AFCON. Its unique "forever" feature allows simulations to run indefinitely, with 220+ national teams' attributes evolving dynamically. You can create new teams with a powerful editor.

title: Grand Piano Simulator
description: Step into the shoes of a virtuoso pianist and experience the thrill of playing a grand piano in the comfort of your home. Grand Piano Simulator offers an immersive and realistic simulation experience with stunning visuals, and a variety of features to unleash your musical creativity.

title: Gym Simulator Ultimate
description: Gym Simulator Ultimate is a first person simulation game. Run your own gym, buy more equipment, grow your business, attract more customer, be the best gym on the city.

title: Horse Farm Simulator
description: Manage your own horse farm; feed and take care of your horses, and interact with your customers. Enjoy riding horses, participate in races, or experience farming by planting crops in your fields. Additionally, run your café to earn income and expand your farm.

title: Idle Game Simulator
description: Have you ever wanted an idle game without all the pesky obstructions like gameplay and graphics? Introducing Idle Game Simulator! Is it a game? No, it is a very serious and deep simulator. This is idle in its purest form, watch number go up without having to do anything at all!

title: Immortal Markets Stock Market Simulator Game
description: In this game, you play as a deity that can gamble their shrine treasury on various financial instruments, including stocks, bonds and commodities.

title: Nightwalk Simulator
description:
Nightwalk Simulator throws you into a nightmare version of rural Georgia—one drenched in darkness and danger.

You don’t know how you got here. One moment you're in the real world, the next you're pulled through a portal into an alternate dimension where the sun no longer rises and the dead don’t stay buried. In this place, zombies sprint without hesitation, alien ships roam the skies, and the deeper into the woods you go, the more reality seems to unravel.

To survive, you’ll need to scavenge, conserve every bullet, and solve a ritualistic mystery that may be your only way out. Along the way, you’ll uncover abandoned military bunkers humming with failed experiments, mysterious signals coming from payphones, and gear that might just keep you alive a little longer.

There are no allies. No safe zones. Only the forest, the lights, and whatever’s hunting you in the dark.

title: Motorbike Simulator MX Driving
description: Hit the gas in Motorbike Simulator MX Driving! Equipped with realistic 3D graphics and adrenaline-filled jumps, this game takes you to the top of motorcycle riding. Test your driving skills now!

title: Mafia Life Simulator
description: Build your own empire in the world of the mafia! In Mafia Life Simulator, take control of everything from marijuana farms to weapon factories, money laundering centers to drug networks. Become the undisputed leader of the region with your gang and make your name known in the world of crime.

title: Coaching Simulator
description: Coaching Simulator is an educational simulation game that combines study techniques, short and long lesson videos, AI university coaching, English practice NPCs, creative crafting areas. Enhance your learning experience and enjoy diverse activities in a virtual library setting.

title: Apprehending the Adventuer Chan!: Live2D Tentacles Simulator
description: A tentacle training simulator developed specifically for experienced players. Players will control tentacles to fully train the captured adventurer-chan. All animations are rendered in full Live2D, providing immediate feedback based on various actions to satisfy your desires for tentacle training!

title: Casino Island Simulator
description: Run your own casino. Buy new gambling games, take payments, hire employees, expand and design your casino. Slots, blackjack, roulette, poker, baccarat, craps and more...

title: Cheese Co-op Clicker Simulator
description: Cheese Co-op Clicker Simulator 100 players

title: DiggerSim: Excavator Simulator
description:
In this non-VR port, DiggerSim is a thrilling excavator and heavy equipment simulator that puts you in the driver's seat of a powerful excavator. With realistic controls, you'll feel like you're really operating heavy machinery.

In this game, you'll be tasked with completing a variety of excavation jobs, from digging foundations to clearing land. You'll have to carefully manoeuvre your excavator through tight spaces and navigate around obstacles to complete the level.

As you progress through the game, you'll have challenges that will test your skills and abilities. With immersive gameplay and realistic controls, Digger Sim is the ultimate experience for fans of construction and heavy machinery. So put on your hard hat and get ready to dig in!

title: Electronic Market Simulator
description: Electronic Market Simulator is a detailed simulation game where players manage and operate their own electronics store. Players sell products, boost customer satisfaction, and aim to become the top store. Strategic decisions in store management, customer service, and finances are required.

title: Fantasy Map Simulator
description: Fantasy Map Simulator: Create and watch imaginary worlds evolve over centuries. Design maps, simulate nations, and control destinies. See empires rise and fall on your desktop wallpaper. A unique simulation for history buffs and creative minds.

title: Fantasy World Simulator
description: Open a Pixie shop and dive into an adventure with whimsical creatures. Tame, train, and evolve Pixie characters, then explore the vibrant city with them. Manage your shop, serve customers, and grow your business. Join now and create your own Pixie legend!

title: Farming Supermarket Simulator
description: Embark on a relaxing but challenging journey to run your own supermarket. Grow organic plants, take care of your animals and sell products to your customers. Build and expand your shelves. Can you turn your supermarket into an empire?

title: Fertiliel: Cupid Simulator
description: As a cupid in this visual novel, help couples have great conversations and get together on dates! These couples you create will have many kids and help repopulate Earth.

title: Simulator of Ukraine 1991: The Great Sea
description: This DLC deletes Russia and turns it into an ocean.

title: Simulator of Ukraine 1991: Play for Israel
description: DLS makes it possible to play for Israel

title: Pawnbroker Simulator
description: Welcome to Pawnbroker Simulator, where you're the boss. Build your shop, strike deals, and test your business savvy in this indie simulation game. Dive into a world of trade and management. Can you make it big in the world of pawnbroking? Time to find out!

title: Train Simulator: Himrrs Freight Wagon
description: With the Himrrs, a special freight wagon is making its way into Train Simulator!

title: Train Simulator: ÖBB 8633
description: Prepare for Austrian regional and commuter operations with the ÖBB 8633 from RSSLO.

title: Train Simulator: St. Pölten - Linz
description: Travel across Austria in Train Simulator with the St. Pölten - Linz railway from RSSLO.

title: Train Simulator: Wessex Main Line - Southampton - Salisbury Extension
description: Explore the Wessex Main Line today with the Southampton - Salisbury Extension from Just Trains.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: EGKK Airport
description: London Gatwick, also known as Gatwick Airport (IATA: LGW, ICAO: EGKK), is the secondary international airport serving London, the capital of England and the United Kingdom.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: KDTW Airport
description: Michingan's busiest airport - KDTW arrives to Tower! Simulator 3 - the primary international airport serving Detroit with six runways, two terminals, and 4 concourses with a total of 147 gates keeping you busy controlling!

title: Ship Graveyard Simulator 2: Submarines
description: Submarines DLC gets you a new challenge awaiting you. Submarines, which bring many new challenges and possibilities! Get ready to smash some Submarines!

title: Euro Truck Simulator 2: Scania S BEV
description: Enjoy the Scania S BEV in Euro Truck Simulator 2! The Scania 40 S and 45 S BEV, which are both based on the Scania S with a 4x2 chassis, feature two powertrain options, a 6-speed transmission combined with 3 electric motors with a power output of 400/450 kW. For now only as Quick Jobs trucks.

title: Ham Pafe: Hamster no Sweets Puzzle
description: This is a puzzle game that combines easy difficulty and hamster raising for little kids to enjoy. Let's raise various hamsters in a cage!

title: Alice's Hanny Hanny Crush!
description: Alice's Hanny Hanny Crush! is a casual Hack & Slash game featuring satisfying Hanny crushing!Please show no sympathy. Afterall, they are just ceramics. Share your results on social media to show off your Hanny crushing skills!

title: Commentator
description: "Commentator" is a novel game where you become a commentator for a popular news program. By selecting the news to comment on and your critique stance, you will experience a manipulation of public opinion and a changing a world.

title: 3D Puzzle: Courtyard
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful place.

title: 3D Puzzle: Deserted Village
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful place.

title: 180 Seconds: A Firefighter's Call
description: 180 Seconds is all about choices and consequences. Arriving at the scene of a fire, you will have only 3-5 minutes to rescue people from a burning building. You must decide what to prioritize once inside. Can you save everyone or will your choices seal the fate of those depending on you?

title: White Cat Adventure Team
description: You will play the role of the White Cat Adventure Team, embarking on adventures on this fantasy continent and experiencing the story. Search and collect various skills and items to face various battles.

title: Mainichi Danjo Irekawari Seikatsu?! My Body Your Body
description: "My Body Your Body" is a novel game where the protagonist and three heroines find themselves under a curse that swaps their bodies. As they navigate everyday activities like changing clothes and bathing, they search for a way to reverse the situation in this gender-swapping story.

title: Sokubaku Kanojo to Pet na Boku: I'm Your Pet
description: Wouldn't anyone be happy to have a girlfriend who makes them lunch and comes to pick them up every morning? If I had to pick one flaw...it would be that this love is very suffocating...

title: Zrust
description: Will you be the greatest space pirate? Build your ship, plunder enemies, and conquer the galaxy in Zrust!

title: ZonZon
description: The main character is a journalist who arrived at a large warehouse to record a documentary about the warehouse operation. But instead, he is faced with a real nightmare. The warehouse turns out to be populated by hungry guards and crazy warehouse operators who turn it into a death trap.

title: Zombie Treasure Land
description: Play the role of Maoshan Taoist , go on an adventure to solve puzzles.

title: Zombiehood
description: Zombiehood is a quirky yet brutal run-and-gun roguelite: scavenge weapons, equipment, and artifacts, unlock powerful upgrades, and blast through procedurally generated biomes with witty dialogue and explosively satisfying combat.

title: You Struck Gold
description: Stranded on a mining planet, your escape hinges on quarrying gold. Solve challenging puzzles by using unique card abilities to uncover riches and escape in this strategic, card-based puzzle game!

title: You See Me?
description: What do you think consciousness is? Is it a mirror of the soul or a dark labyrinth filled with fears? Losing your only friend means losing your sanity.

title: Zaru
description: Explore a PSX-style horror game where your senses are your tools for survival. Sacrifice one sense for another to detect threats and make it out alive. Experience the sensory deprivation as you sneak throughout the warehouse, doing your last tasks for the night.

title: Zenith Armada
description: Embark on interstellar conquest in a 2D space strategy game. Command ships, explore galaxies, engage in real-time battles, and customize your fleet. Traverse hazardous star maps, unlock factions, and strategize for victory. Are you ready to conquer the cosmos?

title: Zero Factory
description: Embark on a journey from Stone Age to industrial power in Zero Factory, where survival meets automation in a magical, corrupted world. Face bosses, harness artifacts, and build a mechanical empire.

title: Zero-Sum Heart
description: "I" make a deal with the witch to give up my heart, in exchange for love— from everyone. Is it worth it if losing my heart means gaining *his*?———————————————————————In this short visual novel, make choices and answer the question: is love a zero-sum game?

title: Zombetes
description: Face the undead apocalypse while managing your diabetes. ZOMBETES is a gripping text-based game where every choice is crucial to your survival. Navigate procedural levels, scavenge for insulin, food, and supplies, and fight to stay alive in this unique blend of survival and strategy.

title: Zombie Dolls
description: Fend off hordes of cute zombified dolls using guns, bombs, bats, and boomerangs. Zombie Dolls is a light-hearted, but intense, stand your ground shoot em up game. Don't be fooled by their friendly appearance, they are tough and unrelenting!

title: Zombi Efem
description: Join the battle for survival against zombies with "Zombi Efem"! Play solo or online with up to four players in both TPS and FPS modes. This horror survival game invites you to face challenging combats and thrilling moments. Plan your strategy, prepare your weapons, and fight to survive!

title: Zilar: Empire of The Underground
description: Zilar is an exploration adventure game developed by two young developers, where we control the main character Zemandevi.

title: Yixin
description: The first love simulator, the real immersive real-life love game, the video novel type, the only pure love experience, takes you into the pure and beautiful love world that seems like dreams, and feels the emotion that has been buried in your heart for a long time.

title: Yomp for Zhi
description: Yomp for Zhi is a difficult turn-based RPG with no getting lost or backtracking. It has perma-death, a lot of randomization, 41 characters to hire, and most enemies can become temporary allies.

title: You Know My Name?
description: A short visual novel about finding your name and a girl in the fog.

title: You Must Retry
description: You Must Retry is a roguelike where you will kill crowds of enemies. Dynamic battles, unique items and abilities. Character upgrading for any style of play. And even death here is not in vain, because after each attempt you will become only stronger.

title: Young Detectives: Animals
description: Dive into a world of colorful discovery with the ultimate spot the difference game designed for young minds! Your mission is to identify the subtle distinctions between seemingly identical scenes.

title: Young Detectives: School
description: Dive into a world of colorful discovery with the ultimate spot the difference game designed for young minds! Your mission is to identify the subtle distinctions between seemingly identical scenes.

title: Young Detectives: Farm
description: Dive into a world of colorful discovery with the ultimate spot the difference game designed for young minds! Your mission is to identify the subtle distinctions between seemingly identical scenes.

title: Young Detectives: Space
description: Dive into a world of colorful discovery with the ultimate spot the difference game designed for young minds! Your mission is to identify the subtle distinctions between seemingly identical scenes.

title: Xiuzhen World 2
description: Xiuzhen World 2 is a 3D world where your goal is to level up from a mere mortal into an immortal at the end. Its a semi-idle game with fun immortal cultivation mechanics such as - leveling up to become stronger. - capturing monsters as pets to fight for you. - AFK(Away From Keybourd).

title: X Roulette
description: Roulette is a 3D Horror-Adult game that revolves around the chilling ritual of taking turns firing a shotgun.

title: X-War
description: X-WAR is a dynamic AAA first-person shooter where players can win in-game prizes through unique mechanics not found in any other game.

title: Yancy
description: YANCY is an NES style action adventure that follows a small protagonist in a vast world full of danger, swords and rewards. Lead your own adventure in a non-linear game world, exploring dungeons, forging magical weapons, battling challenging bosses and unearthing ancient secrets!

title: X Run 3
description: Utilize parkour skills to avoid all obstacles and dangers, and reach the finish line as quickly as possible. With a fragile human body, defy gravity and pursuit, showcase your advanced parkour techniques, and experience the fun and excitement of the sport.

title: YanYueDao Kill
description: This is a simple point-and-click game where you must slay demons at the right moment. Along the way, you can acquire exquisite cards to enhance your combat power.

title: X-Plane 12: FACO Simulations - F-15C Eagle
description: If you think you only fly Airliners and GA: The archaic navigation system of the F-15C will give any pilot a challenge offering a fun way to practice those difficult instrument skills at a much faster pace!

title: X-Plane 12: Axonos - Owen Roberts International Airport
description: Nestled in the Caribbean islands, MWCR Robert Owens International Airport stands tall as one of the busiest airports in the region.

title: X-Plane 12: Aerosoft - Airport Madrid
description: Sim-wings presents the Airport Madrid with all buildings and service facilities for X-Plane. The aerial image covers a total surface of 400 km², and the detailed 3D models and animations bring the scenery to life.

title: X-Plane 12: Axonos - Varna Airport
description: Varna Airport (Bulgarian: Летище Варна, Romanised: Letishte Varna) is the primary airport for the city of Varna, the historical maritime capital of Bulgaria, now one of the most popular summer tourist destinations in Eastern Europe.

title: X-Plane 12: Aerosoft - Airport Stuttgart
description: Airport Stuttgart XP brings the international airport of the state capital of Baden-Wuerttemberg as a native add-on to the flight simulator X-Plane 12.

title: Xenospore
description: Defend humanity against a creeping alien fungus in this strategic, turn-based puzzle game. Destroy tiles to isolate the Xenospore organism and protect populations in a minimalistic yet challenging experience.

title: Xenocrystal TD
description: A Rogue-like Tower Defense game with 10 towers, 5 damage types, 20 abilities, and hundreds of upgrades. Select one or more upgrades to your towers and/or abilities at the end of each level that stay with you through your mission to protect the Xenocrystals. Limitless possibilities!

title: Xenowars
description: This is a turn-based strategy/RPG game set in the stars. In the early stages, you will recruit a team of experts on Earth for exploring a distant alien homeworld, choosing between scientists, mutants, and soldiers. Scour the planet for lost alien technology and uncover the secrets to Earth’s doom.

title: Xeroes
description: Xeroes is a fast-paced brawl-action game with charming characters and innovative combat mechanics. Play with friends or solo across a variety of game modes and battle in a variety of familiar and mysterious locations across the world.

title: Woxin Jianghu
description: A massively multiplayer online game (MMORPG) independently developed by me is also a continuation of a childhood dream, I hope it can make everyone feel happy and communicate with each other! I also hope that all game lovers will give me more advice, and I will try my best to improve...

title: Wrong Bullet
description: Wrong Bullet is a captivating chill shooter that unveils an ever-changing world with random weapons scattered everywhere, accompanying your bloody campaign against enemy heads. Collect golden shards from them to unlock characters, discovering even more facets of gameplay.

title: Nerd Simulator
description: It’s never too late to turn your life around! Step into the shoes of a 40-year-old finally ready to leave the nest in this hilarious RPG-Life Simulation mix. Tackle wacky challenges, embrace absurd adventures, and prove that with determination (and a bit of chaos), you can start fresh at any age.

title: Wukong's Pool
description: Wukong's Pool is a unique fusion of roguelike elements, poker strategy, and the gameplay of billiards. In this pool game, you take on the role of Wukong, the Monkey King, facing a series of challenges.

title: Wyatt Earp and The Cowboys Wargame Ssp
description: Arcade, Arcade! Arcade!! back to the Eighties and the wild west. Stop the Lawmen getting past by shooting them, if they get past they will make arrests. you get three lives to get the highest score you can.

title: X Dash 3D
description: A classic game in which you have to overcome obstacles to reach the yellow point or finish line at the end of the map in a given time in the upper right corner.

title: World Eternal: Battlegrounds
description: A thrilling blend of MOBA, Battle Royale, and arcade action with an innovative hero and gear collection system. Experience the first open game economy where players can trade items freely on Steam!

title: World Horror Story
description: World Horror Story is a cooperative survival horror game where you need to banish evil before it destroys you. In the game, you can communicate with ghosts and demons using your voice, but be careful; if ghosts respond, it doesn't mean they are friendly.

title: Winter Girl
description: 'Winter Girl' is a visual novel game that begins with a miraculous encounter with the alien, Se-A. Combining modern direction with classic visual novel charm, it offers an immersive story and interactions. Experience various endings based on your choices.

title: Wind Story
description: "Wind Story" is a simulation game, players can immerse themselves in rural lifestyles, including farming, breeding, and fishing. During the day, they can freely roam the Ranch's flower fields, while at night, they can enjoy drinking and dancing by the lakeside bonfire.

title: Wolf Hero: Animals vs. Robots
description: Build a strong pack and protect the forest from evil robots!

title: Wizard Duel
description: Study and cast spells and prove yourself in a duel as the superior wizard.

title: WitchRider
description: This is a building tower defense game with RPG elements to hunt down the demon guard altar.

title: Wisps of the Elements
description: A tactical rogue-lite set in a medieval-fantastic scenery. Defend yourself against your foes, learn the magic of this realm, and discover the deepest secrets of its inhabitants

title: Wire Throne
description: Blast your way out of captivity, upgrade your ride, and unleash devastating firepower to take down the Wire Throne! One life, one car in this roguelite top-down looter shooter!

title: Wonder Loop Village
description: You’ve wandered into a mysterious village. Let’s search for anomalies and aim for the exit!

title: WonderLang French
description: Embark on an RPG adventure in WonderLang, where mastering a new language is part of the journey. Learn through quests, dialogues, and puzzles. Available in multiple languages with immersive gameplay. Begin your quest for language mastery today!

title: Whispers of The Shadow
description: Detective Grace Lawson sets out immediately upon receiving a tip about her missing stepsister Amy, and when she gets there, she suddenly finds herself trapped inside the house. Now, Grace has only one goal: to find her missing sister and escape this nightmare.

title: Whispering Death
description: Whispering Death is a short horror experience that puts you in a mysterious realm blending in with your past. Solve puzzles and find out who you are. But remember you are always beeing watched, so think through every decission you make before it's too late.

title: While Mom is Away
description: While Mom's Away is a fast-paced First-Person Shooter where you kill players with toasters, pizza and satellite dishes... And also shoot with chips? What kind of goofy game is this?!

title: While Sleeping
description: A first-person horror game dealing with sleep paralysis. You are lying in bed, unable to move, experiencing creepy phenomena and having to survive until morning from ghosts.

title: Who is the Defendant: Deliberately Rough
description: "Who is the Defendant" is a mystery genre visual novel. Players take on the role of a prosecutor, investigating a case involving "a game with rudimentary art published on STEAM."

title: Whisper of the House
description: What's happening in this seemingly peaceful town? Strange residents, bizarre incidents, and unexpected storylines! Please be sure to let go of all your human lifestyle preferences and strive to meet the special requests of your otherworldly employers. Decorate this house with peculiar furniture!

title: Why Don't They Laugh?
description: A first-person narrative horror game where you will get dangerously close to the secrets of the Kensington circus dynasty and discover what lies behind their famous shows' scenes.

title: Vorago
description: Welcome to the Oracle-Fields. You are AL-1, a droid tasked with assisting research across space stations on the edge of the galaxy. But now, the 'Time-Event' has changed something. Everyone has disappeared. Locate the others. Face the horrors of space. Solve puzzles. Find your way home.

title: Voodoom
description: Voodoom is a casual asymmetric horror game set in a sprawling, eerie mansion. Team up as voodoo dolls to explore, collect powerups, and seek revenge on the monster that cursed you. Or, lurk in the darkness as the giant monster, ready to strike and eliminate the dolls before they grow too powerful.

title: Wag
description: Survive the Worst Apocalypse Game in WAG, an action-packed open-world survival game. Battle with zombies, fight other survivors, and find refuge in the central church of the city, your last hope in a chaotic world.

title: WaggaSim
description: Take to the skies in the ultimate paragliding and speed-flying simulator. Experience lifelike physics, design or modify your own gear, and perfect your style: soaring, thermaling, acro, freestyle, and more. With soft-body wings that move like real fabric, the sky is no longer the limit!

title: Wait: The Patient
description: Wait: The Patient is a non-combat mystery horror game, that takes place in the 90s and follows the story of Dr. Alice Fincher. After a new patient arrives in the mental hospital she works in, strange events start to unfold.

title: Up With Doznik
description: A failed accountant finds himself on an unfamiliar ring. Rescued by a dwarf, they head for the castle, equipped with a mildly menacing stick, questionable potions, and a dream. Fight shapeshifting monsters, upgrade, die, repeat—and grow stronger each time.

title: Utility for the Soul
description: A miniature meditative puzzle experience based on the Lithuanian-American environment artist Aleksandra Kasuba’s concept of the Retreat House - a unique, utopian facility used by large corporations to rejuvenate their overworked employees.

title: Blood Sea
description: In this game, you transform into a blue-black bat engaged in a heart-pounding escape from an ancient brown castle.

title: League of Abyss
description: 《League of Abyss》It is a 2D top-down pixel style dungeon Roguelike, where players will play as a hero and defeat terrifying monsters in the abyss, clearing the abyss and saving the world!

title: Trifoil
description: Trifoil is a minimalist, cerebral line drawing puzzle game, that explores how lines can interact with themselves. It has multiple puzzle mechanics, secrets to discover and mysteries to solve.

title: Blackwoods
description: Alternate history Cold war FPS. Join the Blackwoods unit and unravel a conspiracy which threatens to end your resistance once and for all.

title: Virtual Dream
description: A simple game scene editor Players can place blocks You can customize the position rotation size You can modify the material on the block Can play local videos You can customize the color of the image Custom Sound Map size unlimited one plowing one harvest

title: Kill Kill Kill Kill
description: KILL KILL KILL KILL - Intense arena shooter featuring a space warrior annihilating invaders from the distant cosmos. You're the last line of defense against their domination. Destroy them with diverse weapons, tearing through hordes of enemies.

title: Format
description: Are you ready to take on the challenge and become the top scorer in this pixel battle?

title: Blubber
description: This game is a mechanically-styled flying hazard avoidance game

title: Incompatible Fusion Machine
description: A scene kid's misadventure

title: One Dreamy Night
description: One Dreamy Night is a traditional RPG game that takes inspiration from Yume Nikki to create a surreal world with oddities at every turn. There's things to find to increase your stats and skill set, along with wacky individuals to encounter. You'll get to the end as long as you look and explore.

title: The Aching Aversion: Blood Orange Dreams
description:
The Aching Aversion: Blood Orange Dreams is a Surreal RPG Maker Horror game about exploring Rahma's disturbing dreams.

Unlike many games of this type, progress in Blood Orange Dreams is earned through killing NPCs in your dreams.

Made for Dream Diary Jam 8, Blood Orange Dreams is the second game from the Aching Aversion series.

title: MuMuMu: Mist of Six Dreams
description: MuMuMu is a traditional Yume Nikki Fangame about exploring dream worlds.

title: Hickory Clock
description: You are Hickory, someone with a pocket watch. To entertain yourself, you may zone out and explore your own thoughts.

title: The Invisible Smoke Factory
description: Surreal point-and-click exploration game inspired by Yume Nikki. 100+ rooms, a few mostly optional puzzles, and minimal text. Meant to be unsettling. No jumpscares.

title: ZDoom Community Map Project II
description: ZDoom Community Map Project: Take II, abbreviated to ZDCMP2, is a single map for ZDoom designed by a large number of mappers. It is one of the largest levels ever made. Like the previous project, each mapper was assigned a set of dates to work on the map, each one continuing where the last mapper finished. It took over two years to build, with a final release on 25 May 2014. The map makes extensive use of ZDoom features, such as 3D floors (including swimmable water), and portals.

title: While (true)
description:
Ina is a young woman that refuses to leave her room. She instead escapes into a dream world of endless possibilities. Play as Ina, and discover the possibilities of infinite dreaming.

Created for the 2024 Dream Diary Jam 8.

title: INTER08JECT
description:
INTER08JECT is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame made with RPG Maker 2003.

Explore the dreams of Tomatsuki, a teenager who really likes tomatoes and cannot get out of their apartment building.

title: Debilitating Dream
description: Debilitating Dream is a Yume Nikki Fangame developed for Dream Diary Jam 8. The game is an attempt to create a traditional YN experience with a different style.

title: Somnilithe
description: Multiplayer Yume Nikki inspired game made for Dream Diary Jam 8, featuring characters from Yume Nikki and .flow.

title: The Dreams of Fritz
description:
Count to three, walk into your deepest dreams. The visions await.
Made for DDJ8, explore a dark dreamscape and perhaps you'll start to uncover what exactly went wrong.

title: Dreaming Network
description:
A traditional Yume Nikki fangame where you play as a robot stuck in an abandoned facility, left to wander through digital worlds.

Created for Dream Diary Jam 8

title: Layered
description: layered is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. The game stars Gatatsuki and Gakutsuki, who must collect Qualia, this game's version of effects.

title: Hangar 8
description:
Hangar 8 is a psychological horror set within the unsettling confines of a derelict space station. Brave the looping corridors, spot all ?? anomalies, collect key items, and escape the nightmare!

Blending anomaly spotting mechanics from games such as "The Exit 8" and "I'm on Observation Duty", with the liminal-space psychological horror of "The Backrooms", HANGAR 8 challenges both your memory and your sanity.

title: Capybara Fighters!
description: Capybara Fighters! is a 2D/3D hybrid beat-em up set in modern Tokyo. You play as the star capybara of a cafe, whose life is disrupted when the Yakuza abduct your friend. To rescue them, you'll battle through enemies, earn money, and ultimately secure a plane ticket to Brazil for the final battle.

title: Not A Banana: Capybara
description: Hello! Welcome to the wonderful world of capybara clicker! Here you will become a true friend of the capybaras, clicking on the screen and calling the cutest and sometimes special capybaras! Don't forget to keep clicking to attract even more capybaras to you!

title: Western Death
description: Western Death is a 2D roguelike set in the Wild West, combining RPG and fantasy elements.

title: SMOD: Outbreak
description:
I have been laid down in a pit of darknesses and the shadow of death. And thy anger has pressed down upon me; and all thy cares have come down upon me. And from this bed I cry out for the kindling of thy Light!

Outbreak might be best summed up as an add-on to the original SMOD that encourages the same frenzied action as it throws a generous number of hostiles at the player, especially zombies. Following its base, Outbreak's arsenal includes usual suspects like the G36 carbine, as well as less conventional ones such as a katana that gives the player a speed boost.

Outbreak started off in Summer 2007 as a small, personal mod by SMOD: Tactical forum member veteran_gamer. His hobby project was later released and was well received. As time went on, others like Useful, Jen4, and IneptGuard contributed work and ideas as well.

title: SMOD Troopers
description:
SMOD Troopers is a multiplayer version of SMOD 40a, made from scratch.

The game features the SMOD Money system, that is used to buy health or battery, that is NECESSARY to use the flashlight or night vision in some dark areas.

Money can be gained through killing enemies, finding it in crates or trying your luck at the base's casino's SLOT MACHINE.

title: Opossession
description:
Humanity has reached unparalleled heights of advancement, traversing the vast expanses of space and establishing settlements across the cosmos. With a staggering population of 400 quadrillion souls, our species has become ubiquitous throughout the universe. This era of evolution has heralded the emergence of novel technologies and occupations, among them the enigmatic profession of Mailmans.
These individuals navigate the expanse of the cosmos aboard spaceships reminiscent of delivery boxes, ferrying parcels and missives across the boundless reaches of space. Yet, amidst this sea of interstellar couriers, there exists a singular figure who stands apart.
A Mailman unlike any other, accompanied not by mere machinery, but by an unconventional companion—a pet opossum named BOB.

title: Escape Capyland
description:
An amazing, yet depressing place where your goal is to survive the night! You are stuck in your office till 6 AM, and all you can do is 'keep them away'.

Good luck in your shift!

title: The PTSD Mod
description:
The PTSD mod, It's weird. It's dumb, it's a guy who has an obsession with old punt and outdated memes.

PTSD mod let's you see the world from PTSD guy's eyes, experience memories, nightmares, memes and all sorts of stuff in this crazy world full of ptsd. Fight back the new punt leader and win back old punt!

title: The PTSD Mod 2
description: PTSD guy returns in this all new adventure, full with completely new levels, secrets, weapons and returning characters Experience weirdness to it's full extent, and maybe even discover something more sinister/serious in it all...

title: PTCS: A Post Traumatic Christmas Special
Whale Well
description: Whale Well is a short adventure game where you play as a duck. Collect and trade items while exploring a civilization in the belly of a great whale.

title: Final Fantasy XI: The Voracious Resurgence
description: Final Fantasy XI: The Voracious Resurgence is an episodic story series update to Final Fantasy XI that began release in 2020. Like add-ons previously released for the game, the story series is introduced as part of a regular version updates. Unlike those add-ons, The Voracious Resurgence does not require an additional purchase to access.

title: MetroRunner
description: in a post apocalyptic world where the inhabitants of bucharest have moved in the metrosystem you set out on a journey to escape to the surface

title: Plumo On The Farm
description: Series of learning activities, using a range of multimedia tools, help children develop basic cognitive skills (observing, classifying, finding relationships, etc.) through play

title: Deltarune - Spamton Restitched
description: a fan-made sequel to the Spamton Neo fight.

title: Aquaball
description: Experience a magnificent underwater world of sunken ships and pirate booty in Aquaball, a visually stimulating and addictive new Arkanoid adventure. As you dive into 140 exotic levels, you'll be challenged to keep one or more balls in play as you shatter brilliantly animated seashells, hit daggers that slice across the screen and enter portals that transport your ball into protected treasure troves.

title: Grapple Up!
description: Grapple Up is a game inspired by other one-level, unforgiving platformers such as Only Up, Chained Together, Getting Over It and Sisyphus, but with a grappling hook! Who doesn't love a grappling hook?

title: Animal Farmland
description: A casual simulation management idle game. Players can click to place crops and buildings, earn coins, unlock a wealth of animals and buildings, and expand the farm

title: The Three Kingdoms of Destiny
description: The Three Kingdoms of Destiny is a turn-based strategy simulation game, the opening has four different characteristics of the monarch representing 4 countries for players to choose, there are as many as 100 controllable generals, rich transfer system and rich skills of generals,

title: Zone 13
description: Find anomalies, escape the endless loop, and uncover dark secrets of Zone 13.

title: 101 Cats in Brazil
description: Find and discover 101 cute cats hidden throughout the Brazil landscape in this hand-drawn hidden object game. Can you find them all?

title: A Beaver's Tale
description: A cozy, adventure, builder game. Live out the life of Buckey the Beaver: go swimming in the river, build dams, and find treasures! In story mode, learn to protect your beaver kits and become a master builder. Fully customize this colorful and cozy world in builder mode.

title: Abomin-Agency!
description: Abomin-Agency! is a party game for 3 to 8 players. Players compete to design the 'best monster for the job' for the clients of Dr. Frankenstein's Super Fantastical Monster Factory. Design & pitch your creation to your fellow players to win the big pay day!

title: Abrasion
description: Abrasion is a short exploration-focused horror game set inside an ancient megastructure.

title: A Bumpy Ride
description: Take a jaunt into the world of A Bumpy Ride, a casual train-driving and exploration game! Inspired by railroading of the 19th century with a whimsical spin, you'll adventure around the open frontier in your trusty little train, picking up passengers and freight.

title: Abysmal Gateway
description: Abysmal Gateway is an Open World Dark Fantasy action-RPG with fast-paced combat. Venture into the depths and the forsaken realms of the abyss. Will you emerge victorious, or be consumed by the darkness? This journey is not for the faint of heart!

title: AbyssalRestaurant
description: You will play as a tavern owner in a fantasy world, entertaining guests, shopping at the market, cooking yourself, fully customizing your own delicious (and possibly peculiar) recipes, and promoting your shop and dishes to more friends~ (with lots of physics in the game)

title: Abyss Looters
description: Abyss Looters is a cooperative extraction dungeon crawler game, for 1-4 players. Explore Abyss dungeons with friends, avoid traps and dangerous monsters, collect artifacts, build your own adventure guild!

title: Dashoot: Abya's Adventure
description: Shoot to move in a hardcore precision platformer. As ABYA, a robot from ruins, use your floating cannon to trigger mechanisms, flip platforms, and launch through a post-human world guided by AI Deus. Every shot counts; one mistake resets. Uncover the truth.

title: Academy Love Saga: Tennis Angels
description: Become a coach for the tennis club in a prestigious sports academy with all members being hot chicks, but they all hate you. What to do now? Conquer them all, of course!!! Prepare yourself for heated tennis matches with dynamic gameplay and powerful abilities. Prove your skills and win their hearts.

title: Academy Love Saga: Tennis Angels EX
description: Become the coach of a prestigious sports academy's tennis club, filled with stunning girls who all dislike you. How will you handle it? Win them over, of course! Prepare for intense tennis matches with dynamic gameplay and powerful abilities. Prove your skills and earn their bodies.

title: Access: EnTree
description: A social-sim RPG where players develop a small town to make it more accessible and inclusive for residents with disabilities. With elements of community building, strategy, and interactive storytelling, players learn to make decisions that affect the game world and its inhabitants!

title: Accident Liquidator
description: Accident Liquidator is an exciting 3D arcade action-adventure game that throws you into situations where each day presents new challenges necessary for survival.

title: Push & Plunder
description: An Arcade game where you fire coins at evil statues that hurt you if they fall off the bottom of the board. Complete Challenges, unlock classes, perks, and equipment for your next attempts. Earn Gems & Coins in runs to buy permanent upgrades and unlocks. Can you survive 'til the end?

title: Megis Adventure
description: "Megis Adventure" is a role - playing, open world pixel game. You find yourself on an isolated, faraway island and starts an adventure to overcome quests, dungeons, monsters and foes – all in hope to help the residents of "Megis Island"

title: MultiHero
description:
MultiHero is a 2D fighter puzzle platformer inspired by Super Smash Bros, featuring various characters from popular game franchises, such as Street Fighter (Ryu), Super Mario Bros. (Mario), Spiderman, Batman, etc.

The game features two modes: Adventure mode and VS mode. Adventure mode is a 2D combat platformer game mode with 50 levels which gets progressively harder, even featuring some sort of puzzle and precision platforming at later levels. VS mode consists of 4 game modes: death match, capture the flag, keep the flag, and hit the target, all based on the platform fighting format from Super Smash Bros. Playable characters as well as levels in adventure mode and vs mode are unlockable by progressing through adventure mode. The game supports single player as well as multiplayer (up to 4 player) for all of its game modes.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic
description:
Enter the abandoned workshop of Murray’s Costume Manor and unravel the mystery left behind by the reclusive inventor, Edwin Murray. In Five Nights at Freddy’s: Secret of the Mimic, you’ll step into a world where every dark corner holds a secret and every flicker of light hints at an ever-present threat. The Mimic, a prototype endoskeleton, can adapt to any costume and become any character, including what you fear most. Armed with only your wits, a few gadgets, and a heavily redacted corporate briefing, you’ll attempt to retrieve Fazbear’s prized prototype technology while grappling with cryptic clues and a relentless shadow determined to dispatch all unwanted company.

Prepare for heart-pounding thrills as you explore the labyrinth of the deserted Costume Manor, discovering remnants of Edwin’s unfinished work and eluding the monster he’s created. Experience Five Nights at Freddy’s: Secret of the Mimic, and survive the mystery and madness. Five Night’s at Freddy’s: Secret of the Mimic will be available on June 13th, 2025.

Disclaimer: Fazbear Entertainment is not responsible for whatever you awaken in the dark.
