As for the story, find out yourself :)...

title: Child of Vision
description: A short Yume Nikki-style RPG Maker game.

title: Fart Killer
description: "Fart Killer" is a short trash comedy game mixed with cult horror from the 80s. With totally absurd and meaningless scenes. Don't expect a super Hollywood production... It's much better than that!

title: We Are Not Alone: Contact
description: "We Are Not Alone - Contact" is a reimagining of the first game. Inspired by alien horror films from the 80s, bringing comical horror and at the same time scary and bloody.

title: He is Coming
description: He Is Coming is a roguelite auto battler where you have to collect and combine powerful items in order to defeat the demon king and his minions. Upgrade your weapon, discover hidden treasures and survive, because whether you're prepared or not, he is coming!

title: Descenders Next
description: Grab your board and master the mountain! Descenders Next is the ultimate extreme sports game, with sprawling snowy peaks, winding dirt tracks, and tons of parks to conquer. Will you and your friends become the Next Ultimate Descenders?

title: The Good People
description: A narration-focused interactive fiction about conversation and exploration of a haunted landscape

title: Tricks of Light in the Forest
description: "Tricks of light in the forest is a choice-based text adventure with light puzzles, a narrative walking simulator through a deep interactive environment, and a hopeful and unsettling post global-warming near-future story."

title: Church Simulator
description: Manage your own church. Perform baptisms, hear confessions, collect donations, oversee weddings and funerals, sell souvenirs, and customize your church. Manage the church’s economy and work to expand your church.

title: Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden - Wanderer Set DLC
description: Defend yourself from the supernatural and slash back against darkness with the Wanderer Set DLC. This gear set includes the Wanderer outfit and Cortador and Ascua, fabled weapons from a long lost, noted banisher.

title: Setteeh
description: Setteeh - is a horror game created based on real stories of Yakutia residents. Each episode of the game tells a new story.

title: Coin Factory
description: Welcome to Coin Factory. Build your first coin maker factory and explore the different synergies and combinations. Level up your buildings and become the ultimate money maker. Strategize and plan ahead. Unlock new buildings and compete in the global leaderboard!

title: 3x3
description: 3x3 is a 29-level megawad that came to life as a community project hosted by MFG38. Participating mappers were given a week to make up to 2 maps each while only allowed to use 3 flats, 3 textures and 3 enemy types. (A select few textures/flats were excluded from the limit.)

title: Skibidi Toilet Hero: Sex Mod
description:
This is DLC Created for those who are ready to test themselves and their skill to the limit.
New Difficulty Level
Level Rebalance
New Enemies
New Final Boss
BDSM Costumes for toilets!

title: 3x3: Take Two
description: 3x3: Take Two is the spiritual sequel to the 3x3 community project, hosted by MFG38. The set contains 30 maps from 22 different authors, using only 3 flats, 3 wall textures and 3 enemy types per map. Maps were sorted *roughly* by difficulty this time around to make the final mapset more friendly for continuous play.

title: BlueAge
description: BlueAge is a brand new 32 map limit removing megawad made by Skronkidonk and @DCGRetrowave.This megawad was made in 1 1/2 years on and off & was tested on DSDADoom.Pistol start was made in mind and is designed for UV, but lower difficulties are implemented as well.

title: Confinement Community Project
description: The Confinement Community project was created with one objective in mind. Create a map of any size between 1024x1024 and 2048x2048. Nineteen talented mappers came together over an extended period of time to produce Twenty Three beautifully detailed maps, built into a confined space.

title: Crispy Chicken Speedmap Session 02
description: The second installment of a speedmapping event taking place in Clippy's discord server. The wonderful recolours by @Jimmy² from his Zoon-tech subset of Zoon-tex were used and some things were painted by mappers to fit resulting in 12 total maps.

title: Sawmill
description: Quest games, such as "Sawmill", offer an engaging immersion into a world of puzzles and mysteries. One of the most exciting aspects of these games is the ability to play both solo and in pairs, which makes the gameplay even more interesting and diverse.

title: First Blood
description: A set of 14 Boom-compatible maps designed for pistolstart. The difficulty starts off like Episode 1 of Doom 1, then ramps up to some Plutonia / late TNT difficulty near the end.

title: Habitat Complex
description:
Welcome to the complex! Inspired by the [adjective] map of the [adjective] WAD!
Habitat was always a fascinating map with some [adjective] ideas that never reached their full potential. This project started as a joke, but has nowballed into something more.

title: Maps 4Matt
description: 7 maps created for Matt Tropiano's birthday in 2015.

title: Micro Plutonia
description: 3 very much Plutonia-inspired maps

title: Nostalgic Entropy: Neo Retro
description: Welcome to the Neon Circles of Hell! Nostalgic Entropy: Neo-Retro is a large non-linear Vaporwave map where the architecture twists and turns into familiar structures of a future that wasn't meant to be. Experience a variety of combat scenarios, from classic coincidental encounters to gimmicky mini-game-like ones.

title: Star Cycle
description: Star Cycle is a Limit-removing set of 11 short, punchy maps which take 2-3 minutes each to beat.

title: The Dime Birthday Level Collection
description:
Twelve levels designed for the 25th birthday of Doom speedrunner Dime! The restrictions given to the designers were:
- Boom compatibility (a.k.a. PrBoom+ -complevel 9) - No green or blue armor - Maximum 75 monsters - In the style of scythe map 22-24 gameplay (texture use is up to [one]self) - Must [have] a BFG, but only a maximum of 200 cells in the map INCLUDING BFG pickup.

title: Shattered Palace
description: In your journey to find a way back to Parthoris, you've come across a desolate palace. In hopes of finding a way out, you step through the portal at the entrance.

title: Xexis
description: Hell-themed floating fortress of pain, anguish, and other not-so-friendly things.

title: Doomworld Roulette: Session 1
description: The first in a series of exercises that dares participants to break away from the trends and ideas typical in day-to-day Dooming. The challenge? Create a map that best depicts a theme generated by jmickle66666666's level theme generator. Themes were created, numbered and then hidden from participants, who were made to select a number at random in order to be assigned a theme. The event ran for just under two weeks, totalling 12 maps. These maps are designed to be played from pistol start.

title: Doomworld Roulette: Session 2
description: The second in a series of exercises that dares participants to break away from the trends and ideas typical in day-to-day Dooming. The challenge? Create a map that best depicts a theme generated by jmickle66666666's level theme generator. Themes were created, numbered and then hidden from participants, who were made to select a number at random in order to be assigned a theme. The event ran for just under two weeks, totalling 11 maps. These maps are designed to be played from pistol start.

title: Verse Hopper
description: Verse Hopper is a Gzdoom-centered community project. The goal is to create high quality maps with a selected set of custom textures and monsters.

title: Maps 4TMD
description: 8 maps created for TMD's birthday in 2015.

title: Chotex Jam
description: Mapping jam event based on a custom texture set created by Chris Holden: nine small to medium-sized levels including a start map. It comes with a skybox and a few new models.

title: Secrets of the Dark: Temple of Night
description: Your friend is a journalist who is staying in a seemingly quiet desert town. After getting involved with a story involving the dark forces, he is kidnapped by three dark priests! Now they are getting ready to sacrifice him to provide the Demon of Darkness with limitless power, and it's up to you to stop them! Save your friend in Secrets of the Dark: Temple of Night, a challenging Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game!

title: It Goes Away in the End
description: This map was cre﻿ated as experiment to learn about eternity engine and mapping by Misty.

title: Debrecen
description: A city themed map, inspired by the hometown of HUNdebLeonidasX

title: Liberate 1024
description: Liberate 1024 is a 7 map 1024 set for doom2, it covers various different themes and every map is designed with pistol start in mind.

title: Ludicrium
description: An experimental set of slaughtermaps by antares031 who normally does not make slaughtermaps. They vow to never make slaughtermaps again.

title: Neon Wars
description: Neon Wars is an arcade game where vivid graphics, great music and exciting game play combine to create an amazingly new yet classic experience for the next generation of players. It's a simple game of collecting stars and staying one step ahead of the action. Plus there's access to powerful "special" weapons that even the odds with massive pyrotechnic special effects. The easy controls will delight the young at heart, but the action on higher difficulty levels is sure to create intense competition for the highest score.

title: Secret Thursday
description:
Every four years, there is a leap year...
And if leap day falls on a Thursday...

Then that day is...

Secret Thursday.

title: Temple Run: Legends
description:
Temple Run: Legends is the first level-based runner within the Temple Run family and features all-new gameplay modes, challenges, and rewards.

Run, swim, and hop on crocodile heads while crossing rivers to achieve a 3-star rating on hundreds of levels. Explore and conquer the saga map and learn the secrets of the world of Aperion. Experience the different climates, inhabitants and challenges of this new land as you run from level to level with a wide cast of characters!

title: Xiyan
description:
The universe is too big and too old.
The Milky Way is just one of the hundreds of billions of galaxies in the universe, the sun is just one of the hundreds of billions of stars in the Milky Way, and the earth is just a speck of dust in the solar system.
Can anyone notice the tiny and short-lived lives that are wandering, crying, enduring, struggling, above that dust?
They are us, the last children of the earth...
- Xi, the descendant of the ancient god of the Arctic Ocean,
- Yan, the blue servant of the Old World,
- Xi, the man-made ancient god of the Pacific Ocean,
- Yan, the red servant of the New World.
All that we do, is it to continue to survive, or to end the pain?
Or, just to prove our existence...

title: The Train Station
description: The Train Station is a short horror game developed by one person. Play as a stationmaster on a foggy night in 1940s England. Carry out essential tasks such as collecting lost luggage and cleaning toilets, but remember to attend the ticket booth when you hear the bell.

title: Nadir: Giant Hunter
description:
Nadir: Giant Hunter is a fast paced action game.

At the Zenith, abyssal creatures awakens and try to climb the Rift. With your grapple, you can swing in the Rift and accomplish your mission : eliminate the creatures before they can reach surface. To do so, swing towards them, get close enough, and slash them in a single shot !

title: Frozen Hearts
description:
Sophie has been frozen inside a crystal for two centuries. When the ice thaws, she wakes up in an unfamiliar world. Everything is frozen, including the people of the palace in which she finds herself. When she makes her way to the nearby village, people’s shocked reactions surprise her too - they call her a Hero. Legend says she sacrificed herself two centuries ago to end a terrible war, freezing the leaders of both factions along with the rest of the world.

But is that tale all there is to the story?

What roles did Richard the Ice King and Ivan the Rebel Leader really play in Sophie’s life?

What will they do now that they have escaped their icy prison too?

Can Sophie reverse the permanent winter, or will the world be thrown into a final, destructive conflict that freezes the future forever?

title: Project Kyzen
description:
Project Kyzen is a casual, multiplayer game in which players will have the choice to compete against each other in several different mini-games. Users can craft
unique avatars and explore the Kyzen universe.

Project Kyzen will be developed in phases throughout its lifetime in which players will be able to provide feedback to create the ultimate immersive experience in gaming.

title: MareScape
description: MareScape is a challenging 2D platformer that will make you question your sanity! Navigate through unforgiving obstacles, fight your muscle memory, and try not to succumb to raging frustration. Will you escape the nightmare?

title: Julia Was Alone
description:
Julia is a 19 year old horror fan who dreams of becoming a novelist. Her mom went to the store and now she'll have to stay alone for about an hour. Meanwhile, a deranged maniac escaped from the local asylum and now he's heading to Julia's neighborhood. What could possibly go wrong?

This is chapter 1, with future chapter to come.

title: 007: Licence to Spell Doom
description:
007: Licence to Spell Doom is a nine-level Ultimate Doom mapset for ZDoom by Stephen Clark (The Ultimate DooMer). It was released on December 24, 2002.

The player takes on the role of '007', a "Special Secret Service" agent (stated to be the protagonist of Stephen Clark's previous WADs, Fragport and Operation: Lightning). 007's mission is to assault the facilities of a terrorist organization called MISSILE, who are allied with the forces of Hell.

title: Creatures of Ava: Deluxe Edition
description: Creatures of Ava: Deluxe Edition includes a set of trinkets to hang on your backpack. The bundle also consists of the original soundtrack and artbook.

title: Fashion Store Simulator
description: Step into the glamorous world of fashion retail with Fashion Store Simulator, the ultimate 3D fashion store management experience! As the owner of a burgeoning fashion boutique, you'll have the opportunity to turn your store into the go-to destination for style-conscious shoppers.

title: Tiny Whaley 2
description:
Embark on an exciting 2D adventure under the ocean!
In this puzzle platformer game, where we manage a magical and unusual whale,
we not only overcome obstacles by jumping,
but also create our own path by positioning your dead bodies at the right points.
In this adventure you have to prove not only your reflexes and speed but also your strategic and mind skills.
Determine your own strategy, Try to finish the level as fast as possible!

title: Mangavania 2
description: Old school action platformer game with pixel art graphics.

title: Isolation Instinct: Farming, Craft, Survival
description: Show your ability to survive! Be a part of a wild world with unlimited borders!

title: ArkCraft: The Rebirth of the World
description: In this open-world crafting and building game, you explore an ancient world full of dangers and secrets. Collect animals and plants, build bases and master the craft as you build your ark and save civilization from destruction by the flood and then rebuild it.

title: Liminalcore
description: Explore and admire while navigate through eerie, surreal environments inspired by the Backrooms lore. Explore this uncanny world lost in time and get lost in the otherworldly architecture in a world where reality bends and your sanity is tested.

title: Brutalist Golf
description: Post Industrial Horror (Golf)

title: Meowmentum
description: Run, young Meowcolyte - finish the elders' speed trials and prove yourself worthy of wielding Meowmentum! Harness your paw-kour skills, dash through magic orbs, and race against the world!

title: Dodge 2
description: Bullet hell with the mouse.

title: Rock Digger
description: Be a rock-digging rock star! Dig for ressources and alien technologies. Upgrade your body and powers. Explore alien worlds. Find numerous secrets. Reach the core. Become a rock god.

title: Ani
description: Liam wakes up alone after surgery. He walks around the facility and sees what happened while he was unconscious.

title: Gaming Raiding
description: Third-person shooter games

title: Copper
description: COPPER brings you to a dystopian, industrial world. With tight third-person shooting controls and demanding 3D Bullet Hell mechanics. Push your reflexes and spacial awareness to the limit as you face a rogue machine in the heart of a long lost cave.

title: Country Tales 2: New Frontiers - Collector's Edition
description: Join the new sheriff in town, forge strong friendships and explore the Wild West in this fun and dynamic time management strategy game! Enjoy in dozens of unique levels, bonus levels, medals and collectables; build, upgrade, trade, collect, clear the road, explore and much more...

title: Sarab 2: Thalj Mountains
description: Sarab 2: Thalj Mountains is a JRPG-styled game which focuses on story-telling, exploration and turn-based battling. Each main character has its own mysterious story. Furthermore, the game has a unique atmosphere which absolutely makes it a different experience in comparison to other JRPG games.

title: Undergoes
description: Undergoes is a stylized survival horror game where players navigate a drill ship through procedurally generated mines, gather resources, craft tools, and build bases while fending off dangerous enemies.

title: Stray Cats in Cozy Town: Night Lights
description: Who knew that Cozy Town had such a great nightlife? It appears that some strays only venture out at night! All proceeds that Devcats and Travellin Cats will receive from this DLC will go to the Humane Society, so you’ll be having fun while making a real difference in the lives of stray cats. Explore the nighttime streets and alleys of Cozy Town to find and help the nocturnal strays!

title: Marble Hill
description: Marble Hill is a new 20-level episode megawad for Doom 2 designed for limit removing source ports (complevel 2) made by the various members of Doomer Boards, led by Matador. The theme is loosely based on the aesthetic of the Marble Zone levels from Sonic the Hedgehog. These maps tend towards ancient temples/structures and feature limestone, lava, overgrown vegetation and purple rocks.

title: Grave Space
description: Pilot through 10 progressive levels in this SNES style retro side scroller/bullet hell.

title: PhobLack
description: "I'm here to stay. But if I don't assert my presence, no one will notice me." PhobLack is a horror adventure game in which you explore a haunted ruin. In a dark and enclosed mansion, restore the ability to communicate with the outside world in order to call for rescue.

title: Rogue Tanks
description: Blast through random levels of enemies with or against up to 3 of your friends in this action roguelike top-down shooter! Travel from the desert to the enemy base and...into space!? Upgrade with quicker firing, bouncing bullets, and more. Defeat huge bosses to unlock more tank classes!

title: Jinko
description: Jinko is a physics-based musical arcade game where balls fall to the rhythm, and your job is to keep them up! Fight against gravity and time across a variety of unique songs and levels, or challenge yourself in the arcade mode to see how your best score stacks up on the global leaderboard.

title: Robot Female Hero Remastered
description: The evil SON has taken over the MULTITOWER and attacked the people of Apann with his army of CORRUPTED ROBOTS! And only Serena Robo, the Defender of Apann, and her new friends can save the day and stop the SON's evil plans! Many twists are along the way in: ROBOT FEMALE HERO REMASTERED!

title: I Wanna Fuck My Mom's Best Friend
description: Naoki has long harbored feelings for Shiori, his mother’s best friend, who helped raise him. Now an adult, his view of her has shifted from maternal to romantic and sexual. When his mother leaves for a work trip and asks Shiori to stay with him, the boundaries between familial familiarity and romantic tension begin to blur. Naoki wonders if his feelings may finally be reciprocated.

title: Fantasmagorie
description: It’s simple enough to make the puppets move–that’s not what makes them special. You see, when children watch our shows, they believe what they’re seeing is real. To them, the puppets are alive.

title: NTR Loop
description: This story is about Syrius and his girlfriend, Arlene, who are sent back in time to relieve their first adventure. An offended and bored Witch will immensely enjoy corrupting this love story.

title: NoLimits 2: Vekoma MK1101
description: This add-on contains an additional coaster style: The Vekoma MK1101. It is a modern and popular coaster type with a sleek design.

title: Golfing In Aether: Cauldron
description: The fifth free expansion to Golfing in Aether, adding several new levels and new hat customizations.

title: Public Enemy
description: Stealth and rebellion in an absurd totalitarian government.

title: The Ripper Wash
description:
You are Mia, a woman who recently moved to another city. You worked in a restaurant as a waitress, but since the place was far away you decided to change it to one of serving people and calls in a laundromat on the night shift.

Time goes by and the atmosphere becomes more tense, you read a newspaper about the 1993 murderer, "The Ripper Wash", who is thirsty for the blood of a new victim. It also says that in one door of your premises there are all the things about him and his murders...

title: LakeLady
description: After his girlfriend died in a flood, the surgeon Salvio, in search of the truth behind his missing daughter, enters the "Ward No. 9" of Hongqiang Hospital, shrouded in the legend of the LakeLady.

title: Savior's Hand
description: Save the underworld occupied by robots with your own hands.

title: Modern Fear
description: A horror game and walking simulator

title: Ninja Rift
description: Embark on an epic journey in Ninja Rift, an immersive RPG where you create and customize your own ninja. Level up your skills, master powerful techniques, and join forces with clans and crews to dominate the battlefield. Challenge other ninjas in intense battles, prove your prowess, and rise to become the ultimate ninja warrior. In Ninja Rift, the path to greatness is paved with strategy, skill, and unwavering determination. Will you conquer the rift and claim your place as the best ninja of all? Join now and begin your adventure!

title: Bad Credit? No Problem!
description: Step into the shoes of a title loan agent for 14 days. Make tough decisions and uncover stories in a world where every choice matters.

title: Freudian Slipgate
description: You are playing Quake, you walk into the Slipgate only to find out it's Freudian, suddenly, you are in Doom.. #doomtwid realm, you have angered the #doomtwid gods and they throw you into the random maps for invading their privileges on internet.

title: Freudian Slipgate 2
description:
Taking place after the events of the first Freudian Slipgate, our tale follows the eponymous Guy of Doom as he struggles to reconcile with what transpired over the course of those twenty-two maps of Oedipally-charged madness.
Freudian Slipgate 2 is a 'classic' 32 map megawad meant to be a sendoff to the good ol` Boom, as we approach the new age of MBF21 and the fancy gzdoom indie games.

title: Loathsome Cleft
description: A 7-hour speed map for Obsidian's birthday, mapped entirely on the 32-grid (aside from thing placement) which uses the STONGARG gargoyle patch from Doom, the brown rocks from Quake and a squashed (both vertically and into the palette) version of the second hell sky from Doom 3. You start in a little cave and work your way round to the exit on the other side of little valley.

title: Rented Nightmare
description: Having a girlfriend who lives very far away is a challenge. After our car breaks down, we have to take a series of buses with many transfers to see her. Since the buses don't run at night, halfway through the trip we rent a cool looking trailer at a trailer park. Now we just need to survive the night...

title: Antonball
description:
Underground ping pong with an athletic twist!

After a long night on the town, Anton's struggling to find his way back home. You'll have to help Anton out by using your balls to break the bricks!

You'll also run into pesky Ballbusters during your adventure together. Get rid of them by smacking them with your balls, or hitting them from behind!

title: Punch Ball Antonball
description:
Punch Ball Antonball (later referred to as Punch Ball Antonball Classic) is a platforming video game developed and published by Summitsphere and released on Itch.io. It is the second game in the Anton series. The game is a noticeable shift in gameplay style, resembling the Hudson Soft-developed PC game Punch Ball Mario Bros.

Due to the game's poor quality, Punch Ball Antonball was delisted from Itch.io in December 2021.

The gameplay of Punch Ball Antonball was later iterated on in Antonball Deluxe under an identically-named mode.

title: Hat Kid Steals the Declaration of Independence 3: Kingslayer
Sonic and the Moon Facility
description:
Sonic and The Moon Facility is a 2D Sonic fangame that follows Sonic and Tails on an adventure to discover the secrets of a mysteriously reactivated research facility.

This build includes all the levels in the game, however only SONIC can complete the main campaign of the game. Debug tools will unlock once you beat the game, or if you know how to access them already.

title: Annalynn '16
description: Annalynn is back at it once again! As her day at work in the mines is about to come to a close, Annalynn discovers a hidden crevasse from an otherwise well-known cave. With the allure of adventure too strong to resist, she crawls through the narrow passageway and discovers an underground utopia of many treasures, but also many dangers! Now, in hot pursuit by the Venom Brigade (Randy, Handy, Candy, and Mike) and their unexpected arachnid ally (Gil), Annalynn must defend herself with the mystical Blinding Rubies as she explores this mysterious cave for its many riches!

title: The Super Mario Bros. Movie Demastered
description: Experience and play through the Super Mario Bros Movie in an all new epic way through an action packed retro 2D Platformer with over 80 levels, 6 playable characters, 90 Missions, Multiplayer and a rewritten story!

title: Digimon Card Game Tutorial App
description:
A tutorial app that lets you experience the trading card game "Digimon Card Game" to be released in 2020! Enjoy Digimon Card Game on your smartphone or tablet! Learn how to play Digimon Card Game! Equipped with "Tutorial Mode" to understand the basic rules and "Free Battle Mode" to actually play! Play with 3 different start decks!
You can enjoy a free battle using the half deck of the 3 start deck! Experience the fun of Digimon Card Game with Digimon Teaching App!

title: Nitro Express
description: Nitro Express is a 2D side-view gun action game with pixel-art graphics. The game utilizes a 360° free aiming system. You play as a member of the "Atypical Vehicle Disposal Squad" division of the Nitro City police force, tasked with destroying a variety autonomous mechanical drones known as "Companions," which have gone rogue and are wreaking havoc throughout the city.

title: Pokémon Royal
description: Return to the Galar region in an adventure that rewrites the story of Pokémon Sword and Shield, with new events that enhance it and new faces to meet. Enjoy a beautiful pixel art style, along with all the quality-of-life improvements from the newer generations and every Pokémon available to date.

title: Legacy of Rust
description: Created in collaboration by id Software, Nightdive Studios, and MachineGames, Legacy of Rust is the newest episode for DOOM, and the first official episode since DOOM II to feature new demons and weapons. This 16-map Episode is broken up into two 8 map sections: The Vulcan Abyss and Counterfeit Eden.

title: Fairy Tail: Dungeons
description: Fairy Tail: Dungeons is a deck-building rogue-lite featuring characters from the Fairy Tail series. Collect Magic Cards based on moves from the series to build your own unique deck and take down powerful monsters as you head for the dungeon depths!

title: Doom + Doom II
description: Developed by id Software, and originally released in 1993, DOOM pioneered and popularized the first-person shooter, setting a standard for all FPS games. The critically acclaimed sequel, DOOM II, followed in 1994. Now the definitive, newly enhanced versions of DOOM + DOOM II are available as a combined product.

title: Fairy Tail: Beach Volleyball Havoc
description: The cast of Fairy Tail is ready to bring mayhem to the summertime beaches! Unleash over-the-top magic to BLAST that volleyball!

title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime: Isekai Chronicles: Digital Deluxe Edition
description: The Digital Deluxe Edition includes That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles main game, Bonus Side Quest Collection: Shopping, DLC 1, DLC 2, DLC 3, and Season Pass Bonus Content: Bonus Side Quest Collection: Remembering Shizu.

title: The Super Robot Bros
description: Learn about this inspiring story of hope and the power of effort to revive a lost world. Join ECHO on their journey to discover if the Earth can be saved and if humanity can return home.

title: Parking Masters
description: Face the ultimate test of your parking skills!

title: Thief Puzzle
description: Steal your way to the top and become the king of thieves!

title: Parking Jam
description: Navigate through an overfilled parking lot and move cars out of the way to help them all escape!

title: Love Elysium: Secret of the Goddess - Ultimate Edition
Bobby Six Seven: Time Traveling Detective
description: A side-scrolling action platformer for the Nintendo Entertainment system. Travel through time in a humorous police adventure. Developed by calgames.

title: Medieval Fantasy: Jigsaw Puzzle
description: A magical jigsaw puzzle that will immerse you in the atmosphere of medieval fantasy.

title: Medieval Fantasy: Jigsaw Puzzle - Fantastic Beasts
Medieval Fantasy: Jigsaw Puzzle - Great Warriors
Shadowblade Knight Symphony
description: Embrace the darkness, bend reality, and carve your legend in shadowblade knight symphony.

title: Ring Sculptors
description: A gripping text-based narrative adventure set in a dystopian future where your choices truly matter.

title: Sky Airplane Racer: Flight & Fight Simulator
description: Welcome to the exciting world of air plane racing, where speed and strategy are everything!

title: CH Retro Episode
description: The summer of 2001 brought you CH Retro. A level filled to the rim with all that good John Romero episode 1 stuff we all know and love!

title: Deadly Standards
description: A community made Episode 1 replacement for Ultimate Doom. The only limit given was to use the stock IWAD resources (graphics, sounds). The exception being a new midi/soundtrack.

title: Deadly Standards 2
description: A community made Episode 2 replacement for Ultimate Doom, sequel of the Deadly Standards. Again, the only limitation is to create a map for Doom using only the stock assets (graphics, sounds, etc.), with the only expection of new midi soundtrack.

title: Tremor: Part I - Genesis
description: Tremor is a medium-sized techbase map, fairly open-plan but cramped in some areas.

title: Deadly Standards 3
description: A community made Episode 3 replacement for Ultimate Doom, sequel of the highly acclaimed Deadly Standards episodes. This time things gets a little change from the previous two installments with a new sky, a black void patch, a reskin of the original monsters and a theme of a frightening horrors that are hiding in the depths of a mysterious void world....

title: Deadly Standards 4
description: A community made Episode 4 replacement for Ultimate Doom, sequel of the highly acclaimed and cacoward runner-up Deadly Standards episodic series. This time the classic stock assets theme got a rough deviation to more new assets, taken mostly from Alpha Doom and Romero dump of unused assets, as well as some other sources like Doomer Boards: Earth Ends and Ghostbusters Doom. Fight a terrifying world of a hell (on Earth?) that you never experienced before! Behold, the horrors of bureaucracy in a corporate world where anonymous towns are dominated by brutalism!

title: Phobos Revisited
description: Phobos Revisited is a nine-level episode replacement for The Ultimate Doom, created by Rex Claussen and released on September 10, 2004. It replaces the entire first episode and its levels are re-imagined versions of the original levels. Notably, all the levels remain (mostly) faithful to the geometry and pathing of the original levels.

title: Misao: 2024 HD Remaster
description: Misao: Definitive Edition was released back in October 2017, and now it's about to be updated to Misao - 2024 HD Remaster at midnight on August 15, 2024! Misao - 2024 HD Remaster doesn't only add HD graphics and update the overall presentation, but also adds new features that make exploring stages all the more enjoyable, giving the game a new playfeel.

title: Temple of Chaos 2: Warped Reality
description: Temple of Chaos 2 - Warped Reality is a single-level PWAD for Doom II with the ZDoom source port. It was designed by Melissa McGee (Agent Spork) and uses their own music track, "Nocturnal Bise".

title: Clock Out At 2
description: Clock Out at 2 is a roguelite visual novel in which you have to survive inside the corporate machine known as the "workplace". Eat fast food. Drink lots of espressos. Experience microaggressions. Pray they don't fire you.

title: Untitled RPG from WolfEye Studios
description: A first-person action RPG that's set in an alternate America in the 1900s. The game will be set near or in the Colorado area and conjure a "steampunk 1900s" aesthetic rather than pull from traditional Western tropes.

title: No Rest for the Living
description: A remastered version of the No Rest for the Living made in the KEX Engine, community-published mod support, original midi soundtrack or the modern IDKFA version by Andrew Hulshult, improved performance with multithreaded rendering, BOOM source compatibility, accessibility options and translated into eight new languages.

title: Super Antonio
description: Super Antonio is a difficult 3D platformer with satisfying movement. Climb to the top while enduring a punishing experience.

title: Cupig's Key Collectathon
description: Cupig's Key Collectathon is a little puzzle game where a pig collects keys to open treasure chests. Levels have increasingly difficult solutions. The game measures speed per level bases, the player should get high scores in time.

title: Wuhu Island Explorer
description: Roam around freely in Wuhu Island without any restrictions.

title: Late Homework
description: Retrieve your forgotten class assignments from school while avoiding the creature known to haunt it at night.

title: Idle Dyson Swarm
description: Manage a solar empire, produce bots which will make solar panels for you. Send your panels to the sun to generate energy and sell that energy to make money which you can spend on even more bots!

title: Bang Bang Barrage
description: Survive the treacherous sea in this quirky top-down roguelike shooter! Play solo or team up and fight off Cthulhu's minions. Master a unique recoil-based mechanic to blast enemies and chart your course. Mix and match upgrades to craft the perfect sea-surviving strategy!

title: Five Years Old Memories
description: This is an interactive omnibus animation based on interviews with my friends about their memories around the age of five, based on their personal sensory memories and episodes.

title: Mesmerizer
description: This is fan-made game of "Mesmerizer," a vocaloid song! The battle system is based on the Undertale-like battle system.

title: Seaflower
description: Seaflower is a short sapphic visual novel about a selkie who washes up on a remote scottish island and her friend, a total selkie chaser.

title: Verses of Hope
description: Verses of Hope is a 2D platform game and interactive poetry adventure where you shape the world through the power of your words. Build your own poems to change the landscape and narrative.

title: Sages of Vandaleria: Rebirth of an Empire
description: Vandaleria. A fallen empire. Since the ruling house was overthrown, it has known only misery and hardship. What it needs is a savior. Embark on an epic RPG adventure, fighting across land and sky, restoring the ancient religion, and retake your birthright! That is, if you are ready to pay the price.

title: Resident Evil: Wesker Rebirth
description: Experience the story of Albert Wesker as he fights his way out of the Arklay Research Facility and Spencer Mansion to escape before the entire complex self destructs in this exciting mod that takes place moments after the original game!

title: Clover's Space Beat
description: Clover’s Space Beat is a gay lewd rhythm space shooter game in which you take control of Clover in his quest to stop Doctor Deadbeat. You’ll get help from Miller, the engineer and mothership pilot and the Colonel of the Dance Federation.

title: Snazzy and Groovy in Crystal Town
description: Snazzy and Groovy in Crystal Town is a bite sized, story-focused RPG surrounding two cat friends and their relaxing holiday in a place called Crystal Town. However, something sinister brews beneath the surface... will you give the people of crystal town a hand? Or give them the cold shoulder...

title: Energy Lab
description:
ENERGY LAB!
In 30 episodes, can you escape this lab?
You can trigger the mechanisms with your energy orb,
Remember that some things need to be triggered if you want to get through!
Only this energy orb will not trigger anything!

title: Parking Masters: Deluxe Edition
description: Welcome to Parking Masters, where you'll face the ultimate test of your parking skills in a variety of challenges! Maneuver vehicles through numerous levels, all designed with realistic physics and a captivating visual style.

title: Astral Ascent: Yamat - The Breach Traveler
description: Play as Yamat, a powerful dark mage that summons wild creatures and can fight with her magic fists, a bow and a two-handed greatsword!

title: Hentai Girls: Obon Love
description: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!

title: Legend of the Hunter: House of Dragons
description: In a remote dragon-hunting village, a boy establishes an unlikely friendship with a small dragon, challenging the traditions and prejudices of his community.

title: Survivor Heroes
description: Unleash Your Inner Hero, evolve or perish, upgrade your arsenal to face relentless waves of monsters!

title: Cat Quest: The Fur-tastic Trilogy
description: Cat Quest: The Fur-tastic Trilogy contains three meow-nificent catventures!

title: Arcade Archives: Tecmo Stackers
description:
"Tecmo Stackers" is a puzzle game released by TECMO in 1995.
Match the falling balls with the same color to make them disappear.
Balls near the disappeared ball will be surprised and stretch left and right, creating an unexpected chain reaction.

title: Ruthless Carnage Hotline
description: Ruthless Carnage Hotline : Fight, Survive, Dominate! Are You Ready?

title: Escape: Backrooms Horror
description: Find your way through a disorienting maze as reality distorts and fear grips your mind.

title: Underground Station
description:
An adventure into the mysterious world of the underground Labour Office begins.
Here, money decides everything.

title: Synaxarion Christian Stories: Holy Martyr Neophytos
description: Active around 290 A.D., during the fierce government of Maximos in Nicaea, Saint Neophytos the Holy Martyr worked many wonders and underwent a brutal martyrdom, putting his torturers to shame. This is his story.

title: Truck Simulator 2024: USA Driver Zone - Premium Edition
King Arthur II: The Role-Playing Wargame + Dead Legions
description: Includes King Arthur II: The Role-Playing Wargame and the Dead Legions DLC

title: Nyotai Inkan: Utsurikawaru Chijokuteki Koukishin
description: While on a field trip to a museum, the protagonist's 4-person group accidently breaks a cursed jar due to some trivial dispute. And the following day, it seems that their minds and bodies are swapped because of the curse. Thus begins their struggle to dispel the curse in order to change back to normal.

title: Outertale: Project Spacetime
description: Project Spacetime is my take on Outertale by 2mi127. Main character designs are borrowed, but the music, tilesets, battle sprites, and backstory are new. If you're like me, and want to experience UNDERTALE for the first time again, this is for you.

title: Ruin 2: Mimic Adventures
description:
Taking place after the "Elevator Ending" of Ruin, Ruin 2: Mimic Adventures follows the journey of the Mimic trying to escape the Freddy Fazbear's Mega Pizzaplex!

Platform your way through the ruins of the Pizzaplex, go through familiar areas in a completely new way and take on old foes and other wacky shenanigans in this crazy quest for freedom!

title: Toad Tavern
description: Mix drinks, master recipes, and learn about your froggy clientele in this 1920s bartending sim. It's up to you and your mixing skills whether this bar is a major hop or a major flop.

title: Freddy Fazbears: Security Replacement
description: a Horror Survival Game Made By KwixAF

title: Fantomas
description: Made for the 02A2 Visual Novel Jam, this short, surreal visual novel is an exploration on the work of Rene Magritte, the allure of crime, and the nature of art.

title: Of Ash and Dust
description: Of Ash and Dust is Dark Souls Remastered overhaul mod, that rebalances the game, adds new weapons and spells, restores cut content and much more.

title: Search Dungeon Master
description: Search Dungeon Master is an exciting hidden object puzzle game set in a medieval dungeon setting. This game is a great way to relax after a hard day and get away from problems.

title: Forest God
description: Forest God is a psychological horror game from the first person. The investigation of Agent X of the secret service turns into an endless journey deep into the universe, filled with abnormal incidents, the nature of which is previously unknown to anyone.

title: The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 2: The Price of Desire
description:
The Legend of Dark Witch 2 retains its simple controls and enough challenges to satisfy the completist.

Created by indie games company INSIDE SYSTEM in 2014, The Legend of Dark Witch 2 is a 2D action story sequel to "The Legend of Dark Witch". True to its predecessor, Legend of the Dark Witch 2 retains its simple controls and enough challenges to satisfy the completist.

Players have 8 stages to choose from and must use SHOTs to make their way through a variety of obstacles to reach the boss enemy. Within each stage there are hidden "Pura Syega" which are helpful to power up player characters.

title: The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 4
description:
The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 4 is the latest entry in the action game series that began in 2014.

This 2D action game features charming pixel art, where defeating enemies earns you Tres, a resource used to power up your character.

title: Yokubou Lock: Boku no Kanojo wa Shasei Kanrinin
description:
The main character, Tsukasa, confesses his feelings to Tsubomi, the girl he fell in love with at first sight. Surprisingly, the answer was OK. Tsukasa was happy to have found the lover of his dreams, but...

Tsubomi is such an incredibly caring person. And I'm grateful, but... things just keep escalating and she keeps craving my semen.

title: Falskaar
description:
A DLC sized new lands mod that adds 20+ hours of fully voiced lore friendly (But not canon) quests, dungeons, and more.

For hundreds of years Falskaar has been inhabited by the Nords, though most of its history from before then is unknown.

For the first time since the party's arrival in Falskaar almost 600 years ago a portal activates deep within the ruins of Mzubthand and the player steps through, arriving in Falskaar. They are denoted 'The Traveler', based on an old prophecy.

"They who arrive through the shimmering wall mark the start of the worst."

title: Wyrmstooth
description: Travel to the foreboding island of Wyrmstooth in pursuit of a dragon that's interrupting trade routes throughout Skyrim. Wyrmstooth adds a new quest that takes the Dragonborn to the island of Wyrmstooth situated north of Solitude across the Sea of Ghosts. Battle across new landscapes and through new dungeons in this fully voice acted DLC-sized mod. The task may seem simple enough: slay a dragon that's stirring up trouble. But things never quite go that easily...

title: Sqube Escape
description: A unique action-platformer game set in the Sqube universe. Challenge yourself through 60 levels filled with obstacles and bosses. Choose from four difficulty levels and enjoy immersive graphics and sound.

title: Feed the Cat
description: When the girl she's dating needs an emergency cat sitter, Claire jumps to volunteer. After all, what could go wrong with pet sitting an adorable little cat for one night? (A short horror visual novel.)

title: Phoenotopia
description:
A mysterious force abducts the peaceful villagers of Panselo. As Gale, loyal denizen and survivor of the incident, set out to solve this mystery and rescue your friends!

Adventure, fight, and puzzle solve your way through the world of Phoenotopia!

title: Mystical Crash in Magical Middle Ages: Adventure of Valkyrie
description:
A guy named Dimon, the main character of this game, inexplicably got into the magical Middle Ages and was forced to disguise himself as a valkyrie - a warrior girl Diana). What awaits him, will he be able to understand what happened, return home or stay in the magical world. Is he still he, or maybe she, or something else?

What adventures are waiting for the character? All or almost all actions and their consequences depend on the player.

title: Mighty Math: Calculating Crew
description: An edutainment game involving four superheroes and four games, each involving math.

title: PS!Outertale
description: Project Spacetime, or PS!Outertale for short, is a take on Outertale by Mimi Pippinski (2mi127). It is set on a space station (the Outpost) which the monsters were banished to after their home planet was destroyed.

title: Mighty Math Zoo Zillions
description: Mighty Math Zoo Zillions teaches kindergarten, 1st, and 2nd grade students the concepts, facts, and thinking skills necessary to build math confidence and develop a strong, lasting understanding of math! Innovative activities teach number line concepts, addition and subtraction, counting money and making change, problem-solving skills, and early three-dimensional geometry. Learning and understanding math is fun with the entertaining creatures of Zoo Zillions!

title: Crayola Paint 'n Play Pony
description:
Create and Care for the Virtual Pony, Horse or Unicorn of Your Dreams! (Ages 5 - 10)
Learn all about horses as you color, decorate, and dress their own horses, ponies, or unicorns!
Tons of Creative Activities: Color with 48 Crayola colors.
Decorate with pretty accessories such as flowers and bows. Dress your pony in over 100 fashions.
Learn fun facts about horses and ponies!

title: Hot Wheels: Custom Car Designer
description:
Mattel Media's Hot Wheels Custom Car Designer CD-ROM puts you or your child behind the virtual wrench, spray brush and stamp pad, allowing you to customize the appearance of 20 different traditional Hot Wheels models (including the jeep, speedboat, blimp and a number of racers). But why stop at detailing your dream machine when you can also draft licenses and traffic tickets, label trophies and ribbons, and create flags and license plates?

From the main access screen, you can visit the Print Shop to create a newsletter, greeting cards, business cards, letterhead, and postcards; the DMV to make licenses and license plates and issue tickets; Victory Lane for ribbons, trophies, banners, and flags; and the Customizing Garage where you customize your cars.

The customization features include choosing the colors for your car from eight available, placing decals and adding different styles of tires, muffler pipes, spoilers, and weapons. Licenses, ribbons, and trophies can be personalized including imported photos for licenses. Also, traffic tickets can be created using traditional violations or personalized to include "special violations," such as "Dad didn't take me to the movies...$20 fine." Everything you create can be saved and printed.

Hot Wheels Custom Car Designer CD-ROM sports a basic point-and-click interface and has no demanding PC requirements. Anyone familiar with MS Paint will be able to make use of the variety of creativity applications. Geared towards children, the product includes voice-recorded online help and links to the Hot Wheels Web site. No longer must you pine over your inability to tweak, tune or trick out your own car or truck; Hot Wheels Custom Car Designer CD-ROM puts all the tools at your disposal for making your souped-up fantasy car into a (virtual) reality.

title: Reader Rabbit Math Adventures Ages 4-6
description: Spend a day at the park where math is your ticket to thrilling rides and fun–filled games! Join Reader Rabbit and friends as they hop along from the arcade to the roller coaster, using numbers to solve puzzles and win great prizes. Even pre-readers can play independently!

title: Japaritale
description: Welcome to JAPARITALE, a crossover fan-game between the 2017 anime "Kemono Friends" and the hit RPG "UNDERTALE". One day, a human named KABAN, a long-lost child of the Park, randomly shows up in the Savannah Area. Fallen by a few vines on her path, she realizes the importance of dangers set afoot in this foreign land.

title: Lost Resolve
description: Master your movement skills to blast through exhilarating areas at a breakneck pace. Lost Resolve is a quirky, charming adventure about finding hope in the midst of chaos.

title: FrogFlop
description: In Floppy's Great Leap, you play as Floppy the frog, aiming to reach the highest peak. Jump and climb through challenging levels in this 2D pixel art adventure. Reach the summit to make your wish, but be careful—one wrong move and you could find yourself back at the bottom!

title: Craz'D: 13th Anniversary Edition
description:
The 13th anniversary edition adds balance changes, improved boss battles, bugfixes, quality-of-life features, support for more operating systems, mail nerds and also egg.

The changes are designed to improve the flow of the gameplay while altering the experience as little as possible.

Longtime fan, friend, and mentor the Oddwarg created this version of the game.

title: Mario & Sonic at The Olympic Winter Games Pyeongchang 2018
description: Play as Mario or Sonic in 20 different dream events!

title: Coagulation Station
description:
COAGULATION STATION is a short atmospheric horror game that blends cosmic horror with dark absurdist humor. Maintain a malfunctioning blood rig located deep within the universe's only 'Living Planet' and experience the horrors that lurk within.

In an attempt to pay off your debt to the Grand Galactic Bank, you stumble upon an opening for a job on Carrion Prime, a living world that is famous for it's blood based foods. Your job is to look after one of the various blood rigs that supply the surface with 'Product'. But beware, the pipes tend to suck up all manner of things in addition to blood. Worryingly, there is a rumor going around about the existence of "something big" lurking within the throbbing depths below...

Will you survive to pay off your debt or become another "workplace accident" for the company to downplay?

title: Tower of Nod
description:
Tower of Nod is an action-roguelike deckbuilding platformer with unique sleep-based controls. You are a Hero that can masterfully manipulate the falling Blocks and build a path upwards... but only while you're asleep! Move quickly and confidently to avoid the blocks above and lava below.

Build a deck of pieces at your disposal to aid your journey upwards and grant you temporary boosts. Pair them with powerful relics to create unique synergies. Climb higher and higher while managing your sleeping state to stay out of danger!

title: Fortnite: Chapter 5 - Season 4: Absolute Doom
description:
Suit up for Fortnite Battle Royale Chapter 5 Season 4: Absolute Doom and become a Marvel legend -

Become the heroes first on the scene to defend against Marvel’s Doctor Doom and his forces or take up the mantle of villainy and join the reign of Doom. Luckily, there's some brand new heavy munitions to take on a worthy adversary. Go head-to-head with new items like Dual Micro SMGs, Captain America’s Shield, or War Machine’s Arsenal.

title: Happy Challenger Yamada
description: A story-driven racing game in which the player controls the gear shift of a motorbike with mouse gestures.

title: Slash/Jump
description: How do you platform if walking and jumping aren't an option? With a sword of course! Bounce and slash your way through this short and sweet, uniquely controlled precision platformer!

title: Mad Devils: Damned-finitive Edition
description: Mad Devils is a co-op, arcade shooter set in a twisted WWII setting. What does an Allied special forces squad who hunt Nazi occultist do when betrayed, killed and resurrected as demons? Their job.

title: TrotMania V: Shrive
description: TrotMania V: Shrive is the 5th game in the TrotMania series.

title: Nintendo Nightmare Deluxe
description:
10 years ago, a game that would change the very internet came out.

Nightmare revamped, with uncapped framerate and resolution support (as opposed to the original games 640x480 at 20FPS restriction)

title: Protect Your Gold From Barack Obama
description: A satire RPG Maker game by ClickHole (a news parody site owned by The Onion), made to make fun of right-wing media portrayals of American politicians in 2018. Originally playable in-browser, any link to this game is now broken, and as such this game is possibly lost media.

title: Awesome: The Game
description: A choose-your-own-adventure game about dying in unique ways.

title: No One Lives Under the Lighthouse: Director's Cut
description: Director's cut (previously known as Isolated Year Update) introduces a remake of most of the late-game content, completely changing the second hour of the game and also adding some new things to the earlier part of the game. All of game's endings were remade and some of them became much harder to achieve than the others. Additionally, many achievements were remade to fit with the new content.

title: Eating Nature
description: Sift through a nature documentary for clips about your favorite animal, the fish.

title: Koppotate's Rescue Mission 2: The Path to Eradication
description: Join Koppotate, Ruby and A.J. on a journey to save Koppai from a terrible pandemic. Explore lush environments and brand-new custom story mode maps as you progress towards the eradication of this virus!

title: Pikmin 1x3
description: Pikmin 1x3: A demo of my latest hack for Pikmin 3 Deluxe that contains 2 levels in Mission Mode, Collect Treasures : Impact Site, Forest of Hope, Forest Navel and Distant Spring, with fully HD assets and (somewhat) faithful level layouts of Pikmin 1.

title: The Distant Planet
description: The Distant Planet is a sci-fi RTS. Command an army of creatures called Sprouts to explore an uncharted world, carry back foes you've defeated, and convert the once-hostile creatures into miniature units of your own to command, suited to the environment around them!

title: Fabrika Mortis
description: Your mission is to exterminate the enemy forces within the Fabrika Mortis space station.

title: Seismic Ventures
description:
Seismic Ventures is a singleplayer & co-op episode inspired by the original Quake game.
It has 8 mainline maps and 1 secret map.

title: Centaurus
description: A medium sized base map made with the progs dump devkit.

title: Let's Go Read: An Ocean Adventure
description: Robby Raccoon and Emily Squirrel are on a mission to find the missing book mobile under the ocean. Along the way they find lots of things to do. At Pier City there is a stingray that paints long and short vowels. Kids hear the sounds vowels make and then hear words and sentences that use the sounds. Young readers then use what they learned to deliver mail. The postcards and packages have vowel sounds and words. At the Powerstation kids put letters together to sound-out words. This is a great phonics activity. Kids hear all the letters sounded out as they form words. Children also blend bubbles to make words with consonant blends, find words with a target blend or digraph sound and find books under the sea. Once children find storybooks they can hear them read aloud or record themselves reading the story and play it back. Kids will love playing these activities and parents will agree for learning phonics the Let's Go Read series is remarkable.

title: Richard Scarry’s Busytown: Best Math Ever
description: Richard Scarry's Best Math Program Ever is a Power Computer game. It was released in 1997.

title: The Liminal Dimension
description: You're trapped in an endless loop within a liminal dimension, where each loop leads to increasingly unsettling places. Will you find the way out of this psychological horror? The game offers a unique déjà vu experience that blurs the lines between reality and illusion.

title: Secrets of the Dark: Eclipse Mountain
description: Save your friend from the Demon of Darkness in Secrets of the Dark: Eclipse Mountain! Follow clues left by stone monks in a deserted town in Thailand to uncover a thrilling mystery. Battle the dark and magical werecreatures that want to sacrifice your friend in this macabre hidden object puzzle adventure game!

title: Muerto de Risa
description: Alberto López Felisberto is a normal young man with a problem... Not being able to stop laughing at the most inopportune moments. Today, the event is his grandfather's funeral.

title: Boxcar Brats
description: Boxcar Brats is a wacky, top-down, multiplayer, "anti-racing" game. Your box car is out of control, so do everything you can do stay in last place! Swerve, skid and smash everything in sight to build up your brake meter and spin out your opponents! So hop into your boxcar, cause some mayhem and eliminate your buddies - nothing is off limits when you're a brat!

title: Donald Duck's Basics in Education and Learning
Donald's Basics in Hamburguers and Learning
Cenk The Chopper
description: Cenk The Chopper is a fast paced hack-and-slash game. Fight through hordes of mutants and robots in a world you've made go to hell. Chop 'em up everything you see till the end of it.

title: Dragon Quest XI: Echoes of an Elusive Age S - Ultimate Edition
Thregnar and the Crystals of Chaos
description: Thregnar and the Crystals of chaos is a cute but challenging platformer where you take control of a ninja on a quest to save the world. Mastering his legendary dive kick is key to overcoming any obstacle.

title: Chernobylite 2: Exclusion Zone
description: Explore the mysterious open world of the Chornobyl Exclusion Zone in this post-apocalyptic action RPG adventure. Craft your story by facing sinister hazards and monsters. Survive furious encounters with the help of your crafted weaponry, developed skills, gathered teammates, and supported factions

title: Fortnite Festival: Season 5
description: Put your hands together for the next Festival Icon! Fresh off her historic stadium world tour, award winner and pop culture powerhouse Karol G brings her Latin sounds to the world of Fortnite in Festival Season 5.

title: Fountaintale
description: FOUNTAINTALE is a fan-made sequel to UNDERTALE, inspired by elements from it and DELTARUNE as well, adapting both games into a fresh and new experience.

title: Fountaintale: Chapter 1
description: One year after the events of UNDERTALE, Monsterkind has been adapting to their new lives on the Surface. The game begins on a very special day, Frisk's Birthday! After a very fun party night with their friends and family, Frisk is ready to end the day, though fate still had a gift of their own to give...

title: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Extended Edition
description: Emotional, 3rd-person, story-driven, adventure game focused on solving puzzles and using stealth mechanics. Use your bow to interact with environmental elements. Sneak, climb or distract guards to move further unnoticed. Solve light puzzles alongside your path to rescue your loved one.

title: Outbreak: Detective Collection
description: Lost alone in a zombie infested mansion in the woods...

title: Puzzle Master: The Ultimate Challenge of Wits
description: Puzzle Master: Unleash Your Genius, Piece by Piece!

title: World War II: Airplanes Battle
description: Conquer the Skies, Change History.

title: The Guardian Shift
description: The Guardian Shift is a whimsical adventure about a young guardian, awakened from slumber, who faces a series of perilous trials to fulfill their destiny of safeguarding the planet. Despite the daunting challenges, the guardian must rise to the occasion and protect the world. Go forth, Guardian.

title: Roadies: Unsung Heroes
description: Fast Paced Roadie "Simulator"

title: Gunzle
description: Gunzle is a game made in 3 days for the Nonejam 9. In the game you control Clover and you have to use your gun to pass trought the levels and reach the stars. As the game jam theme was genre mix the game is a mix of Gun and Puzzle.

title: Cargo Hunters
description: A third person shooter and extraction looter shooter which involves robots trying to survive rather than humans. A PVE and PVP shooter game with looting mechanism to build/craft gears in your Outpost. Gears and items can also be sold or bought from the market in your Outpost.

title: Halo Infinite: Operation Fleetcom
description:
This content update brings a bunch of additions and improvements to the game, including the return of two beloved modes from Halo 3 and Halo: Reach, a veritable swath of enhancements to Forge, major sandbox changes, a free new Operation Pass, and more.

The free cosmetic "operation pass" which launched aside this update ran from July 30, 2024 to September 3, 2024. It was made available in perpetuity to those who purchased the pass.

title: Mystery Trackers: Darkwater Bay
description:
Elephant Games presents the latest exhilarating installment of the Mystery Trackers series!

When a renowned scientist goes missing from the Poseidon research vessel, you're sent to investigate. You quickly uncover that there's much more to this expedition than simple research. A powerful and dangerous artifact awaits beneath the waves, and the Mystery Trackers aren't the only ones after it! Can you uncover the artifact's history and keep it from falling into the wrong hands? Find out in this thrilling hidden-object puzzle adventure game!

title: Save: Teaser - Before the Dawn
description:
Save Teaser: Before the Dawn

"SAVE Teaser" is a first-person survival psychological horror teaser game set just before a nightmarish search mission in ‘SAVE’. Players take on the role of a protagonist trapped on the 6,000-ton ship 'SENARA,' which is sinking due to mysterious phenomena. Experience the desperate escape process in this hyper-realistic real-life 6,000-ton ship 'SENARA,' and immerse yourself in a hauntingly realistic atmosphere of mystery and horror.

title: TrotMania: Aeternum Obscurum
description: TrotMania: Aeternum Obscurum is the third entry of the TrotMania series. It is primarily based around the fourth season of My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic.

title: TrotMania IV: Euphorius
description: TrotMania IV: Euphorius is an unofficial My Little Pony rhythm game and the fourth entry in the TrotMania series. The game is focused on adding songs from the fifth and sixth seasons of the show, alongside various fan songs, putting over 100+ songs in this installment.

title: Godforged: Origins of Ozgalor
description: Godforged: Origins of Ozgalor is a story-rich, single-player Action RPG set in the world of Nelethar. Experience tactical combat, class blending, and kingdom ruling in a world besieged by a god, where your actions and choices shape the future of Ozgalor.

title: Portal: Google Translate Edition
description: This mod seeks to take the text, dialogue, and developer commentary of Portal, put it through varying amounts of languages in Google Translate, then put it back into English.

title: The Dreamers Foresight
description: Embark on a dreamlike journey as a ninja in this roguelite adventure, shaping your world with randomized biome tiles, align similar Tiles for better loot. Build a powerful deck from a variety set of cards while balancing your energy to battle relentless nightmare creatures.

title: Project: G-216
description: Project: G-216 is a Horror themed Observation Game, where you monitor the CCTV feed of a cursed place to check it for supernatural annomalies.

title: Portal 2: Google Translate Edition
description: As with previous works from BinkusTheTrinkus such as Half-Life: Google Translate Edition and Portal: Google Translate Edition, Portal 2: GTE aims to take all of the dialogue, text, and developer commentary of Portal 2, put it through several different languages in Google Translate, then put back into English. This fills the base game with a bunch of garbled nonsense that makes it nearly unrecognizable.

title: The Wanted Man's House
description:
In "The Wanted Man's House," plunge into the shadows of a slasher suspense, inspired by iconic horror films from the '80s and '90s. Take on the role of Mason, a daring adventurer in pursuit of fame, determined to break into the infamous residence of the sought-after killer known as "Baby Face."

The story unfolds as Mason, armed with courage and a camera, discovers that the location of the house has been inadvertently revealed by his own friends. His goal? Record every chilling moment to expose the terror in the city's newspaper. However, things take an unexpected turn when Baby Face returns home. Are you ready to face the nightmare?

title: Daemon Bride: Additional Gain
description: Daemon Bride: Additional Gain is an updated version of the 2009 Examu game, Daemon Bride, a game about people that have made contracts with demons or angels. The game features some of the traditional angel/demon contractor staples, such as a boy with a succubus and alluring female with a magic snake, but also some more oddball and unorthodox characters, like a gang member with an angry squid attached to his arm, and a dog with a bird form of Satan that follows him around. The cast is very balanced and a lot of fun to play with given their unique designs, tools, and play styles.

title: Umblight
description: Umblight is an Inscryption-like card game adventure where you're trapped in a dark, machine-filled room that changes as you go. Build your deck of shadow and light cards, make new cards by combining them and play mind-bending synergies as you try to defeat your dungeon master!

title: H2 Multiplayer Mod
description:
H2 Multiplayer Mod was a mod for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered (H1) that aimed to recreate the original Modern Warfare 2 Multiplayer experience with new twists. The mod featured a wide variety of maps, new progression, unique camos, remastered weapons, custom attachments, and more. The original MW2 killstreaks made a return as well, completely changing the way Modern Warfare Remastered feels and plays.

On August 15th, 2024, just one day before the mod was set to release, Activision Publishing, Inc. sent a cease-and-desist letter to the members of the H2M-Mod team, effectively rendering the mod defunct. While the mod team ceased all activity on the project, a playtester leaked a build of the mod, making it available to the public.

title: H1-Mod
description:
H1-Mod is a modded client for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered. This client aims to provide a better-than-vanilla experience, with many quality-of-life features which are designed with gameplay enhancements in mind. The original game on Steam did not have a huge player base and is considered a forgotten Call of Duty. Also, the original game has so many game-breaking features that it is hard to play the original experience without facing a issue every so often.

With H1-Mod, new features include, but are not limited to: unlocked field of view adjustment, HUD safe area adjustment, detailed sensitivity adjustment, multiple fullbright modes, disabling of broken shader caching, unlocking all cosmetics, stat changing, uncapped max FPS, and a dedicated server browser.

description: #1Kill is a Doom episode created by Angelo Jefferson in 1997. It was released at the same time as #1Kill Extra and was followed by Number One Kill The Next Generation later in the same yearr

title: Number One Kill The Next Generation
description: Number One Kill The Next Generation is a 22-level megawad for Doom II that was created by Angelo Jefferson and released in November 1997. It is a sequel to Number One Kill, a Doom 1 Episode replacement. This WAD is noteworthy for its difficult levels relative to its early release, leading to comparisons with The Plutonia Experiment and Hell Revealed.

title: Favillesco Episode 1: Genuflected on Io
description: Favillesco - Episode 1: Genuflected on Io V1.2 is a Doom 1 episode designed entirely by Nicolas Monti that attempts to emulate the Phobos style to the best of his abilities, released in 2013.

title: Number One Kill Extra
description: #1 Kill Extra is a single-level PWAD for Doom that was designed by Angelo Jefferson and released in 1997. It was released at the same time as #1Kill and was followed by Number One Kill The Next Generation later in the same year.

title: Monochrome Mapping Project
description: A collection of maps experimenting with the concept of simple textures in order to emphasize the fundamentals of level design (lighting, elevation, thing placement, simple contrast, etc.)

title: Countdown to Extinction
description: 32 maps for vanilla Doom, each one made in one hour over a period of 3 weeks.

title: Azagthoth
description: A collection of larger maps than normal Doom2. Should provide about four hours of play on Ultra-Violence. Three of these maps were released in earlier versions as "Perdido", 1,2 & 3.

title: Erkattäññe
description: Erkattäññe is a set of 11 levels for Doom II by Nicolás Monti, aiming to imitate the style of 1994-1996 maps, with a restrained texture set for thematic consistency being the only concession given to aesthetics. The levels are dominated by curves and irregular shapes, and filled with secrets.

title: Eternity
description: Travel through the time and find your grandfather in Eternity, a fun and amazing Hidden Object Adventure game! After inventing the time machine, your grandfather decided to experiment on himself and is sent hurtling through time. Use your courage and puzzle-solving skills to travel through time and find him somewhere in Eternity! Meet characters from all parts of the past and future, and solve perplexing puzzles.

title: Stomper
description: Stomper was a once unfinished megawad for Doom II, created by Pawel Zarczynski (NMN). A year later, Przemek Zimny (alterworldruler), began working on a finished version of the megawad with NMN's permission and barring 1 map was able to do so.

title: Realm of Chaos
description: Realm of Chaos is a Doom II megawad that contains 32 levels and was released on October 31, 1996 by The Macintosh Team (TMT). As the name of the mapping team implies, the project was exclusively built by Doom mappers on Apple Macintosh computers.

title: Blackjack Elf
description: Play this casino gambling card game with some elves and win big money.

title: Habilis
description: Follow Nathan Walters as he quickly descends into insanity. Discover the ancient secrets held within a futuristic abandoned factory. A bodycam, Lovecraft-style horror experience not for the weak of heart. Hide, and survive if you can.

title: My First Date RPG: Elliot - Story Two
Nostalgic Entropy
description:
As the sun sets on the horizon, the last rays of light fade in the sky, like dancing ambers of a half-forgotten memory.

This place feels strange yet familiar in a nostalgic way. But you know not all memories are good, so steel yourself for the journey ahead.

title: Skyless Blind
description: Skyless Blind is an upcoming surreal space exploration RPGmaker game about uncovering the mysteries of a broken universe. Travel across beautifully ancient worlds and meet strange new friends, collect mystifying artifacts that bend reality, and discover the dark secrets that shattered the skies.

title: Midnight Fury
description: Experience a TV show featuring Max Cobra and his teammates as they clean up zombies in quarantine zones. Impress sponsors and boost your fame.

title: Elite Exorcist Miko
description: A bullet hell shoot 'em up featuring hololive’s Sakura Miko! hololive has been possessed by evil spirits! Combine melee and ranged combat with a variety of items to fight your friends and set them free!

title: Nightmare Pursuit
description: Nightmare Pursuit is an intense multiplayer horror game where survivors must avoid the deadly traps and unique abilities of terrifying killers. Rely on stealth, strategy, and teamwork to survive in horrific environments. Experience the thrill of the chase—escape or become the hunted.

title: Spirits of Baciu
description: SPIRITS OF BACIU is the enigmatic adventure of The Lost One, a mysterious cat-like spirit who suddenly awakens in the dark Baciu forest. Help him to find his way through the woods, solving puzzles and facing the spirits that inhabit this strange place.

title: Pet Lands
description: Collect quadrillion of coins, hatch pets to mine for you, and unlock 100 unique hand-crafted areas! An incremental clicker/idle creatures-collection adventure. Dopamine heaven has arrived!

title: CrisisX
description: Immerse yourself into a realistic open world experience and find your way out in the ruins of a dying world. Survive the threats from the Infected, the living and most importantly, the wilderness. Fight or cooperate with others, and build your own territory. Build your own new post-apocalyptic world.

title: Inigo Gets Out
description: Interactive storybook adventure featuring a cat named Inigo.

title: Days of Night: Episode 1
description:
You're freshly 18 and seeking experience in the work force. You struggle to find work until one day the opportunity of a life time would come your way.

Little to you're knowledge you would be stepping in a world of HORROR!

Experience the HORRORS of working night shift at you're local grocery store.

title: Room 202
description: While traveling, you get tired and decide to stop at a hotel. Little do you know who - or what - else has checked in.

title: Helward: A Tanuki Story
description:
Helward is a gay furry romance VN about a fish out of water tanuki named Howl. After a year of an intimate long-distance relationship, he will finally pursue his romantic interest.

Given his propensity for misfortune, many mishaps await Howl in his efforts for love. On top of that, in the territory of Helward secrets and dangers abound. He'll have much to overcome while also juggling secrets of his own.

title: Oh So Hero!
description: Oh So Hero! is a lewd furry metroidvania game! Play as the dragonesque Joe to fight and fornicate with your rivals, get intimate with a menagerie of anthropomorphic characters, and embark on a sex-filled adventure to win the mysterious alien tournament being held on Joe's island!

title: Derma
description: Short horror RPG

title: Immemory
description: In Immemory, Chris Marker has used the format of the CD-Rom to create a multi-layered, multimedia memoir. The reader investigates “zones” of travel, war, cinema, and poetry, navigating through photographs, film clips, music, and text, as if physically exploring Marker’s memory itself. The result is a veritable 21st-century Remembrance of Things Past, an exploration of the state of memory in our digital era. With it, Marker has both invented a literary form and perfected it.

title: Paper-Girl-Chain
description: A short dreamlike visual novel about a shy girl and her obsession with her best friend.

title: Shien Mogui
description: Two girls travel to a small abandoned village to investigate an urban legend. This game is an incomplete work that was discontinued. Therefore, the ending is included halfway through.

title: Smog City
description: Smog City is a 10 level mapset for Doom II with a toxic, industrial theme.

title: Urban Side
description: Urban side is a 5 level (plus 1 credits map) boom wad, themed around a urban city environment.

title: Ruined Vacation
description: Ruined vacation is a wad composed of three (plus a credits map) action packed levels to kick some ass through

title: Star Light Dynamics
description: Star Light Dynamics is a doomII boom wad comprised of 5 (plus a credits map) science fiction themed maps

title: Cave Halls
description: A single level for vanilla Hexen with about 25 minutes of gameplay. Both combat and puzzles (not switch hunting) included.

title: Thirty Monsters Challenge 2: Thirty Aliens
description: A sequel to the original 30MC, the task was simple: create a map with 30 monsters in it. This set of 36 cl21 maps features work by a number of talented community map designers and contains some custom assets on top of the colorful Ancient Aliens texture pack!

title: Dark Scythe
description: Dark Scythe is an April Fool's project where mappers were tasked with making a Dead Simple knock-off that's beatable. Apologies to anyone thinking this has anything to do with Scythe.

title: Persona 3 Portable: Kotone Cutscenes Project - Steam Version
description: The Kotone Cutscenes Project implements reanimated versions of every cutscene from the original PS2 release of Persona 3 to match the Female protagonist route of Persona 3 Portable. This includes alternative versions of scenes for choices exclusive to this route (eg. Theodore or Elizabeth).

title: ReBullet
description: This is a local two-player tank battle game where two players control blue and red tanks; Players will use a limited number of bullets to eject and defeat enemies in the scenario!

title: Ventreville: A Cure for Sorrow
description:
Ventreville: A Cure for Sorrow is a fantasy visual novel game with a colorful cast of playable characters, each with their own unique mechanics, and all of whom are necessary in solving this mystery. But be careful, as your choices will determine whether their stories end in ruin or victory.
