Interrogate your own player characters in this six-chapter murder mystery! Your decisions determine how many clues are uncovered for the final player character, the detective. Explore each stage of grief: Chapter 1 stars Orven as he navigates the shocking deaths of his dream and his hero.

title: Upekkha
description: Escape reality and find peace through meditation, wall running, interacting with mushrooms, discovering hidden easter eggs, and more.

title: Schismo's Sideshow
description:
A hand-drawn action roguelike set inside of a strange circus attraction.

Defeat hordes of fast-moving enemies to generate energy for the circus. Collect Schismo's lost Stamps to change your playstyle and raise the skill ceiling. Meta-progression comes in the form of Marlbes that offer mutually exclusive choices.

title: Nululu Online
description: Nululu Online was a Thai fantasy MMORPG for PC and Symbian mobile devices.

title: Epic! The Humorous RPG
description: Epic! The Humorous RPG is a parody RPG game made by the YouTuber The Mysterious Mr. Enter in 2012. The game runs on the Official Hamster Republic Role Playing Game Construction Engine.

title: Lost in the Dark Woods
description:
In the dense, shadowy forest, the crackling fire is your only defense. The flames flicker and dance, casting long shadows that keep the predators at bay. But the fire is weakening. The night is alive with sounds—rustling leaves, distant growls—reminders that danger lurks just beyond the light.

You must gather wood quickly, feeding the flames to keep them strong. Every piece of wood you find is a lifeline, each spark a promise of safety. The fire is your shield, your beacon of hope in the dark wilderness.

If the fire dies, the predators will close in, their eyes glowing in the darkness, and the forest will consume you. You have no choice—keep the fire burning, or face the terror that waits in the night.

title: Dark Wraith
description: Dark Wraith is a first-person grid-based dungeon crawler game, similar to Wizardry or The Bard's Tale. The main character is Zion, a magic user that finds out that a friendly town-person's daughter has been kidnapped by the Dark Wraith as part of a periodic ritual sacrifice. Up to four other characters can accompany Zion as he searches various dungeons in search of the Dark Wraith. As with many Japanese dungeon crawlers, characters are not created by the player. Rather, they are met throughout the story. However, upon leveling up, the player gets to assign points to various skills and attributes. The game features turn-based combat with enemies appearing within the dungeon, similar to Might and Magic games.

title: Steamed Hams, but it's RPGMaker2003!
description: "Well Seymour, I made it, despite your directions"

title: Void Dash
description:
A simple endless runner arcade game about dodging dangerous asteroids.

Use powerups to break your highscore and collect Voidbucks to unlock new skins in the shop.

title: Factorio: Space Exploration
description:
Space Exploration is an overhaul mod for Factorio that continues player's journey after launching the rocket. Expand your factory into space and manage interplanetary logistics. Travel around the solar system in buildable ships and reach light speed to beat the game.

The Space Exploration mod predates the Space Age DLC and both are being developed by the same individual, so they will have similar elements. Space Exploration is meant for players looking for a lengthy, expert challenge.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Legend of Z RPG
description: A fan-made Dragon Ball Z RPG Maker 2003 fan game that takes place from Saiyan-Buu Saga with some 'GT' and 'Super' content afterward.

title: Tailgate
description: Hyde, an aging labrador retriever, wakes up and realizes that Derek, his beloved Human has disappeared. The doggo reluctantly leaves the house to investigate, only to find himself in the middle of an ancient dog prophecy.

title: Chatty's Bratty Tryst
description: Chatty's Bratty Tryst (CBT) is a fan-made visual novel made in Ren'py centered around Lucy Pyre, the cringe femcel demon girl Chatty loves and adores.

title: Satisfactory: 1.0 Update
description:
The 1.0 release of Satisfactory, a 3D co-op factory building game.

1.0 will contain many new features, including story content, and the addition of tier 9 and phase 5.

title: Locked Room on Rails
description: A Murder Mystery visual novel starring homicide detective Santiago Moore, as he tries to solve a sudden murder on the luxurious Jacob's Ladder Express Train.

title: Asphodelium
description: A melancholic boys love visual novel about killing cults and your past confronting you.

title: Miraculous: Paris Under Siege
description: Embark on a thrilling adventure where heroism, acrobatic combat, and stunning parkour collide as Shadow Moth unleashes a wave of villains across the city. It’s up to Ladybug and Cat Noir to save the day!

title: My First Date RPG: Oriana - Story Three
Naddagil: A Nordic Nightmare
description: Enter the mythical world of Naddagil: A Nordic Nightmare. In this cozy-horror game you have to guide a little child back home. But be aware, that not all creatures in this world will try to help you. Your only chance of survival is to hide and avoid the mysterious Naddagil lurking for you.

title: IguaRPG 2
description: Welcome to the world of IguaRPG 2. Become an adorable iguana and jump, fight, chat, put things in your pocket, and finish quests!

title: Arrival, or Attack of the B-Movie Clichés
Sawdust
description: A collection of seven maps scrapped from Valiant early in it's development.

title: Death of the King
description:
The King of Robots has been betrayed.

Caught off-guard, he finds himself trapped in his Mech. The Mech itself can probably last until help arrives -- but its overheating core can't. Use an army of robots running around the Mech to try and stabilize it!

title: A Day to Bring Them Happiness
description: Made for the Global Startupcities Gamejam with the theme "A Win-win situation".

title: Doki Doki Ace Attorney
description: A mod for DDLC based on the Ace Attorney series, where you must defend Sayori for a murder she didn't commit!

title: FNF x Ace Attorney: Turnabout
description:
OBJECTION!!
Phoenix Wright fights in court using the power of funk, against Miles Edgeworth, in the pursuit of a Not Guilty Verdict!

title: The Devil Within
description: A Sonic.EXE re-take by Brigandistian.

title: Pearl Rising
description:
You play as Pearl, a young cadet, woken up when your city is under attack by the Bugs. Your job is to secure the area and find out what's going on!
The only good bug is a dead bug, they say.

title: Sugary Shifter
description: Sugary Shifter is a short, turn-based RPG that is easy to understand and finish without any guides. It features graphics inspired by 1980s video games.

title: Sojourn Through the Decade
description: An autobiographical game focusing on the ten years of creating worlds and its respective characters, with The Sojourner seeing how his stories have fared since then.

title: Stellar Bewitching
description: A Sci-Fi turn-based RPG featuring teenage drama, touching storylines, and fast-paced battles!

title: Whispering Dream
description: Aisly is a little boy who was having his sweet dream after a long time. Different from the usual, he was engaged in quite a realistic dream. As he goes, someone was trying to wake him up from his sleep...?

title: Luciel Angel Mission
description: This is the story of the apprentice angel 'Luciel' who loves to study about the world. Once upon a time, all 3 worlds were ruled by God. after the war between The angels are led by 'Lucifer' the anti-God. Defeated and expelled, but then one day he disappeared, no one knew where he was. and gave the mission to Luciel for some reason.

title: The Haunted House
description: Our heroine "Mikae Mitsu" lived in a house with his aunt after the death of her parents. Mikae was in the house when she woke up and saw the letter placed on her table. But she didn't care Because it was everywhere the water was going anywhere Mikae went to the bathroom. Enough to come back to the room, but suddenly, something unusual happened. Because of a sudden noise from behind her when she turned around, she discovered that a ghost had broken into the house, and Mikae hurried to hide, she began to feel anxious and afraid Then Mikae So find a way to get out of this house.

title: Prenup Struggles
description:
Prenup Struggles is the game that is about the story of a young man from Buriram who wants to marry a woman, yet he wasn't able to do that because of the high prenup from the woman's father.

The young has no choice, but to move to the new city to fulfill his dream

Or not?

title: Farewell, My Dearest Love
description: What if the only room for an overnight stay is haunted by supernatural stories? Can you survive until morning?

title: 77Survival Part I
description: 77Survival is a survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Players will control four characters who accidentally find themselves stranded on the rooftop of a 77-story building. Their mission is to survive as long as possible or venture down to the first floor to uncover the mysterious events happening in the building. Each character has unique abilities, allowing them to solve puzzles and complete missions. If all four characters die, the game is over.

title: There's an Only One Way Exit.
description:
Dream is kindly illusion. Find the way to wake up, find the truth beneath the fog.

An interactive RPG game that you is someone who struck in the dream place, find the way to exit, true or lie this is no fault, it only meet the end.

title: Touhou The Excalibur: Mystic Arena of Reversal Spirits
Shepherd’s Plan
description: An office point-and-click puzzle game mixed with visual novel-style storytelling set in a noir-fabled world. As you are fired from the job, to save yourself from a collapsing dream, it’s time to investigate, discover the black company’s secrets, and take sweet revenge for the money you deserve.

title: Jigoku Train
description:
Waking up to an unfamiliar place, what course of action will you choose?

Play as Ling, your average office worker having her usual shifts and living her usual life, woke up on the train one night, finding that she was not going to head to her usual destinations.

Not only that, you will also play another character! He wakes up with no memories on a train heading towards an unknown location. Grant is your average amnesiac guy.

Where are they heading, and what can they do in order to head back home? Or is there even any way home?

title: Borrowed Book
description: Borrowed Book is a simple yet heavy-dialogue; psychological horror RPG Maker game on two microorganisms attempting to completing their chores for the librarian to get out from the library quickly.

title: Mary Had A Lost Lamb
description: Mary Had A Lost Lamb is a exploration psychological horror RPG Maker game on a microorganism who is finding her lamb. Do be aware this game is very dialogue heavy.

title: Twilight Horizon
description: A surreal sci-fi horror RPG. Play as two protagonists, trapped in two doomed realities. Uncover secrets, solve puzzles, and survive industrial nightmares in a haunting journey through the Twilight Zone.

title: Loneliness Butterfly
description:
Loneliness Butterfly marks the thrilling conclusion of Arachne's Anthology trilogy.

Picking up right after the events of Realm of Lament, this installment introduces Eddy Ruina, Feedra's wife and a lieutenant in Measuryville. Alerted by Penelope's email regarding Thomas's disappearance, Eddy joins the search. Their investigation leads them back to the events of Carnival, where they uncover the existence of the Soul Realm Gate, a potential path to Thomas. But is it truly that simple?

title: Adventure in Wachirawit World
description: In this game, you will go on an adventure in Wachirawit's world.

title: Gallium
description: A 3D platformer where you are being raced against the clock! Get the fastest time possible across all the elements in the Periodic Table of Elements while finding secrets! Keep a close eye for shortcuts though!

title: Escape from the Cursed Convent
description: Escape from the Cursed Convent is a narrative-driven adventure game set in a medieval girls' convent, offering a rich storytelling experience, and several gameplay styles including QTE, hunting, cooking, and puzzle-solving.

title: Cage: Story of Lust
description: The story of the love of a fallen angel with a beloved angel. You have to make him love you and make this world colorful again!!

title: De:Lithe Last Memories
description: "De:Lithe Last Memories" is a Rogue-like RPG game.

title: Charlie Charlie Challenge
description: A 1-4 player CO-OP horror game, you have come to try and banish a ghost, or is it a demon? At the end of your venture you will just be trying to escape.

title: Deadly Days: Roadtrip
description:
Deadly Days: Roadtrip is an exciting action roguelite, that combines reverse bullet hell gameplay with strategic inventory management.

Start your road trip through the zombie apocalypse! Fight your way through, gain experience and collect items to assemble an epic inventory.

Craft more effective weapons and find out what items you can combine to withstand the ever-increasing waves of zombies.

title: The Kantist
description:
The Kantist is an action-packed adventure 2D-Platformer.

Escape the testing facility and explore the deep and reaching vents of the lab to uncover its secrets. Use your abilities as a test subject to find new Zones, master minigames and befriend other test subjects.

title: A Shelter Full of Cats
description: A Shelter Full of Cats is a hidden object game set in a cat shelter specially designed for cats with special needs. Join the Shelter's manager, Hannah, as she prepares a charity party to help these cats find their forever homes. Let's show that love has no boundaries!

title: Chicken Strike: Cluck Ops
description:
In a world where chickens have had enough of being served up on platters, one fearless fowl rises to lead the resistance against the fast-food giant known as FCK. Welcome to "Chicken Strike: Cluck Ops", the action-packed adventure where feathers fly and the claws come out!

Take control of a courageous chicken armed to the beak with an arsenal of weapons, from egg launchers to poultry-powered rockets. Embark on an epic quest through a variety of vibrant environments, from bustling city streets to the heart of the FCK empire. Prepare for intense battles against waves of crispy adversaries, including Major Fanders.

Join the resistance, cluck up your courage, and embark on an egg-citing adventure to save chicken-kind from the clutches of the fast-food industry. It's time to show FCK who is the boss!

title: Half-Life 2: Aftermath
description: Half-Life 2: Aftermath is a singleplayer first-person shooter Half-Life 2 modification (mod), running on Source engine. This mod brings together content from the cancelled Half-Life 2: Episode Three, and Half-Life 2: Episode One, with more updates to come.

title: Dead Cells: The End Is Near
description: Dead Cells final new content update. It brings new mobs, weapons, mutations and biome effects all expanding on the curse mechanic, 40+ new head skins, almost 20 new legendary affixes, extra accessibility options and more.

title: Kong: Survivor Instinct
description: When giant monsters fight, no one’s safe. Embark on a thrilling quest of survival in a city that’s become a battleground for Titans. Use the lethal strength of Kong and other monsters to your own advantage in this official Monsterverse game set shortly after the events of Godzilla vs. Kong.

title: Fever Golf
description: This is a game about early 2000s bargain bin CD culture, that is, games that few people played & fewer remember. They were the last few digital artifacts that were allowed to fall into the quiet oblivion of history—the rear guard of an older era that pre-existed our current climate of perpetual distribution. This is a game for the MySimAquariam and MoonTycoons of the world; bottom-shelf junk-ware with a soul.

title: Read, Write, & Type
description: A game for kids following "Lefty" and "Righty" as they attempt to get back the letters than Victor the Virus stole. The game teaches kids how to read and type.

title: Love the Game
description:
Love the game is a semi-autoclicker unlockable type of game!
For every space button pressed over a passing civilian, your love meter increases. hit target goals to unlock wacky costumes and bonuses to help increase your love points.

title: Inside My Friend's Mind
description: An abstract adventure inside my friend's head. He inspires me and motivates me to move forward.

title: My First Date RPG: Elliot - Story Three
Hard Nut to Crack
description: Blast through 32 chaotic levels to rockin' MIDIs from 'round the net! These short but weird levels, inspired by powerful mappers like Sandy Petersen, Stanley Stasiak (Castle of Evil), and Greytale (DARKHELL.WAD), include a wide variety of challenges and themes.

title: Into Sandy's Cities
description:
Welcome to "Into Sandy's Cities". This MegaWAD shows what Doom 2 from an alternate universe might look like, with all 32 maps being made in the style of Sandy Petersen's original levels. And not just visually! Layouts, gimmicks, enemy placements, even all bugs, glitches, limitations and other quirks have been faithfully recreated.

This WAD doesn't distinguish between "good" or "bad", it just aims to recreate the original experience as accurately as possible, warts and all. It's a celebration of Doom 2, and a love letter to Petersen's design philosophy in particular.

title: The Talos Principle II: Deluxe Edition
description: The Deluxe Edition includes The Talos Principle 2 and Road to Elysium DLC.

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Khaos Reigns Kollection
description: New to Mortal Kombat 1? Get started with the Kollection Edition! Includes instant access to Base Game, Kombat Pack, and Dragon Krystals. Gain access to the upcoming Story Expansion and Kombat Pack 2!

title: Outbreak: Old School Collection
description: Brutally difficult retro survival horror nightmares await in this collection bursting at the seams with zombies and dinos!

title: Sam & Max: The Complete Trilogy
description: What's better than one Sam & Max season? Three Sam & Max seasons!

title: Bendy: Studio Collection
description: Survive and discover the mysteries of Joey Drew Studios in this dual collection of the popular Bendy franchise. Bendy: Studio Collection tells the story of Henry in Bendy and the Ink Machine and Audrey in Bendy and the Dark Revival. Find out what nightmares lie within the inky abyss of this classic animation studio.

title: The Things You Do For Love
description:
A dark romantic-comedy where you get to play as a hopeless yandere who is desperately trying to understand their newfound, romantic feelings all while taking down the competition.

Whether you decide to stalk your crush, eliminate your rivals, or make new friends, just go out there and win some love — no matter what, no matter how!

title: VirusRush + Hazard of the Ages
description: Face powerful bosses in a soulslike challenge amidst bullet hell! Each one will test your adaptability, skills, and strategic thinking, as you are fragile and will need to manage your stamina to dodge with your dash amidst intense, fast-paced action! To progress, you don't just need to defeat them but also master the combats to achieve the best rankings and obtain the stars needed to unlock more battles.

title: Dragon Ball Gekishin Squadra
description: This brand‑new title is a battle arena game that will divide players into teams of four and have them fight it out! You can take part in exhilarating battles where you overwhelm your opponents and enjoy amazing teamwork with your allies!

title: Witch & Fieriness
description:
Witch & Fieriness is an action-packed adventure beat-them-up game where you take on the role of "Flameryn," the Fire Witch, who embarks on a journey to find her lost sister, "Iceika." Armed with powerful magic, Flameryn can overcome all defensive and offensive obstacles.

However, despite her fiery prowess, Flameryn is vulnerable to sunlight! Players must navigate carefully and prioritize finding water sources to keep her cool and prevent her from being overwhelmed by the scorching rays.

title: Alice in Vivaldi's Four Seasons
description: Alice walks into a magical Music Clock dropped by the White Rabbit. But the clock is broken, and Alice is trapped inside!

title: ReSetna
description: ReSetna is a post-apocalyptic Metroidvania, in a crumbling world dominated by the APEX AI. As a mysterious Signal driving robots to madness emerges, ReSetna sets off on a journey to uncover the mystery. Explore, engage, evolve, navigating through the crumbling ruins of a once glorious civilization.

title: Nobk Overlay
description: Welcome to NOBK Overlay, the ultimate fruit-clicking adventure! Your task is simple: click on delicious, vibrant fruits to generate even more fruits. The more you click, the more your orchard grows, and the juicier your rewards become!

title: QuickBite Express
description: QuickBite Express is an ultra-dynamic platformer about the challenges of courier work. Deliver orders on time and undamaged across multiple cities to maintain your rating.

title: Eye of the Commando
description: A turnbased grid movement dungeon crawler with an 80s action movie theme. Players raid an island fortress of evil, fighting, exploring, gearing up, and solving puzzles.

title: Train Sim World 5
description: The Rails are Yours in Train Sim World 5! Take on new challenges and new roles as you master the tracks and trains of iconic cities across 3 new routes. Immerse yourself in the ultimate rail hobby and embark on your next journey.

title: Miku'n Pop
description: This game is stylized like an action platformer game from 80's - 90's. Your objective is to defeat all enemies on the screen. Each character has their own different play styles. Featuring 2 difficulty modes; Hard Mode & Easy Mode. There are 9 stages, & for each 10 levels, you will encounter a boss.

title: Payday 3: Chapter 3 - Houston Breakout
description:
Dallas found his brother, Houston, alive but not safe. On trial for a slew of charges, Houston is injured, about to be sentenced, and sent off to one of Concord’s private prisons, from which he’s bound never to reappear.

Whether you break him out silently or go in guns blazing is up to you, either way, we’re getting our man out.

title: Banana & Cucumber
description: Banana & Cucumber is a clicker Game, in which you click a Banana & Cucumber! In Banana & Cucumber you click the Banana & Cucumber to gain even more Banana & Cucumber!

title: Car Clicker
description: Car Clicker is a clicker Game, in which you click a Car! In Car you click the Car to gain even more Cars! Every 1 and 18 hours, you get dropped a car. Each cars is also made by the community in discord. Come hang out with us and let's grow into something awesome !

title: Clothing
description: Clothing is a clicker Game, in which you click a Clothing! In Clothing you click the Clothing to gain even more Clothings! Every 1 and 18 hours, you get dropped a clothing. Each clothings is also made by the community in discord. Come hang out with us and let's grow into something awesome !

title: Box Clicker
description: Box Clicker is a game in which you break Boxes to get more Boxes. And that's just the beginning!

title: Sniper Elite: Resistance
description: Offering unparalleled sniping mechanics, stealth and tactical third-person combat, Sniper Elite: Resistance turns the attention of the award-winning series towards a hidden war, far from the front lines, deep within the heart of occupied France.

title: RoadCraft
description: As the leader of a company specialized in restoring sites devastated by natural disasters, use your construction machinery to restart the local industry. Clear debris and faulty equipment, rebuild roads and bridges damaged by weather, and much more!

title: Tapple: Idle Clicker
description: Welcome to Tapple, the idle clicker game where every tap brings you closer to an ever-growing collection of Tapples. Build your empire one tap at a time, discover unique Tapple drops, and experience the rewarding gameplay that keeps you coming back for more.

title: We Harvest Shadows
description: A first-person farming horror allegory. Become a recluse, build up your farm, and survive the lonely nights.

title: Honey Peach Clicker
description: Honey Peach Clicker is a Clicker game, which you can keep click the honey peach to Relieves stress. And also, Honey Peach Coin (HPC) will drop after a period of time while the game runing. HPC can be used to exchange special items to Enrich your community inventory collection!

title: Revenge of the Savage Planet
description: Revenge of the Savage Planet is an upbeat, satirical action adventure Sci-Fi. Jump, shoot and collect your way across vibrant alien worlds, uncovering new gear and upgrades, while discovering various hidden secrets.

title: Pizza Clicker
description: PIZZA CLICKER. You get dropped a pizza every 2 hours 5 times per day. Your chance to try every kind of pizza in the world and share it with friends!

title: Banana Monkeys
description: Banana Monkeys: The Ultimate Monkey Collection.Dive into the enchanting world of Banana Monkeys, where you collect whimsical, quirky monkeys every 3 hours and share the fun with friends through trading and exciting events. Join a vibrant community of collectors!

title: Borderlands 4
description: See if you have what it takes to go down in history as a legendary Vault Hunter as you search for secret alien treasure, blasting everything in sight.

title: Meh
description: Meh is a game where you click on a computer to earn random computers from time to time. Collect them all!

title: Melon
description: Click the melon! Check out discord for more info and news.

title: Raspberry
description: Raspberry is a simple and fun way to collect and trade raspberries with others. Most importantly to declare war on the evil banana's!

title: Goat Simulator: Remastered
description: Goat Simulator Remastered is the latest in goat simulation technology. Your favorite chaotic sandbox is back and more beautiful than ever, with updated graphics, every DLC, and more bugs that you can shake a goat at. WASD to rewrite history.

title: Dying Light: The Beast
description: Dying Light: The Beast Restored Land is a new enhanced version of the game that includes the base game, all previously released updates and the premiere Restored Land content in one package. This includes Legend Levels, New Game+, Ray Tracing, Nightmare Mode, dozens of new brutal finishers, hundreds of parkour and gameplay improvements, and numerous visual and audio enhancements - delivering new ways to experience the apocalypse.

title: Eggz: Collectible Eggs Clicker
description: Click on the Egg: after 100 clicks, the egg will crack open, and you'll unlock a unique skin. Collect all the skins and become the master of eggs! Unlock legendary skins and enrich your collection!

title: King of Meat
description:
King of Meat is a co-op party platformer, pitting up to 4 players against devious dungeons filled with puzzles to solve, challenges to traverse, and ridiculous monsters to fight.

Progress through official and community-built dungeons to unlock new abilities and gear on your way to becoming the ultimate contender!

title: Lynked: Banner of the Spark
description: Team-up, brawl and build in this co-op action game that blends hack and slash combat with roguelite-inspired missions and town-building progression that goes beyond the run! Unlock and upgrade gear, rescue robot allies, and lead the resistance against the world-dominating Combots!

title: Bananamana
description: Bananamana is a clicker Game

title: Butt
description:
This is a game about collecting butt.
You click butt, you get butt. Sometimes a little, sometimes a lot.

title: Ducks
description: Enter the universe of NFDs (Non-Fungible Ducks)! Click the duck and earn more ducks. Collect as many limited edition and rare ducks as you can!

title: Pickle
description: Pickle is a clicker game, click to win new styles of pickles! Let's start clicking!

title: Reanimal
description: The creators of Little Nightmares I & II have returned to take you on a darker, more terrifying journey than ever before. In this horror adventure game, a brother & sister go through hell to rescue their missing friends and escape the island that they used to call home.

title: Masters of Mayhem
description: Masters of Mayhem is a free-to-play social deduction game with roguelike twists for 4–15 players. Work together to restore abandoned facilities and contain terrifying monsters — unless you're an impostor, in which case… have fun unleashing mayhem!

title: Starfield: Rev-8
description:
This update added the REV-8 land vehicle, available after installing a vehicle module. It is an armored vehicle with a mounted turret and boosters that will be automatically deployed outside your ship wherever you land.

Along with the general fixes and improvements for the game, this update also included new Xbox Series S display settings to mirror the existing Xbox Series X settings with frame rate targets, Visual or Performance priority options and a VSync toggle.

title: A Shrimpful Adventure
description:
A Shrimpful Adventure is a free short 2D puzzle-platformer developed in under four days for GMTK 2024 by a small team with minimal game development experience.

"Two shrimps, a father and a child, embark on an adventure in search of treasure."

title: Herdling
description: Guide a herd of mysterious creatures on a stirring and beautiful journey into the mountains… and beyond.

title: Masters of Albion
description: In Masters of Albion, shape a living world as a god - or step into it and experience it through your people. Build, guide and defend your town by day, then survive the night when everything is under threat. There is no single solution. Only yours.

title: Floatopia
description: Discover all the beloved elements of life simulation games—farming, fishing, logging, and decorating your dream home. With a sprinkle of magic to sweep away your worries, set sail on your very own floating island and journey through a world of superpowers!

title: Mafia: The Old Country
description:
Mafia: The Old Country is a third-person action-adventure game set in early 1900s Sicily. It follows Enzo Favara, a former forced laborer who joins the Torrisi crime family in search of a better life and becomes involved in the violent world of organized crime.

The game follows a linear narrative structure and combines gunfights, knife combat, stealth, and exploration. Enzo travels across Sicilian towns and countryside on foot, horseback, and in period automobiles while carrying out assignments for the Torrisi family.

title: Dave the Diver: Potion Craft
description: Dave the Diver: Balatro is a DLC that adds content themed around the management simulation game Potion Craft.

title: Dave the Diver: Balatro
description: Dave the Diver: Balatro is a DLC that adds content themed around the poker-themed roguelike deck-building game Balatro.

title: Dave the Diver: Mxmtoon
description: Dave the Diver: Mxmtoon is a DLC that adds content themed around the American singer-songwriter and YouTuber mxmtoon.

title: Retrojam I
description: Map-Center's first endeavor into Quake 1 mapping. Features 24 new classic Quake maps.

title: Journey to the Centre of Nirn
description:
Follow in the steps of a famous explorer as you follow the clues to the location of a long lost city.
Travel through vast magma chambers and dark caverns solving puzzles, riddles and intriguing mazes before finally discovering the fate of a lost Ayleid city.

title: Pip My Dice
description: Pip My Dice is a Yahtzee Roguelike experience. Score enough to make it to the next round, customize your dice to score more and collect relics to create game-breaking combos. Climb the leaderboards and enjoy a different run every time!

title: Burger Kombat
description: Assemble your most expensive burger from whatever you can find in the kitchen.

title: Kawaii Slime
description: An idle/clicker game where the player collects slime inventory items over time. Slimes can vary from size, color, shape, and rarity. Some limited slimes maybe released during certain times of the year for a short time so be sure to stay alert for new announcements.

title: Ciggy World
description: Ciggy World is a clicker game where you click on a cigarette to earn rewards! In Ciggy World, every click brings you closer to a treasure trove of drops, or butts.

title: Labyrinth of Eclipse
description:
Arcade style roguelite where you fight demons an angels to try to stop a cults leader from ascending to god hood.

Made for the 2023 1 bit gamejam

title: Coconut
description: Welcome to Coconut! ✨ Dive into the ultimate coconut-clicking frenzy where the fun never stops. Ready to get your click on?

title: Pets
description: PETS is a platformer puzzle game. You will cross different dimensions and go through the maze, find your dogge.

title: Letters
description: Letters is a clicker game where you click a letter to get more letters! Every 3 hours you can get 4 common letters, Every 5 hours you can get 2 uncommon letters and every 24 hours you get a rare letter.

title: Phat Phrog Clicker
description: Join the community of Phat Phrog Clicker enthusiasts today and become the ultimate cute creature collector! Earn 28 unique Steam inventory skins, dropping every 30 minutes of gameplay. These skins can be traded or sold on the Steam Marketplace. Can you collect them all?

title: Coin
description: Invest in ChadCoin by simply clicking! In ChadCoin, you click the Coin to gain even more Coins! Get a random coin every time you click enough and grow your collection!

title: Weeb
description: Weeb is a Anime Clicker game where you will gather new friends to your collection.

title: Banana Gine
description: Banagine is a clicker game. There is a banana and there is an aubergine. So, this is a Banagine. Click to Banagine and count more Banagine. Because everyone loves Banagine!

title: Lemon
description: Welcome to Lemon, the clicker game more addictive than cat videos! Click your way to Lemon glory, gathering Lemons faster than you can say "Lemon counter." Unlock mysterious inventory drops with golden Lemons, magic Lemons. Dive in and may the Lemons be ever in your favor!

title: Idle Kitties Online
description: Welcome to Idle Kitties Online! This is a free game with relaxing gameplay where you can collect cute kitties alone or with friends.

title: The Apple
description: The Apple is a clicker game where you click on the apple to increase your score.

title: Poop
description: Poop is an idle-clicker game where you click poop to get more poop

title: Befriended Curse
description: Witches, curses, and fairy tales meet horror in this classic walking sim with an eerie atmosphere and well-paced jumpscares.

title: Bloons Card Storm
description: A turn-based collectible card game set in the Bloons universe.

title: Gravelord
description: Gravelord is a fast-paced boomer shooter voiced by a badass protagonist featuring hand-crafted levels filled with secrets and hordes of enemies to kill. Dish out some brutal carnage with powerful guns and collect Tarot Cards to gain even more killing power. Let's put the fun back in funeral!

title: Payday 3: Chapter 2 - Boys in Blue
description:
What would you do if some corrupt cops raided your completely legitimate business, planted some evidence, and showed every sign of wanting to keep the gold they “confiscated”? Well, in Vlad’s case, he got in touch with his old friends in the Payday Gang to enact revenge and get his damn gold back.
The Boys in Blue Heist tasks the gang with breaking into a secure holding facility of the NYPD on Vlad’s behalf. He wants his gold back, and the gang has never let him down before.

title: Eldritch Empathy
description: Learn the language of a cosmic colossus in the Lovecraftian rogue-lite Eldritch Empathy. Study eerie horrors to learn their secrets, or destroy them and face the consequences. Your choices determine the fate of humanity.

title: Orange: The Annoying Clicker
description: Orange is a spiritual successor to certain phallic fruit clicker Game, in which you click an Orange, only a little bit more annoying *wink*! All you have to do is click the Orange! No Drama No Stress

title: Mindfall
description: "MINDFALL" is a tense first-person psychological horror game that explores the depths of the human mind and its struggle with the unknown.

title: The Hamster
description: Welcome to "The Hamster" – a fun and relaxing clicker game where you collect unique skins for your adorable hamster. Earn points, unlock new skins, and enjoy the simple yet captivating gameplay. Perfect for those looking for a light and enjoyable gaming experience.

title: Crazy Corn
description: Crazy Corn is an addictive clicker game where your clicking skills can lead you to unimaginable riches! Improve your level, automate your income and unlock new items.

title: Tiny Dino: Royale
description: Can you avoid extinction in Tiny Dino: Royale? A new genre bending clicker game where you compete with players to see who can survive the longest. Collect unique dino skins that can be used to craft rare rewards, climb the leaderboards, and find out how many ways you can destroy asteroids.

title: Watermelon
description: "Watermelon" is a gamAn interesting and unusual clicker game in which you need to level up!

title: Bertha Butt's Boogie
description: Made for the June 2013 Monthly AGS competition. Bertha wants to win a dance contest, and needs her family's help to win.

title: Have Your Monster
description: An experimental interactive poem about toxic lesbians ripping each other apart, under 800 words with 2 outcomes

title: Chronicon: Survivors
description: Fight a mix of familiar and new dangerous foes in this fast paced horde survival game! Upgrade your weapons, unlock new items & characters, advance in the permanent passive skill tree, and try to survive the horde! Based off the ARPG Chronicon by the same developer.

title: Alys vs. the Phantom Feline Foe
description: An adventure game in the style of an early 90's Sierra adventure with a lewd twist! Alys is trapped in Bizarro World. Help her escape or she shall be trapped forever as the unwilling sex slave of Ignatius Cat, the Phantom Feline Foe.

title: In Search Of You
description: Rekindle the exhilarating sensation of youthful passion—to perfectly capture the essence of romantic endeavors, making the experience of falling in love both sweet and meaningful, and to inspire players with the beauty of love within the nightlife entertainment industry.

title: Dreamlike Love with Seira
description: Enjoy the memories with a beautiful maid in your dreams and heal your fatigue in reality.

title: Las gafas nuevas del yayo Carmelo
description:
Josemi's grandfather has been fitted with new glasses that make his eyes huge and, apparently, these glasses allow him to see far away.
A very short interactive fiction about a summer afternoon between a grandfather and a grandson.

title: Diablo IV: Season of Hatred Rising
description:
Mephisto’s hatred has spread far and wide, creating nightmarish monstrosities to roam the land and reinstilling a sense of dread in the hearts of Sanctuary’s denizens. No one and nowhere is safe from the Lord of Hatred’s maddening influence, not even you.

Stand against encroaching hatred with fearsome new power in Diablo’s latest major update. Experience updated progression systems, more levels, gain all-new skills, discover new items, grow your glyphs to a new legendary level, and test your mettle in new difficulty levels that reward the most daring. Seek out and take down the Realmwalkers and explore the Seething Realms. Unite with allies via Party Finder and save Sanctuary from the relentless tide of Mephisto’s corruption.

title: Let's Build a Dungeon
description: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

title: Forza Motorsport: 1969 Chevrolet Camaro Jordan Luka 3
Forza Horizon 5: 1969 Chevrolet Camaro Jordan Luka 3
Stellarcraft
description: Stellarcraft is a captivating sci-fi tower defense game that delves deep into the vast expanses of the universe, offering players the opportunity to explore planets, gather resources, and defend against numerous threats.

title: Dungeons of Dreadrock 2: The Dead King´s Secret
description: Dungeons of Dreadrock - The Dead King's Secret is Part 2 of the (yet unfinished) Dreadrock Trilogy. In this episode you'll puzzle and fight your way through the ancient cavern parts of Dreadrock Mountain. The game features 100 levels, 5 bosses, two different endings and tons of adorable pixel art.

title: Bauhaus Bonk
description: In this single-player game of skill, the movement is not straightforward. Switch between pivot points to maneuver your way through Bauhaus art-inspired arcade levels. Avoid obstacles, reach the goal and beat the high score!

title: The Games You Make
description: “Quit your job, take out a loan and make a top seller game” sounded like a great idea two months ago. Now, you’re chasing bizarre bugs, combining features that should never go together, and striving to capture that mysterious thing called “fun”. Every decision is yours—and so are the consequences.

title: Hamster Combat
description: Hamster Clicker is a clicker game about collecting hamsters! Every 3 and 18 hours, you get dropped a chest with hamsters!

title: Warhammer: Vermintide 2 - Versus
description: Versus is a free game mode* providing an entirely new way to play Warhammer: Vermintide 2. Engage in thrilling 4v4 battles, alternating between the Five Heroes of Vermintide and the Skaven Ratmen, all set against the backdrop of the rich Warhammer Fantasy Universe.

title: Pizzeria
description: Click to eat delicious pizzas, buy powerful upgrades, and become the ultimate pizza master. Seek out exclusive drops to make your collection unique. Can you get them all? Start clicking now and rise to pizza greatness!

title: Banana Cat
description: Banana Cat is a simple clicker in which you click a “catnana” (a fusion from a cat and a banana). If you wait a specific amount of hours you’ll obtain cat bananas, some cat bananas will also be drawn by YOU in our discord server. What are you waiting for? Come and click banana cats with us!

title: Mob Trader
description: Poke the dungeon and stick around to see what comes out! Every 60 minutes you will receive a tradeable mob in the form of a Steam Item. Grow an impressive collection of unique mobs to show off and trade with other players on the Steam Market!

title: Apple Clicker
description: Easy clicker game for apple enjoyers!

title: Adventure in XX City 2: Finding BB
description: Fangame for the "Anthology of the Killer" series

title: Fruits
description: You get a fruit every fixed hours of game time, each fruit is different it ranges from rarity, fruit and a multiplier to your basket clicking. You can also chop any unwanted fruit into fruit bits and use those to craft another fruit Each fruits and bits can be traded and sold.

title: Giraffe
description: Welcome to the world of Giraffe Clicker – an addictive clicker game where every click brings you closer to a new giraffe! Tap the screen, earn points, and collect rare and unique giraffes, each with its own special traits and abilities.

title: Mars Attracts
description: Mars Attracts is a park management sim set in the iconic universe of Mars Attacks. Build rides, hire staff, manage guest needs, and abduct humans to serve as the star attractions. You'll face demanding visitors, environmental hazards, and the ever-looming threat of human escapes!

title: Croak?
description: This is an idle game that places numerous frog tanks on your desktop. Just let it run, and your screen will be filled with ugly yet adorable frogs!

title: Will: Follow the Light
description: Dive into a realistic, single-player, first-person journey through the harsh northern latitudes as you sail endless waters, searching for a way back to your loved ones. Will you follow the light?

title: Rogue Waters
description: Rogue Waters is a tactical turn-based rogue-lite in a cursed pirate world. Build a fierce crew of rogues and form alliances with mythical creatures as you navigate an ever-changing world and master combat on land and sea. The crew and the Kraken await your command—will you heed the call?

title: Dfuse
description: FPS meets MOBA in DFUSE’s adrenaline-fueled mashup. Wield realistic military tools and outsmart your rivals in quick-fire matches that blend strategic depth with adrenaline-pumping action. Plant the bomb, secure the defusal, or dominate the battlefield.

title: Faaast Penguin
description: "Faaast Penguin" is an action-packed racing game where up to 40 penguins compete in a chaotic race to the finish. Players can unleash attacks, ride on ultimate rides, use shortcuts, and outpace rivals to reach the finish line first.

title: Maui The Shapeshifter
description: Play as Maui the demigod in an adventure to save his island home from a darkness that threatens to consume it. Transform into majestic animals, meet spirit Aumakua, explore unique biomes, face epic bosses, and defeat nefarious enemies in this epic hand-painted 2D open world Metroidvania.

title: Echoes of Mystralia
description: Mages of Mystralia's award-winning spellcrafting system enters a new era. Free Mystralia from the Shadows of the Past in this action-RPG roguelite. Create an infinite variety of spells to save the Memory of the World.

title: Nightmare House: Reimagined
description: No sleeping beyond this point. Escape a waking nightmare in this classic survival horror experience. She's waiting for you.

title: God Save Birmingham
description: Doom has come to Birmingham, and you are the last soul alive. Survive an undead plague in a painstakingly recreated medieval market town. Manage your needs, master physics-based mechanics, and evade the horde for as long as you can.

title: Banana 2: Fruit
description: Bop your banana.

title: Wilmot Works It Out
description: Wilmot Works It Out is a puzzle building game about completing beautiful images and using them to decorate the walls of your house.

title: Egg Surprise
description: A fun clicker with economic simulation in the penguin kingdom. Obtain rare collections, venture into dangerous dungeons, and build your own civilization!

title: Blackthorn Arena: Reforged
description: Re-experience the thrill and challenges of managing a Gladiator arena in this management/simulation game. With new content with over 10 hours of gameplay, new graphics, Quality of Life updates, and all DLCs packed into this new experience, this is how Blackthorn Arena was meant to be experienced.

title: Huaxia: Warring States
description: Build your own epic story in the Huaxia: Warring States. Start a clan, conquer the lands, and build an empire. Or roam the Nine Provinces as a lone warrior fighting bandits and monsters. The choice is yours!

title: Doom: The Golden Souls 3
description: Explore giant colorful worlds while completing quests to obtain Golden Souls! You can fully explore the maps at your own pace, and even experience completed missions again!

title: Endoparasitic 2
description: Three limbs ripped off, infected with a deadly parasite, you must survive. Drag yourself through the hallways of an infested arcship, fight off twisted eldritch creatures, craft vaccines and ammunition, and escape to civilization.

title: Lost Ember: Rekindled Edition
description:
The remastered edition of the acclaimed adventure features 4k, HDR, and overall improved graphics powered by Unreal Engine 5. Apart from the visual improvements, it includes a brand-new Free Roam mode with a new open world spreading over several biomes that includes all playable animals and new mini-challenges!

Owners of the original game will be able to upgrade for a small upgrade fee!

A breathtakingly beautiful world holds the secrets of its past for you and your companion to uncover in this 5-hour journey.

title: DigDigDrill
description: DigDigDrill is an underground mining and resource collecting game. Dig freely for minerals and treasures. Use the items you collect to forge your original drills in a hack-and-slash style equipment system.

title: Warriors of Nova Thera
description: Warriors of Nova Thera is a roguelike action-adventure where you play as Pixelmons! Explore and battle your way through the different biomes and discover exciting encounters. Collect shardstones from your expeditions out into the wild and use them back in the game hub to unlock upgrades and become stronger.

title: SubwaySim 2
description:
Dive into Simuverse Interactive's new public transport simulation!
SubwaySim 2 allows you to explore not only the underground network of Hamburg but now also that of the German capital Berlin! Face various unique scenarios and transport your passengers safely and punctually from station to station.

title: Galactic Economy
description: Can you become a leader in the Galactic Economy? Buy spaceships and spacestations on you way to get some additional income. Roll the dice and see what you can achieve in this board game.

title: Hoomanz!
description:
Scare away all the invading Hoomanz!
A stealth-adventure packed with coziness and humour, featuring non-combat gameplay & family-friendly content. Play as Shoo, the mythical guardian of Planet Erf, with a hidden dual nature. Darkness is nature’s friend, light is its enemy.

title: Sigilfarer
description: Sigilfarer is a roguelite adventure where every decision rests on the roll of your dice. Master a dice-building system while navigating a sprawling, procedurally generated world. Strategize your route, manage resources and push your luck to the limit!

title: Kinu Shoku Ryuu Hana: Weaving The Blue Orient
description: Kinu Shoku Ryuu Hana is another Touhou shooting game which is, unfortunately, not very popular due to lack of publicity. With standard gameplay, the gameplay mechanics rely on 2 features: spell card system and spark counter, with the spell card system the player may choose 2 of 7 different spell cards before embarking on a mission. The spark counter consumes magic gauge and is basically very similar to a bomb that will fire lasers to eliminate enemies and bullets. The game's story is around Marisa who is investigating magic fluctuations.

title: Hela: Of Mice & Magic
description: See the world through the eyes of a brave little mouse in this enchanting 3D co-op adventure. Explore breathtaking landscapes inspired by Northern Sweden, solve puzzles, and be a force for good in a land where heartwarming storytelling and the beauty of nature intertwine.

title: Micro Wars
description: Micro Wars is a fast-paced real time strategy game that throws you into the action in short, intense online battles featuring up to 8 players. Tailor your strategy with a variety of commanders and units, build your base, mine some minerals, and micro your way to victory. Hone your skills with the campaign and custom maps, and demonstrate your prowess to climb the ranks!

title: Tony Hawk's Underground 2: The Shell Secret
Tony Hawk's Underground 2: Wuhu Island from Mario Kart 7
WinDepth
description:
WinDepth is a Windows game developed by the Japanese freeware group Bio_100%. It’s an arrangement of the 1992 shooting game SuperDepth (originally for PC-9801) for Windows.
In WinDepth, players control a warship moving on the water’s surface while countless submarines lurk underwater. The objective is to destroy the submarines while avoiding their torpedoes and mines.

title: Sports: Renovations
description: Give sports facilities a second life in this relaxing first-person simulator! Restore the glory of old gyms, courts and pitches as you try to make enough money to save your hometown basketball court.

title: Half-Life 2: Game of the Year Edition
description:
The critics agree, Half-Life 2 has been named PC GAME OF THE YEAR by over 35 organizations worldwide. Play the game that set a new benchmark in gaming with its startling realism, digital actors, advanced AI, and physical gameplay.

+ Also Includes:
Counter-Strike: Source
Half-Life 2: Deathmatch
Half-Life: Source

title: Park Ranger Simulator
description: Manage your own park facility in a huge open world in Park Ranger Simulator. Take on all the tasks that need to be completed as a park ranger - alone or together in cross-platform multiplayer! You have a variety of vehicles and equipment at your disposal to complete the challenges ahead!

title: Hexahedral
description: Hexahedral is a cuboid, challeging, 3D platformer, physics based, puzzle game with specific mechanics and surreal atmosphere, where you need to understand how your movement works and use your abilities to your favor to reach as high as you can. This game is intentionally difficult and confusing at some points, though the mechanics are pretty simple, once you learn how to move propperly, you will notice it isn't enough for you to overcome it, you must as well have patience and be persistent, then you may be able to reach the end. This journey depends completly on you, so don't give up, and remember, it can always get worse.

title: Slimey Climbey Chambers
description:
Help Sobay the Slime get out of this strange tile maze! Use goop to propel yourself to new heights, and gain new forms and abilities by collecting the mega slime essence!

Made for the GMTK 2024 Jam in 96 hours, for the theme "Built to Scale!"

title: Terminal City
description:
What if you took 80s adventure games like Space Quest, crossed them with auto-runners like Canabalt and threw in a dash of Another World?

You'll need all your wits, cunning, and typing skills to make it in TERMINAL CITY, as you guide street-kid V-Loc on his quest to evade the evil Syndicate corpos and rescue his friends.

In a world of instant-deaths, no checkpoints and dead ends, how far will YOU get?

title: The Strawman Augment
description: A game made within a month with Adventure Game Studio

title: The Last Scaler
description: A Foddyvania, where you build yourself up from scrap, collect new abilities, and scale a sacred mountain.

title: Mario Doom
description: Mario Doom is an awesome unofficial mod of Doom created by Valigarmander that runs in Zandronum and GZDoom. A port running on Vanilla Doom was later made by Doomkid. The Mod acts as a texture pack replacing enemy and gun sprites alongside sound effects and animations. Since it is vanilla-compatible, it will run with any port, including the 2024 release of Doom on PS5, Switch, and Xbox.

title: Horizons: The End Of Words
description: Humanity has written all there is to write about anything and everything. Words will soon lose all meaning. Find fragments of lost words drifting in space and explore the universe through your prose.

title: Luggage Lane
description: Luggage Lane is an action-packed game where you take on the role of a check-in agent named Lane who has to work a shift alone. Your goal is to process luggage as fast as you can on 3 check-in desks.

title: Tokyo Xtreme Racer
description:
Countless souls wander the ring road at night.
The title of “fastest” never fades, no matter how times change.

The stage of battle is a sealed future Tokyo.
Race through the night highways weaving through the city in your customized machine.
Defeat the countless rivals and aim to become the fastest on the Shuto Expressway.

title: Lost in Random: The Eternal Die
description: Lost in Random: The Eternal Die is an action-packed, rogue-lite adventure in the world of Random. Play as Queen Aleksandra and wield her living die-companion Fortune, as they go all in against the ancient evil that took everything from her.

title: Musicmenia
description: Musicmenia is a strategic and musical card game. Face off online against other players, build your deck, and adapt your strategy to win. Adjust the tempo and lead your concert to victory!

title: The First Descendant: Season 1
description:
Step into the action in The First Descendant’s thrilling Season 1 Update: Invasion starting August 29th!
Tackle new dungeons, unlock fresh content, and play as Hailey, the new sniper Descendant.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator: World Update 18
description: World Update XVIII provides pilots the highest resolution yet for the stunning scenery of Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

title: Box Bop
description: Box Bop is a simple game where you just get to tinker and play with funny physics with boxes and spheres and stuff in a ball pit. Just made as a fun little tinker game...?

title: Mightreya
description: Join schoolgirl superhero Reya and her manager Nio as they embark on their journey as Hero Content Creators, fighting monstrous beings that emerge daily from a dimension beyond. Anime-inspired, heart-pounding hero action is waiting for you!

title: FNF Weekly
description: A new FNF mod every single week? You must be tweaking, boss!

title: NHL 25
description: From the modernized skating of Next-Gen Vision Control and an overhaul of Chel’s AI player movement to authentic Reactive Action animations — experience true hockey intelligence.

title: 13th Friday Night: Funk Blood
description: Boyfriend and Girlfriend have decided to join up few campers for a camping trip, while hanging out by themselves they decided to have some fun, but unknown to them they have entered the forbidden territory and their presence has reawakened the dormant killer.

title: Sonic Legacy
description: Sonic Legacy was a fan-made game collection celebrating the 25th anniversary of Sonic the Hedgehog. It included HD remasters of classic titles such as Sonic Adventure, Sonic Adventure 2, Sonic Heroes, Sonic the Hedgehog (2006), Sonic Free Riders, and Sonic Boom: Rise of Lyric. The game also features bonus content like playable Amy and Knuckles in Sonic CD, and special stages from Sonic 3 and Knuckles in Sonic 2.

title: Lysium: Stardiver
description: In the distant rings of the planet Alphios, rookie mechanic Samantha Krain takes her first careful steps into the field as an official member of a crew of misfit space salvagers. When a huge salvage mission turns up on the surface of the planet, however, the race is on as opportunity calls to be the first one to reach a trove of technology. Is it fortune smiling upon the intrepid explorers, or is treachery leering from the shadows...?

title: FNF: Executable Mania
description: FNF: EXEcutable Mania was a Friday Night Funkin' creepypasta mod created by danii. The mod planned to star several EXEs and internet horrors in a grab bag fashion. It has 7 songs on its demo, with more planned on its full release.

title: Friday Night Funkin' vs. LSE
description:
Vs. LongestSoloEver is a Friday Night Funkin' Mod featuring YouTube guitarist LongestSoloEver, with all new original music, artwork, charting, remixes and more.

The full week features five songs, and two "mania mode" remixes.

title: Una noche sin nombre
description: This is a world where witches and demons dwell on the fringes of reality. Charles finds himself in the rain, seeking shelter when he encounters a woman in the forest who asks him for a favor—to search for something very precious to her. At that moment, Charles finds a house and ventures inside, where he encounters a mysterious girl.

title: Friday Night Funkin': vs. Hex
description: What's this? Your Girlfriend's father is making an award show and you're invited? Seems like nothing can go wrong! Besides that, a familiar face appears. It's Hex! Your robotic lookin' fella from before seems to have a performance scheduled during the event and he asks for your help. With the whole country watching you, people you fought before, and your Girlfriend, there's no way you could lose!

title: FNF: V.S. Tabi Ex Boyfriend
description: Your girlfriend, invited by her dad's friend for some unknown reason, asks you to come along with her. When you arrive at the place, there was no one, except for one weird guy that scared your girlfriend out. Will everything go well or is something bad going to happend

title: Pharaoh's Purse
description: An economy focused tower defense where you play as an Egyptian pharaoh seeking to reclaim his lost wealth in modern times.

title: Payday 3: Gold Pass
description: The Payday 3 Gold Pass includes all four Year 1 Expansions - Syntax Error, Boys in Blue, Houston Breakout, and Fear and Greed - as well as some special bonus content.

title: Payday 3: Houston Breakout Heist
description:
Houston is on trial for a slew of crimes, and Concord is lurking behind the scenes, waiting to snap him up the second the sentence is rendered.

Whether you sneak your way through and pass without trace, or smash your way through the judiciary system with your own brand of justice is your choice; either way, Houston has a problem, and it’s your job to solve it.

title: Shapez 2: Supporter Edition
description:
Show your support and get two unique rollercoaster inspired track pieces for your space railways, plus 40 minutes of additional music and the full soundtrack!

Rollercoaster Railway Pieces
Use the Twist and the Loop to add some rollercoaster flair to your railway lines!

Additional Music
Unlock additional 40 minutes of in-game music from the composer of the original shapez soundtrack, Petter Sumelius, with some tracks by Patrik Pettersson.
Official Soundtrack

The upgrade includes access to the full soundtrack, including the base game music and the additional music for a total of 80 minutes sci-fi inspired electronic music, keeping the essence of the original shapez sound while adding a touch of space to fit the new theme. High quality FLAC versions of every track are included.

title: Monster High Skulltimate Secrets
description: It’s your first day at Monster High, where all monsters are welcome… but some strange events are happening. Can you uncover the mystery of the doors and ancient keys and bring the school back to its authentic, spooky self? Play and discover its skulltimate secrets. Create your unique monster character with a vault full of different monster kinds, skills, and scary-chic looks to choose from. Explore the school with your beasties Clawdeen Wolf, Draculaura, and Frankie Stein, and find creeperific clues and powerful new skills. As the newest member of the Boo Crew, you’re in for one hex-citing adventure!

title: AAA Clock 2
description:
In a world where most clocks are either boring or colorless, AAA Clock 2 is going to change everything.

This autumn AAA Clock will prove once again that sequels can be just as extraordinary as the originals. Customize your clock and set up alarms in this engaging clock experience.

There is more! Sink into the built in platformer game Jelly&Vulca. A continuation of the game first introduced in the original AAA Clock. Customize your character and set out on an epic adventure.

title: AAA Clock 2: Color Set 2
description:
Add more colors to your clock with the new AAA Clock 2 DLC.
Choose dark blue, orange or cyan.

title: Troy: The Red Winged Hero
description: Play as Liam Newguard in a Item-Turn Based RPG game about weird things nobody asked for. Run through many locations finding new skills and spells for each of your party member's two classes. Enjoy well over 15 hours of gameplay/story in this conglomerate of inspirations I created for thee.

title: Subway Surge
description: Subway Surge is a fun endless runner game featuring pirate heroes. Navigate using your mouse, and collect gold coins by running, jumping, and sliding. Help the pirates gather all the gold!

title: Weird O's: Chaos Royale
description: Dive, dodge, and dash your way to victory in the wildest fantasy brawl! Weird O's: Chaos Royale is a 3D platforming battle royale like no other, blending hilarious co-op exploration with chaotic free-for-alls. Team up to gather crystals, unleash your animal spirit and conquer wacky obstacle courses.

title: Dead Detention (Rescribbled)
description: Dead Detention is a scribbly interactive story about a nerdy teen turned dooms day survivor! Play as 15 year old Max as he tries to escape his high school during a deadly zombie pandemic! Will he and his new friends get to safety?!

title: Cursebane
description: Cursebane is a fast-paced, stylish katana-action roguelite. Step into the forest of fate, where your choices twist your journey. Empower your sword and spells as you seek out those doomed by prophecy and save them from the Curse.

title: Clutter
description: The first un-hidden object game in the long running Clutter series of PC games

title: The Pyrite Talisman
description: The Pyrite Talisman is a 3D graphic adventure involving exploration in third person direct movement, puzzle solving and inventory use through a point & click interface. During gameplay the player will play with two characters switching through time to collect informations to progress further into the story.

title: Rubber Head Bob
description: It's a mountain climbing game with a rubber-headed human! The controls are incredibly challenging! Bounce around like crazy!

title: Snow Wave Community Project
description: Snow Wave Community project is Christmas holiday project that ran from 2023 November to January 2024. Initially, there were 21 levels submitted, but for undisclosed reasons, it became 20 levels pack. Difficulty goes from easy to really hard, use difficulty skills provided if you find set too hard to manage!

title: Block Factory
description: Block Factory is a production and automation game focusing on creating 3D figurines from building blocks in a factory. Shape your models, design and optimize your assembly lines to bring your creations to life!

title: Heroes of Might & Magic: Olden Era
description: Heroes of Might & Magic: Olden Era is the official prequel hailing back to the origins of the genre-defining, critically acclaimed series of turn-based strategy games. Explore the map solo or in multiplayer, triumph in iconic battles and establish peace on a continent where it was never an option.

title: The Duck Song Game
description: The ever so loved The Duck Song has returned.

title: Xin Yi Tian Tu Long Ji
description: Xin Yi Tian Tu Long Ji was an RPG published in 2000 by Soft-World International Corporation. The game was adapted from The Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber, also known as Yi Tian Tu Long Ji, a famous Chinese martial arts novel by Jin Yong.

title: The Cope
description: The Cope is a 2D, point-and-click game that presents the fear of the unknown. Your night shift client service job as a janitor will start with you getting entangled in a series of strange stories in The Cope mansion. Work cleaning and serving your client and find the truth of this mansion of fear.

title: Guilty: Takiko's Nightmare
description: Guilty: Takiko's Nightmare is a single-player story-based game. Play as Takiko to explore several areas inside her unique reality. Players can interact with various objects, solve puzzles, fight enemies, or discover some unreal phenomena.

title: Frequency of Fear
description:
"FREQUENCY OF FEAR" is a third-person, episodic psychological horror game that drags you into the disctrict of Halimun, a village that used to be known for it's mysticism, folklore, and secrets. Are you brave enough to find out? Discover what's still there in Halimun District!

Play as Maya, an aspiring urban explorer. Break taboos, film forbidden places, and explore the district of Halimun. Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, but be careful. Some curses don’t wait to be believed. Stay hidden, and don’t get caught!

title: Psycho Dead
description: A third-person survival horror game that you play as a girl with psychic power who tries to escape from a secret lab and is pursued by deadly stalkers.

title: DeMyth
description: DeMyth is a short puzzle game inspired by Helltaker. In it, you Interact with cute demit girls to find your missing aunt in the Astral Realm.

title: Onward: Asylum
description: Going onwards as we escape this horrific asylum— an indie 2D horror sidescroller where your task is to get out of the facility without getting captured by the monster itself.

title: Disconnect
description: What happened to the protagonist !?!? You're a skull, connect the dots in the platforming levels to expand upon the story and solve the mystery. All set in a black and white art style, inspired by classic 80/90s Punk posters.

title: La Perlas
description: A survival horror set in the Philippines.

title: Demon Guardian
description:
Four girls and a newbie witch doctor explore their friend's haunted house. Although welcoming at first glance, the house shows its true colors when night falls...

Based on the ghosts and beliefs of Thai folklore, Demon Guardian is a visual novel with multiple endings, told from the perspective of Pim, a girl who attract spirits. She quickly drew the attention of the new transfer student, who seems to have a ton of these spirits under his control...

title: Mario Party Superstars: Mario's Rainbow Castle
Mario Party Superstars: Mario's Rainbow Castle + Luigi's Engine Room
Backyard Beans
description: Lovingly smack your loved ones and stylishly throw them into various things! As Backyard Beans, you meet where it hurts and joyfully brawl through your circle of friends.

title: Microsoft Golf: Multimedia Edition
description: Multimedia Edition adds video segments such as tutorials, course previews and tips as well as more voiced samples and sounds for a more interactive experience.

title: Zooika
description:
Zooika is a casual puzzle game where you match animals in order to create a larger animal. It's a Suika style game with animals, leaderboards, challenges, achievements.

It features Twitch integration, allowing chat to play the game in 'chat plays' mode. And a whole new dimension is unlocked when chat plays against/with the streamer, voting on events and effects to occur and helping or hindering the streamer.

title: AAA Clock 2: Color Set 1
description:
Add more colors to your clock with the new AAA Clock 2 DLC.
Choose pink, gray or red.

title: AAA Clock 2: Color Set 3
description:
Add more colors to your clock with the new AAA Clock 2 DLC.
Choose pale pink, blue or yellow.

title: AAA Clock 2: Color Set 4
description:
Add more colors to your clock with the new AAA Clock 2 DLC.
Choose light blue, light green or dark green.

title: AAA Clock 2: Color Set 5
description:
Add more colors to your clock with this DLC.
Choose khaki, light gray or purple.

title: AAA Clock 2: Jelly Clock
description:
Customize your clock with this DLC.
Your favorite Jelly character on the clock face.

title: AAA Clock 2: Vulca Clock
description:
Customize your clock with this DLC.
Your favorite Vulca character on the clock face.

title: AAA Clock 2: Premium Edition
description: This bundle includes the third Color Set DLC with pale pink, blue and yellow.

title: AAA Clock 2: Extended Edition
description: This bundle includes the first Color Set DLC with pink, gray and red.

title: AAA Clock 2: Ultimate Edition
description: Enjoy this extravagant timepiece along with the new Vulca Clock skin.

title: AAA Clock 2: Deluxe Edition
description: Enjoy this extravagant timepiece along with the new Jelly Clock skin.

title: Aether Diving
description:
"The Aether Diving program aims to perceive energy levels in the body and help get rid of imperfections. These imperfections get in the way of a healthy lifestyle. Pairing the latest in technology and relentless study of the Divine Scriptures, we have kept our followers’ faults and defects at bay. Join us now, diving deep into consciousness and freeing the mind from torment. Enlightment awaits."
-High Priest Maxime

title: Tiebreak+: Ace Edition
description: Play the complete tennis season in Tiebreak: Official Game of the ATP and WTA

title: Badminton Time
description: Get ready to move your arms to hit the badminton shuttlecock and become the new champion!

title: Find Room 96 + Exit Station 7 + The Eerie Surroundings + HighScore Anomaly Shop + HighScore Anomaly Underground
Fruit Attack!!
description: Merge the funny fruits and get the giant cherry!

title: Uboat Attack
description: Rise through the ranks and become a legendary commander!

title: Bubble Blaster DX
description: Pop, Bounce, and Conquer the Leaderboards in the Ultimate Bubble Blaster!

title: The Secret Behind the Exam Paper
description: A first person horror decryption game with bizarre rules

title: Assassin's Creed Mirage: The Forty Thieves
description: The Forty Thieves is a downloadable content expansion for Assassin's Creed: Mirage, following Basim Ibn Ishaq as he investigates the legend of the Forty Thieves. Initially given to players who pre-ordered the game, it was later made available to all players on Ubisoft Connect for 60 units.

title: Solaris 2
description: Free online MMORPG game. Play with your friends. Conquer the continent and be the best. This is a private server for Metin2.

title: Dark Seraphim
description: Dark Seraphim is an action role-playing game released for the PC-98 in Japan in 1995. The game is based on Christian mythology and you play as Alucard, a seraphim who was sent down to hell.

title: Sega vs. Capcom: The Next Level
description: Sega vs. Capcom: The Next Level is a fan game made by 4CYDE Studios that crosses over the two major franchises, resembling the combat style of Tatsunoko vs. Capcom.

title: Artifact Seeker: DLC 1 - The Legacy of Mortia
description: New characters, new maps, new boss, new Synergy, new artifacts, new events, and many more new contents await everyone’s exploration!

title: Brute Horse
description: Brute Horse takes you into a savage world of South Vulgaria. Play as barbarian called "Brute", carrying his injured companion through the divided kingdoms. With the help of Michelle, an inventress, forge an unlikely bond, either in singleplayer or coop, that will change Brute's fate forever.

title: 60 Minute Marathon 2
description: 60 Minute Marathon 2 is a 74-map MBF21-compatible gigawad made (mostly) in a single hour, just like last time, but with more than twice the friends, including me, @Synami, and new friends @Phoenyx and @OverflowingMocha, twice the "production quality" as last time, and even a completely bespoke soundtrack made by Phoenyx! Much like the first 60 Minute Marathon, this was mostly a fairly simple yet somewhat extreme mapping exercise, this time with four mappers all making 16 maps over an hour and deciding to jam them all together at the end alternating between each mapper, with maps only being edited after the designated hour to actually make them possible.

title: Piglet's Big Game
description: Point-and-click adventure game loosely based off the 2003 film Piglet's Big Movie, where the main objective is for Piglet to collect all the ingredients for a soup in the Hundred-Acre Wood's annual Very Large Soup Party.

title: Cold Steel
description: A classic RTS with a major twist. Your units are fully autonomous drones. Every unit runs code which you design using an intuitive visual coding interface. Automate everything from mining, to combat, even unit production.

title: Drömmar
description: Drömmar is a map based on images from Astar's dreams related to doom.

title: Battle Wizard Attack
description: Unleash your inner spell caster in this action-packed, retro-style RPG! Choose from eight powerful magic disciplines and face monstrous hordes across sprawling maps packed with destructible chaos.

title: Sprawl 96
description: Sprawl 96 adds enemies and gameplay from the 2023 game Sprawl into the original Quake.

title: Reignbreaker
description: Lockpicks meet spiked iron gauntlets in this 'medievalpunk' single-player action-roguelike. Fight through hordes of lock-operated mechs and free the world from the corrupt elite. Plunder their coffers, smash the kingdom and become The Reignbreaker.

title: Hidalgo
description: Embark on the most iconic and cozy adventures from the classic novel "Don Quixote of La Mancha". In a handcrafted, colorful puppet world, you'll battle windmills, be knighted, will solve puzzles with Don Quijote and Sancho and fight for the love of your beloved Dulcinea.

title: Trickster Trove
description: Feel the fear and adrenaline in the deadly dungeons in search of treasures. Create impenetrable catacombs, protecting loot from other players. Test your skills and strategies in a world where every decision can be your last. One life - one chance!

title: Telly the TV
description:
Telly the TV is a throwback action/adventure platformer with a 1-bit style. You'll explore six themed worlds while collecting Remote Control Keys in a scavenger hunt gone wild. Can you defeat the baddies of TV Kingdom and restore the airwaves?

Enter six exciting and quirky worlds while bashing baddies and traversing terrible traps! Collect items to save each TV program, and face-off with the enemies of TV Kingdom.

title: Micro Ninja
description: A game that fits into a 64 x 64 space, made to LOWREZJAM.

title: Nodebuster
description: Nodebuster is a short, experimental incremental game about busting nodes and destroying reality.

title: Squirreled Away
description: Be the squirrel. Scurry through gardens, up trees, and leap limb to limb in this craft and thrive park life adventure. Explore solo or with up to three squirrel buddies in co-op. Meet and help other residents and collect bits here and there to build and decorate your dream treehouse.

title: Angel Night
description: In the miraculous World of Demons, there lived a vampiric count. One day, standing near the statue of the Goddess of Time, the count thought with sadness of everyone's mortal fate; at this moment the God of Death appeared, telling the count he has a visitor in his castle. The visitor turns out to be a succubus named Karuru, who suggests that the count trains two young female demons, Tiris and Emalis, and sends them to the other worlds...

title: Anonono. Kimi to Sugoshita Ano Hi Ano Toki Ano Mirai
description:
The protagonist suddenly returns to those bygone days of three years ago ...

Leading a life choked with regret, just wishing that he could have one chance to set things right ...

The protagonist is an ordinary college student, living out his tedious days in relative peace. But even through his college life, he feels a kind of disquiet that is hard to place -- the root of which comes from the incidents of a certain failed school festival three years ago. After that time, the life and the friends that he had known were scattered to the winds, leaving him with the life he knows now.

But if he had the opportunity to do things over again, to set things right, what would he do?

title: Arcshu: Kagerou no Jidai wo Koete
description:
Arcshu: Kagerou no Jidai o Koete is loosely related to the greater Arcus series. It is a visual novel created in the parody style, and in the process hits many common pop culture items of the day (movies, novels, comics, animation, etc.).
