description: Run your own supermarket! Buy, stock, and sell items, expand your store, and manage customers. Customize your layout, explore new locations, and hire staff. Keep things fresh with variety and new challenges as you grow your business.

title: Truck Simulator Cargo Driver 2024: Euro
description: Explore a meticulously recreated Europe, delivering cargo across iconic landmarks and diverse landscapes. Master the challenges of the road, manage your virtual trucker's well-being, and customize your rig to become a legend of the European trucking scene!

title: Drift Master Simulator
description: Prepare to dominate the drift scene in Drift Master Simulator! Embark on your journey as a street drifter, where you'll begin by selecting your first car from iconic options in the USA, Japan, or Germany. With hard work, dedication, and skillful drifting, ascend through the ranks to claim your place as a top drifter. Feel the adrenaline as you master the art of controlled slides and perfect your technique on challenging tracks.

title: Street Survival: Homeless Simulator
description: Street Survival: Homeless Simulator plunges you into the unforgiving world of life on the streets. As a homeless individual, your daily struggle for survival is real and relentless. Set in a sprawling urban environment, the game challenges you to navigate the complexities of street life with limited resources and constant dangers.

title: Amer Fighting
description: Get ready to rumble in Amer Fighting, the ultimate party fighting game where the fun never stops! Gather your friends and dive into an exciting family fight for up to 6 players as each battle is a chance to become a legend! In Amer Fighting, everyone can fight, but only one can win!

title: Arcade Archives: Lead Angle
description:
"LEAD ANGLE" is a gun shooting game released by SEIBU KAIHATSU in 1988. You control the main character, GEORGE PHOENIX, and fight against gangsters.

Use pistols, grenades, machine guns, and shotguns to defeat the big boss "KING in the final stage.

title: World of Outlaws: Dirt Racing 24
description:
iRacing presents the Official Game of The World of Outlaws, featuring the World of Outlaws Sprint Car, Late Models and Super DIRTcar Big Block Modifieds, as well as 8 additional series including the all-new Micro Sprints, and many others.

World of Outlaws: Dirt Racing 24 features 49 tracks, including all your favorites like Eldora Speedway, Knoxville Raceway, and Volusia Speedway Park, with new additions like Kevin Harvick’s Kern Raceway, and Millbridge Speedway.

Become a LEGEND like Donny Schatz as you work your way through Career Mode in your quest to best his 10-time National Champion status. With so many combinations of cars, tracks, and experiences, your path to victory will be unique! And, don’t forget to check out the all new challenge mode where you can test your skills against Donny himself! Are you Outlaw Tough? It’s the Greatest Show on Dirt!

title: Pixicharm: Fit Frog's Feast
description: Help a lively frog collect tasty fruits while avoiding hazards. Use simple left and right controls to gather nutritious treats and enjoy a fun, stress-free experience with no lives to lose or defeats to worry about!

title: Game Empire Tycoon: Dealer Simulator
description: From small shop to big empire—can you level up?

title: Bus Simulator Driver 2024: City Zone
description: Step into the driver's seat of a variety of meticulously detailed buses and embark on a captivating journey through bustling city streets in "Bus Simulator Driver 2024 : City Zone" As a skilled bus operator, your mission is to faithfully follow designated routes, pick up passengers, and deliver them safely to their destinations. The city's intricate traffic patterns, unpredictable road conditions, and the needs of your passengers will put your driving prowess and multitasking abilities to the test.

title: Visa Control: USA Border Simulator
description: Will you uphold the law and make the right choices at the USA border?

title: Drag Racing Professionals: Dirt Mechanic Simulator
description: Immerse yourself in the world of adrenaline, speed, and drag racing mechanics on the quarter-mile with "Drag Racing Professionals: Dirt Mechanic Simulator." Become a master of drag racing, working in the atmosphere of gritty tracks and thrilling competitions.

title: ZombFarm
description: Engage in rewarding life sim elements and farming mini games while avoiding the undead that roam the nearby woods!

title: P Fit
description:
P Fit is a puzzle game in which the player has to match the top and bottom pieces to move to the next level.

Both walls move slowly towards each other, if they touch you will have to start all over again. Your goal as a player is to last as long as possible.

title: The Jumping Ice Cube
description: From the developers at The Jumping Food Games comes a refreshing new game of skill: "The Jumping Ice Cube". In this fast-paced endless game, you play as a nimble ice cube jumping through icy challenges that test your reactions and skill. How long can you hold out and chase your high score?

title: Vigilante Ranger
description:
Vigilante Ranger is a tower defense game in first person view and in virtual reality.
The player must protect your own base against hordes of enemies using several weapons, all this immersed in a dystopian and monumental future.

title: Martian Supermarket Sim
description: Embark on an unprecedented retail adventure with "Martian Supermarket Sim," where you spearhead the first supermarket venture on the dusty red plains of Mars, within the bustling colony of New Olympus. This is more than a business—it’s a cornerstone of a new civilization.

title: Around The World: Travel To Canada - Collector's Edition
Chimp Test
description: Chimp Test is an innovative and engaging memory challenge game designed to push the boundaries of your cognitive abilities and thoroughly test your short-term memory skills. Inspired by the exceptional memory feats of chimpanzees, who have demonstrated remarkable ability in recalling complex sequences with astonishing speed and precision, Chimp Test offers a unique and interactive experience for players of all ages. Whether you are a casual gamer looking for an entertaining challenge or a dedicated enthusiast aiming to sharpen your mental acuity, this game provides a dynamic platform to enhance memory, concentration, and mental agility.

title: Color Recreator
description: Test your color recreating skills!

title: Crasho Cars
description: In Crasho Cars, race through the desert while evading obstacles and police cars that crash into each other. Collect money and power-ups to survive longer. The goal is simple: stay alive as long as you can in this high-speed, chaotic chase!

title: Chorus of Carcosa
description: Chorus of Carcosa is a psychological horror game inspired by the iconic book 'The King in Yellow' by R. W. Chambers. Test the limits of your mind and survive in the old, ever-changing building. Just don't get lost in the dark, twisted labyrinths... or in your own madness.

title: Portal to the Cosmobeat
description: On his mission, to become the very best dancer ever, Gorb challenges incredible dance coaches all around the galaxy. Unfortunately, he is terrible. Can you dance him to the top?

title: Missing Banban
description: Grab your weapons and delve into this action side-scroller intense adventure. Jump around and explore the insane levels. Shoot and dodge your way through enemies. Fight to find your friend and solve the disappearance!

title: The Rescue 1-4
description: A Tomb Raider fangame made with TRLE.

title: The Rescue 5: Temple of Osiris
description: A Tomb Raider fangame made with TRLE.

title: Little Magic World
description: Little Magic World for Enchant Jam.

title: Upducted
description: Farmer Zeke must escape his alien abductors.

title: Final Outpost: Definitive Edition
description: Final Outpost is a survival strategy base-builder. You lead the last survivors of the apocalypse. Assign roles, craft tools, and manage resources carefully. Construct buildings, level up your citizens, and fortify your town against hordes of zombies. How many days can you survive?

title: GigaBash: Mighty DLC - R.O.J.A.K & Balzarr
description: Will you invade Earth as “Balzarr”, the Demon Star? Or will you serve as mankind's last line of defense with the super mech, “R.O.J.A.K.”? This DLC adds “Balzarr” and “R.O.J.A.K.,” 2 original GigaBash characters, to the game, both featuring unique abilities and playstyles.

title: Project Reignition
description: Project Reignition is an on-rails platformer developed by KumaPauZ. This unofficial remake of Sonic and the Secret Rings, originally developed by Sonic Team and published by SEGA in 2007 for the Wii, aims to bring the classic game to modern systems. Built using the Godot engine, this free and open-source project features enhanced graphics, refined controls, and a smoother frame rate, offering a fresh experience while staying true to the original.

title: Cybermatrix
description: CYBERMATRIX is a game about speed and movement. A difficult and exciting adventure awaits you, which you will have to pass using one multifunctional knife and many different abilities. But the further you go, the more different techniques you will discover, and the stronger your opponents will be.

title: Hockey Hockey Club
description:
Hockey Hockey Club is a feel good ice hockey game with the cutest and wobbliest animals of the whole polar circle. But don't be fooled by their adorable little faces, Hockey Hockey Club is a die-hard hockey game with all the usual hockey stuffs (5 on 5 games, faceoffs, one timers, bodychecks, one on ones , ...) and a twist of arcadey moves (super shots, flips, slowmo...).

Eight teams of determined hockey players are present in the game with a lot of statistics for all the numbers fans: stamina, speed, handling, shoot... Pick the best teammates to defeat the other teams!

Play against the computer (3 levels of difficulty), or play with your friends locally (for up to 4 players). You can even play the game online with the help of the fantastic Parsec technology!

title: Spooktober Visual Novel Jam!
description: Help digital mascots Lime, Cherry, Plum and Lemon navigate their way through the Spooktober Visual Novel Jam competition. Laugh, learn, and scream(with excitement, we hope) through this visual novel and make choices to guide the girls to great success or dramatic failure!

title: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous - Visitors from Morta
description: A window into another world has opened among the wastelands of the Worldwound

title: The Adventurers
description: The Adventurers is a turn-based tactical RPG where every decision shapes your legacy. Lead your party of heroes in an open world filled with random events that affect your story. Survive a high fantasy landscape where your epic saga is waiting to be written.

title: Digable Planet
description:
You're the only one that can save Mankind's fate. Find the artefact buried deep beneath the surface of the planet and be a true hero!

The Galactic Governor has spoken: you're Mankind's only hope! Find the artefact buried deep beneath the surface of this unstable planet to give Mankind a chance for a brighter future!

Hint: There are several artefacts buried on the planet but only one will save Mankind's future!

title: EyeOS
description: A short (and borderline nonsensical) mystery game where you are trying to find out what happened to your missing friend by rooting around in their computer. Play by clicking on things and searching terms in the EyeOS home screen!

title: My Dancin' Computer
description:
We are sitting at the computer and everything seems to be going smoothly, but then Virusnya appears! A character who does not have access to administrator rights wants to infect our computer. We can stop this by using my protective dome to protect our files from Virusny's attacks, then charging up Sultan, the Anti-Virus, to defeat that prankster!

This and more will be available in the new game "My Dancin' Computer". This is a rhythm-based game based on "Game & Wario: Pirates" with interesting characters, catchy music, custom OS, and much more.

title: Revive of The Moon
description: Mitsuki, a high school girl, is caught up in an unprecedented disaster that comes out of nowhere. And the town is filled with deformed monsters. What is her destiny? A fusion of light action and zombie horror, A zombie action game supervised by Eiko Kano.

title: What's done is Done
description: A narrative-driven puzzle game about souls and forgetting. On the brink of reincarnation, she loses all her memories, and her soul is scattered. The memories of lingering spirits on the bridge seem to be connected to her story...

title: Plastic Spouse Interrogation
description: A post-human bio-management simulation. In a strange future, you awaken in a plastic body. The authorities question you, but you don't even know what you are. You must quickly grasp this weird world and your place in it, or else face state-sanctioned oblivion.

title: GhoulScrapers
description:
Ghoulscrapers is a precision platformer where you play as Eggroll, the new employee at Ghoulscrapers.
You owe the government one gazillion dollars and it's your job to pay the debt before it's too late!

title: NPC Adventure: The Arena Update
description: The Arena Update is an update to NPC Adventure to add an infinite battle mode alongside many new additions

title: My Time at Evershine
description: Be the Governor of a brand-new settlement on the fringes of the Free Cities, facing the almighty Duvos Empire. Recruit settlers, build infrastructure, tame the wilds, and lead your people to become a new cornerstone for the Alliance in this adventure-packed simulation RPG!

title: Happiness! Sakura Celebration!
description: Once every ten years, the cherry blossoms stay in bloom longer than usual, and the seasonal festivals are much more grandiose. This year is known as the Year of the Cherry Blossoms. With the arrival of the Year of the Cherry Blossoms once more, various people begin to feel various feelings sprout up again.

title: Run from the Feds!
description: Third person 3D platformer with the goal being get to the end as fast as possible.

title: Amazing Math Starring Marvel Super Heroes
description: Educational arcade-style games with Spider-Man, Wolverine, Iron Man and She-Hulk. Learn addiction, subtraction, multiplication, division, fractions, geometry and more. Exciting animation, sound and interactivity. Ages 8-12.

title: Megaman X: Omega Blaster
description: Megaman X Omega Blaster is an Arcade/Arena style fangame inspired by the classic saga arcades (Megaman: The power Battle & Megaman 2: The power fighters) but focused on the X saga but more dynamic, fun, challenging and with improved graphics.

title: Friday Night Funkin': Yellow
description:
FNF: Yellow is a love letter to the hit fangame: Undertale Yellow!

In this mod you will sing with many familiar faces from UTY, as well as some extra guests from various parts of the UT/DR fandom.

title: Adventure Kitty: Drill Buster - Lights Out
description: Get ready to dive back into the fast-paced world of Adventure Kitty: Drill Buster! This thrilling drilling game takes you on an exciting journey through unique biomes where danger lurks at every turn. In this chapter, Carton and Felicity have retrieved the Earth element, but their adventure is far from over. Now, they must brave the treacherous Lab Biome, a high-tech environment filled with perilous machines and cunning enemies determined to stop them from reaching their goal.

title: Project: ARK
description: Project: ARK was developed for the first GBJAM over a two week duration.

title: Hero Guider
description: Hero Guider is a construction puzzle game. In the game the player is required to build a various facilities to connect the roads in order to help the hero go through the maze.

title: Zenless Zone Zero: Update 1.1 - Undercover R&B
description: Zenless Zone Zero 1.1 released on August 14, 2024, adding more story content, new characters and a bunch of changes to the base game. Including new game-play content and balance changes.

title: Just Another Platformer
description: It's a challenging 2D platformer from an indie studio, where you must climb a treacherous tower to save your mother's life from a deadly illness.

title: Pro Basketball Manager 2025
description: Pro Basketball Manager 2025 is the ultimate basketball manager experience. Suit up and become the manager of a basketball team. You’ll have all the managerial tools you’ve come to expect in a manager game, scouting, facilities, training and more. Will you put emphasis on coaching or player development? Success is only the result of your decisions both on and off the court.

title: Al Gurbish in... Nick it & Run!!!
Void Climber
description: Climb to the top of a collapsing universe in this parkour platformer with roguelike elements. Gather resources, spawn platforms, and obtain powerful upgrades to survive before the world crumbles beneath you. Just don’t fall into the void.

title: Easy Ball Game
description: Easy Ball Game is a brand new game that unlike its name is an extremely difficult game based on the Only UP style of play! Climbing has you rolling, jumping and testing your balance. The game consists of several zones with different graphic styles and obstacles all to be discovered.

title: Art Strikers
description: Draw your path to victory in Art Strikers! A unique art themed bullet hell shoot-em-up that looks and plays like a beautiful work of art.

title: Iter-8
description: Welcome to the surface, ITER employee #8. Mine the Pillar, upgrade your tools, defend your base, reach the top... or die miserably. Each expendable worker pushes the mission forward - one glorious, replaceable iteration at a time.

title: Catacomb Towers
description: This is the author's very first level made with the level editor. It took him 2 months to build. Although some people found the level too dark he did not change the lighting values nor the ambient settings. The level recieved very good ratings and reached the number 5 position in the top 10 chart at that time on the famous review site of Michael Prager. It has now vanished into the hall of fame on December 2002 and has become a classic title in the tomb raider custom levelworld.

title: Astropods: Starside Glaze
description:
Astropods: Starside Glaze is a 2D Fighting Platformer with endless mobility and combat potential! Starring as Hemi and Acro, swap between them at any time to utilize their unique attacks and physics within various environments.

Astropods combines platform fighter combat with platformer styled levels, alongside nonlinear progression and perk customization, to create a dynamic combat-platforming experience unlike anything else!

title: Sunes Sportlov
description: Sune is love-stricken by his neighbours daughter Sophie, who is also vacationing at the same resort, but manages to antagonize her at the start of the story, so she makes up some difficult tasks for him to fulfill before accepting his invitations.

title: Princess Maker: Children of Revelation
description: 「Princess Maker: Children of Revelation」is a raising simulation game that returns after 18 years as part of the "Princess Maker" package series, where you raise a young girl into adulthood. Become a parent in the game and help fulfill your daughter's dreams!

title: Balloon to the Moon 2
description: Balloon to the Moon 2 is a Semi-Open World Retro Style Platformer inspired by Jet Set Willy. After the First Game, Peter made it to the Moon but is then greeted by the moon's Inhabitants. Which are humans with rabbit ears. The Moon Rabbit Princess offers you to live with them if you can complete a trail to grab all the moon treasures scattered throughout the moon. You will have to navigate several areas to grab all the treasures.

title: The Bound of Time
description: The Bound of Time is a tiny action adventure and was made for #lowrezjam within 3 weeks. There a some bugs yet, but the game it's playable and i hope it's enjoyable to.

title: Black Cat Blitz
description: Welcome to Black Cat Blitz! A game of magic, wonder, and gambling your life away. Play as Nemo (or Mimi if you're a gamer girl rawr) as you try to make the best hand possible by collecting cards, climbing stairs, grabbing chips, and avoiding obstacles. Try playing with a friend in co-op mode! or dont... and be lonely

title: Blobun
description: You are a blob bunny. Your goal? Touch every tile!

title: Cheezure
description:
Game made for NoneJam 7 in which the player controls the ship of the great pirate captain Lespito and helps him face the dangers that await him on the seas.

Manage your cheese intelligently and improve your entire ship to reach the golden treasure, the great Cheezure.

Could you be the most fearless mouse on the seas?

title: Snow Fight
description: A multiplayer snowball fight game using snowmen.

title: Last Star
description: Last Star is a space shooter roguelite with tower defense elements. Pilot a spaceship to protect your solar core from endless waves of alien invaders. Upgrade both your core and spaceship to become unstoppable. Execute tactical counterattacks against alien motherships to slow down the invasion.

title: Ark: Aberration Ascended
description: On Aberration, survivors face exotic and extreme challenges within a vast underground biome system upon a derelict, malfunctioning ARK. Survivors will uncover the ultimate secrets of the ARKs, and discover what the future holds in store for those strong and clever enough to survive!

title: Bristle and the Artificial Invasion
description: Bristle and the Artificial Invasion is a platformer game made in GB Studio that tells the story of a paintbrush named Bristle, whose planet is invaded by an army of artificially generated monsters. It's up to Bristle to rescue his friends and save any neighboring planets affected by this catastrophe.

title: BuKnight: The Order of the Golden Crest
description: BuKnight is a fun and speedy action-platformer mixing the late '90s era mascot fever with the mid-2000s indie game craze. Use your up-and-downsmash attacks, as well as the special swirling move to hurl pain at your enemies or to change your momentum and dodge their attacks as you zoom past or towards them.

title: Russian Train Trip 3: Gorbachev's Posters In The Apartment
description: Posters of Soviet President Mikhail Gorbachev will appear in your apartment.

title: Russian Train Trip 3: Personal Computer In The Apartment
description: An old personal computer appears on a table in the character's apartment

title: Russian Train Trip 3: Instant Arrival In Novosibirsk
description: This add-on allows you to instantly get to the main goal in the game - the train station in Novosibirsk.

title: Russian Train Trip 3: Flashlight
description: The add-on adds a regular flashlight with which you can find something interesting in the game

title: Russian Train Trip 3: Beer On The Train
description: The add-on adds beer bottles, 3 pieces, to the passenger train car.

title: Russian Train Trip 3: People In A Train Car
description: This add-on adds a girl and a guy to the passenger car of the train.

title: Russian Train Trip 3: Posters In The Train Car
description: This add-on adds a girl and a guy to the passenger car of the train.

title: Radical Problems
description: A Half-Life 1 Modification where you play as a Scientist in Area 9 Hazardous Waste Facilities.

title: Russian Train Trip 2: Fast Time
description: Adds time acceleration to the game Russian Train Trip 2, to see all the content, all the train stations and not to spend 10 hours playing the game.

title: Russian Train Trip 2: VIP Seat In The Train Car
description:
This DLC makes a real VIP seat out of your compartment car, which includes:

Various items on the table (pizza, soda, mug, etc.)
Posters
Headphones
Other items.

title: Russian Train Trip 2: A Beautiful Girl In Your Place
description:
This DLC adds a girl companion to your compartment car.

The girl lies on top of your seat and is pleasing to the eye.

title: Russian Train Trip 2: Putin's Posters in the Train Car
description:
This DLC adds Vladimir Putin posters to your compartment car.

The posters hang on two walls and always delight your eye, no matter where you sit.

title: Red October
description: Red October: A scientific thriller in the USSR. Physicist Sokolov is drawn into the race for the energy of the future in the closed city of Oktyabrsk-21. Intrigue, espionage, moral choices. The fate of the world is in your hands!

title: Fábulas Porteñas
description: In this game, you'll take control of a character who was riding the subway when it unexpectedly stops at an unfamiliar station named "Pirámides". As you look around, you realize you're alone in this strange place. To find your way back home, you'll need to discover codes, solve puzzles, and explore your surroundings.

title: Sir Fallen: Shadows of the Phoenixheart
description:
Step back into the armor of Sir Fallen in the first DLC Expansion. Years ago, a cataclysmic war shattered your home and disbanded the knighthood, leaving the powerful artifact known as the Phoenixheart stolen and lost to the ages.

Now, after many years, you have returned to a world where shadows of the past linger. Retrieve the Phoenixheart and restore it to its rightful place, rekindling the legacy of your order.

The fate of the kingdom lies in your hands.

title: Alter Ego S
description: Enhanced version of Alter Ego.

title: Cain & Iddo: Break Week
description:
Cain the dog and Iddo the hyena are two plucky 24-year-olds navigating life alone in the East Coast American metropolis of Westside City. Their zany misadventures don't turn out exactly as planned, wacky unforeseen circumstances arise, and hijinx ensues...

Cain works as a barista at the local mall's Starbuzz franchisee. Due to requirements from higher Starbuzz management, his boss Sergio has to give Cain a week off work for the summer. Cain and Iddo have decided to get some bucket list activities done over this week-long break... but you can probably guess that finishing that list is not going to be as simple as it seems.

title: Potatostrike
description: A space shmup featuring the ultimate potato-based space fighter.

title: Canvas Intruder
description: Canvas Intruder is a game about an artist named Pix who got sucked into the canvas world unfortunately thanks to her apprentice's black magic. goofy. But now its up to Pix to navigate through these canvas levels!

title: Celestial Soul
description:
Celestial Soul is a 2D game about anthropomorphic fox who's found himself in the middle of somewhere??

He's on a quest in the Void to retrieve the lost shards of his SOUL, which was shattered by his clumsy new friend.

title: Alex's Caves
description: Alex’s Caves is a Forge mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that adds 5 new cave biomes to the Overworld. Unlike most normal biomes, these cave biomes are exceedingly rare - yet they all contain a variety of unique blocks, items, mobs and mechanics that makes them considerable subterranean destinations. These five biomes are the Magnetic Caves, the Primordial Caves, the Toxic Caves, the Abyssal Chasm and the Forlorn Hollows.

title: Cubenen Gardens: Befriend
description: Cubenen Gardens: Befriend is a story-driven indie RPG where you play as Michael, a nerdy kangaroo inventor from the Tech District. They have a lifelong goal of making monsters less of a threat to society. And their research takes them to the abandoned offices of the Mall District to test a theory regarding how monsters relate to the memories of the deceased. Things go well, but then they get caught up in a corporate nightmare. Slowly breaking them down and leaving them desperately searching for a way to escape.

title: Danger Cliff 2
description: Danger Cliff 2 is a very open-ended 2D Platformer inspired by Super Mario 63. Run, jump, and drill through huge, interconnected levels with wild themes, unique mechanics, and branching paths. Between being able to hunt down whatever collectibles you want, taking advantage of deep movement mechanics, and three playable characters to choose from, you decide how you tackle this adventure!

title: Scifi Zombie
description: A deadly virus, designed to reanimate the dead and integrate them with cybernetic enhancements, escapes containment and turns the facility's inhabitants into relentless, cybernetic zombies.

title: Rods: Rod Roll
description: Keep rolling! Gift drops every hour!

title: Distancy
description: Distancy is a tightly made with passion, tough as nails, Game Boy Color-inspired 2D platformer with various other inspirations! Originally, the game started out small but blossomed into a full team for its creation. Feel the world come to life before your very eyes!

title: Eggs: All Guns Broken
description: Warning: This game starts 6 minutes long but can go on forever. Eggs is a slow-paced casual rail shooter that places you in a desert loop to face endless variations of baddies. Fly as far as you can!

title: Kurragömma med Mumintrollen
description: The first release in a series of nearly a dozen Nordic PC games based on the Moomin stories. A simple point-and-click experience based on finding missing Rock Dass in Moomin Valley.

title: Dream Enkoure
description: A not so simple platformer where you go from left to right.

title: DreamShock
description: Blast through nightmares, come dreams or reality!

title: Dungeon Gals
description: A small polycule-turned-crisis control team been summoned to help a civilization in the sky escape impending doom! Explore dungeons, solve puzzles, and find lots of treasure to help prepare yourself for incredible challenges!

title: Bleeding Roots
description: Bleeding Roots is a short horror walking simulator taking place throughout the seasons. Water the plants in your garden, learn about them, and grow along them over time. Immerse yourself in a story about loss, grief and obsession. The controls are simple, moving the character through tank controls and reading up on the environment with an interact key.

title: Lovely Lady RPG
description: Lovely Lady RPG is a game about wandering around and just sort of seeing what happens. After waking up with a hole in her ceiling, a cosmic space Orb embedded in her chest and no recollection of basically anything, Ghost sets out to continue her life as best she can.

title: Swords of Freeport
description:
Swords of Freeport is a text-mode social RPG heavily inspired by the style of Bulletin Board System door games from back in the '90s. It is part MUD and part BBS Game (without the need for a BBS). You can play it on your home machine alone, or play/install it on an internet-accessible machine where others can join you.

It is heavily inspired by games such as Legend of the Red Dragon, with a certain numbers of turns per day. Select a profession, join a guild, and make a name for yourself.

title: Firedog: Swooce & Rescue
description: Firedog: Swooce & Rescue is a momentum-based platformer where you play as a firefighting dog with a powerful firehose. Balance the uncontrollable force of a handheld firehose with the athletic moves of a high-energy Pomeranian as you fight enemies, put out fires, and rescue the good citizens of Dog City. And yes, you can pet the dogs.

title: Foxblade Fable
description: A young boy is forced to embark on a quest to master the powers of the Divines,

title: Dice, Destiny and Death
description: Fairy tales were truth, Koschei has awakened, and along with him, all the unclean creatures. Hut on chicken legs, nymphs, water spirits, and other beings may seem cute, but only until they have fed on your flesh. We don’t need a hero, we need someone who will survive!

title: Rocket League: Season 16
description:
Urban Legends Emerge from the Arena’s Darkest Depths.From the menacing Mothman to the chilling Chupacabra, ancient folklore revs to life in Rocket League Season 16!

Legendary monsters have been sighted on the field, but are they real or just an illusion? Turn up those headlamps and shine a light on the myths (and moths) of Rocket League Season 16 starting September 4!
⁠
⁠In Season 16, wade into the worrisome wilderness and compete in an all-new Arena, Drift Woods. And if things get too eerie, take comfort behind the wheel of Rocket League’s latest cars.

title: Frebbventure Alliance
description: That's right, the cat came back, and this time, with more. More what? More friends, more enemies, more action, more levels, more bosses, more story. More everything! Frebbventure Alliance takes the formula for a game that prided itself on being jam-packed no-frills action platforming madness, and does it even harder!

title: TNT: Threevilution
description: "TNT: Threevilution" is a full thirty-two map boom compatible megawad inspired by the works of TNT, specifically in their contribution to Final Doom, created by General Roasterock and @DoomTheRobot (featuring @NaN and American McGee). It has zero meaningful story, as God intended, and has been able to create cancerous growths in a lab environment.

title: Free Skies
description: Free Skies is a mix of arcade skating and speedy platforming inspired by Jet Set Radio, Tony Hawk, and Sonic.

title: Rooftop Rascal: The Drizzle Cat
description:
In "Rooftop Rascal: The Drizzle Cat," you control a clever cat navigating city buildings' fire escape stairs to the rooftop.

The gameplay centers on jumps, and quick thinking.
Your goal is to climb as high as you can and reach the rooftop.

title: Frostbite Friends
description: Frostbite Friends is an 80's arcade-style top-down shooter inspired by both niche and classic retro games, starring two snowkids, Mike and Milly, as they venture to rescue the mysterious Dream Stars from the hands of the devious King Guzbum and his assembly of goons!

title: Fuu3: Minus3’s Lab
description: Fuu3: Minus3’s Lab is a point-and-click game being created on the Clickteam Fusion 2.5 engine. Discover what you thought you knew about the titular Minus3, Fuu3’s sworn rival! Meet some extravagant characters, take systems down, and piece together who you were meant to be in this 2000s Newgrounds-inspired take on origin stories!

title: The Object
description: A man who lost his head and his memories found himself trapped inside a mansion. He must search for clues as he tries to escape, with or without the solution to both of these mysteries.

title: Garbage Girl Louise
description: Garbage Girl Louise is an indie platformer about breaking down boxes, cleaning up streets, and taking names! Of course, this is done through bouncing on evil moles, magic trash cans, and cardboard boxes, all while tossing anything you can get your grubby trash girl hands on! Save trapped raccoons, meet weirdos around the city, and even race against your ex-girlfriend! Dingy streets! Bubble wrap! Magical eggs! Lesbians! Yeah, we have everything!

title: GingerSnap
description: Collect and combine ingredients for a wide combination of moves. Inspired by old N64 era favorites, like Kirby 64 and MegaMan!

title: Goldio
description: Goldio is about 6 random people who got sent to a different dimension by the villain, Gamebear. The friends have to escape and stop Gamebear from luring more people into his universe, they do this by going through all the different stages of the game to explode Bresh Mountain!!

title: Hexachampions
description: Hexachampions is a TCG-tabletop RPG hybrid: every Champion has its unique die and abilities. Your strategy is key, but it will be up to the roll of the dice to dictate what your tools will be. So you always know what to blame in case you lose.

title: Real Cake Maker
description: Grab your mixer and let the cake-making fun begin!

title: Alian Planet
description: Sci-fi horror action ADV fighting aliens on an unknown planet!

title: BallZ DX
description: Ultimate block breaker with all the bells and whistles

title: Pixel Game Maker Series: The Willow Man
description: Beware The Willow Man as he lurks throughout the halls, in your dreams, and into your soul. Can you survive the night in this horror adventure.

title: Mahjongus: Mystery of Fortescue
description: Uncover the mystery of Fortescue solving classic mahjong puzzles

title: Helix Fruit Jump
description: Helix Fruit Jump is a casual arcade game where you control a ball that bounces through a platform made of fruit and cake slices.

title: Hentai Girls: Lovely Lieutenant
description: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!

title: Eggconsole Dragon Slayer: The Legend of Heroes PC-8801mkIISR
description: Falcom's Dragon Slayer VI is the series' first command-type RPG! As Prince Selios of the Farlane Kingdom, defeat the evil Akdam!

title: City Driver: Police Parking Simulator
description: A fun and realistic parking simulator that will test your driving skills in a police cars and other transport!

title: Cooking Arena Pancake Paradise
description:
Your adventure begins with Food Truck Tycoon. Cook, chop, bake and enjoy hundreds of unique dishes. But the journey of a thousand dishes is just the beginning!

As you hone your cooking skills and build your reputation with food trucks, you'll be given the opportunity to explore more gourmet games as DLC. Customize your kitchen with countless upgrades and serve delicious food in different locations. Keep the grill hot, keep your customers smiling, sauté, mix and serve to the top.

title: Brain Training!! Hiragana ＆ Katakana Search
description:
Find the indicated letters among many letters!
This is a brain training game to train your quick thinking skills!

title: Farm It: Fluffy DLC
description: Change your farmer's style with cute and fluffy clothes! With this DLC, you'll unlock 16 hats of different cute animals, 2 sets of panda clothes, 1 pair of panda shoes, 128 awesome decorations to make your house unique, and 5000 coins to buy everything you need. Have fun with your new style and decor.

title: Farm It: Funky DLC
description: Change your farmer's style with classy and funky clothes! This DLC offers a delightful range of new customization options to freshen up your look and transform your living space. With this expansion, you'll unlock 9 crazy hats and 9 stylish sets of clothes to mix and match, allowing you to express your personal flair. Additionally, you'll gain access to 128 awesome decorations that you can use to make your house truly unique. And to top it off, you'll receive 6000 coins to purchase everything you need to achieve your desired style and decor. Have fun exploring these new possibilities and updating your farmer's appearance and home environment!

title: The Dresden Files Cooperative Card Game: Expansion 6 - Faithful Friends
description: Don't despair — you've got faith on your side in this expansion for the Dresden Files Cooperative Card Game! Inside you'll find two new character decks — Sir Waldo and River Shoulders — and two new book decks — PEACE TALKS and BATTLE GROUND.

title: Buffet Boss: Rolling Sushi
description: A brand-new sushi restaurant has arrived, and it's time to dive into exciting new challenges! Players can master the art of delicious sushi rolls just like a pro sushi chef, create refreshing bubble tea that will have customers coming back for more, use a conveyor belt to serve guests efficiently and keep things moving smoothly, and expand their restaurant to become the top dining destination in the city. Rise to the occasion, build your reputation, and become the ultimate sushi and bubble tea sensation.

title: Umamusume: Pretty Derby - Party Dash: DLC Vol. 1 - Team Iris
description:
Additional playable characters for Umamusume: Pretty Derby - Party Dash.

Includes:
• Duramente
• Cheval Grand
• Satono Crown
• Sounds of Earth
• Royce and Royce

title: Drift Master Simulator 2024: Rich Racer DLC
Uboat Attack: Zeppelin DLC
description: Board the great Zeppelin and rule the skies!

title: Uboat Attack: Vortice DLC
description: Board the cunning Vortice and control the battlefield!

title: Uboat Attack: Cloverfield DLC
description: Board the mighty Cloverfield and tear down your enemies!

title: World War: Fury Wave
description: Defend against advancing enemies in a broken tank! Experience the impossible battle on WWII’s front lines. Survive with limited supplies in intense tank warfare!

title: There's No Dinosaurs 2: Dark
description: An extra difficulty level with dark mode.

title: Supermarket Manager Empire 2024
description:
Dive into the fast-paced world of retail with Supermarket Manager Empire 2024, an exciting and immersive 3D market simulation game. As the ambitious owner of a supermarket, your goal is to elevate your modest store into a sprawling retail empire!

In this vibrant and cartoon-styled adventure, you have complete control to upgrade and customize every element of your supermarket. Expand your aisles, enhance your product displays, and curate a wide array of goods to keep your customers delighted and your profits climbing. From fresh produce to cutting-edge electronics, the selection is vast, and the decisions are yours.

title: Supermarket 3D Tycoon Buisness Simulator
description: Step into the shoes of a budding entrepreneur in Supermarket 3D Tycoon Buisness Simulator, a 3D open-world simulation game that brings the excitement of building a retail empire to life. Begin your journey by purchasing an old, run-down market and transform it into a bustling hypermarket.

title: Spot the Difference: Ukiyo-e Thirty-six Views of Mt. Fuji
description:
Find mistakes in Thirty-six Views of Mt. Fuji!
Enjoy brain training while looking at Ukiyo-e!

title: Pinball FX: Goat Simulator Pinball
description: Get ready to experience the wildest pin-baaa-ll game, inspired by the absurdity of Goat Simulator 3! From headbutting bumpers to launching yourself through loops, every move you make will leave a trail of chaos behind.

title: Pinball FX: The Princess Bride Pinball
description: The Princess Bride Pinball - Not just your basic, average, every day, ordinary, run-of-the-mill, ho-hum pinball table. Jump into a world of treachery, peril, revenge... and a bit of kissing.

title: Real Cake Maker: Cool Kidz
description:
With this DLC, you'll unlock:

4 new cute dresses
8 new charming tops
8 new colorful shorts
5 new adorable aprons with fun designs
8 new playful baseball caps
4 new fresh pairs of shoes
14 new fantastic hairstyles
2 new kitchen gadgets: a mixer and a cup blender

title: Real Cake Maker: Sugar Rush
description:
With this exciting DLC, you'll unlock three new cupcake recipes that are sure to win over everyone’s hearts:

Banana Chocolate Cupcake - a perfect blend of rich chocolate and creamy banana
Lemon Marshmallow Cupcake - a delightful mix of zesty lemon and fluffy marshmallow
Strawberry Vanilla Cupcake - a mouth-watering combination of fresh strawberries and classic vanilla

title: Some Some Convenience Store: Yena After Story
Some Some Convenience Store: Soohee After Story
description:
Find out what happens after Soohee Pyeon's ending

Before I knew it, it had been a year since I'd met Soohee.
As if fate were guiding our actions, we all ended up back at the convenience store.
The reason: the store, relationships, and Some Some...

title: Some Some Convenience Store: Adela After Story
Some Some Convenience Store: After Stories Pass
Food Fight
description: Food Fight is a cozy but crunchy grid autobattler roguelike. Your snacks fire on their own cooldowns across a grid of 8 slots while you make the real decisions between fights: what to buy, what to upgrade, which risk is worth taking, and which fight to take next.

title: South Park: Snow Day! - To Danse with the Veiled Horde
description: Gather up to three fellow souls and delve into four maps "Main Street", "South Park Elementary," “Town Square,” and beyond.

title: Hotel Hysteria!
description: The evil Dr. Von Gordo has kidnapped Madame Moon! you, Vince Vinchi and your...sidekick Kaizo have to find clues to her location by searching through Dr. Von Gordo's Kooky Hotels!

title: WorldNeverland: Elnea Kingdom - Ancestral Garb Set: Berry
WorldNeverland: Elnea Kingdom - Fluffy Panda Suit
Medieval Fantasy: Jigsaw Puzzle - Funny Moments
Just 1 Minute! Memory Test with Masterpieces
description:
Which Hand Was on Top in the Mona Lisa’s Lap?
Test Your Memory with Famous Paintings in Just One Minute!

title: Mixx Island: Remix Plus - Ultra Definitive
Illurama: Masters of Illusions
description:
Illurama: Masters of Illusions it's a bullet hell shmup in the form of a platformer! Inspired by such games like Touhou Project, Dodonpachi, Megaman and more.
Enemies and bosses will shoot projectiles, but beware because they will shoot a TON OF BULLETS.

title: JettFuel+
description: In JettFuel+, you play as Jett: a robot used by a factory until its sudden closure. You managed to escape the factory before it was destroyed, but the whereabouts of your brother and fellow coworker Brody, are unknown.

title: PolyFight
description: Duel your adversary and prove your skills to be superior.

title: JawshRPG
description: Jawsh RPG is a fangame made for Jawsh and his fans a while ago.

title: Resident Evil Crossfire
description: Resident Evil: Crossfire was a Resident Evil fan game designed by Thor Steinbach in 2001. Set in Raccoon City during the Raccoon City Incident, it stars gothic high school student Lucrecia Callahan as the primary protagonist, who is caught at the subway station when the outbreak reaches her. At that point she frantically tries to reach her friends' house to save them. The second playable character is college student on leave, Felicity White.

title: CEO City
description:
CEO City is the Edutainment game which intend to support and provide players learning of current CEO Governor"s obligation comparing with the previous general governors that how different they are. Besides, it is the game which can increase and develop management skill as players were CEO themselves and have to manage their good province for their citizen satisfaction. This will judge whether they could be voted to be the CEO again for next election or not.

Not only supporting learning of CEO, but also a tool to encourage the OTOP by setting OTOP as a part of management stipulation which CEO have to distribute for their province highest utility.

title: Karma II
description: Karma II was a Korean first person shooter by DragonFly.

title: Din's Champion
description: Mine and gather resources, craft useful items, and explore a dynamic, evolving world all while fighting off the evil gods' minions and machinations in this side scrolling, action RPG. Become a Din's Champion and stop Valta's new scheme to destroy the world. Oh, and beware of exploding barrels...

title: Suikawa Lead
description: The controller is your voice! An action RPG that can only be controlled with a microphone! Now, use your words to control the "Splitter" and split the watermelon to become the legendary "Guide"! SUIKAWA LEAD is a game that utilizes a voice recognition system.

title: Sonic 1 Strange Dream World
description: Sonic 1: Strange Dream World is a comprehensive "cosmetic and layout" mod for the 2013 mobile/RSDK decompilation of Sonic the Hedgehog. The hack is defined by its surreal, dream-like premise where Sonic relives his first adventure but finds the world distorted with vibrant, unusual colors and "scarier" Badniks.

title: Tailwinds
description:
Welcome to Tailwinds, a Pilotwings-inspired mod for Sonic Robo Blast 2,
featuring a story loosely based on the little-known Chuck Yeager origin story.

title: Bowser Gets Clever: Insert Subtitle Here
description: This game is half-parody of a Super Mario Bros. game, a reimagining of a really old game made in 2009 by Adrien Dittrick.

title: Ashura The Glitch
description: A Sonic the Hedgehog Metroidvania inspired by the Metroid series and Axiom Verge.

title: Beavis And Butt-Head In Quest To Score
description: Beavis and Butt-head can't afford tickets to a concert that they want to go to as the tickets are 20bucks and unfortunately they only had 20 cents. With a goal in mind to score and to do things that don't suck Beavis and Butt-Head set off to get $20 to pay for the tickets and to acquire the delicacy known as Nachos as the venue didn't sell it.

title: EvilBritishGuy's Sonic and The Hedgehogs
description: Sonic and The Hedgehogs reimagines how an Open-World Sonic game should play, Open-World in this context meaning that Sonic is free to go anywhere and do anything that Sonic can and would do. Rather than only rapidly progressing through mostly linear stages to reach a goal miles away from where you start, Sonic makes whatever world he finds himself in his playground.

title: Greenmario In Bobbing My Burger
description: A surrealist platformer based on Super Mario and the Amiga demoscene.

title: Hyper's Quest 2: High Voltage
description: The evolution of the Volt Orbs is here!

title: Jack & Bob Remastered
description: Jack&Bob Remastered is supposed to demonstrate an alternative dimension of Sonic The Hedgehog. The game is based off Sonic 1 and 2.

title: Knuckles Quest
description: Knuckles Quest is a continuation of the treasure hunting gameplay style that was present in Sonic Adventure and Sonic Adventure 2, now with a custom framework and levels. Using a radar, search the area for all the emerald pieces, but be careful: the locations are randomly selected!

title: Mixcity Swap
description: Mixcity Swap is a fast-paced, competitive mobile card game set in a futuristic sports world, blending strategic deck-building with dynamic real-time gameplay. Two players face off using unique cards, each with distinct abilities and roles. The game’s key mechanic, the Swap, allows players to switch cards during your tunr, triggering powerful effects and shifting the momentum in exciting ways. With an ever-growing roster of sports-inspired cards, frequent updates, and strategic depth, Mixcity Swap offers endless replayability for players of all skill levels.

title: Mega Man 15: The Robot Apocalypse
description:
This game was made to celebrate Mega Man's franchise and delve deep into its rich history and legacy. This is a turn-based RPG with a lot of difficulty options so even if you don't like turn-based, you can just breeze through its rich new story!

Here you control four heroes who are fated to fight against a evil scientist named Doctor Wily and his evil robots that are destroying the city and breaking Space-Time itself!

Fight iconic enemies, bosses, find many easter eggs, collect mysterious items and uncover new events that connects different timelines.

title: Metal Crash
description: Here is a fangame with a mix of Crash Bandicoot and Metal Slug style gameplay. For the most part it's run & gun, so just make sure you survive, especially since there are no checkpoints!

title: PJ the DJ
description: A Parappa the Rapper fan game starring the character PJ Berri

title: Pokémon Aragonite
description:
Pokémon Aragonite is a fanmade project based on the real life island of Sicily, in the South of Italy.
Started by FrankieChatot and Darkonius Mavakar;
This project aim to reimagine Sicily into the Pokémon world by creating the Sylia region, where you will be able to explore many areas and cities based off actual places!
Initially this started as a fakemon dex where we had fun interpreting our culture, flora and fauna into Fakemon, but then we decided to use Pokémon Essentials to turn it into a playable game!

title: Project After: Shadow Theory
description: Side-scroller beat am map

title: Project X-treme
description: Project X-Treme is a remake of the cancelled "Sonic X-Treme" made by STI (Sega Technical Institute), which was cancelled in 1996

title: Sega Brawlers Megamix
description: Sega Brawlers Megamix is a beat'em up style brawler game featuring many of Sega's classic characters and guests from the Sega Genesis days, with a total of 92 playable characters.

title: Silver The Hedgehog
description: a 2d Silver The Hedgehog game

title: Sonic & Shadow Black Ice
description:
The story is based on the old fairytale story The Snow Queen.

This will be a story driven game. So there will be no battling. Just moving around, interacting with people and objects while solving simple puzzles.

The game will contain voice acting but only for the main cast. Sonic, Shadow and The Snow Queen.

title: Sonic 2: Rescue Tails
description: Sonic 2: Rescue Tails is a reimagined version of the 8-bit Sonic 2 for the Master system and Game Gear, in the style of the 16-bit Mega Drive/Genesis Sonic games.

title: Kane TV: The Game
description: Kane TV: The Game is a tribute game based on the Kane TV channel! Join Kane in his adventure in this cybernetic world, passing through many levels with many references to his YouTube videos!

title: Sonic Adventure Blast 2
description:
Sonic Adventure Blast 2 allows you to play as Sonic, Tails, and Knuckles in Adventure style gameplay.

Blast through over 80 missions as you explore both classic and brand new levels.

title: Sonic Dungeons: Prototype
description: This a concept for a first-person action game set in the Archie Sonic universe. A game where the player explores the open world of Mobius, recruits various freedom fighters to their team, and raids enemy fortresses ran by Dr. Eggman.

title: Sonic Eclipse
description: Sonic Eclipse is a 2D Classic Sonic Fan Game, created by the BrainBox Interactive Team, featured as an entry to this years (2024) Sonic Amateur Games Expo!

title: Sonic Emerald Madness
description: Sonic Emerald Madness is a boost styled Sonic game that takes its inspiration from Sonic Rush, Sonic Colors and a bit of Mario 64.

title: Ping Pong Clásico en 2DD
description: Welcome to Classic 2D Ping Pong! This simple and addictive game will let you relive the nostalgia of arcade games with a simplified version of the classic Pong. Whether you want to compete against a friend or hone your skills, this game is perfect for a good time.

title: Knight George
description: Knight George is a top-down retro-style A-RPG. Travel across the Kingdom of Earlyne to meet friendly characters, explore numerous dungeons and fight terrifying monsters to save the kingdom!

title: Sonic Endless Adventure
description:
Welcome to Sonic Endless Adventure! This is a fan game in which there level created in real time.
In the game you will visit the Green hill level, again. You have only 3 lives, losing them, will end the level. During the passage you will encounter Red Star Rings. With it you can open music for the level.

title: Sonic Fighting Heroes: King of The Ring
description: Sonic Fighting Heroes: King of The Rings (SFH: KOTR) is a MUGEN-based 2D Fighting Game, which has been in development since 2017.

title: Sonic Freedom Frontiers
description: Sonic Freedom Frontiers is a game that intends to feature many levels, three playstyles, and a longer story. It plans on combining light influence from RPGs with and Platformer inspiration, making it a larger scale game. It has cutscenes that tell of a narrative with a science fiction flavor, that I wrote. It also has two different styles of platforming, one with more emphasis on physics and momentum, the other on combat. If it is completed, it is likely to have five different zones, all with five levels in each of them, with most of them being platformer styled levels. It is meant to feature hub worlds with top down gameplay, NPCs you can talk to, and saving.

title: Sonic Gamebook Origins
description:
A brand-new old adventure!
Relive the classic adventure gamebook Sonic vs. Zonik, now in full digital glory!
Everything is recorded by the game! No more pencil and paper - enjoy the adventure without lifting a finger!
Progress saves automatically, so come back and resume your game as you please!
Never get lost again with the included Cheat Sheet, a detailed guide to every section in the game!
Toggle a variety of options to customize your experience and foil Robotnik's diabolical traps!
Features authentic Sega Genesis music to suit the mood of each location!

title: Little Sound Boxing Champion
description:
Coil, a young lightweight boxer challenges the status quo!
In a world where robots have taken over the boxing scene, Coil must box to the beat in order to take the title of Champion back for humanity in this fun little Rhythm Heaven inspired boxing game!

title: Lusa the Cathead
description: Lusa the Cathead is an action platformer game where you get to play as a cute cat-head-looking creature named Lusa! Jump your way through the stages, collect orbs and break capsules while avoiding obstacles... and from now on, gathering polymers and megamers to gain score! This game is very customizable, with possibility for not only custom stages, but custom characters with unique mechanics, powered by Lua scripting, free for any modifications!

title: Lylia's Deadline: Clearance
description: A sequel to the original Lylia's Deadline which features high-speed 2.5D gameplay, low-poly 3D graphics, Rocking music, and more heat-based combat mechanics.

title: Lyrestruck
description: This game follows Irina, who's been wandering through an endless forest, in search of an exit. Will she discover the roots of this curse and break out?

title: Levana Horror Tale
description: You must complete a lunar mission only with the other person on the radio. When you realize that you were not sufficiently informed about the place.

title: Men of Conviction
description: Men of Conviction is an original action platformer following the story of Izik Dang, a soldier of the underground rebel group Men of Conviction. Slash your way through four unique stages with a variety of different enemies. Use Chips to harness the power of the elements to assist you in your fight. Can you find the strength to stand against the trials that await you?

title: Purple Game
description: Purple Game is a JRPG about a castle that has turned pink overnight.

title: Moomi & Spike
description: Experience high-speed thrills and an engaging story in Moomi & Spike, a 3D platformer where agile gameplay and a captivating narrative collide in a vibrant adventure!

title: Mr. Triangle The Pizza Delivery Guy Mania Simulator 2k17
description: This is a really stupid joke platformer game I put way too much effort into. It's a sequel to the first games I ever made, Mr. Triangle 1-5 (6 was never finished) and is partially based off a dream I had.

title: Mr. Triangle The Pizza Delivery Guy Mania Simulator 2k17 Turbo HD Remix GOTY 2024 Edition: Coked Up + 1.5 Collection DX Directors Cut & Knuckles
description:
The first game in the Mr. Triangle Mania series (a sequel to some games I made as a child, of which the 6th entry was never finished), ported to the second's engine.
Including the extra story Mr. Triangle Mania 1.5, originally an SRB2 mod, now with its original intended ending.

title: Nina & Yuri
description: You play Nina, a girl who will need to cross several theater scenes to save her soulmate Yuri.

title: Bulletombe
description:
In ancient Greece, in the land of Helenia, a young woman who lived in the mountains closest to Olympus was in charge of looking after a mysterious vase inside the temple. One day the vase was making strange sounds and when Pandora went to check on it, the vase burst open and released all the evils that lay within, and along with them, a cherub named Lucy appeared to inform Pandora that this event would cause untold disasters on earth and that it was necessary to recapture them.
Pandora, with great courage and the power of hope that still resides in the vase, decides to travel through Helenia in search of the evils; luckily they are not too far away and the disasters they bring behind them are clearly visible.

title: Painter Blazer
description: Painter Blazer is a mix between action, arcade, and light puzzle games. You are playing as Blazer, a bunny who likes to paint. He finds a new job as a painter but the company is no good trying to replace workers with robots. Your job is to paint and blow up the robots and to find who is behind all of this.

title: Penn Guiny
description: After being sucked into a sack full of dreams Penn Guiny lands into an area of the dream realm called "Sunny Shores". With the help of an unnamed cloud lady Penn Guiny learns how to traverse the dream realm.

title: Land of the Vikings: Dage Island
description: Dage Island is a new map for "Land of the Vikings". The map is a new island with a mountainous terrain, providing players with new ways to build their Viking settlements.

title: Angel Legion: Chain Trace - Black
description: Embark on your adventure with player from all over the world! Lead your Angel team to reveal the ancient mysteries of Galaxy…… Welcome to Angel legion, a free RPG gacha game with good fun!

title: Woohoo!: Game "Escape & Evade"
description: Escape & Evade is a game where you need to reach the exit without being detected. You'll need to be stealthy and stay out of sight from the security cameras while maneuvering around obstacles. Make sure you disable the lasers before you walk through a door protected by lasers.

title: Classified: France '44 - Talon
description:
Hit the enemy where it hurts with new missions and a brand new map in the Talon Pack, with new equipment for the US Airbourne.

The Talon Pack contains:
New Map – “Manor”
Two new Special Ops missions:
• Foul Manors
• Hostage Negotiation
New Weapon:
• Mosin-Nagant M1891
New Weapon Variant:
• Trench Gun “Bear”
New Clothing Set
• US Airbourne “Talon” Set

title: DCS World: F/A-18C Operation Mountain Breeze by Sandman Simulations
description: In the fall of 2015, the battles of the Syrian Civil War between the rebels and the Syrian government forces continue intensely. The involvement of several foreign powers, ISIS, and Hezbollah in the conflicts further escalates tensions.

title: Pomeraider
description: Pomeraider's a score attack game heavily inspired on classic arcade games!

title: Salvo Subs
description: Destroy your friends online in Salvo Subs, a retro inspired top-down shooter. Unlock 32 submarine vessels in 10+ arena game modes.

title: Pocket Pusher: The Citadel
description: "The Citadel" a level made to improve the core mechanics of Pocket Pusher, includes new collectibles.

title: Futanari Sex Adventures: Episode 1
description: An adult visual novel series with a beautiful red-haired futanari as a protagonist.

title: Cuckold Sex: Episode 3
description: An erotic VISUAL NOVEL featuring HD graphics, steamy ANIMATIONS, and realistic-looking characters. Lily got herself a new yoga instructor to train her and help relieve her back pain, but James has other things in mind.

title: TaleSpire: Guest Edition
description: TaleSpire - Guest Edition lets you join, build, and play any TaleSpire campaign where the party has seats available. Has an ally of yours bought you a seat at the table? This is how you join them.

title: Forza Motorsport: Porsche 963 Combo
description: Celebrate The Big Race in Forza Motorsport with the 2024 Porsche #5 Porsche Penske Motorsport 963 and Porsche Racing Suit.

title: Nova's Adventure
description: After crashlanding on an unknown planet, Nova the Star sets out on an adventure to collect all the parts from his broken ship that was hit by an asteroid while on his way home.

title: Chromb
description:
Chromb is a clicker game about... chromb (chromb-chan).

In chromb game you click chromb-chan's ahoge to gain more ahoge which you can spend on things in shop or gain a prestige levels after reaching a certain amount of them.

title: Patchworld
description: As in other Action RPGs, you have to save the world. But this time there is no need to look for a legendary spell or an artifact created by a great sorcerer of antiquity. You create the spells yourself, and it's up to you to decide what they will be.

title: Salacot Jack: Deluxe
description: Fun puzzle and action arcade game.

title: Glowie Shooter
description: They glow in the dark and they are coming to get you. You'll need to endure the relentless waves of upcoming glowies. Can you survive the night and get them before they get you?

title: Final Tank
description: This is a top-down barrage shooting Roguelike game. You will experience driving a tank in a dangerous post apocalyptic wasteland to dodge enemy bullets and use weapons such as cannons and machine guns to defeat enemies and save the world

title: Stay Home It Rains Outside
description: Your digital refuge at the Alpha Centauri settlement. Visit whenever things aren't going well. This is a productivity tool with game elements. Customize your second body, gather fluffy creatures, and tackle real-life tasks using built-in productivity features.

title: Almost Reversi
description: This is a board game that combines deck building and Reversi. Buy powerful stones from the store and try to win 12 times within your time limit of 12 minutes!

title: Elevatrix
description: "A first-person indie horror shooter where players solve puzzles on each floor of a haunted building, all while surviving attacks from the undead and racing against the clock."

title: The Cool Guys Are Level 100
description: The goal of this game is in it's name. Hack and slash through randomized stages with 8 different playable characters each with their own unique playstyles. Will you be able to reach level 100 without dying and (possibly) become a cool guy?

title: Rabbit in Dungeon
description: A Little Rabbit Battles Ruthless Skeletons! Escape the Grasps of Numerous Skeletons, Flee the Dungeon, and Reveal Hidden Secrets.

title: The No No Man
description: A terrifying Indie horror experience with puzzle-platforming that will keep you on your toes as you find your way through the decrepit house. The only guidance you'll have going forward is your own wit and possibly the world's worst flashlight. But make no mistake, this is HIS house.

title: Chuzzo
description: Drop pucks. Score points. It's Chuzzo time.

title: Rampage Rowing
description: This game is a thrilling racing adventure that pits four characters against each other in a fast-paced competition.

title: Pollution
description: This game is a pixelated adventure set in a vast, open world where players pilot a plane using the ASDW keys for movement and the left mouse button to attack.

title: Surreal Farm
description: A vibrant and colorful world where creativity and strategy combine. you'll start with a humble plot of land, where you'll plant, harvest, and sell crops, raise quirky farm animals, and expand your farm into the largest and most prosperous in the region.

title: Janosik 2: Prologue
description:
Pick up the mantle of the plucky maiden getting ready for her date night that is unceremoniously interrupted by the dastardly duo of Countess Bathory and Baron de Blonde in this prologue to the colourful Janosik 2 retro action-platformer…

Janosik 2: Prologue is an introduction to "Janosik 2", presenting a separate story that takes place right before the events of the main game.

title: Food Delivery Simulator
description: Live the life of a food delivery driver. Deliver orders, earn money, upgrade your vehicle, explore a vast city, and make way to your success. Dive into a realistic daily adventure and level up to become the best delivery driver.

title: Penelope Pendrick and the Art of Deceit
description: Pick up your magnifying glass as writer-turned-detective Penelope Pendrick in this first-person point and click mystery adventure! Three people have suddenly vanished from the sleepy town of Carlisle. Follow the clues, interrogate suspects, and solve puzzles to end this case - before it ends you.

title: Zafe's Adventures
description: Zafe's Adventures is a new and simplified 2D platformer game with a simple run and gun elements and gameplay. Inspired by abandonware platformer, Sonic the Hedgehog series and its fangame, Spark the Electric Jester, Jazz Jackrabbit and Freedom Planet and as well with other simple 2D game that was made using GameMaker or Scratch in the past. This has been considered as a small solo indie game project only. The game follows a young and heroic pyrokinetic cartoon humanoid who tries to fight back against evil entities around the hillside wilderness. While he ends up on a long journey through another different world via the mysterious dimension portal.

title: Sonic StrikerZ
description:
Welcome to Sonic StrikerZ!
Using 2D Fighter Maker 2022, experience 1v1s, 2v2s, 3v3s and even 4v4 2D chaotic fights across as of right now in this version 27 Zones with 11 characters, including a story/campaign mode with bosses and online!

How you use your power is up to you...
Do not forget your dreams...

title: Ascend to Zero
description: Have you ever wondered what it's like to stop the time? Ascend to ZERO is a time-control roguelike, in which you can use your special ability to stop the time itself and efficiently fight your way through the top. Freeze the time to dodge opponents' attacks using your unique ability, and always hold a higher ground for the combat. However, don't forget that the time allowed for you is confined.

title: The Sims 4: Life and Death
description: Peel back the veil to uncover the secret to fuller Sim lives and beyond in The Sims 4 Life & Death Expansion Pack.

title: Shattered Souls
description: Hell hath no fury like a woman scorned, and you will not forget the betrayals inflicted upon you. With a mark that ties your fate to seven men, you’re determined to lay waste those who tried to shatter you. Will you try again?
3D Minesweeper 3D Logic. Randomly Generated. Unique Mechanics. Built-in Hints. Detection Assistance.

title: 100 Wars
description: The game mode is unpredictable like a kaleidoscope,and every opening is a brand new adventure. Sudden events are like surprise soldiers or mysterious Easter eggs, every shot is full of variables, and every decision is crucial. Multiple roles, multiple skills, multiple weapons, and multiple teammates

title: 15th Prison
description: There is no way out of this prison. But examine your surroundings carefully, do not ignore any abnormalities. Take the envelope given to you by the block officer and proceed, there may be an escape route. Your carelessness may result in death.
You are locked in a quiet apartment room. The only way out of the tightly closed door is to get to the truth of the case. Overcome your fear and try to escape.

title: 4 Rush Together
description: "4 Rush Together" is a light-hearted and funny obstacle course game where you and your friends are tied together with a rope, adventuring through creative levels filled with fun. You can invite up to three friends to play together in local multiplayer or online co-op mode. What are you waiting for?

title: 7 Ate 9
description: Why was 6 afraid of 7? And why did 7 resort to cannibalism? Its your job as detective number 9 to find out what happened in this case of murder by numbers. 7 Ate 9 is a small horror adventure with a lot of secrets to uncover and multiple endings to find.

title: 7 Nights Keeper
description: In 7 NIGHTS KEEPER, take a job to watch over a mansion for 7 nights and uncover a horrifying secret: the elderly occupant is possessed by a demon. Survive the escalating terror and keep the darkness at bay, or become its next victim.

title: 8 Ball Goal
description: Kick the white ball as best you can and score the goal before time runs out.

title: Abandoned City
description: Welcome to the abandoned city. All that's left in this city are zombies, and maybe they're interested in you. At the moment you are isolated, sure to die, but you have to hold on for as long as you can. Do you happen to know if someone will see your desperate uprising and rescue you..

title: Abnormal 1999: The Compass and the Sand
description: The fate of exile, like an endless river, carries Ann to a distant and unfamiliar land. A flame of unwavering determination burns within Ann's heart. She knows that one day, either Sam or SU will surely find her. Until then, Ann must find a way to escape this place.

title: Abnormality
description: Explore abandoned locations, collect paranormal evidence, and survive the wrath of the former residents still haunting them. Team up with up to 3 friends to investigate by day, and hide for your life by night. What begins as an investigation quickly turns into a desperate struggle to stay alive.

title: AboFlah-intelliFinish
description: Puzzle game on a difficult level. Start disassembling and assembling puzzles to reach the finish line

title: Adventure Paws
description: Adventure Paws is a pixel-style 2D side-scrolling adventure game where you and your friend will play as two cats, embarking on an exciting journey across a mysterious and unknown continent. Join the black and white cats and set off on this journey full of challenges and surprises!

title: Adventure of the Bucket
description: Embark on an adventure with the Iron Bucket and Wooden Bucket! Adventure of the Bucket is a cooperative multiplayer game where you control buckets connected by a spring to solve stages. Don't worry, you can play solo too!

title: Adventure in the Dungeon
description: Immerse yourself in the world of 2D action platformer, where you have to fight enemies and overcome obstacles.

title: Adventure Allies
description: This is a casual action-adventure game where you adventure with monsters on an unknown island and enjoy combat, exploration, and training. Work together with your fellow monsters to escape from the island before the terrifying night arrives.

title: Adrenaline Injection
description: Adrenaline Injection is the Demo version of Adrenaline Rampage game - Survivor platformer. You are trapped in a distorted space city. You need to survive and return home. Standing in your way are hordes of techno-mutants. And something strange is going on in this space city.

title: Aetheria: Whispers of the Forest Moon
description: In the enchanting world of Aetheria, three fairy warriors are on the cusp of graduating from their academy when their city is suddenly attacked. Embark on epic quests and missions to uncover the source of the darkness threatening their land.

title: Aetherian Chronicles
description: Aetherian Chronicles is a 3D Casual SideScroller MMORPG focused on interaction with AI controlled players. Explore, train, party up, make friends and trade with real people or AI controlled players! Customize your character to your hearts content and choose your own way to experience your adventure!

title: Aetherdale
description: Fight your way through the magical kingdom of Aetherdale in this roguelite, collecting powerful weapons and artifacts along the way.

title: Aether Collector
description: A surreal point-and-click adventure about harvesting mysterious Aether in an abandoned town. As a new corporate hire, explore a reality-bending anomaly, uncover dark secrets, and confront existential horrors while questioning the true nature of your mission.

title: After Tasks
description: Overtime horror game to be played at school late at night. Wait for the video playback to complete or go solve the paranormal, the choice is yours.

title: Age of Enlightenment
description: Shape the destiny of the world as an 18th century ruler. Forge alliances and prepare your armed forces to expand your domain and colonize new lands. Or focus on internal development and help your subjects thrive with prudent economic policy and lawmaking. The choice is yours in Age of Enlightenment!

title: Agents of Spleef
description: A crazy, single- or multi-player spleef game. Die the least amount of times to win.

title: Agnition: Ignis
description: Conjure the fire to solve puzzles of the mountain that holds the salvation of your people in this top-down puzzle game.

title: Agni: Village of Calamity
description: Agni, a determined investigator from a covert Indonesian police unit who defied orders and ventures into a remote village despite ominous warnings. What begins as an unauthorized investigation quickly plunges Agni into a horrifying reality

title: Alchemists
description: Alchemists is a Co-Op horror game that can be played with at least a minimum of 1 and a maximum of 4 players. Your goal is to expel the evil spirit from cursed places by completing the 4 Element ritual. Destroy the monster alone or with your team using your tools.

title: Project Rodeo
description: Project Rodeo is a proof of concept for a 3D platforming adventure game starring Rodeo, a bat living in an old western/steampunk fantasy-styled world who sets out on a grand adventure throughout the known islands. Inspirations for the game include the Mega Man Legends series, Grandia, Tail Concerto and The Legend of Zelda series.

title: Mighty Metas
description: “Mighty Metas” is an action-packed game where players battle using slash, shield slam, and stab moves. Each action has a counter, demanding quick reflexes and strategic thinking. With diverse characters and stunning environments, the game offers fast-paced, thrilling combat that keeps players hooked

title: What's left of Rave Rough
description: Rave Rough is a comedic and chaotic puzzle platformer about chucking your exposable vinyl collection to bounce your way throughout many platforming challenges! All the while butting heads with wacky friends and foes! Levels are very open ended and the moveset compliments this, with you having a lot of freedom to tackle challenges in all sorts of different ways.

title: Karaoke Joysound for Streamer
description:
"Karaoke Joysound for Streamer" offers unlimited singing of tens of thousands of songs that can be live-streamed and video posted!
In addition, there is a scoring game, a singing key change function, and a lyrics message display function, all of which are well-known at karaoke parlors.

title: The Halloween Party
description: A short point'n'click adventure game

title: Rebellion Stryker
description: Gun your way through this cyberpunk Run-n-Gun with never-before-seen hand-drawn graphics! Pick between two characters and even play co-op in this arcade title!

title: Good Night Pan Pan
description: Explore and investigate the dimly lit halls of a nearly abandoned shopping mall in cyberpunk Hong Kong all while being stalked by a mysterious Yuan Gui, a malevolent spirit hell-bent on taking your soul. Good Night Pan Pan is a short 3rd person survival horror homage to Cantonese horror and culture!

title: Add Town
description: sliding puzzle game

title: Alan Saves Christmas
description: A mild-mannered accountant called Alan tries to find out why Santa isn't delivering toys this year

title: Floor 9
description: In Floor 9, you find yourself trapped in a mysterious hotel known as "Hotel Liminal." To escape, you must identify anomalies on each floor. These anomalies can be anywhere - on the ground, in paintings, or even right in front of your eyes. You must check every corner carefully, as one mistake will send you back to the beginning, to Floor 9. The game offers you a unique blend of eerie atmosphere, puzzle-solving, and survival, all wrapped up in a psychologically thrilling experience.

title: Internet: legko i prosto!
description: The Internet is really easy and fun! It's full of fun adventures, and you'll learn how to navigate the global network with familiar characters like Globi and his companions. You'll explore the magical world of the Internet, learn how to use browsers and email, and understand the basics of online security.

title: Flippee Ball
description:
