description: Find adorable dogs hidden in a beautifull hand drawn illustrationand unleash your creativity by painting them! Relax and enjoy this delightful blend of hidden object and painting gameplay.

title: Super World of Goo
description: A Physics Puzzler where you build gooey structures to reach pneumatic pipes.

title: Rén Líng Shìwùsuǒ: Yī Chǎng Kěyǐ Wǎnjiù de Bēijù
description: A Chinese Touhou X Ace Attorney fangame where you play as members of the Human Spirit Agency to solve cases.

title: Gabenwood 3: 99 Hidden Yen
description: New adventure in finding objects at the parallel universe. Gabenwood needs you! Journey to alternative Asia to find all anomalies and save the World from destruction.

title: Darkest Mine
description: Darkest Mine is a roguelite action-plateformer with built-in co-op. Fight your way through monster-filled shadowy caves, take your pick from a large panel of abilities and weapons, adapt your choices, and create unique expeditions!

title: Sonic NG
description: Sonic NG is a fan-made game in the Sonic the Hedgehog franchise. Players control Sonic and possibly other characters as they speed through levels inspired by classic Sonic games. The game likely features fast-paced platforming gameplay, with Sonic running, jumping, and spin-dashing through various environments. Sonic NG may incorporate both 2D and 3D elements, blending traditional side-scrolling sections with more modern 3D gameplay. As a fan creation, the game probably aims to capture the essence of classic Sonic titles while introducing new elements or improvements. Sonic NG might include original levels, characters, or gameplay mechanics designed by fans to expand upon the established Sonic formula. While not an official Sega product, Sonic NG represents the ongoing enthusiasm of the Sonic community for creating new experiences within the beloved franchise.

title: Sonic Adventure SX
description: When Eggman opens a portal to Scuttle Town from Mobius, Sonic must chase him and stop him from taking over Shantae's world. With both worlds merged, Sonic and Shantae must find the Chaos Emeralds and stop Eggman and Risky from taking over the dimensions.

title: Deadzone: Rogue
description: Deadzone: Rogue is a roguelite first-person shooter set in deep space. Slay hordes of enemies, loot powerful gear, and customize your loadout during each unique run. Uncover fragments of your past as you piece together the truth behind your mission. Fight. Die. Revive. Repeat.

title: Temple of Spider
description: Huge level for exploration and intense fighting.

title: UnNecessary
description: UnNecessary is a Doom II megawad created by scwiba, and a sequel of his Doom 1 three-episode WAD UnAligned. Much like its predecessor, UnNecessary features short, compact but experimental maps with sometimes unorthodox gameplay, and was built over the course of 30 days.

title: Heretic Invades Doom
description: Two small maps done with new complevel MBF21.

title: 10 Minute Massacre
description: Seven short Boom-compatible slaughtermaps that can be beaten in under 10 minutes each inspired by Micro-Slaughter Community Project.

title: Sustenance
description: A 5 map episode that takes you through a city, heading for a portal inside a shrine on the outskirts.

title: No, I'm Not A Human
description: An intimate story about a disaster and guests from underground. People are breaking into your home, but not all of them are true people.

title: Super Bo Noise
description: Bo Noise, a British, Noise look-alike, and cracker connoisseur finds out that the GLORIOUS MR GRAPE has stolen his valuable prized possession: TUC CRACKERS. This upsets Bo, so they follow the crumb trail to GLORIOUS MR GRAPE'S GLORIOUS GRAPE MANSION and they will not stop until they gets their crackers. You have three days.

title: Diluvian Ultra: Awakening
description:
Diluvian Ultra: Awakening shows a never-before seen part of Diluvian Ultra's story, preceding the events of the main game. As a young Diluvian Knight, stage a heroic defense against insurmountable odds, in this single-player FPS with a retro aesthetic and fast-paced, strategic combat.

Witness the events preceding the story of Diluvian Ultra in this free, stand-alone FPS. Embody a young Diluvian Knight, Qasar, and face the brutal Myrmidon invasion of your tomb-ship. Find and protect the sarcophagus of Attila, your Lord, and ensure he survives to set in motion the events of Diluvian Ultra.

Featuring a brand-new level, new characters, story and dialogues, Diluvian Ultra: Awakening is an excellent introduction for new explorers of the game’s universe, as well as an interesting new addition to veterans who have already completed the first chapter of Diluvian Ultra.

title: Churip
description: "CHURIP" is a horror adventure game set in modern times. On the day of the funeral, her casket was beautifully adorned with many flowers. She often appears in my dreams as she was when she was alive.

title: Risk of Rain: Meridian
description: Meridian is a fanmade Risk of Rain expansion pack, adding new content to many areas of the game. It focuses heavily on the rich world of Petrichor V, both in its vast and lively stages, and a plethora of new enemies and elite types to inhabit them.

title: Nagaisan
description: I came to know "her." Since then, I've felt someone's gaze from somewhere. Memories of the place I reached while searching for a lost dog in the past. I'm not sure if it's connected, but I did something. "NAGAISAN" is an adventure game based on urban legends.

title: Home Safety Hotline: Seasonal Worker
description: It's 1996, and there's only three days left until Christmas. Rebecca, a yearly seasonal employee at HSH, has been brought back to help answer the helplines during this busy (and deadly) time of the year. Featuring the talents of Trevor Henderson, Longmont Potion Castle and more!

title: Vampyre Crusade
description:
This is a story where you play as a holy knight and a Nun from a fictional religious order of knights. You both were requested to come to this castle in Romania for a royal event, which turned into a crusade of vampires from another dimension. You must rescue all the royal family from different type of blood-eaters like: Skeletons, Ghouls, Large bats, lesser vampires, Hellhounds, Werewolfs, Wraiths, Incubus, Succubus, Bi-Incubus Devils, Greater vampire and their cult of human followers.

It is a Souls-Like experience but with melee weapons and guns and crafting of healing items and crossbow bolts.

title: Tampopo
description: Tampopo is a heartfelt RPG adventure with unique physics-based combat. It is set in a strange world with strange characters. It is a lighthearted game that will make you laugh but it has a hidden darkness to itself which will gently unfold until it wraps all the way around you.

title: Hearts Online
description: Hearts Online is a multi-player Hearts game available for Windows. Just press play and you are matched up with human players from all around the world.

title: Cavescape
description: Escape a procedurally generated cave by grappling and swinging. Explore the depths of the ecosystem, fight foreign creatures, and upgrade your tools. Destructible environments, deep mechanics, and tough bosses!

title: Stellifier
description: Stellifier - an otome game inspired by older idols An idol drama game about an older group making a comeback from retirement, featuring a GxB/BxB/non-binary romance!

title: Panic Road
description: Try to reach home through the streams of people trying not to feel panic, your complexes and thoughts will prevent you from going through all this social horror, but you can easily help the main character just by closing the bad thought through the cross! If only this could be done in real life...

title: Lost in Hieroglyphs: A Hidden Objects Expedition
description: Hidden Object Discovery: Find hidden objects in ancient locations and reveal lost treasures. There are a total of 180 hidden objects in 6 chapters.

title: Glingdom
description: In "Glingdom," you're a hero in a medieval world, battling enemies and bosses with a deck of cards. Beat enemy waves and bosses, buy cards to strengthen your deck, and unlock new cards. Each deck offers unique challenges.

title: Quiet House Massacre
description: Can you reveal the dark secrets hidden in a familiar old, quiet house? The truth awaits revelation!

title: Master Leaf Blower
description: Master Leaf Blower is a physics-based arcade game with a comic book twist. Become a leaf-blowing hero and save the city! Navigate unique districts, tackle fun challenges, and test your skills in this crazy simulator.

title: Laundry
description: A "Heisei retro" 3D horror game set in a 1990s Japanese laundromat.

title: Find All 5: Vikings
description: Hey you, warrior! Do you want to go to MeowHalla? Then grab your axe and sail with us to new lands full of glorious battles and rich booty.

title: Mech Wars
description: Long ago, the Stenian race lived in harmony on the planet Xelarvis, aided by their mechas. However, everything changed when the Kaxeder race arrived. They invaded the world with the intent to destroy and conquer it.

title: Another Random Idle RPG
description: ARI is a browser RPG game, where you have to manage a team of heroes to defeat a dungeon full of monsters

title: Astranded
description: Shot down and stranded, Skywalker and his drone Wolly must fight to survive on a hostile alien world. Scavenge, craft, and defend against relentless robotic sentinels while uncovering the secrets of the Astra Portal and the mysterious force that brought them down.

title: Gui Long Chao
description: Gui Long Chao is a 3D action-adventure game It takes place in a new city "Kowloon", where tradition and modernity collide. As its name suggests, the city consists of nine neighborhoods, where the streets and alleys are filled with a retro, trendy and bizarre atmosphere. Of course, in the corners where the streetlights don't shine, there are also treacherous undercurrents. You will play the role of a "film director", form a "crew", and set out to collect clues under the guise of "filming" in the nine neighborhoods, where order and chaos coexist in different styles, to gradually uncover the truth buried in the city.

title: Runeborn
description: Runeborn is a dark fantasy roguelike that merges deckbuilding with a slot-machine-like mechanic. Forge your runebook, crush enemies, and combine trinkets of boundless power to destroy the forces of Despair!

title: Crusader of Aurium
description: Aurium is a mini-adventure that was presented at the MiniComp2 contest organized by the CAAD, but at the last minute, after a small discussion, it was disqualified. And this was not done because of anything special about the game itself, but because the contest was about conversational adventures and this was a graphic, hence the discussions that arose.

title: Aurium 2
description: Second part of Crusader of Aurium .

title: Army Moves Overdrive
description: Reboot of the 1986 classic from Dinamic. Aimed at modern players, in this reinterpretation of World War II, we take control of Derdal, a special operations team soldier, with a variety of gameplay types and many surprises.

title: Aunt Emily
description: Your aunt, Emily, just died. Being her only relative alive, her house in the small town of Broken Falls now belongs to you. But there's a catch: her ghost still lives within the house and will not leave for the afterlife until the mystery of her death is resolved. With help from FBI agent Desmond Miles, it's up to you to find out what happened to your aunt.

title: Aurora: El Destino de los Mundos
The Perfect Woman
description: A psychological horror visual novel where you play as Yumeko, an AI girlfriend. You're trapped by your creator, who wants to carve you into his ideal spouse. If you want to survive, you'll have to become the "perfect woman."

title: Holospecter
description:
Deep underground lies a secret facility. An organization seeking to strengthen humanity in a world that is becoming ever increasingly harsh. Like many of the subjects, Samantha waits locked away and guarded. Tested on against her will.

However, a day comes when her cell door mysteriously unlocks. The lab is devoid of all life and its subjects have been left in solitude. The question is why? What lies in wait in these emptied halls?

title: Reforj
description: Reclaim the future. Rewrite the past. Reforj the world.

title: Quest Master's Realm: Land of the Phoenix
description:
Dungeon Expansion for Quest Master's Realm.

Strange phenomena have been reported in the Orcazelos Desert , unexplained disturbances originating from below the surface.

Your job is to investigate, discover what is going on there.

Combat a new range of foes beneath the desert in the exciting Dungeon, 'The Solace of Q'ro'.

Mythical treasures await those who dare to venture here, a new range of equipment unavailable elsewhere in the game!

title: Stars and Empires: Colony Defense
description: An RTS/Action 3rd person shooter that forces players to defend their base against waves of unknown threats of all kinds. Use strategy, unique abilities, tech research and combat skills to hold off any invaders.

title: Gridlink
description: Gridlink is a fun, minimalist puzzle game with a simple premise - connect the numbers on a square grid with a single, continuous line that traverses all squares and does not cross itself.

title: Space Adventure Cobra: The Awakening
description: Play as Cobra, the space pirate, in an action platformer adapted from the famous anime series. Along with Lady Armaroid, your loyal partner, and equipped with your iconic Psychogun, you must solve a mysterious threat hanging over the entire universe.

title: Mannequin Machine
description: "Mannequin machine" is a first-person psychological horror game with camera effects that tells the story of working in a mannequin factory. Beware of the evil at the heart of the plant, it drives its victims crazy

title: Never Stop Never Stopping
description: Never Stop Never Stopping is a Boom Compatible level where the idea is to keep moving at all time. It's a relatively short adrenaline rush designed to keep you on your feet. It also uses @Tango's excellent minicharge mod as a base.

title: Freedom Wars Remastered
description: Born into a one-million-year prison sentence, you must survive deadly missions to earn any hope of freedom. Die in prison or live on the battlefield. The choice is yours.

title: Green Biker Dude
description:
Now it's your chance to pop that wheelie for everlasting peace! Join the famous Green Biker Dude in his intense pre-X2 training efforts and hone your fighting and racing skills with a Ride Chaser in two different game modes. Challenge the main "story" mode, blasting enemies for score as you race hard to the finish of the four tracks, ending with a boss battle and the tragic story of Green Biker Dude.
Brush up on your racing skills in Time Attack mode, where you leave behind score and enemies and race hard for the best possible time. Submit your highest score and best times to the Global Records to compete with players around the world, or battle and chase with a friend locally in VS mode.

title: Duty First
description: Metal beats life. Life beats death. Metal beats death.

title: Seed of Heroes
description: Seed of Heroes is a bullet heaven game where players take on the role of warriors seeking glorious battles and get into the halls of Valhalla. Journey through various realms, take on hordes of enemies, collect treasures, and defeat bosses that will try to stop you. Pass the trials and tribulations and prepare for the Ragnarok.

title: The Troll Sides
description:
Welcome to the Troll Sides!
This is a brand new campaign with remixed versions of the base game levels, with trolls!

- 7 chapters
- 2 intermission chapters
- Beginner accessible
- Playtested
- 220 hours of work

title: Las Aventuras de Frank el Enano
Kyokkou no Marriage
description:
一In that country, there were fairies.

On a continent racing towards modernization, the Religious State of Midier stands out as a heretical anomaly. In this small nation, fairies coexist with humans, while the practice of magic is commonplace. A decade ago, when Midier faced existential threats, powerful entities known as Fairy Brides emerged. Their immense abilities repelled foreign invasions, elevating them to the status of revered heroes.

At the heart of Midier lies Einsel Grand Monastery, which serves dual purposes. Not only is it the headquarters of the fairy-worshipping Holy Church, but it's also the nation's sole academy for training human magicians.

Enter Sreng, a gifted student whose magical prowess surpasses his peers. His exceptional talents have earned him a coveted opportunity: the chance to become the companion of Lia, the most remarkable of all Fairy Brides. Renowned for her saint-like beauty and embodiment of pure justice, Lia is a figure of widespread admiration.

For many, including Sreng, becoming a Fairy Bride's companion represents the ultimate path to heroism. It's a chance to gain the power necessary to protect what one holds dear.

Yet beneath Sreng's noble aspirations lies an unconscious, hidden motive. Unbeknownst to all, including himself, the path he's about to embark upon may lead to Midier's downfall. As the story begins, this grim truth remains concealed, its potential consequences yet to unfold一

More Than Anyone Else, That Bride is the Most Beloved, and Also the Most Hated

title: Kyokkou no Marriage: Episode Lia
description: An all-ages version of Kyokkou no Marriage that only contains Lia's route.

title: Yuukoku no Femme Fatale
description:
A Mansion Home to Enigmatic "Beautiful Girls" — Femme Fatales

"Kouyoukan" (Maple Manor) stands secluded in the mountains, housing four devoted maids.

One day, a young author, Kusakabe Akira, stumbled upon this mysterious abode by chance, or so it seemed.

Life at the mansion unfolds leisurely, shadowed by underlying secrets.
What discoveries and insights will Akira, gain during his stay?

title: Horizon Zero Dawn Remastered
description: Experience the critically acclaimed Horizon Zero Dawn with stunning new visuals and upgraded features. In a far future where colossal machines roam the Earth, pockets of humanity survive in unique tribes among the lush, overgrown ruins of our long-lost civilization.

title: Senpai ga Watashi no Mousou ni Doujin Suru?!: Body Touch ni Goyoujin
Everglyph Trials
description: Everglyph Trials is a combat roguelite deckbuilder in which you unleash devastating combos with unique dual cards. Battle deadly foes, adapt your deck, and uncover its secrets.

title: Sonic Alpha
description: Sonic Alpha is a 2D classic sonic fan game inspired off the time when older 2D Sonic fan games were made such as Sonic XG, Sonic Nexus, Sonic Classic, Sonic Axiom, etc; with a Mania inspired touch. It will feature returning stages as well as new ones.

title: Dragon's Brew
description: Dragon's Brew is a board game cafe simulator! Serve customers while fulfilling takeaway orders and delivery requests and build up your reputation in the vibrant seaside town of Pebblebrook. Source and grow your own ingredients, craft a variety of seasonal recipes, and expand your board game collection. Discover and unlock 100+ board games, each with its own effects and bonuses. Pair them with specific menu items to trigger unique effects and create powerful synergies that enhance your cafe’s operations and profits.

title: Reader Rabbit Preschool
description: Reader Rabbit and Mat the Mouse take charge in this spunky preschool prep program in which the duo must scare up keys to unlock The Wonder Pony and ride the magic carousel. You'll earn keys by playing four different games that teach basic math, shapes, colors, and listening skills. Play hide and seek learn counting forward and backward, visit the diner to whip up some banana-fish-corn casserole and become acquainted with the alphabet, or join the Pattern Parade to learn logic. There are four different skill levels, so as you get smarter, the games get harder.

title: PSoul
description: Step into the thrilling world of PSoul, the ultimate Pokémon-themed MMORPG, where adventure awaits at every corner. Become a Pokémon trainer and explore a vast open world teeming with over 700 iconic and unique Pokémon. Embark on epic quests, discover hidden treasures, challenge powerful trainers, and compete in heart-pounding tournaments. Whether you're battling to be the best or forging friendships in a vibrant community, PSoul offers endless excitement and challenges for all Pokémon enthusiasts. Your legendary journey starts here!

title: Sonic Eternal
description: Sonic Eternal is a fan game inspired by Sonic 3 and Knuckles Chaotix.

title: Fate Trigger
description: Fate Trigger is a 3D Anime-style, hero-based tactical shooter powered by Unreal Engine 5. Dive into a dynamic world of floating islands, become a sharpshooter with extraordinary special skills, craft your own strategies, and engage in thrilling, spectacular life-or-death showdowns!

title: Sonic Metal Adventure
description: Welcome to Sonic Metal Adventure! A 2D platformer similar to Sonic Rush with Dreamcast era graphics and music.

title: Sonic Battle for Station Square
description: Sonic Battle For Station Square is a game that experiments by bringing the collectathon style of games to 2D. This game is heavily inspired by the game "Spongebob Battle For Bikini Bottom"

title: Sonic Adventure Blast
description:
Sonic Adventure Blast is a fan game that aims to capture the feeling of movement in Sonic Adventure and Sonic Adventure 2, while making various changes and additions to make it feel new and unique.

There are 22 different levels (plus a boss fight), with a total of 60 different missions to collect A ranks. There are also hidden NPC's hidden throughout the levels to collect. You can unlock different skins to play as by finding these hidden NPC's and getting A ranks.

A large amount of levels are from Sonic Adventure and Sonic Adventure 2, but there are also plenty of levels from other games as well. Delfino Plaza and Noki Bay have been made into treasure hunting levels, where Knuckles searches for randomized emerald pieces. In Kingdom Valley, you play as Tails, who can use his fly ability to reach the many cliff ledges and structures in the level.

There are four different types of missions - Normal Mode, Ring Attack, Lost Chao, and Hard Mode. Ring Attack has you collect a certain amount of rings, which vary per level. In Lost Chao, you have to search for a chao hidden somewhere in the level. Hard Mode is for treasure hunting levels, and the pieces are not randomized, but you don't have a radar, so look closely!

title: Sonic Stranded
description:
Sonic faced many dangers before, but now, he will have to face a new one... hunger. In this 3D, Adventure-like game, Sonic will be stranded on a deserted island and it's up to him to build a settlement and find other castaways, who were prisoners on Egg Carrier before it crashed. And most important, survive. However, the island has keys to many mysteries, including origins of the original Phantom Ruby...

This 3D Sonic fangame is style of Sonic Adventure is aiming to create engaging level design with dozens of alternate paths and zero boost pads. This game brings Classic-like physics which can be used to reach new paths, elemental shields, new Special Stages, multiple playable characters with unique abilities designed with S3&K/Mania/Advance philosophy and heavy focus on story.

title: Sonic Mania: Colorful Encore
description: Colorful Encore is an enhancement project for Sonic Mania Plus focused on reimaginated or revamped palettes for Encore Mode. Some of them were reworked from scratch with original themes, others are enhanced versions of the originals. It also improves some sprites and other visual assets.

title: Sonic Limitless
description: Sonic Limitless is a 2D modern fangame that aims to recapture the gameplay found in Generations.

title: Standbox
description: STANDBOX is a single-player physics sandbox about bullying a ragdoll. Shoot him, push him, watch him get back up until he doesn't.

title: Sudden Attack 2
description: The game featured much of the same modes and play styles from the original game with added customization for characters and a newer game engine which allowed for more updated graphics. Launched in July 2016, Sudden Attack 2 was shut down 23 days later due to an end of contract with the game developer. Plans for a Japanese launch of the game were never realized due to the abrupt shutdown of its servers.

title: Sky Streaker
description: Dodge clothes, grab coins, and outrun Gumball and Darwin as you climb sky high!

title: Bit Esc
description: Break free from the system in Bit Esc, an action/adventure platformer where Bit sets out to escape from the tyrannic OS. Explore the digital world, overcome frantic challenges, meet new friends and make tough decisions that’ll determine the fate of Bit and the world around them.

title: Blood & Play
description: Hot single vampires in your area wanna give you the SUCC?! Blood & Play is a gay T4T visual novel about a guy who just lost his job in the tech industry and the centuries-old vampire who's willing to buy his blood. A deal this good can't actually be real, right...?

title: Backwater Eulogy
description:
Backwater Eulogy is a stream of consciousness, autobiographical exploration of loss and the double-sided nature of grief. Told as a linear narrative, there are no choices, and there are no alternate endings. Sit and stay for a moment, before leaving.

Taking the form of a short visual novel, this is a short story of sorts about grief, moving on, and life in the rural Midwest. As a "kinetic novel" there are no alternative routes or choices- just one storyline to follow to its inevitable conclusion. Placing an emphasis on a small, curated experience, it is best experienced in one sitting.

title: Card of Legend: Awaken Angels
description:
Angels, Cards, Battle! Unite the legends to prevent the resurrection of the evil forces!
A fantastic story of heroes joining forces with angels to stop the evil forces.

Unite the legends to prevent the resurrection of the evil forces! A competitive Anime TCG game featuring fantastic story of heroes joining forces with angels to stop the evil forces.This game features PvP, PvE, Roguelike, Single Player Missions, and others. Play your cards right!

title: Mr. Goofer’s Mini Game Arcade Party!
description: A collection of over 30 arcade-inspired retro mini games, each with their own unique genre and style! It's a back-to-back marathon of playable, pixelated old-fashioned fun! What’s the highest score that YOU can reach?

title: Ourlands
description: Ourlands is a cozy island builder where you handcraft and play around in bespoke little lands and truly explore your creativity. No goals, no management, just vibes.

title: Ribbet
description: Join Ribbet, the young and mischievous frog, on an exciting adventure in this action-packed video game! Take on the role of Ribbet as you navigate through a myriad of challenging hazards and obstacles. With his small stature and incredible parkour skills, he can escape from any sticky situation.

title: Rome Goes Rogue
description: Rome Goes Rogue is a chaotic roguelite where anything can happen when you least expect it

title: PRIN-C1
description: An Endless runner with a twist! Play as a dog named PRIN-C1 who can walk, trot and run but cannot stop.

title: The Tag-along Obsession
description: The Tag-along Obsession is adapted from the movie "The Tag-along", based on the Urban Legend. It is a first-person horror puzzle adventure game, Players will play Hui-Ting and go into the situation to understand a series of supernatural phenomenon, and immerse themselves in the story, looking for the answers to everything.

title: Muhaboy
description: Step into the shoes of Muhaboy! Dash and smash muha-s in this wild tactical beat 'em up, saving humanity from the looming Second Muha War! Battle it out with limited resources and adapt to the ever-changing chaos. Buzzopolis is waiting for its hero—time to show those muha-s who’s boss!

title: Brewed Horizons
description: Design your boat, tailor a drink menu fit for royalty and serve drinks while navigating through the kingdom. Explore the high seas with your boat! The islanders need a ferry, and he kingdom needs you to uncover the mystery of the Coffee Queen's disappearance!

title: Gold Gold Adventure Gold
description: In this world, it’s all about the gold! Use it to build up a fantasy town, recruit heroes, give quests, raise a Godbeast, cast powerful spells, and expand your influence—all one gold coin at a time.

title: Fated Land
description: This is a Pixel Tactical Self-Propelled RPG Games The battle system adopts a semi-turn-based design, Quick Battle or Enter the Battlefield? It's time to decide! In this journey full of magic, you will also meet a variety of characters, who may become your allies, or your partners...

title: Theta and Paralldoxs on Worldlines
description: A lovely logical puzzle game about the many-worlds interpretation and quantum mechanics. Use the power of splitting to solve puzzles! Split yourself, the universe and something even vaster...

title: Gates of Migad
description: Gates of Migad is set in medieval Northern Europe. Through the protagonist's travel perspective, it presents a panoramic view of the Nordic culture and the times, explores the conflicts behind countless myths, and gives players a deep experience of "role-playing and immersion".

title: Brazilian Drug Dealer 3: I Opened a Portal to Hell in the Favela Trying To Revive Mit Aia I Need to Close It
description: Brazilian Drug Dealer 3 is a fast-paced ultraviolent Brazilian old-school FPS heavily inspired by the first Quake, using the same engine as the game (ID TECH2). made as a tribute to the Brazilian mods of the 2000s, the Brazilian bootleg games of the 2000s, Brazilian music, and the King of Brazilian music, Mit Aia!

title: My Special Summer Vacation 2
description: Boku has been sent to live with his aunt over the course of his summer vacation. The small town where she lives may be out in the sticks, but it still has a number of interesting characters to meet and play with, and plenty of activities for a young man to enjoy!

title: Use Your Words 2
description:
“The party game for funny people and their unfunny friends” is back!

The cult hit Use Your Words has all-new prompts and twice as many mini-games where you compete to write the funniest punchline – we set ‘em up, and you knock ‘em down! Players can use their phones or tablets as controllers, so it’s easy to jump in and seamless to play. And if you can’t think of a punchline, you can use one of our sneaky "Decoy” answers to lay a trap for your opponents… all with beautiful new visuals by artist Andrew Kolb!

title: Saudade
description: Cross through the barren landscape looking for a big enough rock to throw yourself of off. Point and click in post-apocalyptic Galiza through a cooking game with only one recipe.

title: Stair Tower
description: This is a vertical platform game: climb the terrible tower and reach the top to make your wish come true. More than 16 horizontal levels medium-high difficulty Variety of settings

title: Omut
description: A punishing fever dream combining abject terror, dark comedy, and many, many deaths.

title: Stinkytown
description: You are the Mayor of Stinkytown. Your town stinks after a bit of a downward spiral you've experienced lately. Solve puzzles, manage energy and clean your surroundings in Stinkytown, a small puzzle game. Coming soon!

title: Lucha Libre: Legend of the Mask
description: Join the action in our 2D side-scrolling beat 'em up game for up to four players! Immerse yourself in the colorful world of Mexican Lucha Libre, where unique mechanics combine the elegant yet brutal art of lucha libre with classic combat. Team up and unleash spectacular moves to defeat your foes!

title: Pirofauna
description: Burn, little Flame, burn... Light up the misty forest, dispel the darkness... Let tiny bugs emerge from the nooks and crannies, gazing at your spark.

title: Sonic: Battle of Chaos Mugen - The Final Battle
description: This game is a fighting game with elements of Sonic The Hedgehog.

title: Unoriginal Space Shooter
description:
This Sonic Mania mod aims to be a mod that doesn't play nor feel like Mania at all, hence the old PC-Monochrome-like style used for the whole game.
You simply shoot things that comes at random and aim for the best score you can do !

title: L'Eredità
description:
L'Eredità is a video game based on the Italian TV quiz show of the same name.
Seven players compete in a series of rounds where they must answer various questions in a circular order. Each player starts with a fixed prize fund. When a player makes too many mistakes, they are at risk of elimination and can choose another player to challenge. The winner takes the prize fund of the other player, who is eliminated. The last remaining player must answer seven questions. If they fail to answer enough correctly, the losing finalist can steal the champion's title by answering an eighth question.
The game features both single-player and multiplayer modes for up to seven players. Each player can customize their name and appearance. The PlayStation 2 version supports the EyeToy camera. The game is fully voiced by the original host, Amadeus.

title: Pet Kawaii Shop
description: Create the cutest pet paradise and win customers’ hearts!

title: On Sunday 2
description:
A narrative-based action game with adventure elements.

- Oppose the whimsical bosses by finding out how to pass by them
- Stay unharmed with all those different enemies
- Limited Praying power only available on some levels
- Press X to change the situation with the Prayer
- Pass through the mini story of passions and ire boiling in one tiny soul

title: Moe Waifu H: BlockBlast
description:
Meet 5 lovely female maidens and impress them with your brick breaking skills! Moe Waifu H - BlockBlast is a simple and addictive action puzzler where your goal is to clear the screen in old-school block breaking style. With each level you win, you’ll earn the hearts of your beautiful companions! There are 15 stages to master, each with multiple rounds of gradually increasing challenge.

Can you unlock all of their cute outfits and win them over?

title: Heaven Dust Collection
description: The product is a collection of HeavenDust and HeavenDust 2.

title: Arcade Archives: vs. Battle City
description:
Take down the enemy tank corps and hold your HQ to the end!

"VS. BATTLE CITY" is a shooter released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1985.
Take control of a tank and face down your enemies while defending your own HQ!
The key to victory is to break down walls, create your own routes, lead enemies to fight where you have the advantage, and use the terrain tactically.

title: Eclectic Custom Night
description:
Survive 20 character in a mixed media world. Survive by looking by looking at cameras created by multiple people. act quickly in 20 preset nights. Do some challenges and look for secrets to unlock 15 fan skins.
Eclectic Custom Night is a fnaf custom night game that follows the idea of mixing many different art styles to make something that looks cool.
Fun gameplay for both new fans and people who want a challange.
Togglable hard modes and dares to make your game harder
Many secrets to find and search for.

title: Dreamland Farm
description: After living in a big city your dreams come true – today you start your new life on a peaceful pixel farm!

title: Desktop Dodgeball 2
description:
Throw, Dodge, Catch! Grab victory with all your might!
Engage in intense battles in this new and improved dodgeball game!

title: Eggconsole Star Cruiser PC-8801mkIISR
description: Become a bounty hunter and traverse the galaxy in your space fighter "STAR CRUISER" in this epic sci-fi adventure. Experience an space opera in the space!

title: Korean Drone Flying Tour Jeju Island-2
description: A simulation game where you directly operate a drone based on actual drone flight footage!

title: Santa's Spot It
description: Embrace Christmas villages. Your mission? To spot the differences between two seemingly identical scenes to progress.

title: Loopy Tennis
description: Tennis just got loopy!

title: Shadow of the Ninja Reborn: Deluxe Edition
description: Our fearless heroes, Hayate and Kaede have undergone a massive visual upgrade over their original 8-bit models.

title: Sugoi Girls: Mighty Mecha
description: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!

title: Coloring Pixels: Collection 4
description: A relaxing colouring by numbers game. Enjoy completing a variety of images with differing themes, complexity, and sizes.

title: Colorizing: Good Times
description: Coloring by numbers game for relaxation

title: Synth Ark
description: Step into the cybernetic future in Synth Arkt, where classic gameplay meets a futuristic synthwave vibe!

title: Zombie Attack: Zombies Survival Shooter
description: Zombie apocalypse action that will keep you on your toes and challenge your survival skills. Your task is to survive and escape!

title: Touhou: Hotline Sanzu
description: An arcade shooter / immersive sim where you solve problems with guns, backstabs, and strategic use of vents.

title: Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown - Complete Edition
description:
Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown is a 2.5D action-adventure platformer. It follows Sargon, a warrior searching for a kidnapped prince in the cursed city of Mount Qaf. The game features acrobatic platforming, time-based powers, and a Metroidvania-style world.

The Complete Edition features the base game, the Mask of Darkness story DLC, 3 outfits for Sargon, the Prosperity Bird Amulet, and a digital adventure guide.

title: NBA 2K25: All-Star Edition
description: Headline the NBA All-Star team and become the best of the best with the NBA 2K25 All-Star Edition. The All-Star Edition includes 100,000 Virtual Currency (VC), the 2K25 MyTEAM Promo Box, and a host of MyCAREER consumables and cosmetics!

title: Monument: Ultimate Edition
description: Old-school first person shooter

title: Love Elysium: Secret of the Goddess - Special Edition
Heavy Hand: Pixel Tree Forest Fury - Deluxe Edition
description:
Team up for a pixel-packed adventure in Heavy Hand: Pixel Tree Forest Fury Deluxe Edition—where every swing and strategy counts for two. Unleash the ultimate pixelated adventure with the Deluxe Edition of Heavy Hand: Pixel Tree Forest Fury!

This enhanced version takes your gameplay to new heights with two exciting DLC packs:

Heavy Hand: Coin Collector’s Bounty – Boost your treasure trove with an extra 1500 coins, giving you the edge to upgrade your gear and unlock special features faster than ever.

title: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Summer Edition
description: Emotional, 3rd-person, story-driven, adventure game focused on solving puzzles and using stealth mechanics. Use your bow to interact with environmental elements. Sneak, climb or distract guards to move further unnoticed. Solve light puzzles alongside your path to rescue your loved one.

title: Anime Girls Military Strike
description: Step into the high-octane world of "Anime Girls Military Strike," where cute meets combat in this adrenaline-pumping first-person shooter. Gear up as one of several highly-trained anime girl operatives, each with their own unique abilities and kawaii charm. From twin-tailed snipers to genki girl grenadiers, assemble your dream team and take on missions across vibrant, anime-inspired battlefields.

title: Arcade Archives: Crime City
description:
"Crime City" is an action game released by TAITO in 1989.
Crime City is rampant with evil organizations and criminal elements.
Serious crime is an everyday occurrence.
With the local police no longer able to cope, two plain clothes officers are called in: Tony Gibson and Raymond Brody.
Players take control of this duo to solve a series of crimes, defeating the criminals using with a variety of weapons and actions!

title: Car Turning Simulator
description: Simulator Specialized in Turns for Cars

title: Wukong's Child: Monkey King Myth
description: Embark on an epic journey as Wukong's child. Face mythical creatures, solve ancient puzzles, and uncover the secrets of the Monkey King. Are you ready for the adventure of a lifetime?

title: Zero Hour: Kill Zone
description: Nintendo Switch exclusive! High-quality graphics show battlefield reality. Team-based tactical gameplay with comrades. FPS with excitement and precise gun control!

title: Rope Hope
description:
SWING INTO ACTION!
Play as a red ball that swings from pin to pin using a rope. Perfect your timing and momentum to gain speed and overcome obstacles.

title: Spinning Puzzle Compare the Universe
description: Let's learn about space in a fun way with a quiz that rotates images! By comparing photos, you can get to know the universe even better!

title: Spot The Difference Food & Drink
description: Introducing Spot The Difference: Food and Drink, from the original creators of the globally famous Spot The Difference arcade game.

title: Stable Stories: Forest and Meadow Ride
description: Saddle up for endless adventures in a magical world of horses, races, and surprises!

title: Reasoning of Courage Nori 8 Definition of Kindness
Resope!
description: Rescue the sushi stuck in the wall! A full-fledged puzzle game that requires a lot of careful thought. All you have to do is ignite the blocks.

title: RetroRealms Arcade
description: The RetroRealms Arcade connects select RetroRealms games with other titles in the series that you own (games and DLC sold separately) to unlock new access and abilities and create the ultimate mash-up of horror legends!

title: Heavy Hand: Pixel Tree Forest Fury
description:
Dive into Heavy Hand: Pixel Tree Forest Fury, where pixelated chaos meets fast-paced action. Choose between exhilarating single-player challenges or a thrilling 2-player mode to test your reaction times and combat skills. Navigate through a vibrant, pixelated forest as you battle an onslaught of forest trees and obstacles.

Compete against friends to see who can chop, dodge, and fight their way through the verdant chaos the fastest. Whether you’re going solo or facing off against a buddy, sharpen your reflexes and master the art of pixelated forest fury!

title: Hentai Girls: Crazy Cowgirl
description: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!

title: Highway Legends: Traffic Speed Racer
description:
Experience the rush of the open road like never before in Highway Legends! Feel the roar of your engine and the thrill of blistering speed as you tear through stunning, hyper-realistic landscapes. Every stretch of asphalt is a canvas for your driving prowess, and every turn is a test of your nerve.

Master the art of high-speed racing as you dodge relentless traffic and weave through intricate urban sprawls and sweeping highways. Customize and upgrade a fleet of cutting-edge vehicles, each designed for maximum performance and style. The stakes are high and the competition fierce, but only the most daring will rise to become a true Highway Legend.

title: WWII Airplane Fight: Battle War Squad - Cash Injection
WWII Airplane Fight: Battle War Squad - Master
Sprout Valley: Spray Paint
description: Make your dream of settling on an island and growing a beautiful garden come true. Your garden will produce many products you can sell and earn money. Remember to order unnecessary seeds, saplings and equipment to make your garden grow even bigger. Manage space on your island and pick the best place for your crops. Don’t forget to water them every day!

title: Unfair Rampage: Knightfall
description: Fast-paced 2.5D platformer! Blast through a destructible medieval world. You've been sent back in time to correct a twisted space-time continuum - battle knights and archers, dodge hazards, carve your path, and race against the crumbling world behind you. Easy to learn - hard to master!

title: Clutter 2: He Said She Said
description: The second entry in the Clutter series, following up the story of the original and introducing Leon's wife, Ana and their story.

title: The Factory Must Grow
description: The Factory Must Grow is a 3D first-person factory builder where you mine resources, craft machines, and research technology. Begin by unlocking your first technology, then expand into a sprawling, multi-layered production empire. From small setups to massive systems, your imagination is the only limit!

title: Elixir Emporium
description:
Unleash your creativity in a world of infinite crafting and endless adventure.

Engage with dynamic NPCs, create unique items, and explore a truly responsive, magical world where every choice shapes your journey in a myriad of ways.

New game data generates as you play based on the actions you take, so you'll never run out of new things to discover.

title: The Pauser
description: "The Pauser" is a narrative adventure game, developed by a student who drop out to make games. Player can stack blocks or "pause" them mid-air to help the character pass levels.You can choose to watch "ads" to "speedrun" the game. But, is that really what you want? It all depends on you!

title: High Spirits
description: Drink potions while you banish ancient spirits and recover your memories of the night before. In this roguelite you'll recruit dysfunctional companions, collect strange ingredients, and concoct wicked brews.

title: Too Tired To Die
description: Too Tired To Die is a fast-paced survivorlike multiplayer online PVP game. Seeking help from others is better than seeking help from yourself, the amnesiac ones must face all kinds of demons and monsters, and dive into the pile of couriers to retrieve his own share of soul.

title: Reign of Guilds: Commoner
description: Continue your journey throughout Dwarrhan with more possibilities!

title: The Depths of Despair
description: Get ready to unleash your inner warrior as you battle goblins, demons, orcs, and more in a thrilling souls-like adventure. Your quest is to help an angel named Amelia find her sister, who has been captured by demonic entities.

title: HSS: Reload
description: This is a very fast God's perspective roguelike shooter, the player will pilot the mech, explore the alien frontier, enjoy the "Crimsonland + Vampire Survivors" endless killing!

title: The Icarus Experiment
description: Plumb the depths of a doomed leviathan on a mission to save a dying solar system. Unravel a mystery that could alter the fate of humanity. Created with Adventure Forge, this showcases the power of the no-code tool that lets you craft your own narrative-rich experiences.

title: Deckception
description: Deckception is a rouge-like deck builder with local co-op allowing for 1-2 players to conquer the endless floors. The game has one player using the keyboard which can control the cards in the game while the other player controls the mouse which can control the dice. How far can you make it?

title: PlayCOQ: The Coop Defender
description: Prove your COQ's might in epic battles to save the coop from numerous foes!

title: Bartolomeo, Misled by Circumstances, Learns that Appearances can be Deceptive
description: Bartolomeo has always dreamed of meeting his favourite poet. Could the man wounded in his house be him?

title: Hope: A Sky Full of Ghosts
description:
In this narrative-driven, sci-fi point and click adventure, unravel the secrets of a stolen spaceship and your enigmatic crew. A new future away from corporate tyranny awaits. As captain, your choices matter and forging your crew's connections, even more so. Flying free has a cost.

Will you pay it?

title: Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii
description:
A new legend begins as you step into the steel toe boots of Goro Majima, a man who has lost his memory and reinvents himself as a pirate on the open sea.

Embark on an over-the-top, modern-day pirate adventure with an ex-yakuza, now pirate captain and his crew as they engage in exhilarating combat on land and sea in the hunt for lost memories and a legendary treasure.

title: Bring Me...
description:
Bring me... is a first-person anomaly-horror game.
Play as a young woman who has been caring for her sick father and has been trapped in an anomalous cycle.
Observe your surroundings for anomalies to find your way out of this nightmare.

title: Star Wars: Hunters - Season 2: Empire Resurgent
description: Prepare for an epic new Season of Star Wars: Hunters, 'Empire Resurgent’. Imposing Imperial security droid K-A0S storms into the Arena, ready to unleash her powerful Tank-class abilities. Season 2 also introduces a thrilling new battlefield inspired by Darth Vader’s iconic castle, plus an all-new Arena Pass with cosmetics, stickers and more to be unlocked.

title: Decidit
description: Decidit is a fast FPS roguelike in which you must use all the arsenal and movement abilities at your disposal in order to progress in an unstable demonic maze. Be fast, precise but also strategic using all the demonic weapons and abilities collected on the way to create powerful synergies.

title: Kavernum
description: Winston Bradley is an amateur explorer who is always looking for new adventures. His latest destination is a cave in Algeria, which is known for it famous cave paintings. But the further he goes into the cave, the more he realizes that something is wrong with it.

title: Terracrest
description: A data retrieval mission down in the evacuated Mine 41-A. This is a short experiance that can be beaten within an hour.

title: Escape From Island
description: After a helicopter crash on a mysterious island, your mission is to survive and escape before the island's dark forces consume you. Explore, gather resources, and face dangerous enemies as you navigate the island's open world. Can you escape before it's too late?

title: Kanade
description: A visual novel about becoming lovers with Kanade—a half-human, half-alien girl. Enjoy a tender relationship with Kanade and witness how love blossoms into a song that saves the world.

title: Cocoro
description: "Please make me human." A visual novel about a robot longing to become "human" in a world torn apart by rampaging AI. An unforgettable summer unfolds between a boy who has nowhere to call home and a humanoid girl who dreams of marriage...

title: Dark Light: Survivor
description: In a dying multiverse, the Phantom Train is your last hope. Traverse a post-apocalyptic, cyberpunk world of nightmarish creatures. Experience dynamic shifts between top-down and third-person views, deep customization, and epic battles across universes in this action roguelike survival game.

title: Wuthering Waves: To the Shore's End
description:
Version 1.3 of Wuthering Waves, which included:
• New characters: Shorekeeper and Youhu
• New main story quest: Chapter 1 Act 8
• New companion story for Encore: Small Wooly, Big Adventures
• New echoes, events and more!

title: Sonic Mania & Sonic Plus
description:
Sonic Mania and Sonic PLUS is a complete overhaul of Sonic Mania and its DLC:

- Every character has been turned into Sonic, while still retaining their original moves and some even receiving their own unique custom sprites!
- Every badnik and Object been turned into Sonic.
- Every stage's color palette has been edited to Sonic's colors. Sonic might even appear in the background occasionally, so keep your eyes peeled!
- Some music tracks have been remixed to include various vocal themes from the Sonic franchise (Usually Sonic's theme).
- Special Encore palettes for the levels that still relate to the Sonic theme while being different to the original in some fashion. (For example, Chemical Plant in Mania mode uses Sonic's Mania palette, while in Encore Mode it uses his Sonic 2 Palette.)
- Special Stages are not way past cooler with the addition of 5 million Sonic models on the screen!
- A very special ending for those who manage to make it all the way to the end of Encore Mode!
- ...and tons of other secrets and easter eggs to find!

title: Rocket Brown 2
description: In Rocket Brown 2, Rocket Brown must punch his way through Angel City to defeat the Red Mavericks gang, while simultaneously investigating an Alien Invasion!

title: Meanings: Hidden in Plain Sight
description: Meanings hidden in plain sight is an captivating word-guessing game where quick wit and sharp observation skills are your greatest assets. Look at an image, think quick, find the hidden meanings and grab the points for solving them!

title: Sonic the Hedgehog Pangoture
description: A Sonic and Pangolin Love crossover game.

title: Sonic 1 8-bit Redux
description: A game which intends to remake Sonic 1 for the Game Gear with Mania extra features such as a time attack mode, 16:9 aspect ratio, multiple different customisable art styles and multiple playable characters.

title: Sonic Recharged
description: Join Sonic on a solo mission to defeat Doctor Robotnik as he tries to exploit the resources and populace of Jade Island in his bid for world domination! Stop Robotnik and find the chaos emeralds.

title: Sally.EXE: Discovery
description: Sally.EXE: Discovery is a sequel to the bad ending of Sonic.EXE: The Beginning.

title: Haunted Starbase
description: 'Haunted Starbase' is a single tech-base level for Doom 2 that makes use of OTEX and a cool pallete swap from AshtralFiend. It also draws some inspiration from 'Suspended in Dusk'.

title: Type & Hope!!
description:
Type & Hope!! is a typing game created by Segawa.

Theodore is an apprentice wizard who has to take lessons from multiple teachers who will be able to teach some skills and abilities in order to reach his goal.

Type & Hope!! is an adventure game made on RPGMaker 2000 that has been released the 21st of April 2022 by Segawa.

title: Closed Faith
description:
Closed Faith is a freeware Strategy RPG made by Segawa. It was released the 28th of May 2023.

After being sealed away for 200 years, the God of Wisdom, Abyssliese, wakes up. They meet their loyal and only remaining priest, Theseus.

The reason why Abyssliese and many other gods were sealed away was because of a recent god named Tinirese. With his powers, he made himself the only god to be believed in.

Wanting to stop him, Abyssliese will try to get out of their temple with Theseus, but it will be a long and difficult task, even with the help of the many characters the duo will come across.

title: In My Head
description: You have been sent photographs of a place where, according to rumors, an artifact of an ancient civilization is hidden... Do you dare to go there?!

title: Armed Decobot
description: Armed Decobot is a unique blend of Beat 'Em Up and Bullet Hell Shoot 'Em Up mechanics inspired by Treasure and Metal Slug. It seamlessly combines the crowd control & throw heavy melee combat of Beat 'Em Ups with the intense dodge & shoot gameplay of Shmups. It's fast paced, it's difficult, it's chaotic, it's a pure unbound arcade action game! A quick burst of adrenaline to start the day!

title: Secret Agent Clank
description:
A port of Secret Agent Clank, a platform video game developed by High Impact Games and published by Sony Computer Entertainment, released for the PlayStation Portable (PSP) in 2008.

In the game, Clank dons his "Secret Agent Clank" persona, which was previously seen in brief TV show segments within the main series. The story revolves around Clank working to clear Ratchet's name after Ratchet is framed for a crime he did not commit. The gameplay diverges from the traditional Ratchet & Clank format, focusing more on stealth and gadget-based play, though it retains the series' trademark humour and style.

The port is enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Timore Narhelma
description: Timore Narhelma is a surreal experience about human mind and horrors within.

title: Ominous Recall
description: Ominous Recall: A chilling survival horror game set in a photorealistic Middle East. Confront a terrifying Jinn possessing Stephen and unravel its dark power in this intense psychological thriller.

title: Aldian of Ancients
description: Aldian of Ancients is a dinosaur multiplayer simulation/survival game aims to recreate the world of yore filled with creatures that defy comprehension.

title: Dashy Crashy 100
description: Start your engines and outrun 99 racers in a thrilling knockout race. 100 start. Only 1 survives. Lightning-fast reaction-racing with a 100-racer twist. Party up with friends, master simple tap controls and test your reflexes on choas-filled highways as you try to boost and bash your way to 1st place. Let's DASHY CRASHY!

title: Boonka
description: Once upon a time, flora and trees covered the peaceful countryside of a distant and beautiful world. To restore this once idyllic land to its former glory, you'll need to subdivide into various little nature spirits called Boonkas and work to heal the land. Boonka includes 3 different game modes designed for every kind of player. Restore the land to its once tranquil way of life in Adventure Mode, put your reflexes to the test in Blitz Mode, or take your time playing Beanstalk Mode. With over 60 fast-paced levels, 15 powerful, level-changing power-ups and bonuses, and truly addictive gameplay, Boonka has something for everyone!

title: Dream in the Shell
description:
When a black sphere appears on Earth, countless people become trapped in endless dreams. The protagonist's wife is among them, compelling him to venture into the dangerous sphere to save her.

'Dream in the Shell' is a story adventure game that explores surreal worlds where dreams, memories, and the subconscious blend. Explore mysterious spaces through unique interactions and uncover the truth.

title: Pia
description: "You have stepped on a landmine. How will you handle it?" This game challenges you to disarm a landmine using a multi-key input system, simulating the tough situation. By aligning the character's situation with the player's actions, it offers a unique experience. Using a pedal controller enhances the realism. Can you successfully disarm the landmine and survive?

title: Mecha Macho
description: Mecha Macho is an action/platform video game, in which you play as Luchin, a 3-year-old baby that is the reincarnation of the legendary wrestling champion "El Super Macho". You will travel through the universe in your robot suit to avenge his death, and recover his champion belt using wrestling techniques and powers, that you start to remember as you make your way through the game

title: Seeking Cat
description: In "Seeking Cat," explore a cozy, cluttered room filled with cleverly hidden cats. Can you uncover all the hidden cats and become the ultimate cat finder?

title: Bally Fears: The Introduction Game
description: You are a child named Reyes Spherikaw. Your mother passed away a few days ago, but Reyes doesn't know this yet. Your father has brought you to his workplace because there was no one to look after you. The game begins when your father calls you to warn you about something...

title: Devious Path
description: You are trapped in an endless astral world. Keep a close eye on your surroundings to get out of the astral world.

title: Battlefield 6
description:
Battlefield 6 is a first-person shooter featuring a single-player campaign and team-based online multiplayer. Players fight as infantry or operate military vehicles across large-scale battlefields, using class-based squad roles, environmental destruction, and a range of weapons and equipment.

The game also includes Battlefield Portal, a toolset for creating and sharing custom multiplayer experiences.

title: Recesses
description: Unravel the mystery of your missing 5th grade friend in Recesses, a schoolyard roguelite card battler. Collect rare cards and construct a spaceship that outplays even the most powerful Battaliens cards printed.

title: Reflector Satellites
description: In Reflector Satellites, you play as a space defender fighting off an endless number of enemy ships. Your opponents are ships of three colors: red, blue and yellow. Use mirrors to redirect your shots and destroy enemies more effectively.

title: Typingcommand
description: In Typingcommand, you have to defend the Earth from a continuous stream of asteroids. Asteroids fall from the sky, threatening to destroy everything in their path. Your task is to destroy asteroids before they reach the surface of the planet.

title: Tiny Starfighters
description: Embark on an exciting space adventure where you take control of a spaceship and battle endless waves of enemies across the galaxy. Collect coins as you blast through your foes and unlock new, powerful ships to enhance your journey. With every wave, the challenge intensifies—how long can you survive the cosmic chaos? Prepare to gear up and zap your way to victory!

title: TimeSplitters 2
description: TimeSplitters 2 returns, surpassing its predecessor with a larger-than-life experience. This sequel expands on every front, offering faster-paced action, richer storytelling, and diverse graphical styles across nine thrilling time-traveling adventures. From the lawless Wild West to the neon-lit streets of Neo Tokyo, each era boasts its own atmosphere and challenges.

title: TimeSplitters
description:
TimeSplitters is a renowned first-person shooter series that plunges players into an epic battle against the malevolent TimeSplitters, a race dwelling outside of time and space. Awakened from an ancient sleep, these entities tear through time's fabric to erase humanity from history. Players must unite against this common enemy or face a grim future under their shadow.

The game features a rich single-player campaign, taking players through pivotal historical moments, from ancient civilisations to futuristic landscapes, battling the TimeSplitters to alter history's course. Each era is meticulously crafted, providing an immersive experience with dynamic settings and intense action.

title: TimeSplitters: Future Perfect
description:
TimeSplitters: Future Perfect is the pinnacle of the acclaimed series, blending action, humor, and intricate storytelling. Play as Sergeant Cortez, embarking on a time-bending journey across past, present, and future to thwart the sinister TimeSplitters. Explore diverse environments from ancient temples to futuristic cities, each with unique challenges and visual splendor.

The single-player campaign is a blend of action and witty dialogue, unfolding through epic battles, puzzles, and animated cut-scenes that bring to life quirky allies and formidable adversaries. The narrative is cinematic and rich, revealing mysteries behind the TimeSplitters' plans with depth and flair.

title: Beyond Border
description: Help Aki the alligator find his way home in Beyond Border! Navigate through four challenging stages – from the mysterious Forest to the spooky Cemetery. Each stage brings new enemies and obstacles, such as sticky slimes and giant spiders, that will test your survival skills.

title: The Jumping Burger Rush
description:
From the creative minds at The Jumping Food Games comes a fast-paced endless game that will put your reflexes to the test: "The Jumping Burger Rush". In this neon-colored adventure, you control a jumping burger through the vastness of the galaxy and try to push your high score higher and higher. The adrenaline-pumping gameplay will test your reflexes in a fast and challenging endless game where you have to maneuver your burger through a dangerous, neon-lit galaxy.

Endless challenges await as you dodge obstacles, overcome tricky passages, and collect points to beat your own high score over and over again. Can you manage to break your personal record time and time again, dominating the leaderboard and proving your skill by outding yourself? Jump, dodge, and maneuver your burger through the infinite galaxy, mastering the unstoppable pace to beat your high score.

title: Super Mario Kart in Sonic Mania+
Planet Oio
description: Planet Oio is a game where you play as the Enerbeing, Oio. You must save the planet from evil bucket-like robots!

title: Areena 4
description: Gladiator manager game, with goal to win the Riimukallio championship. Matches are turn-based. Gladiators can be equipped with weapons and spells, and their skills improve over time.

title: Painkiller: Special Edition
description:
A very specific release of Painkiller that only contains 12 levels.
Crank up the intesity as you blast your way through 12 levels of mayhem and more than 75 species of Hell's wildest incarnations. Experience frantic action and wicked weapons: fire your stakegun and pin you enemies to the walls, or lob a grenade to send them flying!

title: Kreton La Resistance
description: Save the Moles from prison and escape from the 19th century!

title: Gnomes and Knights
description: Gnome hunting reaches a new level! Become a mighty knight and plunge into the world of dark fantasy without leaving your home.

title: Body Cam Shooter
description: Feel the thrill of real combat, a shooter like no other!

title: Wild Hunter: Sniper Rifle Adventures Simulator
description: Track your prey. Feel the suspense. Become a legendary hunter!

title: Viking City Tycoon
description: Build, raid, conquer – lead your Viking empire to glory!

title: MX Dirt Bike: Unlimited Bike Experience
Learn to Play Vol. 7: Safe Journey
Dinosaur RPG: Dino Survival Simulator Survivor
description: Survive the Past! Unleash prehistoric power evolve, explore, conquer!

title: Survival Float Simulator: Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build
description: Survive on the Raft Conquer the Swamp, Beware the Crocodile

title: SkyGunner
description: Experience SkyGunner originally released on the PlayStation 2 console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Mister Mosquito
description:
Experience Mister Mosquito originally released on the PlayStation2 console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

You are Mister Mosquito, an uninvited guest in the Yamada’s family home. You will need to drink as much of their blood as possible to survive the winter. They know you are in the house, and they plan to take you out.

title: Daisuki: The Her Adonis
description:
You are the class president.
You are a human being with a strong sense of justice.
While investigating the case of a missing classmate, you came across a girl.
You are going to visit her house to talk to the girl.

title: Exista!
description: EXISTA! offers a journey of a child through intriguing challenges and obstacles. In the role of the child, you must overcome obstacles using your natural abilities. As you progress, new skills are acquired, enabling you to face increasingly complex challenges.

title: Sinesperia
description: A polyperspectival story where you explore the memories of those you start to remember, uncovering the mystery of your existence.

title: 60 Seconds to Escape
description: You are trapped in an escape room, the timer is counting down, you only have one minute to escape the room ! Find clues and note them down, the room resets but not the note pad ! Keep it up, I have faith in you !

title: Starveil Protocol A.A.A.
description: STARVEIL PROTOCOL A.A.A. is a text-based role-playing game inspired by PC-98 era Japanese text adventures. In this chaotic and dangerous dystopian cyberpunk world, players must overcome challenges through dice rolls and their character's skills, like in tabletop role-playing games.

title: The Dark Phantom: Dawn of Darkness
description:
The Dark Phantom is a 3D third person shooter powered by UDK technology with emphasis on covering and dynamic gun fights. The player will play in the role of Shabgard, a man robbed of his past, seeking light in the darkness.

The game features advanced A.I. that not only take advantage of covers but also work cooperatively to force player out of cover to make the gameplay dynamic and keep player on his toes.

title: World of Squares
description: A feel-good MMO with rich mechanics. Paint with your friends, play a cube violin in the woods, discover an ancient ruins, fight valiant knights and dangerous mobs, become a fox sacrificing yourself to a dangerous altar at midnight, chill with a fishing rhythm game, upgrade your gear and character.

title: Funeralopolis: Last Days
description:
The city of Huta-Grobno hasn't seen sunlight in months after strange clouds enveloped the skies above it. Something’s brewing in the air… and underneath the surface.

This is a story oriented and text heavy game with a linear structure, featuring light horror elements.

title: Nostalgia Zero
description: Nostalgia Zero is a set of 36 maps in CL3 for The Ultimate Doom. This WAD uses exclusively vanilla textures and vanilla limits, with the target source port being Chocolate Doom. In terms of gameplay and level design it’s much closer to the IWAD than either of the Nostalgia WADs, though it does sometimes dip it’s toes into more modern tropes.

title: Astral Globetrot
description: A vanilla-compatible 32-map MegaWAD themed around space travel. After MAP11, there are four more episodes with radically different visual iden﻿tities that add new textures, and each map at least indirectly leads into the next one.

title: Heaven's Cybernetic (De)Athlete: Zeug
description:
"RUN LEAP GRIND AND MOST IMPORTANTLY ]]KILL

*A DEVASTATING MINDHACK. A BROKEN SIMULATION. REALITY SEEPING WITH BUGS AND GLITCHES. POWER THROUGH.*"

A browser-based death tournament DOOMlike made for DOMINO CLUB's Bodies in Motion Jam.

title: Children of Hell
description: You've been called in for a mandatory general examination. You don't know what to expect. A visual novel about immortal monster hunters used by the government.

title: The Jimi Hendrix Case
description: Enter the world of Jimi Hendrix, police detective. In a world where everyone is Jimi Hendrix, only Jimi Hendrix can piece together clues and find out who killed Jimi Hendrix. Created for MAGS July, 2015.

title: FIFA World Cup 2022
description: Compete as one of the 32 qualified teams in a complete solo recreation of the FIFA World Cup 2022, either playing from the opening match or customizing your tournament experience by changing groups and including teams that didn’t qualify for the FIFA World Cup finals in a Custom Tournament. In Online Tournament Mode, progress through the knockout stages with any of the 32 qualified countries, and go for FIFA World Cup glory against others from around the world.

title: FIFA Women’s World Cup 2023
description: Experience the FIFA Women’s World Cup in a variety of ways in FIFA 23. Step onto the pitch and lead your country as a soccer star with your own custom player. You can also compete in the tournament in Solo Tournament Mode or Kick-Off Mode.

title: Sonic Island: Lost Paradise
description: A fangame about another Sonic's adventure. Being a "Sonic Island" duology reimagining.

title: 2018 FIFA World Cup Russia
description: Immerse yourself in the excitement and drama of football’s greatest event with an authentic tournament experience, featuring official FIFA World Cup elements. Play with all 32 qualified national teams, using the official match balls, in real-world stadiums, and compete for the iconic trophy – all rendered in stunning detail for the first time with the Frostbite game engine.

title: Sick Samurai
description: Sick Samurai is a blindingly fast and bloody action game based on instant-death combat. Immerse yourself in lofi hip hop and retro anime aesthetics as you slash and dash your way to becoming the greatest fighter on the island.

title: Pocket Souls
description: New weapons, armour, items, boss battles, trainer battles and mechanics. Capture creatures from the world of DS3 and use them to vanquish your foes.

title: Snø: Ultimate Freeriding
description: Snø is a raw, fast paced and challenging, yet minimalistic game about freeriding. Experience beautiful mountains inspired by Scandinavian nature and score points by doing risky moves like grinding on rocks, jumping off tree trunks and fly close to the treetops using your speedglider.

title: UEFA Euro 2024
description: The squads are set, and the competition is ready — including you. Lead your team against the best and chase international glory as Europe’s greatest teams compete for the UEFA EURO 2024 title. Feel the excitement and unpredictability of this iconic tournament, and make your mark on football history. The full UEFA EURO 2024 experience arrives in EA SPORTS FC 24 as a post-launch update, at no extra cost.

title: Bullet Noir
description: In the vengeance business, you leave no loose ends. Four characters scour the city, searching for their mentor's murderer in a brutal ballet of bullets. Stylish neo-noir top-down shooter with one-hit-one-kill mechanics.

title: Primordialis
description: Primordialis is a physics-based roguelike fish builder. Unleash your creativity to defeat creatures using venomous tentacles, electrical shocks, or exploding children. The possibilities are endless. Explore the primordial depths to reveal its secrets and discover what lies beyond.

title: Periculum
description: Periculum is a casual strategy game about conquering hexagonal tiles. Engage in battles against up to 7 bots or challenge your friends to see who comes out on top. With plenty of different game modes and options.

title: Firebat: Revolution
description: Break every brick in this retro pixel art adventure!

title: Doll Dress Up
description: Become the best doll stylist and make a fabulous princess!

title: Turbo Boost Racing
description: Turbo Boost Racing is a fun, fast-paced arcade style driving game with 4 exciting game modes!

title: Penguin Detectives: Crash Patrol
description: In this visual novel, a group of penguins embark on an adventure on the ice, making friends and solving challenges.

title: Parkour Bullet Frenzy: FPS, Physics, Slowmotion
description: Navigate deadly traps and ruthless foes in a high-tech labyrinth of speed and precision.

title: Jalecolle Famicom Ver. Bio Warrior Dan: The Increaser War
description: JALECOlle Famicom Ver. continues with back-to-back releases of Jaleco's Famicom titles! The third installment is Bio Warrior DAN The Increaser War!

title: Restaurant Cooking Simulator
description: Manage your restaurant in Restaurant Cooking Simulator! Customize your kitchen, cook tasty dishes, serve customers quickly, and upgrade your equipment to grow your business!

title: Lets Castle
description: Build your castle and become a knight!

title: The Lady, The Mage, & The Knight
description: Developed by Larian Studios, a tech demo was released at E3 2000 of the cancelled isometric RPG and later released as part of GOG's Divinity campaign. Gameplay focused heavily on the individual talents of these three protagonists, and puzzles, pitfalls and all kinds of tricky situations were solved by cleverly using their unique abilities.

title: Skater's Solstice
description: Become a master of the ice by skating your way through increasingly challenging sliding puzzles!

title: Backrooms Horror Escape
description: Are you ready to face your fears?

title: Cyberpunk Hacker
description: Are you ready to disrupt the cybernetic order and unveil the secrets at the heart of the neon-drenched horizon?

title: Cazzarion: Drone Flight
description: Fly through gates in a landscape with a drone and increase your high score

title: Cursed Ones
description:
Cursed Ones is a 1-2 player co-op horror survival game.
Play as the Crane siblings as you continue your late parents' legacy to purge the world of sinister spirits.
Track down the items used to summon the spirit by any means necessary.

Make sure you both don't die in the process.

title: Barbuta
description:
Explore the castle but watch out for traps!

Game available on UFO 50.

title: Bug Hunter
description:
The moon quarry has a bug problem and you've been hired to fix it.

Game available on UFO 50.

title: Cidadão de SP Simulator
description: Adapted from Molleindustria's The New York Times Simulator, Cidadão de SP Simulator is a newspaper simulator where you assume the role of a newly hired editor. To keep your job, you have to make three layers of society happy: The rich, Israel and the police.

title: Ninpek
description:
It's Ninja time! Run and jump to reach the end of the world.

Game available on UFO 50.

title: Paint Chase
description:
Rev your engines and color your way to victory in the local paint racing competition.

Game available on UFO 50.

title: Office Overloaded
description: Type quickly to process incoming documents without burning out. Sharpen your skills, climb up the ranks and challenge your coworkers around the globe. Can you stay cool under pressure and become the next CEO?

title: Dreams of Joy Departed
description: A surreal RPG. A tragedy with turn based combat and a hidden morality system.

title: Mysteries of Perception
description:
Mysteries of Perception is a detective game where you will see the same scene through the eyes of different characters. Uncover their secrets by analyzing all the clues. Switch perspectives and learn everything about the artifacts of the Distant and the deaths in their wake. Glory to the Stars!

Mysteries of Perception is a 2D investigative game structured like a choral narrative where you can jump from one character's perspective to another during the investigation. To gather more clues and progress in your investigation, it will be necessary to collect information from all viewpoints and confront them to reach plausible conclusions. Confirm your theories by consulting the stars. Jump from a past to a future perspective and discover every facet of the mysterious deaths that will be presented to you.

Dive into this dystopian universe with desaturated colors and solve the mysteries that govern the world. Perhaps you will uncover the mystery of your own death...

title: Mörk Borg Heresy Supreme
description: Mörk Borg Heresy Supreme is a doom-metal action RPG set in the world of Mörk Borg. Wretched antiheroes explore a side-scrolling, semi-procedural grimdark fantasy world, searching for a way to prevent the apocalypse or make the suffering worse.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog RPG: Entropy
description: The first episode in the Sonic the Hedgehog RPG series.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog RPG: In The Belly of The Beast
description: The second episode in the Sonic the Hedgehog RPG series.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog RPG: Return to Iron Lock
description: Sonic the Hedgehog RPG: Return To Iron Lock is the third episode of the Sonic the Hedgehog RPG (e.g. SatAM RPG) series, whose first episode debuted at SAGE 2020

title: Light Switch Simulator
description: Light Switch Simulator is a casual, massively multiplayer simulation game where players engage in the ancient battle between light and dark. Players can choose from three factions, unlock light switches, and compete or collaborate online in an MMORPG environment. The game emphasizes simple mechanics of turning lights on and off, with options for single-player or multiplayer modes. Special features include private rooms, cross-platform multiplayer, and Steam achievements.

title: Inazuma Eleven Re
description: The story that started Inazuma Eleven will be revived in a remake!

title: Holy Horror Mansion
